The film won the Emerging International Filmmaker Award at the Hot Docs Canadian International Documentary Festival 2024.
title:YURIE: This drama depicts a chef with communication difficulties and a free-spirited Korean woman who comes to learn Japanese cuisine. As they repeatedly try to revitalize the restaurant, they gradually break free from their rigid values. It is the feature-length debut of director Harumi Ikemoto, whose short film 'The Hunt' won the Excellence Award in the short film category at the 2023 SKIP City International D-Cinema Festival. Three years after losing his father, George Uehara took over the restaurant 'Yurie.' Although his cooking skills are solid, he is forced to accept the reality that the restaurant has recently seen fewer customers. Then Kim Juri, who came to Japan from Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, appears and starts working part-time at the restaurant. Despite clashing due to their differing values, they gradually grow closer and try various ideas to boost the restaurant's business. Sho Aoyagi, a member of 'Gekidan EXILE' active in films and dramas, plays George, a chef who struggles to express his thoughts and feelings and has some communication difficulties. Yeon-su Ha, who moved her base of operations from Korea to Japan and appeared in the NHK morning drama 'The Tiger's Wing,' plays Kim Juri, the part-time worker who initially keeps her distance from George due to her free-spirited nature. Yusuke Mikawa, known for 'Cloud,' co-stars as Iwakura, another part-time employee who watches over the two.
title:Yamaguchi-kun Isn't So Bad: A youth romance live-action film adaptation of the shōjo manga of the same name by Yu Saiki, serialized in Kodansha's 'Bessatsu Friend,' starring Kyōhei Takahashi of the idol group 'Naniwa Danshi.' It depicts the romantic journey of Satsuki, an ordinary high school girl who dreams of love, and Yamaguchi-kun, a transfer student with a scary-looking face and a Kansai dialect. Yamaguchi-kun, who transfers to Satsuki's school, has blonde hair and piercings, giving him a menacing look, and rumors circulate that he's a yakuza. After a certain incident brings her close to Yamaguchi-kun, Satsuki learns about his shy and kind true nature and gradually becomes drawn to him. Satsuki tries to keep Yamaguchi-kun's hidden charms all to herself, but a handsome classmate, Ishizaki, who inexplicably has a grudge against Yamaguchi-kun, stands in her way. It turns out Ishizaki also harbors special feelings for Yamaguchi-kun, suddenly emerging as Satsuki's romantic rival. The love triangle of these three takes an unexpected turn. Kyōhei Takahashi plays Yamaguchi-kun, who has a kind and pure heart beneath his scary appearance; Hikaru Takahashi ('Romantic Killer') plays the heroine Satsuki, who grows close to Yamaguchi-kun; and Yōji Iwase ('The Girl and the Guard Dog') plays Ishizaki, the classmate who stirs up trouble between Yamaguchi-kun and Satsuki. The film is directed by Kentarō Moriya ('PRINCE OF LEGEND,' 'Seaside Motel').
title:Yi Yi: A family drama by Edward Yang, the master of Taiwanese New Cinema known for 'A Brighter Summer Day' and 'The Terrorizers,' which quietly observes the life changes that befall each member of a five-person family living in Taipei. Yang won the Best Director award at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival in 2000 for this film. Elementary school student Yang-yang lives a comfortable life in a luxury apartment with his father NJ, who runs a computer company, his mother Min-min, his high school sister Ting-ting, and his gentle grandmother. They seem like a picture-perfect happy family, but troubles begin after the wedding of the mother's younger brother. The grandmother falls into a coma from a stroke, the father is shaken by a reunion with his first love, and the mother seeks solace in a new religion. To save his company from bankruptcy, the father travels to Japan to secure a contract with a genius game designer named Ota. Meanwhile, the sister starts dating the boyfriend of her neighbor Li-li... Issey Ogata appears as the game designer Ota. As director Yang passed away in 2007, this became his final completed feature film. A 4K restoration was screened as the opening film of the Cannes Classics section at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.
title:You Are the Film: A youth comedy directed by Makoto Ueda, head of the theater group "Europe Kikaku," known for writing screenplays for numerous hit films like "Summer Time Machine Blues" and "River, Don't Flow On." This is his feature directorial debut, set in the real-life building "Shelbo Shimokitazawa" in Shimokitazawa, employing innovative gimmicks. At the cinema Tollywood on the second floor of "Shelbo Shimokitazawa," Madoka, a playwright from Shimokitazawa, and Kazuma, a band musician from Sangenjaya, each go to see a movie. An impossible structure emerges where each other's events are projected onto the screen as a film. Meanwhile, problems arise at the shops adjacent to the cinema, "Good Heavens" and "Mikazuki Rock." Madoka and Kazuma try to solve the problems using this structure, but their films influence each other, and the situation spirals in unexpected directions. Starring Maria Ito ("Summer Film ni Notte") as Madoka the playwright and Kai Inowaki ("Musicophilia") as Kazuma the band musician. The cast also includes Oshiro Maeda and Hinako Kikuchi as members of Madoka's theater troupe, Suzuyuki Kaneko and Yusuke Mikawa as members of Kazuma's band, Takafumi Imai as a semi-delinquent who frequents "Mikazuki Rock," and the comedy duo "The Geese" as a pair of detectives. Additionally, members of Europe Kikaku, including Gota Ishida, Shintaro Kanamaru, and Riko Fujitani, play unique characters.
title:You Can Succeed, Too: The pinnacle of Japanese musicals, depicting a salaryman struggling in the battle for foreign tourists in Tokyo just before the Olympics. Throughout the film, talented performers sing and dance, and Frankie's astonishing physical abilities leave you in awe. The grand group dance in 'Man Alone' is especially breathtaking.
title:You, Fireworks, and Our Promise: A youth romance anime film adaptation of the novel of the same name by Madoroka. Set against the backdrop of the 'Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Display' in Nagaoka City, Niigata Prefecture, one of Japan's three major fireworks festivals that attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors annually, it depicts a promise that transcends time and a summer in the lives of high school students. One day shortly after entering high school, Makoto Natsume meets his classmate Akira Hayama. Since childhood, Akira has been told by her great-grandmother that she would 'one day meet Makoto Natsume,' and she holds a single painting of fireworks. As they investigate the secret of the painting, which Makoto has no memory of, the two discover the existence of 'a certain promise' made in the past. Eventually, the meaning of a fate connected across time becomes clear. The voice of the protagonist, Makoto, is played by Shōri Satō, a member of the popular group 'timelesz,' in his first lead role in an anime film. The heroine, Akira, is voiced by Nanoka Hara, known for playing the protagonist Suzume Iwato in 'Suzume.' The director is Kei Suzuki of the TV anime 'Tower of God.' The project is produced by Shin-Ei Animation, with animation production jointly handled by SynergySP and Answer Studio.
title:Young Mothers: An ensemble drama by Belgian masters Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne, known for "The Child" and "The Kid with a Bike," depicting five young mothers living in a mother-child support facility. The five girls—Jessica, Perla, Ariane, Julie, and Naima—live together in a facility that supports women who became pregnant young. Without anyone to rely on and facing various problems like poverty and violence, they become mothers while confused, troubled, and unable to find a model for the family they should aim for. Struggling not to be swallowed by the overwhelming loneliness, the girls who still wish "to love" sometimes lean on others and choose their own paths to follow. Lukas Dhont, director of "Close," is listed as a co-producer. Screened in the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025, it won the Best Screenplay Award and the Ecumenical Jury Prize.
Director Makoto Shinkai, known for delicately portraying the nuances of male-female emotions against beautiful landscapes in works like "The Place Promised in Our Early Days" and "5 Centimeters Per Second," delivers his first original feature in three years since "The Garden of Words." Character design by Masayoshi Tanaka of "Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day" fame, animation direction by Masashi Ando, known for his work on Studio Ghibli films like "Princess Mononoke" and "Spirited Away," and music including the theme song by popular rock band RADWIMPS. The film remained in the top 10 of domestic box office rankings for 29 consecutive weeks, achieving historic blockbuster success with over 25 billion yen in revenue. It won the Award for Best Screenplay at the 40th Japan Academy Prize, a first for an animated work. One month before a comet approaches for the first time in 1000 years, Mitsuha Miyamizu, a high school girl living in a mountainous rural town, dreams she is a male high school student in Tokyo. Mitsuha, who feels cramped by her small town and longs for the city, enjoys city life in her dream. Meanwhile, Taki Tachibana, a male high school student in Tokyo, dreams he is a high school girl in a mountain town he's never visited. As the body-swapping phenomenon continues and they become aware of each other, Taki and Mitsuha eventually discover an unexpected truth. Voice cast includes Ryunosuke Kamiki as Taki and Mone Kamishiraishi as Mitsuha, with Masami Nagasawa and Etsuko Ichihara among others.
title:Yuho No Border: A documentary tracing the journey and present life of Yuho Asaka, one of Japan's pioneers of peer counseling. Born in Fukushima City, Fukushima Prefecture in 1956, Yuho Asaka has a condition characterized by brittle bones. From a young age, she was forced to give up on learning and grew angry at a society that discriminates and excludes based on disability and gender. Always searching for her place in the world, Asaka connected with the cerebral palsy activist group "Fukushima Prefecture Aoi Shiba no Kai" and, drawing on the independent living movement and feminism she encountered while studying in the U.S., helped establish Japan's first independent living center. She also participated in international conferences and helped spark changes to the Eugenic Protection Law. The film follows Asaka's relentless pursuit of freedom, while also depicting her sister Aiko, who was caught in the turbulent relationship between their father and Yuho; her daughter Sora, who was born with the same condition and works at an overseas institute advocating for the rights of people with disabilities while attending graduate school; and the young caregivers who share daily life with her in a free-spirited relationship. Yumiko Asano, producer of "What Could Have Been?," makes her directorial debut, with Tomoaki Fujino, director of that same film, handling cinematography, editing, and production.
title:Zabriskie Point: Italian master Michelangelo Antonioni, who won top prizes at all three major film festivals (Berlin, Venice, Cannes) in the 1960s, made this film after moving to America in 1970. Set in Los Angeles and Death Valley, it depicts the psychological landscape of love between a man and a woman. In the late 1960s, amidst the peak of counterculture, with university protests raging and students clashing with armed police, Mark grows tired of futile debates at student gatherings. He grabs a gun and confronts the police officers cracking down on campus, but misses his chance to fire and flees. He then steals a Cessna at an airfield and takes to the sky. Meanwhile, Daria, a secretary at a Los Angeles real estate company, is driving across the vast desert to attend a meeting. The two meet by chance and arrive at Zabriskie Point, overlooking Death Valley... The leads are newcomers Mark Frechette and Daria Halprin, whom Antonioni scouted on the streets. The soundtrack effectively features music by Pink Floyd, Jerry Garcia of the Grateful Dead, Kaleidoscope, John Fahey, The Rolling Stones, and The Youngbloods. Released in Japan in 1970, it also had a late-show release in 1996. A revival release is scheduled for 2026, the first in 30 years.
title:Zakken! - The Cosmos Beneath Our F: A youth story based on the manga 'Zakken!' (published by Shogakukan), which was developed from a real club activity, the 'Weed Research Club,' at Tokyo Metropolitan Hibiya High School, by screenwriter and film director Naho Uemura and the scenario creation team 'Monogatari Lab,' with Uemura herself writing and directing the film adaptation. It delicately and freshly depicts a teenage girl lost and unsure of herself, who discovers her own identity through the weeds growing at her feet, which she had never paid attention to before. Spring of her first year of high school. Sugano Yukari, an ordinary girl who isn't passionate about anything and just goes through the motions, meets her classmate Tokuda Mimi, nicknamed 'Dokudami-chan,' who loves weeds and is fascinated by their vitality. Slightly eccentric but with a straightforward and pure heart, Yukari gradually opens up to her. Dokudami-chan dreams of reviving the 'Zakken,' or 'Weed Research Club,' and Yukari, while hesitant about her enthusiasm, begins activities with her aimed at reviving the club, but... Luna Nakajima, who has starred in films like 'A Town of Old Houses' and 'Tore!' and won the Japan Academy Prize for Newcomer for 'Tokyo Taxi,' plays Sugano Yukari, and Miyu Oshima, known for the NHK morning drama 'Omusubi' and the drama 'Bokutachi nchi,' plays Tokuda Mimi, taking on the lead roles.
title:a whisper／小さな祈り: A short film completed after a seven-year production period following director Takashi Miwa's previous work 'a whisper' released in 2017. Miwa, a filmmaker who is also an actor and taught himself stop-motion animation, infuses this work with his own despair and hope for the world, depicting those who continue to pray in a world where things are breaking and being lost, through uniquely original visuals. The film has won numerous awards at film festivals around the world, including Best Inspiration at the WSXA Amsterdam International Film Festival 2025 in the Netherlands and Best Animation in the Short Film category at the Austin International Art Festival 2024 in the USA.
title:aftersun アフターサン: A human drama that recounts a summer vacation spent with a father, 20 years later from the perspective of the daughter who has now reached the same age her father was then, as she discovers a new side of her father she never knew at the time. During the summer when she was 11, adolescent Sophie visits a rustic Turkish resort with her 31-year-old father Calum, from whom she lives apart. Under the blazing sun, they point a video camera Calum obtained at each other, spending intimate time together. 20 years later, Sophie, now the same age as Calum was then, looks back at the nostalgic footage shot at that time, reviving memories of her beloved father. Paul Mescal, who broke out with the TV drama "Normal People," plays the loving yet sensitive father Calum, earning a nomination for the 95th Academy Award for Best Actor. The role of Sophie is played by newcomer Frankie Corio, selected through auditions. The director and screenwriter is Scottish newcomer Charlotte Wells, making her feature-length debut with this film.
title:aftersun／アフターサン: A human drama that recounts a summer vacation spent with a father, 20 years later from the perspective of the daughter who has now reached the same age her father was then, as she discovers a new side of her father she never knew at the time. title:hinata: A mystery film directed and originally conceived by Yukihiko Tsutsumi, created with 20 up-and-coming actors. The original screenplay is by Yusuke Moriguchi ("Beautiful Dreamer," "Kohaku"), and the film depicts the funeral of a person named "Hinata Okimura," where the eulogies of 20 mourners contradict each other, deepening the mystery in an unpredictable narrative. Twenty men and women attend the funeral of Hinata Okimura. According to the deceased's wishes, all attendees are to read eulogies. Before an unnatural altar with no portrait, they begin to speak of their memories with the deceased—some as friends, some as obsessive fans, and some as fellow members of an idol group. However, conflicting images of "Hinata Okimura" emerge, differing not only in personality but even in gender, plunging the funeral into chaos. Alongside 20 emerging actors including Mami Abe, Maya Imaizumi, Sho Oizumi, Eriko Obe, Shuto Okumura, Marina Ozawa, Itsuki Kitamura, Taisei Kurokawa, Rio Shinkai, Shinya, Maina Jisha, Ryuto Tsunami, Tsuru, Rei Tomita, Megumi Nasuno, Kaka Shinke, Tetsumaru Hagio, Kanato Yamato, Miho Yoshihei, and Shoko Wakaki, Shiha Hiroyama, who has worked with director Tsutsumi on films like "truth: The End of the Wicked Mourning," appears as the funeral host. Additionally, Olympic gold medalist and professional figure skater Shizuka Arakawa plays Hinata Okimura, the key to the story.

title:the moment ザ・モーメント: A film conceived by global musician Charli XCX, who also stars, depicting the turbulent behind-the-scenes world of show business involving top stars and industry insiders. In 2024, pop star Charli XCX became a global sensation with her album "brat," sparking a social phenomenon called "Brat Summer" and becoming an icon of the era. Bold and unapologetic, she daily pursues her authentic self. However, her music label, manager, and social media handlers, using the slogan "Brat Summer Forever," try to forcibly prolong the movement, intervening in live performances and promotions with backing from Amazon, pushing Charli into a clichéd star image. Overwhelmed by her busy schedule, Charli escapes to Ibiza for a vacation just days before a live show, throwing the production into chaos. Directed by Aidan Zamiri, who has directed music videos for Billie Eilish and others. The cast includes Alexander Skarsgård, Rosanna Arquette, and Kylie Jenner.
title:the moment／ザ・モーメント: A film conceived by global musician Charli XCX, who also stars, depicting the turbulent behind-the-scenes world of show business involving top stars and industry insiders. title:À bout de souffle: Jean-Luc Godard's first feature-length directorial work. Produced with techniques that broke the conventions of theatrical cinema at the time, such as improvisational direction and handheld street shooting, it is a landmark film of the French New Wave that greatly influenced the later film industry. The original idea was by François Truffaut, and Claude Chabrol also participated as a technical advisor. Michel, a car thief who kills a policeman and flees to Paris, enjoys a free relationship with Patricia, an American student selling newspapers. To test Michel's love, Patricia informs the police of his whereabouts and tells Michel what she has done... A digitally remastered version with a new translation by Jiro Terao was released in 2016. In 2022, a 4K restored version created to commemorate the 60th anniversary of its release was shown. In 2026, a 4K restored version will be revived in conjunction with the release of Richard Linklater's film 'Nouvelle Vague,' which depicts the production process of 'Breathless.'
title:Ástin sem eftir er: In a small rural town in Iceland, artist Anna lives with her responsible eldest daughter Ida, her mischievous twin sons Grímur and Þorgils, and her dog Panda, while searching for her path as an artist. Though she married young and is supposedly "no longer a couple" with her ex-husband Magnús, he can't seem to cut ties, constantly finding excuses to visit, share meals, and even join picnics. Before she knows it, they slip back into a daily life as if they were "still a family"—but what comes next?
title:Éloge de l'amour: A drama by Jean-Luc Godard, the master who led the French New Wave, centered on the theme of 'love.' Edgar, a young artist in Paris, conceives a new work depicting four moments related to love—'encounter, passion, separation, reconciliation'—using three couples. The heroine Edgar considers ideal for this project is a woman he met two years ago. She is the granddaughter of an elderly couple who were once involved in the Resistance, whom Edgar met while researching the history of the Resistance in Brittany. Searching for her, Edgar revives his memories of Brittany two years ago. The first half depicts present events in richly shaded black-and-white 35mm film, while the second half shows protagonist Edgar's flashbacks in vivid color using digital video. The 4K restored version will be screened in Japan for the first time as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
title:Кин-дза-дза!: A deadpan sci-fi comedy made in Soviet-era Georgia in 1986, which became a huge hit in the USSR at the time. One day, a student named Gedevan asks construction engineer Mashkov for help, looking troubled, saying, 'There are some men over there who claim to be aliens.' Mashkov, who doesn't believe in aliens, presses a button on a space travel device the men were holding, and in the next instant, Mashkov and Gedevan are warped to the planet Pluke in the Kin-Dza-Dza Nebula, far from Earth. There, for some reason, Earth matches are extremely valuable, and the two try to use the value of matches to somehow return to Earth... Culturally popular in Japan as well, it was first introduced at the 'Soviet SF Film Festival' held in Tokyo in 1989, later released in a new print in 2001 and a digital remaster in August 2016. In May 2021, to coincide with the release of the animated version 'Ku! Kin-Dza-Dza,' the live-action film had its fourth theatrical release.
title:Солярис: When communication is lost with the space station Prometheus, which is exploring the ocean-and-cloud-covered planet Solaris, psychologist Kris is sent to investigate. Upon arriving at the Prometheus, Kris witnesses the suicide of a friend, traces of people who shouldn't be there, and a series of inexplicable phenomena caused by the sentient organic ocean.
title:جاده خاکی: A car races across the desolate landscape of Iran. In the back seat, the father entertains his exuberant younger son; in the passenger seat, the mother sways to an old pop song; and in the driver's seat, the eldest son stares silently ahead. While the younger son, unaware of the purpose of the trip, frolics innocently, the family arrives near the Turkish border...
title:جدایی نادر از سیمین: Nader is in divorce negotiations with his wife, who wants to leave Iran for the sake of their daughter. He hires a woman named Razieh to care for his father, who suffers from dementia and lives with him, but an unexpected incident sets off a chain of events... An exquisite drama that intertwines a mystery with Iran's divorce issues.
title:خانه‌ی دوست کجاست؟: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame. At a primary school in the village of Koker in northern Iran, Mohammad is severely scolded by his teacher for doing his homework on a piece of paper instead of a notebook and is told he will be expelled if it happens again. However, his best friend Ahmad, who sits next to him, accidentally takes Mohammad's notebook home. Panicked that Mohammad will be expelled without his notebook, Ahmad searches for his friend's house in a distant neighboring village to return it, but struggles to find it... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title:زندگی و دیگر هیچ: In 1990, a massive earthquake in northern Iran mercilessly struck the village where the 1987 film "Where Is the Friend's Home?" was shot, as well as its residents. After the earthquake, film director Kiarostami, accompanied by his son, heads to the disaster-stricken area to check on the safety of the two brothers who appeared in the film.
title:زیر درختان زیتون: A young couple who married a few days after the earthquake appeared in one scene of 'And Life Goes On.' However, the young man who played the husband had actually proposed to the woman playing the wife before and been rejected. When director Kiarostami learned of their past, he decided to make a film based on this episode.
title:صوت هند رجب: January 29, 2024. Based on the true tragedy the world watched from the sidelines—a soul-shaking true-life drama. On January 29, 2024, a volunteer team from the Palestinian humanitarian organization Palestine Red Crescent Society receives an emergency call. It is from Hind Rajab, a 6-year-old girl trapped in a car under gunfire in the Gaza Strip. The Red Crescent volunteer team keeps the line open with Rajab and exhausts every possible means to rescue her— Directed and written by acclaimed Tunisian filmmaker Kaouther Ben Hania, who continues to explore the boundary between fiction and documentary.
title:طعم گيلاس: Buddy, a middle-aged man, invites people into his car and makes a strange request: "Tomorrow morning, call out to me lying in a hole. If I answer, help me; if there's no answer, cover me with dirt." Everyone refuses, but the old man he finally picks up begins to tell him about the joy of living...
title:قضية الغرباء: An ensemble drama inspired by the reality that 14 million people were forced to flee abroad to escape the long devastation of the Syrian civil war, depicting families torn apart by conflict and those around them from multiple perspectives. Set across four countries—Syria, Turkey, Greece, and the United States—the story unfolds in five chapters, intersecting the lives of five families. As the civil war between government forces and rebel groups intensifies in Syria's dictatorship, Syrian doctor Amira decides to cross dangerous borders with her daughter to reach safety. Syrian border guard Mustafa distrusts the brutal government forces and struggles between being a soldier who follows orders and a human with a conscience. Turkish smuggler Marwan seeks to earn money by loading refugees onto boats bound for Greece to move his sick son to America. Poet Fathi boards that boat with his wife and child, facing mortal danger. Greek coast guard Stavros discovers refugees navigating stormy seas and strives to save lives. Film producer and humanitarian activist Brandt Andersen, who made the 2020 short film "Refugee" as his starting point, makes his feature directorial, screenwriting, and producing debut with this meticulously researched work. Yasmin Al-Masri reprises her role as doctor Amira from the short, and Omar Sy returns as smuggler Marwan.
title:مسافر: The feature-length debut of Iranian master Abbas Kiarostami, made in 1974, this human drama freshly depicts the funny yet poignant adventures of a boy struggling desperately to watch a soccer match. Gassem, a 10-year-old boy attending elementary school, is obsessed with soccer, often neglecting his homework and classes, earning constant scolding from his teacher and mother. Determined to go see an important match held in the capital, Tehran, he tries every trick to get money for transportation and a ticket, including stealing from home and deceiving his friends... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title:مشق شب: A documentary by internationally acclaimed Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami ('Where Is the Friend's Home?'), focusing on homework and school education. Feeling that Iranian children are always overwhelmed by homework, Kiarostami himself acts as interviewer, asking elementary school students and their parents a series of questions about 'homework.' Through the interviews, the complex family circumstances of each child emerge, revealing the problems within Iran's education system. Kiarostami vividly captures the children's diverse expressions and words while sounding an alarm to society. A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program 'And Kiarostami Continues' (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title:जवान: A thrilling action film from the 'King of Bollywood', Shah Rukh Khan, in his first collaboration with a young Tamil film crew. It depicts the righteous struggle of subway hijackers who steal a ransom from arms dealers.
title:पठान: A spy action film starring Indian cinema superstar Shah Rukh Khan, known for films like "My Name Is Khan" and "Om Shanti Om." When the Indian government revokes the autonomy of the Kashmir region spanning India and Pakistan, an enraged Pakistani General Qadir teams up with former Indian soldier Jim to plan a terrorist attack. Pathaan, an agent of India's intelligence agency RAW (Research and Analysis Wing), moves to stop Jim's planned biological weapon attack. However, it is discovered that a biological weapon has been planted on a plane flying over Delhi. With only six minutes left in a desperate situation, Pathaan, India's top agent, fights to protect his homeland. It has become a talking point that Tiger, the spy played by Salman Khan in the film "Tiger: The Legendary Spy"—which also features the same Indian intelligence agency RAW—is set as a colleague of the protagonist Pathaan in this film. Directed by Siddharth Anand of "War" and "Bang Bang!" Deepika Padukone, who has co-starred with Shah Rukh Khan in films like "Om Shanti Om" and "Chennai Express," plays the heroine Rubai.
title:विक्रम वेधा: A crime suspense film starring Hrithik Roshan of "Bang Bang!" and Saif Ali Khan of "Go Goa Gone," adapted as a Hindi remake of a 2017 Tamil-language film. Vikram, an excellent police commissioner who aims to eradicate crime itself rather than boost his record through arrests, sees his convictions shaken when the criminal he was targeting, Veda, surrenders himself, bringing forth a series of mysteries. Eventually, Vikram and Veda, each with their own purposes, are forced to fight together. Hrithik Roshan plays Veda, and Saif Ali Khan plays Vikram.
title:वॉर 2: The second installment in the series following the 2019 Indian spy action blockbuster "War," this is part of the YRF Spy Universe, which shares a world with the "Pathaan" and "Tiger" series. It depicts the fateful battle between two men on a grand, global scale. Kabir, a legendary spy who once betrayed the nation and disappeared, has now transformed into India's greatest threat. To stop the unstoppable Kabir, the government deploys Vikram, an elite Indian army officer. Having lost everything due to a certain incident, Vikram is driven by the sole mission of eliminating Kabir. However, the battle soon turns from a mission into a personal vendetta against Kabir. Hrithik Roshan reprises his role as the legendary agent Kabir from "War," and N.T. Rama Rao Jr. from "RRR" makes his debut in the YRF Spy Universe as the soldier Vikram, who engages in a fierce battle with him. The film is directed by Ayan Mukerji, known for "Brahmastra."
title:சர்வம் தாளமயம்: A youth music film about a young man's struggle to become a player of the mridangam, a traditional Indian percussion instrument. Peter, the son of a mridangam craftsman living in Chennai, India, is inspired to become a player himself after seeing a master perform on a mridangam his father made. Apprenticing under the master and training diligently, Peter faces various challenges including caste discrimination, conflicts over preserving traditional arts, and generational differences, but confronts them with passion and respect. The music is composed by A. R. Rahman, who won an Academy Award for 'Slumdog Millionaire.' G. V. Prakash Kumar, Rahman's nephew and a renowned film music composer, plays the protagonist Peter. Screened under the title 'The World Is Full of Rhythms' in the World Focus section of the 31st Tokyo International Film Festival in 2018. For its theatrical release in October 2022, the film was distributed by 'Nandori,' a South Indian restaurant in Tokyo's Arakawa Ward that fell in love with the film.
title:டூரிஸ்ட் ஃபாமிலி: A family, fed up with their impoverished life in Sri Lanka, illegally enters India and, armed with 'smiles and a little bit of meddling', sparks small miracles!
title:மார்க் ஆண்டனி: This Indian sci-fi action film comically and eccentrically depicts a gangster's son who obtains a phone that allows him to talk to people in the past and tries to rewrite fate. In 1975, mad scientist Chiranjeevi invents a telephone that can call people in the past. Using it, he can avert disasters about to befall his past self or loved ones, or make choices that lead to profit. However, Chiranjeevi gets caught in a gang war at a bar while celebrating, and the phone goes missing. Twenty years later, auto mechanic Mark stumbles upon the phone and learns its special abilities and how to use it. This phone eventually sparks a massive upheaval involving Mark's foster father, gang boss Jackie; Jackie's son Madan; and Mark's deceased father, Antony. In Japan, Vishal plays dual roles as mechanic Mark and his gangster father Antony, while S. J. Surya, known for "Jigarthanda Double X," co-stars as Antony's partner Jackie.
title:விக்ரம்: A crime action film produced by and starring Indian national star Kamal Haasan, alongside Vijay Sethupathi from "Jawan" and Fahadh Faasil from "Pushpa: The Rise." It depicts a three-way battle between a drug cartel boss, an unemployed middle-aged man, and a special agent through intense action sequences. Three consecutive terrorist attacks by masked groups occur in Chennai. Special agent Amar suspects Sandhanam, the drug lord who controls the city's gangs, is involved. Meanwhile, Sandhanam is searching for two tons of missing cocaine base that vanished from his territory. As the investigation progresses, Amar becomes strangely preoccupied with Karnan, an unemployed man who was the second victim. Karnan had a police officer son-in-law, who was also killed by the same terrorists. Directed and written by Lokesh Kanagaraj, known for "Master" and "Kaithi," with action choreography by the twin stuntmen Anbariv (Anbumani & Arivumani) active in the Indian film industry.
title:రౌద్రం రణం రుధిరం: From S.S. Rajamouli, director of the "Baahubali" series, which was a huge hit and had a long theatrical run in Japan, comes this spectacular action entertainment set in the turbulent era of British colonial India, depicting the clash of friendship and duty between two men. In 1920, during British rule in India, Bheem rises to save a young girl kidnapped by the British army, while Rama becomes a police officer for the British government for a greater cause. Though they are on opposing sides, driven by their own passionate beliefs, fate brings them together without knowing each other's true identities, and they become inseparable friends. However, an incident forces them to choose between friendship and their missions. N.T. Rama Rao Jr., known for "Baadshah," plays Bheem, and Ram Charan, who starred in Rajamouli's "Magadheera," plays Rama. The title "RRR" is derived from the initials of "Rise," "Roar," and "Revolt." It became the first Indian film to gross over 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office. The song "Naatu Naatu" also became a sensation, winning the Academy Award for Best Original Song at the 95th Academy Awards, a first for an Indian film.
title:ಕಾಂತಾರ: A legendary suspense-action film set in South India, centered on the ancient ritual of 'Bhuta Kola' (spirit worship). It powerfully depicts the strange fate of a land protected by divine grace and became a long-running hit in India. About 170 years ago, a vast forest was granted to the indigenous people by the oracle of the god Panjuruli. The village of Kadu Bettur has long performed the Bhuta Kola ritual and maintained peace through divine protection, even when landlords tried to reclaim the land. However, the newly appointed forest officer Murali attempts to incorporate the villagers' land into a state-designated protected forest. As the village faces a crisis of survival, Shiva, a buffalo race champion whose father was a Bhuta Kola performer, opposes the forest department to protect the village's peace, leading to an incident. Rishab Shetty, who has an unusual background of juggling jobs in water vending and real estate before entering the film industry, directed, wrote, and starred in the film, passionately playing Shiva, the village's biggest rogue.
title:ผีใช้ได้ค่ะ: In Bangkok, Thailand, where dust pollution is severe, March (Wisarut Himmarat) spends his days in grief after losing his beloved wife Nat (Davika Hoorne) to a respiratory disease. One day, Nat's soul returns, inhabiting a vacuum cleaner, and the two reaffirm their love. Meanwhile, at the factory run by March's family, the spirit of a deceased employee possesses the machinery, bringing operations to a halt. Rejected by family troubled by the spirit and by society, Nat tries to prove her true love for her husband and her own existence as a 'useful ghost' by helping with the factory's exorcism...
title:ลุงบุญมีระลึกชาติ: A fantasy drama by Thai director Apichatpong Weerasethakul, internationally acclaimed for "Tropical Malady," which brought Thailand its first Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival. Boonmee, who is nearing the end of his life in the mountains of Thailand, invites his wife's younger sister Jen to his farm. There, the ghost of Boonmee's wife, who passed away nineteen years earlier, appears, and his missing son also shows up in a transformed state. Eventually, Boonmee ventures with them into the deep forest.
title:ལུང་ནག་ན: A Bhutanese film set in the real village of Lunana, located at an altitude of 4,800 meters in the Himalayas, depicting the interaction between a young teacher from the city and the village children. Ugyen, a young teacher dreaming of becoming a musician, is ordered to take a post at a school in Lunana, the most remote village in Bhutan. After a journey of over a week, he arrives at the village, where children eagerly await the teacher's arrival, wanting to study. Ugyen is initially bewildered by life in a place without electricity or toilet paper, but gradually finds his place while spending time with the villagers. Director Pawo Choyning Dorji, a Bhutanese native making his directorial debut, beautifully captures the simple yet precious lives of the villagers, questioning what true happiness really is. The film earned Bhutan's first-ever nomination for the Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards. It was released in Japan in 2021. In 2026, it is scheduled for a revival screening as part of the 40th anniversary of Japan-Bhutan diplomatic relations.
title:’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪: Beginning in 1963 when a re-edited version of the TV anime "Wolf Boy Ken" was screened alongside "Wanwan Chushingura" at some theaters, screenings that bundled children's works such as anime and special effects films became established, held twice a year in spring and summer. Though the name changed over time, it was fixed as "Toei Manga Matsuri" from spring 1969, and from spring 1990, special effects works were separated, and it was held as "Toei Anime Matsuri" and "Toei Anime Fair." The December 1986 "'87 Otoshidama Toei Manga Matsuri" consisted solely of anime works. "GeGeGe no Kitaro" is a theatrical version of the third TV anime series, telling the story of yokai using strange weather to occupy the National Diet Building, with Shigeru Mizuki and his wife appearing in the film. "Dragon Ball" is the first theatrical film, set as a parallel story to the TV anime. "Kinnikuman" is the seventh theatrical film and the only one in standard (4:3) format.
title:⼩屋番 ⼋ヶ岳に⽣きる 劇場版: The Yatsugatake Mountains are home to so many mountain huts that they are often referred to as "Koyagatake"—the Mountains of Huts. In this film, we journey through these peaks alongside mountain photographer Tetsuo Kikuchi to meet the individuals who, driven by their own unique motivations, chose the path of the "hut keeper." Why did they choose a harsh daily life facing nature head-on, in a world without convenience stores or cars? The work of a hut keeper involves supporting those who climb for pleasure, while at times confronting the reality of death. While life in a mountain hut may be defined by its inconveniences, it offers a gentle new perspective on the nature of daily life—and the nature of life itself—to those of us weary of today’s frantic information society, where everything is instantly accessible.
title:〈主婦〉の学校: A documentary covering a coeducational home economics school in Iceland. Founded in 1942 in Reykjavik, the capital of Iceland, 'The School of Housewives' is a small home economics school where students live together in a dormitory and learn practical household management skills. Once common worldwide, home economics schools that trained women, who had few educational opportunities after compulsory education, to become good housewives have largely declined with the changing times. Amidst this, this school became coeducational in the 1970s, attracting students regardless of gender who seek wisdom and skills for 'living in the present.' Through the students learning the art of enjoying an independent life, the film gently questions our approach to daily living and housework.
title:《シネマ歌舞伎》: "Ninin Dojoji" is a performance of the grand Kabuki dance piece "Musume Dojoji" danced by two people. The brilliant dance of Tamasaburo and the eighth-generation Kikugoro is enhanced with cinematic techniques, creating a world of fantastical beauty.
title:「BE-BOP-HIGHSCHOOL」シリーズ: The OVA served as a vessel for violent depictions and risqué dialogue that were difficult to air on TV, making it an ideal medium for the delinquent manga that were hugely popular at the time. This work, at the forefront of the boom—a thrilling youth action piece that was hard-hitting yet thoroughly comedic—selected episodes centered on conflicts with other schools for its OVA release. Character designs were by Junichi Hayama. The musical tracks by James Fujiki are also exquisite.
title:「Cinema As Runway」平岡香純シネマコレクション 特集: At age 14, following epileptic seizures caused by a brain tumor, they began writing screenplays after experiencing what felt like traveling between the seen and unseen worlds. While studying at Doshisha University’s Faculty of Letters, they started filming on 8mm. Their work "Rakugaki Iromachi" was invited to over 40 film festivals across 18 countries, including the International Film Festival Rotterdam, drawing significant attention to both the film and the director’s
title:「SF西遊記 スタージンガー」シリーズ: Based on Eisuke Ishikawa's novel 'SF Saiyuki,' with designs by Leiji Matsumoto. To restore the depleted Galaxy Energy, Princess Aurora and her party head to 'Daiōsei' at the center of the galaxy. Her companions are three cyborgs: Kūgo, Hakka, and Jōgo. Ginkaku's gourd is adapted into a black hole, the kintoun cloud into a small fighter craft, and the rough-and-tumble Kūgo is abandoned and banished by the princess. Bellamis, appearing in the latter half of the series, gained popularity as a handsome character. 64 episodes total. Subsequently, 'SF Saiyuki Starzinger II' aired for 9 episodes.
title:「ひゃくえむ。」メイキングドキュメンタリー 真剣（ガチ）になるため: A making-of documentary for *Hyakuemu.*, the 2025 theatrical anime adaptation of Uoto's manga directed by Kenji Iwaisawa (*On-Gaku: Our Sound*). Utilizing the rotoscoping technique—where animation is created by tracing over live-action footage—the documentary provides close-up coverage of every department, from live-action filming to animation production and sound design, recording the trajectory of the film's completion. It captures the behind-the-scenes process from multiple perspectives, offering a rare look at the live-action shoots that form the foundation of the rotoscoping process, the production of key animation and background art, and the final sound and visual checks. The film vividly portrays the long journey from the project's inception to its conclusion, highlighting the staff's meticulous dedication and trial-and-error process as a single animated work takes shape. This documentary allows viewers to relive the four-year production period and the immense passion poured into the project. It is composed and edited by Ayumu Miyazaki, who also served as the editor for the main feature.
title:「もーれつア太郎」シリーズ: Original work by Fujio Akatsuka. 90 episodes total, with color broadcasting beginning from episode 78. Minoru Tajima handled character designs, and Isao Takahata directed 9 episodes including the finale. While carrying the charm of a working-class neighborhood human drama, it unfolds Akatsuka's signature style of unbridled, outrageous gag comedy. The voice actors, who performed the intensely distinctive characters true to the original's flavor, also contributed greatly.
title:「イメージレス・フィルムズ」シリーズより: In the realms of avant-garde and experimental cinema, filmmakers have repeatedly challenged the medium by exploring how many elements considered essential and indispensable to the definition of film can be stripped away, and whether a work can still function as cinema in their absence. Featuring films that emphasize dialogue or sound collage, works where visual elements consist primarily of text, projector performances manipulating light and darkness, and flicker films, this program explores how artists have experimented with the possibilities of "imageless" cinema—or, more broadly, the concepts of "void" and visual subtraction.
title:「オーディオビジュアル・フィードバック」シリーズより: "The artists presented here move beyond unidirectional flows of information and expression to experiment with circular, reflective, or multidirectional configurations of images, sounds, and ideas, while demonstrating how different technologies generate opportunities for diverse variations, analyses, and philosophical or aesthetic self-reflection." (Jed Rapfogel, Anthology Film Archives) As a companion program to the "Documentary Feedback" series, this screening features film and video works that employ various techniques—including video feedback, acoustic feedback, and mirrors—to create visual or auditory feedback loops.
title:「ドキュメンタリー・フィードバック」シリーズより:
"The ethical dimensions of documentary filmmaking (and, to an extent, ethics in cinema as a whole) are themes that have generated endless debate and critical discussion. The power dynamics between director and subject, the risk—or perhaps inevitability—of exploitation and misunderstanding, the danger of fostering the illusion of objectivity... yet it is often overlooked that filmmakers themselves have attempted to weave these issues into the very structure of their works." (Jed Rapfogel, Anthology Film Archives)

As a work that foregrounds the inherent ethical questions and power dynamics of documentary filmmaking and demonstrates a singular approach to addressing them, we present a screening of William Greaves's *Symbiopsychotaxiplasm: Take One*. Greaves, who was active as an actor in Black theater companies since his university days, moved to Canada in a rejection of the Hollywood production system before returning to become an experimental documentary filmmaker. Though the film remained unreleased theatrically for many years, its screening at the 1992 Sundance Film Festival led to its distribution through the efforts of Steven Soderbergh and others. Drawing on philosopher Arthur F. Bentley’s concept of "symbiopsychotaxiplasm"—the relationship between humans and their environment—the film employs split screens to create a multi-layered portrait of a film production being shot improvisationally in Central Park.
title:「湘南爆走族」シリーズ: Based on the manga of the same name by Satoshi Yoshida. Toei Video released all 12 volumes as OVAs, and 35mm film—the same used for theatrical animation—was used for shooting. The piercing transmitted light accurately captures the Shonan sun, and the color design that produced strikingly vivid blue skies vividly colors the fleeting youth of high school students speeding on public roads over three years—a time often misconstrued as brutal. Only 'Shonan Bousouzoku III: 10 Ounces of Bonds' was released theatrically.
title:「花のあすか組!」シリーズ: Based on the manga of the same name serialized in Monthly Asuka, the first installment depicts the battle between protagonist Asuka Kugura and her former underworld organization 'Zen'naka Ura,' while the second installment portrays a betting tournament orchestrated by a party company. The era's scenery—Kabukicho, the front of Koma Theater, Roppongi—is vividly captured. Directed by Atsunori Umezawa, who would go on to helm many works with female protagonists. Animation direction was handled by Yuri Handa for the first installment and Hideyuki Motohashi for the second.
title:「魔女っ子メグちゃん」シリーズ: A work that marked a turning point in the "witch girl" genre, featuring a tomboyish heroine and the introduction of a rival witch. The sleek character designs by Shingo Araki, the European-style cityscapes by Isamu Tsuchida, and the romance-filled Meg all realized the planning slogan of "beautiful, cute, and chic." Talent from Mushi Production, including the original creator Hiromi Pro and director Susumu Sakaguchi, also joined the project. The final episode, directed by Yugo Serikawa, masterfully drives Meg into a heartbreaking farewell. 72 episodes total.
title:「魔法のマコちゃん」シリーズ／「魔法使いチャッピー」シリーズ: An ambitious work based on the fairy tale "The Little Mermaid," incorporating romantic elements to raise the target age range from the traditional witch girl series. Character design was handled by Shinya Takahashi, and director Yugo Serikawa's direction fills Mako's daily life with the lyricism of a melodrama tinged with tragedy. 48 episodes total.
title:『 丹下左膳餘話 百萬兩の壺』 ＊デジタル上映: A commotion over a pot that reveals the hiding place of a large sum of money draws in the swordsman Sanzen... A delightful gem showcasing the talent of Yamanaka, who lightly and skillfully portrays Daigoro's signature role of Sanzen.
title:『 喜劇 ・日本列島震度0』: A female fortune teller predicts a major earthquake, a tabi craftsman in downtown Tokyo urges evacuation, and a shady loan shark schemes to make a quick profit... Fifty years after the Great Kanto Earthquake, this earthquake frenzy comedy wildly laughs at a Japan caught up in the 'Japan Sinks' boom. The duo of Frankie and Zaitsu is simply the best!
title:『 喜劇 ・男の子守唄』: A former war orphan lives with the child of the prostitute who took him in... A heartwarming comedy woven by a man who, even 25 years after the war, still carries the scars of burnt ruins and black markets in his heart. Frankie gives a poignant performance as a man working hard as a street performer and at a host club.
title:『 喜劇 逆転旅行』: Conductor Goichi (Frankie) on the Tohoku Main Line receives passionate advances from his childhood friend, geisha Sakura (Baisho), but secretly has his eye on another woman. The third installment of the 11-film "Travel Series" starring Frankie Sakai, directed by comedy master Segawa.
title:『 喜劇 駅前漫画』: The 15th installment of the 'Ekimaé Series,' which produced 24 films starring Frankie, Morishige, and Bando. Riding the unprecedented manga boom, this film features Frankie as a manga artist and is a legendary oddity, with appearances by 'Obake no Q-taro' and 'Osomatsu-kun' within the story.
title:『 沓掛時次郎 遊俠一匹』 ＊デジタル上映: Tokijiro sets out on a journey with the wife and child of a man he killed out of obligation to the underworld. This eighth film adaptation of a classic play, directed by Tai Kato, crystallizes supreme lyricism into a poignant love story, resulting in a masterpiece.
title:『 浪華悲歌 』: Synopsis: Ayako (Yamada), a telephone operator, enters into a lover's contract with a married company president to cover her father's debts after he loses his job due to embezzlement suspicions... Considered one of Mizoguchi's masterpieces from before the war, the lively streets of Osaka and Yamada's modern fashion are also highlights.
title:『 𥇥 の母』: Bannosuke Chutaro continues his journey searching for his long-lost mother... A masterpiece among masterpieces, with unforgettable scenes between Kinnosuke, longing for his mother, and the great actresses Kogure, Natsukawa, Naniwa, and Sawamura that bring tears to the eyes.
title:『OPEN HOUSE』: Synopsis: Director Isao Yukisada’s little-known feature debut. Set amidst the chaotic atmosphere of the 1990s, the film lyrically depicts three men and women drifting through life, burdened by a sense of alienation.
title:『Wの悲劇』４Ｋデジタル修復版: Shizuka Mita is a 20-year-old woman who works hard to become an actress as a trainee at the theater troupe "Sea." Moriguchi, a 26-year-old former troupe member now working at a real estate agency, first notices sincere Shizuka in a park. Shizuka prepares for the lead role audition in the troupe's next production, "The Tragedy of W," but her peer Kaori lands the part, and Shizuka is assigned a minor role with only a single line at the beginning of the story. Downcast after failing the audition, Moriguchi confides in her about his own psychological struggles as an actor. He then proposes marriage on the condition that she never becomes a star, and conversely promises to send a large bouquet to her dressing room as a farewell if she succeeds as an actress.
title:『あじさいの歌』: Synopsis: An old Western-style mansion on a hill—there, an eccentric father and his sheltered daughter (Ashikawa) reach a turning point in their lives after a chance encounter with a young man (Ishihara) they unexpectedly take in. You are sure to be captivated by Ashikawa’s radiance as she matures from a somber girl into an independent woman.
title:『いのちの朝』: Synopsis: Fuyuko (Ashikawa) supports her household by working at an insurance company. She asks her father, a painter, to paint her portrait, but... This literary masterpiece depicts the profound bond between a struggling artist and the daughter who devotedly supports him. Ashikawa is breathtakingly beautiful, portraying a strong-willed woman with poise and dignity.
title:『おとうと』４Ｋデジタル修復版: Set in Mukojima, Tokyo, during the Taisho era. Siblings Gen and Aoiro live with their writer father and stepmother. Gen takes care of Aoiro, covering for their sick stepmother, but Aoiro starts hanging out with a bad crowd. They protect each other at times and have big fights at others, living together as siblings, until Aoiro falls ill with tuberculosis.
title:『おへその大将』: Set in a slum along the Hirano River in eastern Osaka. A fine human drama depicting the interactions between the so-called 'Apache tribe,' who make a living by stealing scrap metal, and a town doctor (Frankie) who strives to stand by them. Michiyo Aratama, playing his wife, also delivers a remarkable presence.
title:『お遊さま』: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.
title:『しろばんば』: Synopsis: Early Taisho era. This film depicts the growth of a boy raised by an elderly woman in a mountain village on the Izu Peninsula. A masterpiece of literary drama, it was adapted and filmed by master director Keisuke Kinoshita from the autobiographical novel by the literary giant Yasushi Inoue. Incidentally, "Shirobamba" refers to the snow bug. Ashikawa plays the role of the boy’s fleeting "Madonna."
title:『にっぽんのお婆ぁちゃん』: Synopsis: The comical odyssey of elderly women with checkered pasts who meet in Asakusa. A social comedy addressing the issues of the elderly, this is a tour de force that Mizuki brought to the screen after co-founding a production company with the director and others.
title:『ぼくらの七日間戦争』: At Aoba Junior High, where strict discipline is enforced, eleven boys and girls rise up in pursuit of freedom. They bring food and barricade themselves in an abandoned factory, while the teachers try to disband them strictly according to school rules. The students fend off the teachers using various means, but... A lighthearted youth drama based on the original novel by So Munetari. Screened simultaneously with "Flower's Asuka Gang!".
title:『わんぱく天使』: An unconventional home drama depicting the daily life of a new father (Frankie), who works from home and is run ragged by his mischievous toddler yet raises him with abundant love. His chemistry with his on-screen wife Ikeuchi is excellent, and Bando and Miki are amusing as hopeless fathers.
title:『エレノアってグレイト。』トークイベント付: Eleanor is left with a gaping hole in her heart after the death of her longtime best friend, Bessie. Her estranged family won't give her the time of day. Then one day, thinking she's going to a casual tea party, she accidentally stumbles into a support group for Holocaust survivors. Intending it as a one-time lie, she begins to tell the story of her deceased friend Bessie's life, recounting her memories of the Holocaust. A journalism student named Nina, inspired by the dramatic story, grows close to Eleanor, and Eleanor's heart soars with this new friendship. But as her harmless lie takes on a life of its own, it spirals into a huge commotion.
title:『カウント・ベイシー』トークイベント付: Count Basie, who brought the blues into jazz and sparked a rhythm revolution, built the golden age of swing jazz and was hailed as the 'King of Swing'. In Japan, he has captivated many jazz fans for years, and his music remains highly popular in the repertoires of student big bands and wind ensembles. This film focuses not only on his brilliant public career but also on his little-known private life, which Basie himself rarely discussed. The film's production team discovered numerous home movies shot by his family, vast photo albums, letters, and other valuable materials. It reveals his family love for his daughter Diane, who was born with cerebral palsy, and his wife Catherine, who supported the African American civil rights movement from its early days and interacted with Martin Luther King Jr. and his wife. The film also features members of the still-active Basie Orchestra and friends like Quincy Jones and Annie Ross. Through their portrayals of Basie and valuable archival materials, including collaborations with Frank Sinatra and Billie Holiday, his life's journey and the turbulent social history of 20th-century America are brought into sharp relief.
title:『カラオケ行こ！』: Okasatomi, the choir club president, is suddenly invited to karaoke by yakuza member Narita Kyoji, who asks for singing lessons. To avoid the 'terror' that awaits whoever comes in last at the gang's karaoke contest, Kyoji must improve at all costs. His chosen song is X JAPAN's 'Kurenai.' Satomi reluctantly agrees to coach him, but in time, their relationship begins to change... What fate awaits Satomi? And can Kyoji escape the bottom spot?
title:『サムライ 4Kレストア』: Hitman Jeff carries out his usual assignment, but as he leaves the scene, a pianist catches a glimpse of his face—a film noir depicting the life of a lone-wolf killer.
title:『スローなブギにしてくれ』: Goro and Sachino first met on the Third Keihin Expressway. Sachino, thrown out of a white Mustang, was rescued by Goro, who was riding a motorcycle. The two begin living together. Meanwhile, the middle-aged man who was driving the Mustang is also leading a strange cohabitation. Sachino starts working at a snack bar called Queen Elizabeth. Goro gets into a fight and quits his part-time job. When Goro leaves home, Sachino decides to meet the middle-aged man.
title:『セーラー服と機関銃』４Ｋデジタル修復版: The boss of a small yakuza gang called Medaka-gumi, who has only four underlings, dies leaving a will stating that his successor must be a blood relative. Around the same time, high school girl Izumi Hoshi is saying her final goodbye at the crematorium to her father Takashi, who died after being hit by a car in front of Narita Airport. Izumi's mother passed away long ago, leaving her truly alone. When Izumi returns to her apartment, a woman named Mayumi is there, carrying a letter from her father that says, 'If I die, please take care of Izumi.' The next day, a crowd of men in black suits lines up in front of her school. Ignoring her friends Tomoki, Tetsuo, and Shuhei, who try to stop her, Izumi heads toward the school gate. The man from the crematorium steps forward and says, 'You're Izumi Hoshi, right?' This man, named Sakuma, takes her to a shabby office and asks her to succeed as the fourth-generation boss of the Medaka-gumi.
title:『ビトゥーカ ミルトン・ナシメント フェアウェルツアー』トークイベン: Called the 'Voice of Brazil,' Milton Nascimento, affectionately known as Bituca, led MPB (Brazilian popular music post-bossa nova) alongside contemporaries Gilberto Gil, Caetano Veloso, and Chico Buarque, and collaborated with countless international musicians. This documentary film traces Milton's life and music while following his global farewell concert tour, announced upon turning 80 in 2022. In the first half, Milton's troupe tours Europe and the Americas, receiving ecstatic welcomes. Pat Metheny, Spike Lee, Quincy Jones, and Wayne Shorter speak about Milton, and there are scenes of collaboration with Esperanza Spalding and Herbie Hancock. Milton reflects on his childhood raised as an adopted son, converses with his own adopted child on the road, and shares memories of his benefactor, singer Elis Regina. The second half begins with the landscapes of Minas Gerais, the highland region of inland Brazil that is Milton's home and musical origin. Friends like Chico, Caetano, and Gil, collaborating poets like Márcio Borges and Ronaldo Bastos, and younger musicians who admire Milton, discuss the appeal and depths of his music. Inescapable negative histories, such as racism and Brazil's 20-year military dictatorship starting in 1964, are also revealed. Then, the farewell concert finale approaches: the concert at Mineirão, the football stadium in Belo Horizonte, the capital of Minas Gerais. Members of Clube da Esquina (Corner Club), the title of a landmark 1972 album and the name for the family of Minas musicians centered around Milton—Lô Borges, Beto Guedes, Wagner Tiso, and Toninho Horta—share behind-the-scenes stories and perform together.
title:『ファイブスター物語』: A film adaptation of Nagano Mamoru's work of the same name, centered on episodes from the original first volume. In the star cluster year 2988, on the planet Adler, the unveiling of a new Fatima created by the renowned scientist Balanche is approaching. Headliners confident in their skills gather from across the star cluster, vying to be chosen as the master of the Fatima made by the master craftsman, when Balanche's friend, Radios Sopp, arrives on Adler.
title:『ボロ家の春秋』: Gomi (Sada) begins living in a dilapidated mansion with a man he met by chance, but the man suddenly vanishes, and a string of eccentric characters starts showing up in his place. Based on a Naoki Prize-winning novel, this slapstick comedy features superb banter between Sada and a cast of quirky actors.
title:『リング』: Reiko Asakawa, a TV station director, is investigating an urban legend when she notices that a man and woman rumored to have been involved with a 'cursed videotape' that kills viewers within a week died at the exact same date and time as her niece, Tomoko Oishi, who had died strangely a few days earlier. As her investigation progresses, Reiko discovers that Tomoko and the other three who died simultaneously were acquaintances, that they had stayed at a rental villa in Izu called 'Izu Pacific Land' a week prior, and that the faces of the four in film photos taken at that time are eerily distorted. Seeking to uncover the mystery of their deaths, Reiko visits the villa in question, watches the suspicious tape that was rented there, and immediately receives an eerie silent phone call. From that point on, Reiko's own photos also begin to show her face distorted, just like the four deceased.
title:『ロッコク・キッチン』: A documentary that observes people's lives and the present state of Fukushima through the dining tables of those living along National Route 6, commonly known as "Rokkoku," where areas still remain designated as difficult-to-return zones.
title:『丹下左膳 乾 雲 坤 龍 の巻 』: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title:『人情紙風船』 ＊デジタル上映: The final work of renowned early Showa period director Tomu Uchida, who died of illness at just 28, this is a humanistic period drama. In the Edo period, Shinzo, a barber living in a poor tenement, runs a gambling den and catches the eye of yakuza. Strapped for cash, he tries to pawn his barber tools but is refused. Meanwhile, Matajuro, a ronin living in the same tenement, seeks employment with a samurai his father once served, but is completely ignored. One day, Shinzo accidentally kidnaps the pawnshop owner's daughter and brings her back to the tenement... An adaptation of Kawatake Mokuami's kabuki play "Kamiyui Shinzo."
title:『人間の証明』４Ｋデジタル修復版: A black man is murdered in an elevator at a luxury hotel in Tokyo, leaving behind the word 'Stoha' and a poetry collection by Saijo Yaso. Fashion designer Kyoko Yasugi and her son appear and disappear along the investigative trail. Detective Muneyori travels to the United States to trace the black man's past. The unexpected relationship between Kyoko and the black man, as well as the connection between the American detective and Detective Muneyori, comes to light.
title:『伊賀忍法帖』: Kashin Koji, a mysterious man who appears during the Sengoku period, is a master of various mystical arts, and tales of his sightings and experiences are told in many places. He is summoned by the warlord Matsunaga Hisahide. Hisahide harbors a desire for Miyoshi Yoshiyuki's wife, Ukon no Tsubone, and plots to have his way with her. Kashin proposes a plan to create an "lust stone"—an aphrodisiac capable of melting any woman's heart. It is made by having seven ninja monks under Kashin's command rape women and boiling down the resulting fluids. The sheer horror of this plan leaves the assembled Sen no Rikyū and Yagyū Shinzaemon trembling in fear.
title:『倖せは俺等のねがい』 ＊デジタル上映: A couple working at a factory, on the verge of marriage and moving into their long-awaited new home, are saddled with four distant relatives' children... The third directorial work by the renowned actor Uno, who captures the modest happiness of ordinary people. Frankie won the Blue Ribbon Award for Best Actor for this film and 'The Sun of the Meiji Restoration'.
title:『友よ、静かに瞑れ』: After learning that his old friend Sakaguchi had attacked the president of Shimogata Construction and been arrested, Shindo returned to a small port town in Okinawa. Shimogata Construction was in charge of the town's redevelopment and had been harassing and threatening Sakaguchi to force him to sell his hotel. Shindo stayed at the hotel, the "Free Inn," and began investigating the incident. Meeting Shimogata's development chief Takabatake and Detective Tokuda, who was colluding with Shimogata, Shindo uncovered the truth: Sakaguchi had stormed Shimogata Construction to rescue his kidnapped son, Ryuta. Shindo also learned that Sakaguchi was suffering from cancer and had only a few months to live.
title:『君も出世ができる』: The pinnacle of Japanese musicals, depicting a salaryman struggling in the battle for foreign tourists in Tokyo just before the Olympics. Throughout the film, talented performers sing and dance, and Frankie's astonishing physical abilities leave you in awe. The grand group dance in 'Man Alone' is especially breathtaking.
title:『噂の女』: A commentary: A daughter returns to Kyoto's Shimabara pleasure district, wounded after a broken engagement, and strongly resists her mother, who runs the long-established geisha house "Izutsuya." This masterpiece centers on the mother-daughter conflict, portraying the sorrow of women who have no choice but to live in the flower and willow world. The art direction by Hiroshi Mizutani, who long supported Mizoguchi's films from before the war, is also stunning.
title:『地方記者』: A pollution issue arises in a town in the Tohoku region, and the media war heats up... An excellent film in which Frankie plays a newspaper reporter, depicting the struggles of journalists who, while grappling with the difficulties of maneuvering in a rural setting, burn with passion for producing community-focused articles.
title:『夜の 鴎 』: Synopsis: An unconventional melodrama depicting a woman who, having lost her loved ones one after another, nevertheless strives to live in search of love. Directed by the renowned actor Saburi from an original screenplay by Tanaka.
title:『夜の女たち』: Synopsis: A shocking work depicting the fierce struggle for survival of women who become prostitutes in the burnt-out ruins of Osaka immediately after Japan's defeat. Among the many masterpieces by Tanaka and her ally Mizoguchi, this film leaves a vivid impression with Mizoguchi's cold-hearted direction and Tanaka's passionate performance as a war widow forced into street prostitution.
title:『天外者』七夕上映会 Vol.6: A historical ensemble drama starring Haruma Miura, depicting the life of Tomoatsu Godai, a great man who built the foundations of modern Japan's economy and was called a rare 'Tengaramon' (a person with extraordinary talent). Written by Eriko Komatsu and directed by Mitsutoshi Tanaka, who previously collaborated on 'Ask This of Rikyu' and '1890', it is an original story. In the late Edo period, Japan is shocked by Perry's arrival. Young samurai Tomoatsu Godai (later known as Tomoatsu), sensing the dawn of a new era, ignores the internal strife over expelling foreigners versus opening the country and looks to the world. After meeting the courtesan Haru, he is driven by the desire to 'see a free dream' and joins forces with Ryoma Sakamoto, Yataro Iwasaki, Hirobumi Ito, and others to create a country where everyone can dream. Shohei Miura plays Godai's ally Ryoma Sakamoto, Takanori Nishikawa plays Yataro Iwasaki (who later founded the Mitsubishi conglomerate), Yuki Morinaga plays a young Hirobumi Ito (who became Japan's first Prime Minister), and Aoi Morikawa plays the courtesan Haru. [Admission Fee] Flat rate of 1,000 yen. *As this is a special screening, various tickets, free passes, and shareholder discount coupons cannot be used. In the late Edo period, in a corner of Japan shaken by Perry's arrival, two young samurai who keenly sense the arrival of a new era race forward at full speed. Tomoatsu Godai (Haruma Miura) and Ryoma Sakamoto (Shohei Miura). For some reason, both are being targeted by many samurai. Their lives, which see far into Japan's future, begin to intersect at this moment. Expel the barbarians or open the country? Godai ignores the intense internal strife and looks to the world. Then, he meets the courtesan Haru (Aoi Morikawa) and is driven by the desire to 'see a free dream,' joining forces with Ryoma Sakamoto, Yataro Iwasaki (Takanori Nishikawa), and Hirobumi Ito (Yuki Morinaga) to create a country where everyone can dream.
title:『失楽園』４Ｋデジタル修復版: Kuki, once a sharp editor at a publishing house but now relegated to a dead-end position, meets Rinko, a married woman who teaches calligraphy at a culture center run by a friend, and continues an adulterous affair with her. Their love only deepens, and Kuki eventually rents an apartment in Tokyo to serve as their love nest. But Rinko's husband hires a private detective and learns of her infidelity, while Kuki's wife pressures him for a divorce. Yet the more they are cornered by those around them, the more fiercely Kuki and Rinko's love burns.
title:『小屋番 八ヶ岳に生きる 劇場版』舞台挨拶付き上映: Yatsugatake is home to so many mountain huts that it is often nicknamed “Koyagatake.” Join mountain photographer Tetsuo Kikuchi as he journeys through these peaks to meet the “hut keepers”—individuals who have chosen this path for reasons all their own. In a world without convenience stores or cars, what led them to choose a grueling daily life of facing nature head-on?
title:『山椒大夫』: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.
title:『幕末太陽傳』: Saheiji, left penniless at a Shinagawa pleasure quarter at the end of the Edo period... A masterpiece by Kawashima and Frankie, and a classic in Japanese film history. In this ensemble comedy where late-Edo period patriots and courtesans mingle, Frankie's light and agile movements as he navigates through the chaos are the film's core.
title:『幻魔大戦』: The destroyer of the universe, "Genma," was approaching Earth. Luna, a princess of Transylvania and an esper, received a message from the cosmic consciousness "Froi" and began a battle to protect Earth alongside Vega, a cyborg soldier also fighting Genma. Luna decided to gather psychics from around the world to counter Genma. Among them was high school student Azuma Higashi, who was unaware of his own abilities until Vega's provocations awakened his psychic powers. However, emotionally immature, he closed his heart to Luna's pleas to join the fight to save the universe. Even so, the enemy appeared before him without mercy.
title:『復活の日』４Ｋデジタル修復版: In 1982, the deadly virus MM-88 is stolen from a research institute in East Germany. However, the plane carrying the spy who stole it crashes in the Alps, and the virus spreads across the Earth, wiping out humanity except for a small group of survivors in Antarctica. One of these survivors, earthquake researcher Yoshizumi, realizes an even greater danger is approaching: a massive earthquake could strike the eastern United States, potentially triggering the launch of nuclear missiles.
title:『愛妻記』: A film adaptation of the autobiographical novel by Ozaki, who won the Akutagawa Prize for "Norakuro Megane," with his wife as the model. This endearing film depicts the poor but happy days of a quirky writer husband (Frankie), who calls his wife by the pet name "Yoshihyoe," and his simple, charming wife (Kishi).
title:『戦国自衛隊』４Ｋデジタル修復版: Led by Lieutenant Yoshiaki Iba, 21 members of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, armed with modern weapons, suddenly time-slip along with their supply depot to the Sengoku period while en route to an exercise. As they stand bewildered, Nagao Heizo Kagetora arrives with his retainers to meet them. Upon first seeing Iba, Kagetora takes an instant liking to him, calling him "a kindred spirit," and is drawn to their unfamiliar clothing and weapons, hoping to recruit them. Iba and his soldiers struggle to accept the reality of their time slip. However, after encountering Kagetora and being attacked by guerrilla forces of a rival feudal lord—resulting in a comrade's death—and witnessing Kagetora's battle firsthand, they are forced to come to terms with having arrived in the Sengoku period.
