title:『探偵物語』４Ｋデジタル修復版: This was a highly anticipated comeback film for Yakusho, who had taken a break from acting to prepare for university entrance exams after the massive hit of her starring movie "Sailor Suit and Machine Gun" (1981). The story follows a pampered college girl, played by Yakusho, who is bodyguarded by a private detective played by Matsuda. Director Negishi Kichitaro and the staff devised various strategies to help Yakusho grow as an actress, and she rose to the occasion. It was first released as a double feature with "The Girl Who Leapt Through Time" starring Harada Tomoyo. College student Arai Naomi is set to leave for America, where her father awaits, in one week. Invited by her admired senior Nagai, she heads to a hotel, but a man claiming to be her uncle bursts in and drives Nagai away. The man is a private detective named Tsujiyama Shuichi, hired by her father's former secretary to protect her until her departure. One day, Tsujiyama's ex-wife Sachiko shows up at his apartment, saying she is suspected of stabbing Kazuya, the heir to the Okazaki gang, at a hotel. Naomi suggests to Tsujiyama that they search for the real culprit together.
title:『新・平家物語』: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.
title:『森に聴く Listen to the Forest』舞台挨拶:
In Japan, where 70% of the land is covered by forest, we embark on a journey to discover the true nature of the woods that surround us. From the foothills of Mt. Oakan in Hokkaido to Naruko in Miyagi, Hita in Oita, Mt. Ichifusa in Kumamoto, and Iriomote Island in Okinawa, this nature documentary travels across the archipelago with leading researchers. Venturing deep into forests of giant trees that have survived far longer than humanity, the film explores the mysteries of their intelligence. What is the world that these forests of multi-species coexistence—a realm beyond human imagination—are trying to tell us?

Tetsujiro Yamagami, the producer behind such films as *Village of Dreams*, *All Around Us*, and *The Miharashi Generation*, reflects on his own life as he makes his directorial debut. He is joined by Yuki Imai, a filmmaker who continues to explore the relationship between humanity and nature in works like *Heguru*, as they tackle this new theme together. Within the flow of eternal time, how do nature and humans connect, and where are we headed from here?
title:『楊貴妃』: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.
title:『殘菊物語』 《デジタル修復版》 ＊デジタル上映: A commentary: Kikunosuke, the son of a kabuki family abandoned by those around him, walks a thorny path of artistic dedication, supported by the devoted love of O-Toku, his younger brother's wet nurse... This is a pinnacle of the artistic path genre and a miraculous masterpiece that allows one to touch the essence of Mizoguchi through a succession of tension-filled shots, making heavy use of long takes.
title:『気まぐれ渡世』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: Joe (Shishido) makes a killing by putting his sharpshooting skills to work. After being entrusted with a baby by a man he meets in a bar who then turns up dead, Joe finds himself suspected of murder. Ashikawa plays the beautiful nun at the orphanage where Joe takes the child.
title:『汚れた英雄』４Ｋデジタル修復版: The International A-Class 500cc final (All-Japan Road Race Championship, Round 8) is held at the UGO Circuit. The fateful showdown between bike racers Akio Kitano and Keishi Oki ends just before the finish line when Oki overtakes Kitano, pushing the decisive battle to the final round. Kitano uses his handsome looks and sexual prowess to secure funding from multiple patrons to maintain his team. When Christine Adams, heir to a billion-dollar fortune and owner of an international conglomerate, arrives in Japan, Kitano quickly approaches her and successfully secures funding. Finally, Kitano faces the final race, but...
title:『河内山宗俊』 ＊デジタル上映: To save the daughter of an amazake shop owner from a dire situation, two rogues throw themselves into the fray. A masterpiece showcasing perfect chemistry between the renowned actors of Zenshinza and director Yamanaka. The beauty of a 15-year-old Setsuko Hara is captivating.
title:『炎のごとく』: The turbulent life of gambler Senkichi, who continues to love one woman. Set in Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, this powerful portrayal of unadorned love between a man and a woman stands as Tai Kato's final, crowning live-action film.
title:『牛乳屋フランキー』 ＊デジタル上映: A cheerful young man moves to Tokyo to help at a relative's milk shop and struggles to outdo his business rivals. A film adaptation of a popular radio drama, this is an early representative work of Frankie Sakai, known as a hidden gem of slapstick comedy.
title:『特急にっぽん』: Aboard an express train from Tokyo to Osaka, waitress Sayoko (Dan) pressures kitchen assistant Kiichi (Frankie) to marry her. An adaptation of a popular novel by Bunroku Shishi, this ensemble comedy depicts the chaos stirred up by a group of eccentric passengers sharing the dining car.
title:『犬神家の一族』４Ｋデジタル修復版: The will of the old family patriarch Saibee Inugami is made public, but it states that the heir to the vast fortune is the one who marries Tamayo Nonomiya, the granddaughter of Saibee's mentor. Saibee's three grandsons each scheme to claim Tamayo for themselves, but this soon escalates into a series of murders...
title:『知と愛の出発』 ［カラー復元版］ ＊デジタル上映: High school student Momoko (Ashikawa) nurtures a tender romance while dreaming of her future at university. Set against a backdrop of breathtaking lakeside scenery, this impactful film vividly portrays the sometimes cruel reality of youth. Experience Ashikawa’s legendary appearance in a sailor uniform on the big screen.
title:『祇園の 姉妹 』: A commentary: A masterpiece that gazes with a penetrating eye at two contrasting geisha sisters living in Kyoto's Gion pleasure district. The older sister, old-fashioned and easily swayed by emotion, and the younger sister, modern and pragmatic... You can't take your eyes off the 19-year-old Yamada, who plays the younger sister rebelling against her submissive elder sibling and trying to toy with men, exuding a remarkable presence.
title:『祈るひと』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: Akiko (Ashikawa), now of marriageable age, repeatedly attends arranged marriage meetings at the urging of those around her. However, perhaps due to growing up in a home lacking in affection, she finds herself unable to embrace the idea of marriage. In this film adaptation of a novel serialized in a women's magazine, Ashikawa delivers a dignified performance as a heroine seeking her own path to independence.
title:『私は貝になりたい』: A small-town barber who has returned from the war unexpectedly finds himself put on trial as a war criminal. This film version, directed by screenwriter Hashimoto himself, is based on a television drama that won an Art Festival Award. A legendary work that portrays the absurdity and cruelty of war, with Frankie's heartfelt performance that shakes the soul.
title:『羽織の大将』: A new rakugo performer who jumps from his university comedy club into the world of rakugo and becomes an instant hit... This delightful and bittersweet film gently chronicles the hardships of training in the world of performance, unexpected success, and setbacks. The naturally gifted entertainer Frankie gives a superb and convincing portrayal of a storyteller.
title:『聖の青春』: Murayama Takashi, who suffered from a serious illness since early childhood, discovers shogi during repeated hospitalizations and, at age 15, becomes a disciple of Mori Nobuo. Ten years later, Takashi moves to Tokyo to fulfill his dream of becoming a Meijin champion. Supported by those around him, he devotes himself fully to shogi, and after reaching the rank of 7-dan, he develops a fierce rivalry with Habu Yoshiharu, who won the Meijin title in the same generation. Takashi immerses himself even deeper in shogi, but cancer gradually consumes his body...
title:『蘇える金狼』４Ｋデジタル修復版: Legendary popular actor Yusaku Matsuda stars as a lone wolf with two faces—a salaryman and an outlaw—in this hit Kadokawa action film based on the novel of the same name by Haruhiko Oyabu, which was a huge success upon its release. Following his explosive popularity in the pioneering TV drama 'Taiyo ni Hoero!', Matsuda teams up again with director Tohru Murakawa and cinematographer Seizo Sengen—who also worked with him on the 'Game' film series and the drama 'Daitokai PARTII'—to break new ground in domestic hard-action cinema. A must-see film, Matsuda enhanced his wild charisma by experiencing live-fire shooting abroad for his role. Murakawa's signature long-take cinematography brings unique intensity to the gunfight scenes, and the final line is said to be an ad-lib by Matsuda himself, not in the script. Tetsuya Asakura appears to be an ordinary salaryman by day, but by night he trains his body and plots to take over a massive corporation. One day, he uses drugs he obtained to seduce his boss's mistress, Kyoko Nagai. Soon after, he discovers that a man named Sakurai is blackmailing company executives over an embezzlement scandal. Asakura skillfully manipulates Sakurai and the company to successfully become engaged to the president's daughter, Eriko. Meanwhile, burning with jealousy, Kyoko makes a fateful decision.
title:『西鶴一代女』 ＊デジタル上映: Commentary: An old street prostitute (Tanaka) standing at the gate of an ancient temple recalls her tumultuous life... How did a girl from a good family with experience serving at the imperial court fall so low? Hailed as the greatest masterpiece of the Mizoguchi-Tanaka partnership, it won an international award at the Venice Film Festival.
title:『誘惑』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: A romantic rivalry unfolds among the colorful characters frequenting the art galleries of Ginza. Widely acclaimed as Nakahira’s masterpiece, this stylish romantic comedy features Ashikawa as a young girl who is the spitting image of the protagonist’s first love. Delightful cameo appearances by famous painters like Taro Okamoto and Seiji Togo are another highlight.
title:『貸間あり』: In a large rundown house overlooking the Tsutenkaku Tower in Osaka, a group of eccentric lodgers live... Frankie, in his famous partnership with Kawashima, plays a laid-back jack-of-all-trades who works as a ghostwriter and konnyaku maker. With unique supporting actors like Naniwa and Ozawa, this is a brilliant ensemble comedy that leaves a lasting impression.
title:『赤線地帯』: Commentary: Mizoguchi Kenji's final work. Set in a Yoshiwara brothel in Tokyo on the eve of the abolition of the red-light district, this female ensemble piece depicts the joys and sorrows of women who have drifted there with various circumstances. The nonchalant prostitutes, played by a cast of luxurious actresses, exude a peculiar atmosphere, making this film a one-of-a-kind red-light district story.
title:『近松物語』: A commentary: Osan, the young wife of a Kyoto paper merchant, is suspected of adultery with the clerk Mohei due to a chance incident... Based on a Chikamatsu puppet play, this celebrated film depicts a man and woman who awaken to true love through a life-or-death escape, rendered with rigorous yet flowing brushstrokes. The dignified beauty of Kagawa as Osan is not to be missed.
title:『里見八犬伝』４Ｋデジタル修復版: Kinji Fukasaku directs this adaptation of Toshio Kamata's legendary novel "Shin Satomi Hakkenden," a fresh take on Bakin Takizawa's classic "Nanso Satomi Hakkenden." Starring the glamorous duo Hiroko Yakushimaru and Hiroyuki Sanada, it became a massive hit characteristic of Kadokawa Films, which dominated the era and breathed new life into Japanese cinema. Tamazusa, who once married into the Hikita domain and indulged in debauchery and tyranny before being destroyed by the Satomi clan, returns as a demon queen to exact revenge. She orders her son Motofuji Hikita and his retainers to attack the Satomi's Tateyama Castle. The Satomi clan is annihilated, but Princess Shizu and a few retainers escape, pursued by Tamazusa's forces. The eight warriors, each possessing a jewel inscribed with one of the virtues—benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom, loyalty, faith, filial piety, and brotherly love—scattered from Princess Fuse's body, live their separate lives. Guided by fate, they gather around Princess Shizu and rise to battle, aiming to crush Tamazusa's ambitions.
title:『野性の証明』４Ｋデジタル修復版: A massacre occurs deep in the Tohoku mountains, killing most of a village's residents. A self-defense force special unit member, Misawa, who was training in the mountains, happens upon the scene, kills the perpetrator, and rescues the sole survivor—a village girl named Yoriko. Later, after retiring, Misawa adopts Yoriko and works as an insurance salesperson. One day, he rescues a female journalist named Tomoko from an attacker, but she is being targeted because she tried to expose the corruption of a local businessman, Oba. Meanwhile, Detective Kitano, who suspects Misawa of being the massacre killer, continues to shadow him.
title:『雑居家族』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: Depicts the affection-filled daily life of a female writer living under one roof with children and lodgers to whom she is not related by blood. This film is an adaptation of a novel based on the personal experiences of the original author, Sakae Tsuboi.
title:『雨月物語』: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.
title:『雪之丞変化』４Ｋデジタル修復版: This adaptation of the same-named period novel by Otaguro Mikami was scripted by Daisuke Ito and Teinosuke Kinugasa, with a screenplay by Natsuto Wada, and directed by Kon Ichikawa. Kazuo Hasegawa, who starred in the 1935 version, again plays the dual roles of Yukinojo Nakamura and Yami Taro. The cast also includes Fujiko Yamamoto, Ayako Wakao, Raizo Ichikawa, and Shintaro Katsu, among other luminaries. This film commemorates Hasegawa's 300th appearance. In Edo, Yukinojo Nakamura, a female-role actor of Kamigata kabuki performing in the city, spots Sanzai Tsuchibe and Kaimiya, the men who framed his father on false charges and drove him to suicide. Sanzai's daughter, Namiji, falls in love with Yukinojo, and he uses her to avenge his father. Kawaguchiya, who had been hoarding rice during the Edo famine, is thwarted by Kaimiya—instigated by Yukinojo—and goes bankrupt, after which Kaimiya sets fire to his shop. Enraged, Kaimiya strangles Kawaguchiya but is stabbed by Namiji, whom he had tried to abduct.
title:『雪夫人絵図』 ＊デジタル上映: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.
title:『青春怪談』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: A young businessman (Mihashi) and an aspiring ballerina (Kitahara) are engaged, but as their marriage arrangements progress, they are drawn into a series of strange occurrences. A sophisticated romantic ensemble drama featuring a star-studded cast. Ashikawa delivers a brilliant, eccentric performance as a peculiar young beauty who harbors feelings for Kitahara!
title:『風船』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: The story of a man who abandoned his dream of becoming a painter to achieve success as a businessman, and his family. Ashikawa plays the role of the youngest daughter, who remains bright and brave despite suffering from a serious illness. Discovered by Yuzo Kawashima during her time at Shochiku, this film marks Ashikawa's first collaboration with the director since moving to Nikkatsu. The costumes by Hanae Mori are also stunning.
title:『骨までしゃぶる』: In the late Meiji period, a poor farmer's daughter is sold as a prostitute to the Suzaki pleasure quarters. A fierce masterpiece of women's cinema by Tai Kato, depicting the sorrow and resilience of women exploited to the bone.
title:『麻雀放浪記』４Ｋデジタル修復版: In Ueno just after Japan's defeat in the war. One day, a young man named Tetsu unexpectedly runs into Joshu Tora, who once taught him how to gamble. Led by Tora into the Chinchiro slums, Tetsu bets his last bit of money on a game run by Dosa Ken, a professional gambler. He wins a considerable amount, but most of it is taken by Dosa Ken as a coaching fee.
title:『黒い十人の女』４Ｋデジタル修復版: A black comedy directed by Kon Ichikawa and scripted by Natto Wada, weaving together a philandering man, his wife, and nine lovers. TV producer Matsukichi Kazama, despite having a beautiful wife named Futaba, is cheating with nine women. The wife and lovers are vaguely aware of each other's existence and fully know that Matsukichi is a womanizer, yet for some reason they cannot leave him. One day, the wife and a stage actress lover named Ichiko come up with a plan to kill Matsukichi. It is a fictional scheme meant to vent their frustration with him, but timid Matsukichi becomes convinced that his lovers are trying to kill him and consults his wife. The wife readily admits to the plan and then, to eliminate the lovers, suggests staging a fake murder: they gather the lovers for a meeting to denounce Matsukichi, and at that gathering, pretend to shoot him dead with a pistol.
title:『黒い家』: Director Morita Yoshimitsu, known for '39 Criminal Law Article 39,' adapts the novel of the same name by Kishi Yusuke, which won the 4th Japan Horror Novel Award. Wakatsuki Shinji, who works at an insurance company, encounters the hanged body of a woman's son when he visits her home to explain insurance payouts. The police rule it a suicide, and the insurance money is paid out accordingly. However, sensing something suspicious in the parents' attitude, Wakatsuki begins his own investigation, doubting the suicide verdict. Gradually, the couple's abnormal behavior concerning the insurance money comes to light.
title:【20分シネマ】あいつのロシェル:
Winner of the Best Short Film Award at the 2025 New Zealand Screen Awards. Reckless young Mac decides to give his late friend's beat-up car, "Rochelle," one last moment in the spotlight. He heads to the local junk car race. At first his friends are exasperated, but soon they are moved by Mac's dream and begin to cheer him on in earnest...

title:【クロード・シャブロル傑作選】不貞の女: Praised by many critics and hailed not only as one of Chabrol's best works but also as his own greatest confidence piece. Charles, an executive at an insurance company, lives happily with his wife Hélène and son, but one day discovers that Hélène is having an affair with a writer named Pegala. Visiting Pegala's house, Charles initially maintains his composure, but gradually succumbs to rage... A masterpiece thriller capturing Agnès Varda's 'Happiness', Jacques Demy's 'The Umbrellas of Cherbourg', and the sophisticated visual beauty of Jean Rabier, who shot all three films including this one, along with performances by renowned actors, exquisitely delicate psychological portrayal, and startling violence. (1969) *All films screened in digitally remastered versions.
title:【クロード・シャブロル傑作選】女鹿: Centering on the intense and mysterious relationship between two women—one dominant, one submissive, almost like doppelgängers—this masterpiece from Chabrol's 'peak period' exudes a powerful allure with the film itself baring love and hatred. One day, Frédérique, a bourgeois woman, spots Hoïe, a girl drawing on the pavement of the Pont des Arts bridge over the Seine. Hoïe comes to live at Frédérique's mansion and is drawn to Paul, a guest, but Paul also has a relationship with Frédérique... A sensual work filled with the complex and ambiguous hearts of women. In this film, Stéphane Audran, who was already Chabrol's wife, co-stars with her former husband Jean-Louis Trintignant. (1968) *All films screened in digitally remastered versions.
title:【ジョン・ヒューストン特集】アフリカの女: Master filmmaker John Huston, known for 'The Maltese Falcon,' adapts the classic adventure novel of the same name by British author C.S. Forester. Africa during World War I. Rose, a British woman, is engaged in missionary work with her brother Samuel, a clergyman, but their village is attacked by German forces, and Samuel dies from the shock. Left alone, Rose is rescued by Charlie, who delivers supplies and mail to the village, and boards his ramshackle steamboat, the 'African Queen.' Charlie had planned to take a break from work until the war ended, but is reluctantly persuaded by the vengeful Rose, and the two of them set out to strike back at the Germans. Humphrey Bogart, of 'Casablanca' and 'The Maltese Falcon,' gives a memorable performance as the rough-hewn captain Charlie, a complete departure from his usual hard-boiled image, winning the Academy Award for Best Actor at the 24th Academy Awards in 1952. Katharine Hepburn, of 'Guess Who's Coming to Dinner' and 'The Philadelphia Story,' plays Rose. In 1990, the tumultuous behind-the-scenes story of this film's production was itself dramatized in 'White Hunter Black Heart,' directed by and starring Clint Eastwood.
title:【未体験2026】クラーケン 深海の怪物:
The state-of-the-art Russian submarine *Ataman Yermak* vanishes without a trace during a top-secret mission in the Greenland Sea. On board is a highly classified weapon capable of deciding the fate of the nation. Entrusted with the search and rescue operation, Captain Viktor Voronin of the *Zapolyarye* sets out to prevent the weapon from falling into the wrong hands and to rescue the crew—including his own brother, the missing vessel's captain. However, deep within the abyss of the Arctic Ocean, the legendary monster Kraken has awakened. What began as a national crisis soon escalates into a desperate struggle between humanity and the ruler of the deep.

[What is the Kraken?]
A giant sea creature of Norse legend said to inhabit the waters near Norway and Greenland. Taking the form of a massive octopus or squid, it was feared by sailors as a monster capable of sinking entire ships.

With no way to call for help in the deep mountains, Jonas and Gabi use their wits to fight back with traps set around the cabin. title:【未体験2026】ワールド・ブレイカー:
One day, the sky split open, and the world collapsed. From the rift, otherworldly "Breakers" descended upon humanity. Civilization fell, leaving the few remaining survivors to endure days of terror in a desolate wasteland. After the men lost their war against the invaders, the fate of humanity was entrusted to the women... Taking up the sword as the captain of this female vanguard is Milla Jovovich, the iconic action star of the *Resident Evil* franchise. In this film, she portrays a powerful mother confronting an otherworldly threat, her overwhelming presence and masterful swordplay signaling the triumphant return of the ultimate "warrior woman." Combined with a moving human drama exploring the bonds of family with her husband (played by Luke Evans) and daughter, an epic sci-fi survival spectacle is born!

title:【未体験2026】小さな目撃者:
"Believe me! Everyone's going to be killed!!"

Starring Mark Lester of *Melody* (1971). An ultra-hard suspense thriller with zero mercy and tension levels pushed to the absolute max!!

While it follows the classic premise of a boy witnessing a presidential assassination and being targeted by the killers, this unique film delivers a speedy and powerful impact that belies its 45-year-old origins. Infused with a touch of horror and violence as those around the protagonist are picked off one by one, the film is packed with extreme motorcycle and car chases.

Starring Mark Lester from the smash hit *Melody* (1971) and Susan George from *Straw Dogs*. Directed by the visionary John Hough (*The Legend of Hell House*, *Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry*).

11-year-old Ziggy is a "boy who cried wolf" with a wild imagination. He is spending the summer with his sister Pippa at their grandfather's lighthouse on a Mediterranean island. One day, the two head into town to watch a parade welcoming a foreign president. Ziggy enters a nearby building alone and heads to an upper floor to get a better view of the festivities.

Shortly after the parade begins, the president is shot by a sniper. Ziggy locks eyes with the assassin in the adjacent room. Now the sole witness, he tries to tell his sister and Tom about the assassination, but because of his reputation for telling tall tales, no one believes him. Meanwhile, the assassins—disguised as police officers—begin eliminating everyone who has crossed paths with Ziggy as they close in on the boy...

title:あなたならどうする？ 人生を決める 百万ドルのキス: To reclaim her cherished family home, Van reluctantly follows a plan devised by her sister Kieu and best friend Tien to get close to two wealthy heirs pursuing her. One is a man of calm, mature charm and warmth; the other is young, bold, and a playboy. But just as Van realizes her true feelings, she discovers that both men had their own hidden motives for approaching her. Which one will ultimately receive Van’s "million-dollar kiss"?
title:あなたならどうする？ 人生を決める百万ドルのキス: A massive hit released in Vietnam in 2025, drawing approximately 2.56 million viewers and earning around 1.2 billion yen at the box office, ranking among the country's top 10 highest-grossing films of all time. Its universal themes of love, money, family, and life choices resonated with audiences across generations. To reclaim a lost family home filled with memories, Van reluctantly follows a plan devised by her sister Kieu and best friend Thien, approaching two wealthy suitors who are pursuing her. One is a man with calm, mature charm and warmth. The other is young, unconventional, and a playboy. Van eventually discovers her true feelings, but also learns that both men have their own hidden motives for approaching her. Thu Tran, who has been active as a Vietnamese actor and producer, makes her directorial debut while also starring and producing.

title:あなたを偲ぶ旅: Screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:あのとき: Amidst a landscape of lush nature, a woman walks with single-minded intensity toward a destination. When she pauses and closes her eyes, the days spent with her daughter return to her in vivid detail. Interweaving documentary footage of the director raising her own child with a fictional narrative, this hybrid film is a quiet meditation on what it means to live in the now.
title:あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。: The sequel and conclusion to the 2023 blockbuster 'Till We Meet Again on the Lily Hill', a live-action adaptation of Shiomi Natsue's best-selling novel, which depicted the poignant love between a high school girl who time-travels from the present to 1945 and a kamikaze pilot. Based on the sequel novel 'I Want to Meet You Again on That Starry Hill', it follows the story of Yuri, the protagonist, after she wakes up in the present day, having lost her beloved in a senseless manner. Seven years have passed since her parting with Akira, the kamikaze pilot. Yuri has become a high school teacher, a dream of Akira's, and leads a busy life, but her heart remains left behind on that lily-covered hill in 1945. A young man named Ryo, who bears a resemblance to Akira, appears before her. He is a temporary teacher assigned as the deputy homeroom teacher for Yuri's class. Yuri is swayed by Ryo's straightforward affection, but she cannot bring herself to embrace a new love, feeling it would betray Akira. Amidst her inner conflict, Yuri meets Chiyo, an elderly woman spending her peaceful final days in a hospice. It's another form of love that Chiyo walked after losing Ishimaru. And what Chiyo entrusts to Yuri is a book left by Akira just before his sortie, addressed to the future Yuri. The cast reunites members from the previous film, including Fukuhara Haru as Yuri, Deguchi Natsuki, and Ito Kentaro. Additionally, Hosoda Kanata plays Ryo, the young man with Akira's likeness, and Baisho Chieko plays the elderly Chiyo. Directed by Niinobe Katsuhiko of '366 Days', with the theme song performed by Fukuyama Masaharu, continuing from the previous film.
title:あの鷹巣町の その後: A documentary exploring "what happened next" in Takanosu Town, Akita Prefecture, once called Japan's number one welfare town. Under Mayor Toru Iwakawa, who took office in 1991, Takanosu built a high level of elderly welfare. However, when Iwakawa suffered a major defeat in the 2003 mayoral election, the new mayor, who claimed the town had "gone too far with welfare," drastically shifted the town's welfare policies. Director Sumiko Haneda, who had been covering Takanosu Town for over a decade, captures the town's astonishing changes and highlights various issues facing Japanese welfare.
title:あぶない刑事フォーエヴァー THE MOVIE: Yokohama Port Police detectives Takayama and Oshita, a duo, once arrest Jojima, a member of the internationally wanted terrorist group 'NET,' but Jojima escapes from the police hospital, and the detectives pursue him. One day, an incident occurs where Jojima and his comrades attack a transport vehicle carrying firearms seized by the police, attempting to steal the weapons. Ignoring orders to stay off the case, Takayama and Oshita return to the scene, thwarting Jojima's gang's scheme, but the group's leader Date is advancing an even larger plan.
title:ある子供: 18-year-old Sonia (Déborah François) and 20-year-old Bruno (Jérémie Renier) have a son. After returning from the hospital, Sonia asks Bruno, who has no steady job and lives day-to-day through shady dealings, to get serious about working.

title:あゝひめゆりの塔: A war drama depicting the tragedy of the 'Himeyuri Student Corps,' mobilized as nursing staff during the Battle of Okinawa at the end of the Pacific War. Director Toshio Masuda brings together Nikkatsu's golden couple Sayuri Yoshinaga and Mitsuo Hamada to adapt Keiichiro Ishino's novel of the same name. In 1943, in Okinawa, still untouched by the shadow of war, Yonamine Kazuko, a student at the Okinawa Normal School for Girls, enjoys a sports day with her classmates and meets Nishizato Junichiro, a student from the men's normal school. By 1944, the war situation worsens. As Okinawa itself is about to become a battlefield, Kazuko and Junichiro, now engaged in building fortifications, begin to develop feelings for each other. Soon, Saipan falls. Kazuko's mother Hatsu, an elementary school teacher, boards a transport ship to accompany the schoolchildren who have been ordered to evacuate to the mainland, but the ship is sunk and she never returns. In October, the air raids finally begin. A state of total emergency is declared across the island. Female students are sent to the Haebaru Army Hospital as temporary nurses, while male students join the army as part of the Blood and Iron Student Corps.
title:あゝ特別攻撃隊: A war film depicting the fleeting youth of kamikaze pilots who perished in vain at the end of the Pacific War. This is the directorial debut of Yoshio Inoue, based on a script by Kimiyuki Hasegawa (known for "The Squirrel and the American: Gunshot in the Ruins"). Yoshio Inoue was born in Tokyo in 1926, graduated from Urawa High School's humanities track, joined Daiei in February 1938, and studied under Seiji Hisamatsu, Kon Ichikawa, and Yasuzo Masumura. Cinematography by Toru Watanabe (known for "The White Path Across the River").
title:いしぶみ: A theatrical release version re-edited from a special 70th post-war anniversary program broadcast on Hiroshima TV in August 2015. It reveals the portraits of 321 first-year students of the former Hiroshima Prefectural Hiroshima Second Middle School, who lost their lives in the atomic bombing and for whom a memorial stone was erected along the Motokawa River, based on the writings of their bereaved families. While building on a reading drama broadcast on the same station in 1969, composed by Matsuyama Zenzo, it adds original elements such as projection performances using wooden boxes and interview footage by Ikezawa Akira.
title:いってらっしゃいの花: A fantastical human drama themed around "accepting the death of a loved one," depicting a woman who returns to the world as a ghost after losing her life. Ayaka, who dies suddenly at a young age, wakes up in a "waiting room" that connects the afterlife and the living world. Told by a male guide she meets there that she has a grace period to return to the world, she becomes a ghost and visits her father, her best friend Chiaki, and her fiancé Sota, but no one notices her presence. As Ayaka wishes to exchange words with them just one more time, and Chiaki and Sota are consumed by grief, each reflects on the past and their feelings. Directed, written, and edited by Rei Shiina (known for "Gradation" and "Koko Igai no Dokoka e"), with cinematography by Akira Kawachi (known for "Fear of Missing Out"). Starring Ao Morimoto as Ayaka, Rei Fukuda as Chiaki, and Django Yamada as Sota, with supporting roles by Yusuke Sunaga, Takehiko Fujita, and Ikko Konatsu. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Jūsan Shitamachi Film Festival.
title:いのちのかたち 画家・絵本作家 いせひでこ: This documentary follows the four-year creative journey of painter and picture book author Hideko Ise, who sensed "life" in the fallen trees left behind in the areas devastated by the Great East Japan Earthquake. In Watari, Miyagi Prefecture, where 300 lives were lost, the village of Yoshidahama—once famous for its beautiful coastline—was left in ruins by the tsunami. Though Ise initially found herself unable to paint in the disaster zone, facing a single black pine tree remaining in Watari moved her to naturally pick up her sketchbook and begin to draw. The film is directed by Shinichi Ise, who has crafted numerous human documentaries capturing the essence of daily life, including *The Shape of Wind*, *It’s Okay*, and *Beside: A Journey from March 11*.
title:いろは:
Twenty-two-year-old Iroha lives at home, dissatisfied with her current self and facing an uncertain future. One day, her older sister Karen returns for the first time in five years. Karen is free-spirited and lives for romance—a woman who, unlike Iroha, has always made bold choices in life. But the reality she carries with her is this: "I'm pregnant. But I don't know who the father is."

There are three possibilities: a wealthy heir, an older man with a violent streak, and an ex-boyfriend burdened by debt. In each relationship, there remains an ambiguity that falls short of being called "love." Why does Karen keep repeating romances she knows will only end in pain? Dragged along on the search for the father, Iroha travels across Nagasaki Prefecture with her sister, witnessing the loneliness and the desperate need for validation that lie beneath the surface of romance.

The sister who seemed so strong was, in truth, longing to be loved more than anyone else. Contrary to her glamorous exterior, she had been constantly entrusting her self-worth to others. At the same time, Iroha realizes that she herself had been running away from being hurt by avoiding love altogether.

More important than being chosen by someone else is acknowledging yourself. Before being loved by another, you must accept yourself. Clashing and baring their true feelings, the sisters finally come to understand each other's weaknesses. Carrying their love without answers and their own imperfect selves... the sisters' journey continues.
title:うずまき: "Hey, want to run away with me?" Kirie Goshima is bewildered by the sudden confession from her childhood boyfriend, Shuichi Saito. Lately, Shuichi has been acting listless, as if terrified of something, and Kirie has been worried about him. Eventually, triggered by the incident of a student at Kirie's high school jumping to death from a spiral staircase, Shuichi utters something horrifying. He claims that their town, Kurozu-cho, is possessed by an unknown force of "spirals." Afterward, when Shuichi's father, Toshio, dies a mysterious death, ominous and bizarre spiral phenomena begin to occur one after another around the two of them.
title:うたうひと: The third part of the Tohoku documentary trilogy co-directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi ('PASSION') and Ko Sakai ('Home Sweet Home'). Following the first two works that collected dialogues of Great East Japan Earthquake survivors, this documentary records folk tales passed down in the Tohoku region. With folk tale researcher Kazuko Ono as the listener, three storytellers with richly inflected dialects perform their tales. The unique atmosphere that arises between storyteller and listener is brought to the screen through creative camerawork.
title:えんとこの歌 寝たきり歌人・遠藤滋: This documentary captures the life of Shigeru Endo, who, despite being confined to his bed by cerebral palsy, interacts with young caregivers and composes numerous tanka poems from his bedside. The film is directed by Shinichi Ise, a friend of Endo since their student days, who previously helmed the 1999 documentary *Entoko*, which also followed Endo’s daily life. Despite his physical limitations, Endo organized his own caregiver network called "Entoko" (meaning both "where Endo is" and "a place of connections"). As his disability progressed over more than 35 years in bed, Endo began writing tanka in his late 50s, using poetry to give voice to the cries of his soul. Through the deep emotional connection between Endo and his caregivers, the film portrays people living in a way that honors and sustains life exactly as it is.
title:おいしい結婚: Mieko, a widow running a pawnshop, tries to arrange a favorable marriage for her only daughter Non, but Non pretends to be in a relationship with her coworker Kawata to avoid it. However, the two unexpectedly fall in love and decide to marry for real, only for various incidents to arise between both families surrounding the wedding. This home drama explores what it means to have a happy marriage.
title:おかえりの湯: Produced with full cooperation from the Tokyo Somei Onsen SAKURA hot spring facility, this heartwarming fantasy depicts human connections and renewal set in a hot spring. Directed by Taiichiro Natsume ("First Love Comedian"), the film stars Toru Kazama, with Yuna Hoshino, who gained attention in "Kamen Rider Geats," as the heroine. Sayama, the manager of the hot spring facility, helps a young amnesiac woman named Sakura who has collapsed, and gives her a job at the spa since she has nowhere to go. Sakura's sincere work ethic and mysterious demeanor soothe the guests, bringing a warm atmosphere to the spa. Watching over Sakura, Sayama immerses himself in his hobby of rakugo (traditional comic storytelling), preparing for a performance at the banquet hall. However, on the day before the show, Sakura suddenly disappears. Along with a letter she left behind, Sayama quietly reflects on his time with her as he performs the rakugo piece "Sugagamo no Kitsune" on stage. The cast includes Toru Kazama as Sayama, Yuna Hoshino as Sakura, along with Yuma Ishigaki, Yoji Tanaka, Daisuke Shima, Tamao Sato, Riko Kawase, Mari Irikawa, Sayaka Mizuse, and Kiyoshi Beat.
title:おくりもの: This is the feature debut of 2003 by Michelangelo Frammartino, a solitary and distinctive filmmaker in Italian cinema. Starring the director's grandfather, Angelo Frammartino, it quietly depicts the final days of an old man's life with unique humor, set in a small Calabrian village on the verge of abandonment due to depopulation. An old man lives in a depopulating rural village in southern Italy. One day, young men who help him bury his old dog leave behind a cell phone and a scrap of paper—a nude photo taken for personal purposes. Later, the old man notices a woman in the village; she is the person in the photo. Using no professional actors, filming with local residents, the film creates a quiet visual poem exploring universal themes of "tradition and modernity," "life and death," and "community and solitude." It will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 in a 4K restored version as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."
title:おしり前マン 復活のおしり前帝国: A feature-length animated film by Takashi Taniguchi—who gained fame for his unique independent animations on YouTube—based on his original work, "Oshiri Mae Man." Maejiri, a man whose buttocks are located on the front of his body, is an ordinary salaryman, but his true identity is "Oshiri Mae Man," a hero who protects the peace of the city. One day, a drug called "Shiri-maenare" that moves people's buttocks to the front begins circulating, plunging the town into unprecedented chaos. While investigating the cause, Oshiri Mae Man tracks it back to a certain pharmaceutical company. There, he discovers a document titled "Oshiri Mae Empire Resurrection Plan" and learns of an organization plotting to revive the legendary "Oshiri Mae Empire" to rule over the people. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Oshiri Mae Man resolves to train under his former master, "Oshiri Mae Legend" (the previous Oshiri Mae Man). Just as with his short films, Taniguchi personally handles the majority of the production for this feature-length version, including direction, screenplay, animation, voice acting, and music.
title:おててつないで:
Actor Yuki Sugawara took on a total of 26 roles—including director, screenwriter, producer, cinematographer, and lead actress—to complete this medium-length film. Drawing on over a decade of experience as a bridal photographer and film crew member, Sugawara channels the "regret of failing to be honest with loved ones" she felt after her father’s death into this story of a distorted parent-child relationship, told with a touch of surreal humor.

Yoshihisa Sunaga, a nursing assistant, lives with his 31-year-old daughter, Yui. Their relationship is strained, with Yui maintaining a cold, rebellious attitude toward him. One day, Yoshihisa is fired following a blunder at work. While Yui views the situation with detached optimism, Yoshihisa’s circumstances grow increasingly dire. Though they have lived under the same roof for years, the father and daughter know next to nothing about each other. When Yoshihisa finally reveals a secret to Yui, their lives are forced to change.

Veteran actor Kiyofumi Kaneko, known for the *Midnight Diner* series, stars as the awkward Yoshihisa, while Sugawara herself plays his distant daughter. The film was an official selection for the "A Certain Viewpoint" category at the 26th TAMA NEW WAVE in 2025.
title:おとうと: Set in Mukojima, Tokyo, during the Taisho era. Siblings Gen and Aoiro live with their writer father and stepmother. Gen takes care of Aoiro, covering for their sick stepmother, but Aoiro starts hanging out with a bad crowd. They protect each other at times and have big fights at others, living together as siblings, until Aoiro falls ill with tuberculosis.
title:おばあちゃんの秘密: A home drama set in Tainai City, Niigata Prefecture, depicting a cross-generational connection between a grandmother with a secret longing and her granddaughter. Kamishita Riri, living in Tokyo, visits Tainai City to sort through the belongings of her deceased grandmother, Tokiko, as per her will. Inside the house where Tokiko lived alone after her husband's death, Riri discovers 131 letters exchanged between her grandmother and a man other than her husband. Hurt by her parents' discord, Riri is perplexed by her beloved grandmother's secret but begins to trace her footsteps and memories. The memories of Tainai City and her grandmother's secret slowly melt Riri's heart, and she gradually overcomes her own conflicts. Hidden within is a certain feeling that Tokiko, who entrusted Riri with sorting her belongings, wanted to convey to her. Takei Shizue plays the deceased grandmother Tokiko, vividly embodying the emotional fluctuations of a woman who lived with a hidden love in a realistic manner. Shimada Airisu, known for 'Fish Eye' and 'I'll Come to Parent-Teacher Conference Tomorrow,' freshly portrays the granddaughter Riri, who grows while being perplexed by her grandmother's secret. Imazeki Akiyoshi, known for 'Ren Ren Tofu' and 'Aiko Sixteen,' serves as original creator and director, with Kobayashi Hirotoshi, known for 'Beyond the Starry Sky,' handling the screenplay.
title:おへその大将: Set in a slum along the Hirano River in eastern Osaka. A fine human drama depicting the interactions between the so-called 'Apache tribe,' who make a living by stealing scrap metal, and a town doctor (Frankie) who strives to stand by them. Michiyo Aratama, playing his wife, also delivers a remarkable presence.
title:お別れの歌:
Beyond the goodbye, I found the living present.

People live their lives through birth and meeting, parting and reuniting. Through repeated mistakes and the occasional small miracle, the "precious things" we hold in our hearts grow one by one. Until the day we finally wave goodbye to everything, we live quietly, clutching what is irreplaceable.

The latest film from director Keisuke Shibata, who has steadily built a reputation for noteworthy works. A slapstick rhapsody of
title:お嬢さん: Directed by Park Chan-wook of 'Oldboy' fame, this suspense drama is based on Sarah Waters' novel 'Fingersmith' but transposed to 1930s Japanese-occupied Korea. Sook-hee, a girl raised by a gang of swindlers in a slum, is approached by a con man known as Count Fujiwara with a plan: seduce Lady Hideko, an heiress to a vast fortune, marry her, then commit her to an asylum and steal her wealth. Agreeing to take part, Sook-hee begins working as a maid named Ok-ju at a remote mansion where Hideko lives with her domineering, Japanophile uncle Kouzuki. But as devoted Sook-hee gradually opens Hideko's heart, Sook-hee herself finds herself drawn to the woman she is supposed to betray. Kim Min-hee plays Hideko, while newcomer Kim Tae-ri was cast as Sook-hee through auditions. Ha Jung-woo plays the Count, and Cho Jin-woong plays Uncle Kouzuki.
title:お早よう: In a suburban housing complex, several families live side by side like in a row house. The Hayashi family's sons Minoru (Kōji Shidō) and Isamu (Masahiko Shimazu) beg their parents for a television, but their request is denied. The children go on strike, refusing to speak until their demand is met, and eventually, their parents give in and buy one.
title:お気楽探偵アトレヤ: A film screened at "Indian Movie Week 2020" (September 11 – October 9, 2020, at Kinema Omori / from September 25, 2020, at Shinjuku Piccadilly).
title:お祭りの日:
Director Yuki Horiuchi—who earned high praise at various domestic indie film festivals, including winning the Grand Prix at a student film festival for the dialogue-driven drama *At the End of the Night*, which depicted the end of summer for youths struggling to grow up—returns with an ensemble piece about those who don't go to the festival on the day of a summer celebration.

A man in a coffee shop tries to persuade the school's "Madonna" to star in his independent film. People at a bus stop wait endlessly for a bus that shows no sign of coming. Someone, enraged that the festival's fireworks display was canceled, steals fireworks to set them off themselves. Two girls wake up hungover to find their air conditioner remote missing and search for it while retracing their memories of the night before. A girl works her shift at a cafe. On the day of the festival, the ordinary summer lives of these people who aren't attending begin to intertwine.

The film won the Special Jury Prize at the 24th TAMA NEW WAVE competition. It stars Masahiro Mera, who also appeared in *At the End of the Night*.
title:お笑えない芸人: A fusion of individuality from promising young creators. Directed by Yuka Nishida, a graduate of Kyoto University of the Arts, who now belongs to STARDUST CREATORS as a screenwriter. This film is her graduation project, made when she was 22. It has been nominated for the SKIP City International D-Cinema Festival 2025, the 23rd Ueda Castle Town Film Festival Independent Film Competition, and the 28th Kyoto International Student Film Festival. Lead actor Mao Yoshino passionately plays dual roles: Ichitaro Sahara and his 'ideal self' Sahara. After this film, Yoshino was cast as a main host in 'Love and Rumors Last Seventy-Five Days' (2023, directed by Ririko Shinjo). Satoru Murayama, playing Junji Setoguchi who forms a duo 'Geki Amazu Buta' with Yoshino, portrays his partner while carrying a difficult-to-share secret, and was selected as a main cast member from about 700 applicants for the 2026 film 'Hello My Friend' (2026, directed by Masahide Ichii). Nanami Kitano, playing Sahara's neighbor Suzuka Murii, expresses a delicate distance with Sahara through a transparent performance, and has appeared in many films since. Distribution is handled by GeneHeart, which operates 'GeneTheater,' a streaming service curating only high-quality Japanese short films that stir emotions.
title:お終活3 幸春！人生メモリーズ: The third installment in the human comedy series that explores family dynamics and second chances through the theme of "shukatsu" (end-of-life planning), following "Oshukatsu: Jukushun! Jinsei, Hyakunen Jidai no Sugoshikata" and "Oshukatsu: Saishun! Jinsei Rhapsody." Aya, the eldest daughter of Shinichi and Chikako Ohara, finally decides to marry her fiancé Ryota. However, just before the wedding, a casual remark from Aya causes a rift in their relationship, escalating into a major commotion involving both families. Meanwhile, Shinichi's junior colleague Kato struggles to accept his mother Toyoko's progressing dementia, speaking harshly to her. Chikako gently tells Kato, "Even with dementia, the heart doesn't forget." Continuing from the previous two films, director Hideyuki Kazuki helms this installment, incorporating the latest end-of-life planning trends and knowledge while depicting family bonds with light humor and a warm perspective. The cast reunites familiar faces from the series, including Tsurube Shofukutei as Shinichi Ohara, Junko Takahata as his wife Chikako, Ayame Goriki as their daughter Aya, along with Yuki Matsushita, Masahiko Nishimura, Norika Fujiwara, Renji Ishibashi, Kumiko Fujiyoshi, LiLiCo, Kunikazu Katsumata, and Yoshihiko Hakamada. Guest stars include Keiko Mita as Toyoko, who has dementia, and Fumiyo Kohinata as her son Kato, who supports her despite his own inner conflict.
title:お艶殺し:
A noir romance inspired by Junichiro Tanizaki's 1915 novel *The Murder of Otsuya*. Produced as part of the "TANIZAKI Reimagined" film project commemorating the 140th anniversary of Tanizaki’s birth, the film depicts the warping of love and obsession into violence as a man’s weakness and a woman’s presence become inextricably entwined. 

After serving time for copper wire theft, Shinsuke Abe is released from prison and begins working as a live-in employee at a surveying company. Soon, he is confronted by Santa Tokui, the childhood friend who instigated the crime, and Tsuya Yanagida, Shinsuke’s former lover. Though the theft had been Santa’s idea, Shinsuke had shouldered the full blame and served the sentence alone. While Shinsuke still harbors feelings for Tsuya, she is now involved with Santa. However, their reunion rekindles their mutual attraction, leading them to begin a secret affair behind Santa’s back. Amidst this tension, an irreversible tragedy unfolds.

The film stars Yugo Mikawa (*Cloud*, *Dish Up*), Remi Naoki (TV drama *Sayonara, Teacher*), and Jun Matsuo (*Red Bridge*, *Six Loners*). It is directed by Yoshihiro Tokijo, who previously wrote the screenplay for Toshiki Sato’s *Wandering Bonbon Candy*.
title:お遊さま: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.
title:かもめ食堂: A drama depicting the peaceful daily lives of three Japanese women set in a small restaurant in Helsinki, the capital of Finland. Based on the novel of the same name by author Yōko Mure, adapted and directed by Naoko Ogigami, who gained attention with her feature directorial debut "Barber Yoshino." Japanese woman Sachie opens a small restaurant called "Kamome Diner" on a street corner in Helsinki, but no customers come. One day, Sachie happens to meet a Japanese tourist named Midori and asks her to help out at the restaurant. Soon, a variety of colorful characters start coming to Sachie's shop one after another... Satomi Kobayashi, Hairi Katagiri, and Masako Motai play the three Japanese women, with Markku Peltola from "The Man Without a Past" co-starring.
title:きっと青春大革命！カルラ8年の記録: A documentary by transgender director Kani Lapuerta, recording eight years in the life of a transgender elementary school student in Mexico as she grows into a teenager. In Tepoztlán, a town south of Mexico City, 15-year-old Carla talks with director Kani Lapuerta in a secret cocoon. They discuss what kind of film they want to make, and begin to look back on Carla's life chronologically from her elementary school days. The schoolyard where she couldn't line up with either the 'boys' or 'girls,' the bedroom where she endlessly practiced makeup, the morning school reopened during the pandemic, the city hall where she officially changed her name, the slogans she shouted at the Pride March, and the baton club she admired. Watched over by her punk and hippie chef parents, her friends, director Lapuerta, the queer community, and the sacred rocky mountain, Carla encounters various versions of herself. Director Kani Lapuerta also appears in the film, gradually sharing her inner thoughts with Carla like an exchange diary. With comedic touches, it portrays the struggles and fluctuations of adolescence growing up in a small town with strong gender stereotypes.
title:きれっぱしの愛: In a small rural town in Iceland, artist Anna lives with her responsible eldest daughter Ida, her mischievous twin sons Grímur and Þorgils, and her dog Panda, while searching for her path as an artist. Though she married young and is supposedly "no longer a couple" with her ex-husband Magnús, he can't seem to cut ties, constantly finding excuses to visit, share meals, and even join picnics. Before she knows it, they slip back into a daily life as if they were "still a family"—but what comes next?
title:きれっぱしの愛［上映後ｲﾍﾞﾝﾄ］: In a small rural town in Iceland, artist Anna lives with her responsible eldest daughter Ida, her mischievous twin sons Grímur and Þorgils, and her dog Panda, while searching for her path as an artist. Though she married young and is supposedly "no longer a couple" with her ex-husband Magnús, he can't seem to cut ties, constantly finding excuses to visit, share meals, and even join picnics. Before she knows it, they slip back into a daily life as if they were "still a family"—but what comes next?
title:ぐるりのこと。: "Unforgettable masterpieces" return to the screen! Since his directorial debut with "A Touch of Fever" (1993), Ryosuke Hashiguchi—known as a "master of few works" eagerly awaited by film fans both in Japan and abroad—has delivered acclaimed films including "Like Grains of Sand" (1995), which won the Grand Prix at the 25th Rotterdam International Film Festival; "Three Stories of Love" (2015), which swept various film awards including the Kinema Junpo Best Ten Japanese Films No. 1; and his latest work "Motherhood" (2024), released nine years after "Three Stories of Love." "Hush!" depicts a gay couple and a woman—three people who had given up on connecting with others—forming a "new kind of family." "All Around Us" portrays the hope that arises between people through ten years in the life of a married couple. Both films are often cited as "all-time best films" and are known as "unforgettable masterpieces." Now, these two works will be revived in 4K remastered versions! "All Around Us" returns 18 years after its June 2008 release, while "Hush!" returns 25 years after its production in 2001 (released April 2002)—a full quarter-century later. "All Around Us" follows a wife who falls into depression due to her overly serious nature and her husband, a courtroom sketch artist who supports her, tracing their inseparable bond over ten years against the backdrop of various shocking events from the 1990s. The film was screened in the Panorama section of the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival.
