title:プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー: A film adaptation of the bestselling science fiction novel by Andy Weir, author of "The Martian" (the basis for the Oscar-nominated "The Martian"). It depicts a middle school science teacher entrusted with the fate of Earth on the brink of extinction, who encounters an unknown life form with the same purpose at the edge of the universe, and together they risk their lives to save their home planets. An unexplained anomaly occurs where the sun's energy is being drained. If this continues, Earth will freeze and humanity will perish. It is discovered that the same phenomenon is happening not only to the sun but to countless stars scattered across the universe, and a single intact star is found 11.9 light-years away. Humanity's only remaining option is to travel to that star in a spaceship and solve the mystery to save the sun and humanity. Sent into space for this "Hail Mary" project is Grace, a brilliant scientist who left academia and now works as a humble middle school teacher. Alone in the vastness of space far from Earth, he relies on his scientific knowledge to tackle the mission, where he meets Rocky, an alien also struggling to save his home planet. Despite their different forms and languages, the two use science as a common language to face challenges, developing a friendship along the way. Ryan Gosling of "La La Land" and "Barbie" plays the protagonist middle school teacher Grace, with Sandra Hüller of "Anatomy of a Fall" and "The Zone of Interest" co-starring. Drew Goddard, who also worked on "The Martian," wrote the screenplay, and Phil Lord & Christopher Miller, known for producing and writing the "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse" series, directed.
title:ヘブンズベル:
A suspense-action film from director Kyoji Kamui, who continues to define a hard-boiled worldview in works like "Moonlight Diner" and "7WAYS." Triggered by a family massacre 20 years ago, the story depicts the intersecting fates of those seeking the lost truth within a lawless zone known as "Area 4."

Natsumi was only ten years old when she survived the massacre two decades prior. Aside from her, the only other survivor was a "third man" whose existence was officially erased, while the two perpetrators met mysterious deaths. Twenty years later, the adult Natsumi receives a photograph from an anonymous sender. Guided by clues written on the back, she heads to the extraterritorial city of Area 4. Meanwhile, Rinka, a woman working for a dark organization, is tasked with collecting slush funds using hired convicts. However, she is betrayed by the organization and finds herself marked for death. Rescued by escaped prisoners Yabuki and Fujikawa, Rinka enters Area 4—the site of the transaction—to launder the stolen cash.

The film stars Chiaki Hiratsuka, a regular in Kamui’s films since "Smoky and Bitter." She is joined by fellow regular Miko Nakagawa and Kazunari Moriwaki (formerly of the duo "Saruganseki"). Furthermore, reflecting Director Kamui’s own history of appearing in special effects (tokusatsu) dramas, the cast features a lineup of genre veterans, including Shiro Izumi (Kyoryu Sentai Zyuranger), Yasuhiro Ishiwata (Choushinsei Flashman), Matsuri Kamizato (Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger), Eri Tanaka (Kamen Rider Kuuga), and suit actors Kazutoshi Yokoyama and Ryoko Gomi.
title:ベイビー・ブローカー: A road movie that won two awards at the 75th Cannes Film Festival, featuring a Korean production team and cast. Two male brokers who kidnap an infant from a 'baby hatch' and the mother who once abandoned her child. Bound by a strange sense of solidarity, they journey to find adoptive parents, quietly pursued by two female detectives. This film returns to Kore-eda's signature theme of 'quasi-family,' depicting certain hope beyond the moral dilemmas surrounding the salvation of unwanted lives.
title:ベルリン・天使の詩: A masterpiece fantasy film directed by Wim Wenders ('Paris, Texas'), who took the helm in his home country of Germany for the first time in a decade, winning the Best Director award at the 40th Cannes Film Festival in 1987. Set in Berlin before the fall of the Wall, it poetically and beautifully depicts the fate of an angel who falls in love with a human. Damiel, an angel who listens to the inner voices of humans and comforts their sorrows, meets Marion, a trapeze artist performing in a circus. Strongly drawn to her loneliness, Damiel decides to descend from the heavenly realm to the human world. Bruno Ganz stars, and Peter Falk ('Columbo') appears as himself. The screenplay was contributed by Peter Handke, who would later win the Nobel Prize in Literature. A sequel, 'Faraway, So Close!,' was produced in 1993.
title:ベルヴィル・ランデブー: The feature directorial debut of bande dessinée artist and animator Sylvain Chomet, this animated film humorously depicts a grandmother's desperate quest to rescue her kidnapped grandson. Minimizing dialogue and featuring stylized characters on a jaunty jazz-infused soundtrack, this adventure earned high international acclaim, becoming the first French film nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature. The grandmother learns that her shy, lonely grandson, Champion, is interested in bicycles. To help him become a cyclist, the grandmother trains with him, and he eventually grows up to compete in the world's greatest bicycle race, the Tour de France. However, during the race, Champion is kidnapped by mysterious figures. The grandmother sets off on an adventure with her loyal dog Bruno to rescue her kidnapped grandson. With the help of three legendary triplet musician old ladies, and armed with her life experience, wisdom, and humor, she overcomes numerous obstacles. Besides Best Animated Feature, the film was also nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Song. In Japan, it was praised by Isao Takahata of Studio Ghibli and was first released in theaters in 2004. A revival screening was held in 2021 as a pre-20th anniversary project.
title:ペパーミント・キャンディー: A human drama that traces twenty years in the life of a man against the backdrop of modern Korean history, winning five major awards including Best Picture at the Grand Bell Awards, South Korea's equivalent of the Oscars. This is the second feature film by director Lee Chang-dong, made in 1999, known for "Oasis" and "Secret Sunshine." Spring, 1999. Kim Yeong-ho, at the depths of despair after losing his job and family, shows up at a picnic with old friends wearing an out-of-place suit. It is the same place he visited twenty years earlier with his first love, Sunim. Standing on the railroad tracks, Yeong-ho shouts "I want to go back!" at an oncoming train, and his life begins to rewind. We see his self-destructed marriage to his wife Hong-ja, his love for Sunim that drew them together but was never fulfilled, and the Gwangju Uprising he witnessed as a soldier. Yeong-ho's journey through memory eventually arrives at the time twenty years ago when his life was most beautiful and pure. The film was released in a 4K-restored digital remaster in 2019 to coincide with the release of Lee Chang-dong's "Burning." A 4K restoration was also screened in 2023 as part of the special retrospective "Lee Chang-dong Retrospective 4K."
title:ペリカン・ブルー 自由への切符（チケット）: An animated film that visualizes an astonishing true story from 1990s Hungary in Eastern Europe, incorporating documentary materials. In 1990s Hungary, after the fall of the Iron Curtain opened the door to Western Europe, foreign travel was liberalized, and many people turned their eyes to the outside world. However, international train tickets were expensive and out of reach for ordinary people. Amidst this, three young men—intellectual Akos, fearless Pecha, and swimming enthusiast Laci—find a way to forge tickets. They dissolve the blue carbon ink "Pelikan Blue" from the company Pelikan, used on the tickets, with household detergent and rewrite the destinations. After enjoying overseas trips with forged tickets, they decide to distribute "tickets to freedom" to other young people in similar situations. The plan seems to go smoothly, but eventually, a police investigation begins, escalating into a major uproar that shakes the nation. Directed by László Csáki, known for his distinctive animation style, who conducted meticulous research over ten years and blends documentary materials like archival footage and interview audio with hand-drawn animation.
title:ペンギン・ハイウェイ: An animated film adaptation of the novel that won the Japan SF Award, written by popular author Tomihiko Morimi, known for works like "The Night is Short, Walk on Girl" and "The Eccentric Family." This is the first feature-length film from Studio Colorido, the studio behind the shorts "Shiranpuri" and "Typhoon Noruda." It is directed by the emerging talent Hiroyasu Ishida (of "Shiranpuri" fame), with character designs by Yojiro Arai ("Typhoon Noruda"). Aoyama-kun, a studious fourth grader who diligently records everything he learns in a notebook, is close friends with the young woman at his dental clinic. She, in turn, dotes on the slightly cheeky and precocious Aoyama-kun. One day, a penguin suddenly appears in their residential town, which has no ocean nearby. Why would a penguin show up in a mere housing district? Aoyama-kun begins his research to solve the mystery, but then witnesses the young woman's discarded cola can transform into a penguin. Kana Kita, known for the TV drama "Byplayers," voices Aoyama-kun in her voice acting debut, while Yu Aoi, who has voice acting experience in "Tekkonkinkreet" and "The Case of Hana & Alice," plays the role of the young woman.
title:ホッテントットエプロン-スケッチ: An unconventional fantasy directed by Kei Shichiri, known for "Sleeping Princess" and "Marriage Ring." It follows a girl's inner journey through fantastical imagery, completely devoid of dialogue. Rika is a girl with an ugly birthmark in a hidden place. One day, she sees a piper in a mouse-colored hood and, drawn by his melody, wanders into a mysterious world. The heroine is played by Yuko Akune from "Heart and Body." The music is composed by Hidetoshi Wabi, who has long collaborated with director Shichiri.
title:ホームワーク: A documentary by internationally acclaimed Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami ('Where Is the Friend's Home?'), focusing on homework and school education. Feeling that Iranian children are always overwhelmed by homework, Kiarostami himself acts as interviewer, asking elementary school students and their parents a series of questions about 'homework.' Through the interviews, the complex family circumstances of each child emerge, revealing the problems within Iran's education system. Kiarostami vividly captures the children's diverse expressions and words while sounding an alarm to society. A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program 'And Kiarostami Continues' (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title:ホールディング・リアット: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.
title:ボタニスト 植物を愛する少年:
Set in a remote village in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, this drama chronicles the coming-of-age of a boy who converses with plants, told through a lens of poetic visual beauty. In a small village nestled in the grasslands of northern Xinjiang, Arsin, a Kazakh boy living with his grandmother, spends his days observing and documenting plant life, earning him the nickname "The Botanist." For him, plants are more than just nature; they represent a worldview passed down by his missing uncle. One day, a Han Chinese girl named Meiyu arrives in the village. Her bright, free-spirited presence brings change to Arsin’s quiet life, but when she eventually leaves for Shanghai, Arsin is forced to confront his solitude once again. As reality and fantasy begin to blur, Arsin gradually discovers what it is he has truly been searching for.

Director Jin Yi, a native of Xinjiang, makes his feature debut with this film, drawing on his own childhood memories to create a unique cinematic world infused with magical realism. The cast features non-professional actors, including Yesul Jasere as Arsin, while the score was composed by the internationally acclaimed Iranian composer Peyman Yazdanian. The film was awarded the Grand Prix of the International Jury in the Generation Kplus competition at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.
title:ボヘミアン・ラプソディ: A biographical drama depicting Freddie Mercury, the vocalist of the world-famous rock band Queen, who passed away in 1991 at the young age of 45. Queen's current members Brian May and Roger Taylor served as music producers, and the film's soundtrack primarily uses Freddie's own vocals. It recreates the moments of birth of classics like "Bohemian Rhapsody" and "We Will Rock You," as well as legendary performances in music history such as the stunning performance at "Live Aid," the largest charity concert of the 20th century, while also portraying the untold stories behind his glamorous career. Rami Malek, known for "Night at the Museum," delivers a passionate performance as Freddie. Bryan Singer, known for the "X-Men" series, is credited as director, but he left during production, and Dexter Fletcher, known for "Sunshine on Leith" and "Eddie the Eagle," completed the film, handling the remaining shooting and post-production. Despite the production troubles, it was embraced by audiences worldwide, and in Japan, it became a massive hit, surpassing 13 billion yen at the box office, the highest for a film released in 2018. It won Best Motion Picture – Drama and Best Actor – Drama at the 76th Golden Globe Awards. It was nominated for five Academy Awards at the 91st Academy Awards, including Best Picture, and won four, including Best Actor.
title:ボーイズ・ゴー・トゥ・ジュピター:
Acclaimed by media worldwide! "A memorable masterpiece," "A wonderfully chaotic experience."

Set in Florida as the end of the year approaches, Billy is a teenage high school dropout who spends his days chatting with friends or working a food delivery gig. This is the story of his desperate struggle to earn $5,000 and change his life. From encounters with strange creatures to being tossed about by suspicious rumors surrounding a famous corporation, Billy is forced to make difficult choices regarding love, friendship, and money amidst a series of completely unpredictable twists and turns.
title:ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール: The feature debut of French maverick Leos Carax, released in 1983. It depicts the encounter of two lonely souls wandering through the Paris night in beautiful black-and-white imagery, winning the Youth Prize at the 37th Cannes Film Festival and generating buzz at festivals worldwide. Alex, a young man whose best friend stole his girlfriend, has a fateful encounter with Mireille, a woman who just fought with her lover. Alex falls in love with Mireille at first sight, but they soon meet with an unexpected tragedy. The roles of Alex and Mireille were played by then-newcomers Denis Lavant and Mireille Perrier. The protagonist Alex, played by Lavant, later reappeared in transformed forms in 'Bad Blood' and 'The Lovers on the Bridge', forming what is known as the 'Alex Trilogy' along with this film. Jean-Yves Escoffier handled the cinematography and continued as cinematographer for the subsequent two films. In Japan, it was first theatrically released in July 1988, following the release of 'Bad Blood' in February of the same year. A 4K restored version was re-released in January 2026.

title:ポカポン: Living in poverty, bothered by noisy neighbors. Frustrated with an absurd reality, middle school student Kenta struggles to support his mother Asako and younger brother Yuji. And then there's the mysterious "pokapon" sound echoing around him. Watching over this family quietly is the housing complex manager, Shunichi. Eventually, Kenta and Shunichi begin to understand each other, but rumors start to circulate that the perpetrator of a series of child murders that once shocked the nation is hiding in this housing complex...
title:ポゼッション（1980）: Polish maverick Andrzej Żuławski's absurdist thriller starring Isabelle Adjani, known for "The Story of Adele H." Set in West Berlin's suburbs. Mark returns home after a work assignment to his wife Anna, but finds her strangely distant. Learning from Anna's friend Margie about another man, Mark confronts his wife, but she not only denies the affair but completely rejects him. One day, after dropping off their son Bob at school, Mark meets Helen, a teacher who is Anna's exact double. Mark eventually meets Anna's lover Heinrich, but he too doesn't know everything about Anna. Mark hires a private detective to tail Anna to investigate a mysterious "third man." Starring Sam Neill of "The Piano" as Mark. Won Best Actress at the 34th Cannes Film Festival (1981) and the 7th César Awards, among others. Theatrically released in Japan in 1988. An HD remastered version was re-released in January 2020 to commemorate the 40th anniversary of its production.
title:ポパイ・ザ・スレイヤー・マン: A horror film based on the popular cartoon character 'Popeye,' created by American cartoonist Elzie Crisler Segar in 1929. Produced after the original copyright expired in January 2025, entering the public domain, it depicts the righteous sailor Popeye awakening as a brutal murderer, armed with his familiar can of spinach and powerful forearms. College student Dexter is making a documentary about a local legend in a small port town: a sailor who wanders the docks every night in search of prey. One night, Dexter brings along Olivia, whom he has long had a crush on, and their friends to sneak into an abandoned factory near the port for investigation. As they proceed in a somewhat playful mood, the smell of pipe tobacco begins to drift from somewhere, and soon the legendary sailor emerges from the darkness. As his companions are brutally killed one after another, Dexter and Olivia desperately flee, following clues left in the factory to uncover the sailor's true identity.
title:ポルノスター: Kamijo struggles to scrape together tribute money for the yakuza while harboring ambitions of one day surpassing them. Then, a man named Koya appears—a man who kills yakuza without so much as a flicker of expression. Koya fills a sports bag with knives and goes around stabbing anyone who calls himself a yakuza, one after another.
title:ポーラX: The fourth feature film by French wunderkind Leos Carax, released eight years after 'The Lovers on the Bridge.' An adaptation of the novel 'Pierre' by 19th-century American author Herman Melville, written the year after his masterpiece 'Moby-Dick.' Shifting the setting to modern-day Paris, it uses emotional imagery and sound to depict the intense, racing love of a man and woman swept up by fate and drawn into despair. Pierre, a young novelist living in a Norman castle, enjoys a wealthy, contented rural life with his mother Marie and fiancée Lucie. One day, Isabelle, a Bosnian refugee claiming to be Pierre's half-sister, appears. Drawn to Isabelle's charm, Pierre abandons everything and heads to Paris with her. Guillaume Depardieu, son of Gérard Depardieu, passionately plays Pierre, and Katerina Golubeva, known for 'Paris at Night,' plays Isabelle. Catherine Deneuve co-stars as Pierre's mother Marie. Cinematography is by Éric Gautier, known for 'My King,' and music is by singer-songwriter Scott Walker. A 4K restored version will be re-released in February 2026.
title:ポール・マッカートニー：マン・オン・ザ・ラン:
For the one-day-only global theatrical release on February 19, it has been confirmed that an exclusive special conversation between Paul McCartney and director Morgan Neville will be shown as a theater-exclusive bonus! Experience this rare music documentary, featuring many of Paul McCartney and Wings' most iconic songs, on the big screen.

After the breakup of the Beatles, the most important rock band in history, what path did Paul McCartney choose?

*Paul McCartney: Man on the Run* is the latest documentary that traces Paul McCartney’s journey as he forged a new path by forming Wings with his wife Linda following the dissolution of the Beatles, told from an unprecedentedly personal and intimate perspective. Academy, Emmy, and Grammy Award-winning director Morgan Neville meticulously follows the trajectory of Paul’s creative rebirth—producing works that would define a new decade while facing numerous challenges and conflicts—to reveal sides of his story that have never been told before.
title:マイ・ブラザーズ・ウェディング: A director's cut, completed in 2007 through re-editing, of Charles Burnett's second feature film from 1983. Burnett, an influential figure in American independent cinema who consistently depicts the daily lives and humanity of African Americans, presents a tragicomedy of a working-class young man torn between family, friendship, and identity. It quietly reveals class differences within the Black community, psychological gaps between generations, and the frustration of young people left behind by social success, all from the gaps in everyday life. Pierce, a 30-year-old helping his parents run their dry-cleaning shop, drifts aimlessly through his days with no clear future. His childhood friends are either in prison or already dead. When his brother, a lawyer, marries a woman from a wealthy family, Pierce's discomfort and feelings of inferiority grow. Around this time, Pierce reunites with his best friend Soldier, just released from prison, and finds himself caught between his sense of duty to his family and his loyalty to his friend, forced to make a choice. In Japan, this 4K restored version will have its theatrical premiere at the special screening series 'Charles Burnett: Everyday Blues' (from February 7, 2026, at Theater Image Forum).
title:マイ・プライベート・アイダホ: A youth road movie directed early in the career of Gus Van Sant, one of American cinema's leading masters, and notable for the collaboration of River Phoenix and Keanu Reeves. Mike, who suffers from narcolepsy and suddenly loses consciousness when tense, was abandoned by his mother at age 12 and left his hometown of Idaho to live on the streets of Portland, selling his body. Scott, raised without want as the son of Portland's mayor, grew disgusted with his superficial family and ran away from home. After meeting on the streets, the two head to Mike's hometown of Idaho to search for his missing mother, but eventually their paths diverge. River Phoenix, who played Mike, won the Volpi Cup (Best Actor) at the 48th Venice International Film Festival. The film is inspired by William Shakespeare's plays "Henry IV, Part 1," "Henry IV, Part 2," and "Henry V."
title:マイ・リトル・クイーンズ: Set in Peru in the early 1990s, a bittersweet yet humorous drama about a last summer spent together by an estranged father and his teenage daughters. In Lima, the capital of Peru under the Alberto Fujimori administration, with the domestic situation unstable, mother Elena decides to move with her daughters Aurora and Lucia to Minnesota in the United States, where she has stable work. Their departure is scheduled for three weeks later, but for the daughters to leave the country, they need the signature of their father, former husband Carlos, on a travel consent form. Carlos works as a taxi driver, but tells passengers his real profession is acting, and spins fabrications to friends about being in the import business. To his daughters, whom he meets again after a long time, he claims he was bitten by a crocodile in the jungle or boasts that he is actually a spy. At Aurora's request, the three father and daughters head to the seaside for the summer and spend their limited time together. A few days later, after arguing with her mother, Aurora goes with Lucia to search for her father in the city center, where a curfew has been imposed. Director Claudia Reynike, who herself left Peru at age 10 to live abroad, made this film while confronting her own roots. It won the Grand Prize in the Generation KPlus section, which targets works for children and young people, at the 74th Berlin International Film Festival in 2024.
title:マザーズキングダム: A psychological drama that portrays with quiet tension the collapse of the family "kingdom" alongside a mother's dementia-induced confusion of memory. Interweaving themes of memory, lies, faith, and truth, it depicts the anxiety and disintegration lurking within the human psyche. Gyeong-hui, living a peaceful life as a hairdresser, begins to show signs of early-onset dementia. Meanwhile, her son Ji-uk, who works as a writer, sustains himself through his book "The Power of Truth," but fragmented words spoken by his mother force him to confront forgotten memories of the past. Furthermore, the presence of his uncle, Pastor Jeong-myeong, brings to light secrets sleeping within the family and truths concerning faith. Starring Nam Gi-ae, Han Ki-jang, and Yoo Seong-ju. Screened in the competition section of the 2024 Jeonju International Film Festival. Released theatrically as part of the "Hangeul New Wave Film Festival 2026," a special screening of Korean indie genre films.
title:マジカル・シークレット・ツアー: A crime drama about three women who have drifted through life, who deepen their bond through gold smuggling and reclaim their respective lives. Director Chihiro Amano ("Mrs. Noisy") was inspired by a real 2017 incident in which housewives were arrested for gold smuggling at Chubu Centrair International Airport. She co-wrote the original script with Madoka Kumagai, with whom she also worked on "Sato-san and Sato-san." Large-scale location shooting was conducted in Singapore, depicting the glamorous yet perilous journey of gold smuggling. Wakako, a mother of two living a peaceful life, learns that her husband has been fired from his company for embezzlement. To pay off her husband's debts, she becomes involved in gold smuggling in Singapore, where she meets Kiyoe, a non-regular researcher struggling with student loan repayments, and Mayu, an unmarried pregnant woman with zero savings. After successfully smuggling gold and getting a taste for it, the three decide to start smuggling on their own. For the first time, they gain money, freedom, and the joy of living authentically, spending a magical time together—but... Kasumi Arimura plays Wakako, the mother of two who learns of her husband's embezzlement; Haru Kuroki plays Kiyoe, the indebted researcher; Sara Minami plays Mayu, the unmarried pregnant woman; Akihisa Shiono plays Wakako's husband Takashi; Yuzu Aoki plays Kiyoe's colleague Shiina; and Takumi Saito plays Takashi's boss Tanoue.
title:マジンガーZ 対 暗黒大将軍: A theatrical version of the TV anime "Mazinger Z," featuring a piloted giant robot as the protagonist. Director Nobutaka Nishizawa heightened the drama by entrusting the robot with the protagonist's worries and pain, depicting the invincible Mazinger Z fighting while battered and broken. The surprise appearance of the successor Great Mazinger, ahead of the TV series, astonished children. "Mazinger Z" achieved strong revenue from merchandise licensing, sparking a trend of incorporating merchandising into projects from the planning stage onward.

title:マスター 先生が来る！: Starring Indian superstar Vijay, known for "Bigil" and "Jilla," this action drama follows an unconventional teacher who confronts a ruthless gang to reform delinquent youths. JD, a professor at a prestigious university, is popular among his students for his toughness and proactive nature. However, after a riot breaks out during a student union election he advocated for, he is forced to take responsibility and resign. JD then takes up a new post at a juvenile detention center in a provincial town, only to find the facility controlled by a local gangster named Bhavani, creating a wretched environment where the boys are mired in crime and violence. JD stands up to fight for the boys' reformation. Vijay stars as JD, with acclaimed actor Vijay Sethupathi playing the role of Bhavani. The film is directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, the director of "Kaithi."
title:マスターズ・オブ・ユニバース: A new live-action film adaptation of the popular "Masters of the Universe" series, based on the action figures created by Mattel in 1981, which have been expanded across comics, animation, and other media, and previously adapted into the 1987 live-action film "Masters of the Universe" starring Dolph Lundgren. Prince Adam of the planet Eternia is sent to Earth as a child to protect him from war, and grows up hiding his identity. Fifteen years later, guided by the legendary Power Sword he accidentally discovers, he returns to his homeworld and learns that Eternia is under the control of his archenemy Skeletor. To save Eternia and its people, Adam transforms into the warrior He-Man and plunges into a deadly battle against the forces of evil. Directed by Travis Knight ("Bumblebee", "Kubo and the Two Strings"), with a screenplay by Chris Butler ("Missing Link"). Nicholas Galitzine, who has gained attention for roles in "Red, White & Royal Blue" and "The Idea of You", plays the lead role of Adam/He-Man. Camila Mendes ("The Revenge Swap", "Upgraded") plays the warrior Teela, who fights alongside He-Man; Jared Leto ("Tron: Ares") plays the villain Skeletor; and Idris Elba plays Man-At-Arms, a father figure to He-Man, in a star-studded cast.
title:マダム・ソワ・セヴェンヌ: This documentary captures the revival in Japan of "Cévennes," the legendary Rococo-era silk said to have been loved by Marie Antoinette, after 300 years. Renowned as the world’s most beautiful silk, Cévennes is characterized by a divine whiteness, a rich luster, and a nature that is both light and strong. To carry its tradition and techniques into the future, the film spent three years documenting the efforts of Japanese and French sericulturists, silk reelers, weavers, dyers, researchers, and global fashion houses at the forefront of the silk industry. While exploring the current state of Japanese sericulture—once the highest quality in the world—and incorporating international perspectives, the film vividly portrays the artisans' handiwork and the brilliant colors achieved through natural dyes. The film is directed by Koichi Sato ("The Red Dye Maker," "The Best Cinema in the World"). Narration is provided by Kabuki actor and Living National Treasure Bando Tamasaburo, who possesses deep knowledge of Nishijin-ori and Tango Chirimen.
title:マテリアリスト 結婚の条件: A love story directed and written by Celine Song of 'Past Lives,' set in the modern marriage market, depicting a love triangle with beautiful imagery. Lucy, a matchmaker at a New York dating agency, is a professional at matching clients' high ideals and detailed conditions, and a materialist who judges love not only by emotion but also by asset value. Leading a busy, work-focused life, she receives a passionate approach from Harry, a wealthy investor she meets at the wedding of a couple she matched. Meanwhile, at the same reception, Lucy reunites with her ex-boyfriend John, who was working as a waiter. They had loved each other, but she couldn't endure the poor life with John, who was drifting between part-time jobs while pursuing his dream of becoming an actor. Lucy begins a relationship with Harry, who is perfect in family background, personality, and education, but her feelings for John, who hasn't given up on his dream, are rekindled. When a client gets involved in an incident, Lucy finds herself at a crossroads in both work and love. Dakota Johnson of the 'Fifty Shades' series plays protagonist Lucy, Chris Evans of the 'Captain America' series plays struggling actor John, and Pedro Pascal of 'Welcome to Eddington' plays investor Harry.

title:マリアの沈黙: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:マリー・メンケン／マージョリー・ケラー作品集: Marie Menken (1910–1970) was a key figure of the New York underground who exerted a profound influence on the style of Jonas Mekas. Marjorie Keller (1950–1994) was described by film critic J. Hoberman as "the avant-garde’s most selfless champion." This program features a collection of their short films, which, after years of limited visibility, have been brought back to life through restoration by the Anthology Film Archives.
title:マルグリット・デュラスのアガタ: French writer Marguerite Duras, known for 'The Lover,' adapts her own book 'The Malady of Death / Agatha' into a film. Set in a dilapidated seaside hotel, this experimental work depicts the forbidden love between a brother and sister through lyrical imagery and Duras's own narration. Agatha, reuniting with her brother after eight months at the winter seaside villa Villa Agatha, decides to leave the next morning and part from him forever. The two reminisce about their forbidden love. The brother is played by Yann Andréa, Duras's lover who was 38 years her junior. In Japan, the film had its first theatrical release in 2003, 23 years after its 1981 release. It was re-released in 2012.
title:マルジェラが語る“マルタン・マルジェラ”【再上映】: Martin Margiela is a designer who has constantly challenged the aesthetic values of the era and continued to deconstruct the very concept of clothing. Throughout his career, he never appeared in public, refused all interviews and photographs, and maintained a steadfast anonymity. Director Reiner Holzemer (*Dries Van Noten: Dog, Flowers and Fabric*) won the trust of the seemingly impenetrable Margiela. Under the condition that it was "only for this documentary," Margiela reveals private records for the first time—including drawings, extensive notes, and Barbie doll clothes he made at the age of seven. From the influence of his dressmaker grandmother and his time as Jean-Paul Gaultier’s assistant to the birth of the iconic Tabi boots, his appointment as a designer for the global luxury brand Hermès, and his sudden retirement at age 51—Margiela himself speaks before the camera about the career and creativity he has never discussed before, resulting in an invaluable documentary.
title:マルセル 靴をはいた小さな貝: A talked-about film that adapts short films sequentially released by amateur filmmaker Dean Fleischer-Camp into a feature-length movie. It depicts the adventures of Marcel, a small shell, in a mockumentary style combining live-action and stop-motion animation.
title:マーク・アントニー: This Indian sci-fi action film comically and eccentrically depicts a gangster's son who obtains a phone that allows him to talk to people in the past and tries to rewrite fate. In 1975, mad scientist Chiranjeevi invents a telephone that can call people in the past. Using it, he can avert disasters about to befall his past self or loved ones, or make choices that lead to profit. However, Chiranjeevi gets caught in a gang war at a bar while celebrating, and the phone goes missing. Twenty years later, auto mechanic Mark stumbles upon the phone and learns its special abilities and how to use it. This phone eventually sparks a massive upheaval involving Mark's foster father, gang boss Jackie; Jackie's son Madan; and Mark's deceased father, Antony. In Japan, Vishal plays dual roles as mechanic Mark and his gangster father Antony, while S. J. Surya, known for "Jigarthanda Double X," co-stars as Antony's partner Jackie.
title:マーターズ:
Pain and salvation. Rejection and worship. Despair, and then ecstasy. The world's fastest theatrical release—you will become a "witness" to film history. Since its French release in 2008, 'Martyrs' has sparked controversy with its brutally intense depictions, while leading audiences to an unpredictable conclusion that borders on the sublime, igniting fierce debate worldwide. The pinnacle of the "French horror" movement that dominated an era, and the masterpiece of the eccentric genius director Pascal Laugier, now revived in the Reiwa era with a 4K digital remaster in the world's fastest theatrical release. The origin of Laugier's consistent portrayal of women with the conviction to face despair, this film pushes terror and philosophical depth to their absolute limits, venturing into realms beyond human comprehension. Even 18 years later, it remains undimmed, continuing to exert immense influence on contemporary French filmmakers including Coralie Fargeat's 'The Substance' and Julia Ducournau's 'TITANE'. What awaits beyond the pain swirling with conflicting emotions is an unknown realm no other film has ever reached. *Please note: This theater will screen the 2K version.
France in the early 1970s. A missing girl named Lucie is found wandering the streets, battered and emaciated. She had been imprisoned, tortured, and abused by someone for a long time, and escaped on her own. However, there were no signs of sexual abuse, and the motive for the crime remained unknown... 15 years later, one morning, a doorbell suddenly rings at a peaceful family home surrounded by forest. When the homeowner opens the door, Lucie (Mylène Jampanoï) stands there with a hunting rifle. Convinced she has finally found the person who abused her, she pulls the trigger of revenge. Anna (Morjana Alaoui), Lucie's best friend, receives a phone call from her and rushes to the house, turning away in horror at the carnage. The two set about disposing of the bodies and preparing to leave. But then, they are confronted with an unimaginable truth.
Admission: General/Student/Senior 1,700 yen, HC discount 1,000 yen. *Other discounts, various invitation and courtesy tickets, and T-tickets cannot be used.

title:マーダレス: Screened at "EU Film Days 2026" (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:マーティ・シュプリーム: A drama starring Timothée Chalamet, set in 1950s New York, inspired by the life of real-life table tennis player Marty Reisman. Marty Mauser, who dreams of becoming the world's number one table tennis player in America where the sport has low popularity, works at a relative's shoe store to raise funds to participate in the World Championships. After losing to Japanese player Endo at the World Championships held in London, Marty aims to compete in the next World Championships in Japan. With his mistress Rachel pregnant, his player eligibility revoked by the table tennis association, and his funds running out, Marty tries every possible way to raise money for the trip... Gwyneth Paltrow plays Kay, a retired famous actress; Grammy-winning artist Tyler Okonma, known as Tyler, The Creator, plays Marty's friend; Odessa A'zion plays Marty's girlfriend; Kevin O'Leary plays Milton, Kay's husband and president of an ink company; and Japanese Deaflympics table tennis representative Kōto Kawaguchi plays Japanese player Endo. Directed by Josh Safdie ("Uncut Gems," "Good Time"), the film was nominated for nine Academy Awards at the 98th ceremony, including Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actor.

Portuguese filmmaker Miguel Gomes continues to pursue a unique, poetic cinematic world through a style that effortlessly transcends the boundaries between fantasy and reality, documentary and fiction. His early masterpieces will be screened on a daily rotating basis.

title:ミステリアス・スキン: A youth drama depicting the fates of two boys deeply scarred by childhood sexual abuse. Based on the novel "Mysterious Skin" by Scott Heim, which draws from his own experiences, the film was directed and written by Gregg Araki of "The Doom Generation." In the small Kansas town of Hutchinson. In the summer of 1981, 8-year-old Brian and Neil, teammates on a Little League team, have their lives drastically warped by their coach, who habitually sexually abuses children. Brian, suffering from psychological shock, loses his memory and is plagued by aftereffects, becoming convinced he was abducted by aliens. Neil, on the other hand, believes there was "love" between him and the coach, and spends his life selling his body to older men while searching for a shadow of the coach. Brian, trying to recover his lost memories, discovers that the boy who repeatedly appears in his dreams is Neil... A pre-breakout Joseph Gordon-Levitt plays Neil, and Brady Corbet, who later became a director known for "The Brutalist," plays Brian. The film was not released in Japanese theaters for a long time, finally premiering in April 2025.
title:ミックスモダン: A human drama about a young man who could only feel himself through committing crimes, and how he finds meaning in life through his encounter with a couple running an okonomiyaki restaurant. Directed and written by Toshizo Fujiwara, who has acted in films such as "A Scene at the Sea," the film was selected for the Panorama section of the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025. Hiroyuki and Sonoko Kiuchi, a couple running an okonomiyaki shop, hire former prisoners and juvenile detention center graduates to help them reintegrate into society. However, since an incident involving a former employee a year ago, they have been plagued by online harassment. During an interview at a juvenile detention center, the Kiuchis meet 18-year-old Yuto Nishimura, who pleads to start his life over, and they hire him as a new employee. Yuto begins working earnestly, but after a certain event, he reconnects with his old friends and becomes strongly drawn to Yukiha, a dancer he meets at a club. The script was written based on extensive research at various sites, including an okonomiyaki shop in Osaka that actually supports the employment of former prisoners and juvenile detainees, and incorporates Fujiwara's own experiences. Daiki Ido stars in his first leading role as Yuto, Fujiwara plays Hiroyuki, Rino Tsuneishi plays Sonoko, with supporting roles by Tomoko Fujita and Jiei Kabira.
title:ミニオンズ＆モンスターズ: The third installment in the 'Minions' animated film series, an adventure comedy featuring the popular characters born from Illumination's 'Despicable Me' franchise as the main protagonists. The Minions, continuing their quest for the most powerful and evil boss, arrive in Hollywood, the city of dreams. Getting into a movie studio by chance, they eagerly decide to make their own monster movie and attempt to summon a real monster. The first to appear is an unexpectedly small green monster, but soon, extremely dangerous monsters are unleashed upon the city one after another, throwing Hollywood into chaos. Adding to the mayhem, a rift forms among the Minions themselves, putting them in an unprecedented crisis. Directed by Pierre Coffin, known for the 'Minions' and 'Despicable Me' series. The screenplay is co-written by Brian Lynch, who worked on Illumination's 'Pets' series, and Coffin. In the Japanese dub, Matsudaira Ken voices film director Max, Chiba Yudai voices the new boss candidate Dott, Suzuki Airi voices Debbie, who falls in love with Dott, and Yamadera Koichi voices the mysterious monster Goomy. Comedy duo 'Batterys' members Ace and Ie are cast as the unique monsters Phillips and Howard, marking their voice acting debut. Additionally, singer LiSA joins the dub cast as a Hollywood actress.
title:ミラクル7号: Ti, who lost his wife to illness, works at a construction site to send his only son Dicky to a prestigious private elementary school. While retrieving a pair of sneakers Dicky wanted from the garbage dump, Ti finds a green ball. Dicky begins keeping the creature (or is it an object of unknown nature?) that is born from the ball Ti brought home, naming it Miracle 7.
title:ムカデ人間: Dr. Josef Heiter, a German who was once a renowned surgeon for separating conjoined twins, harbors a secret desire to do the opposite of his previous operations: to connect a human's mouth to another's anus and create a "Human Centipede." One day, two American women traveling, Lindsay and Jenny, get a flat tire while driving and seek help at Dr. Heiter's house. To fulfill his desire, Heiter welcomes the unsuspecting pair warmly and begins work on creating a human centipede, adding Katsuro, a Japanese man he had already captured, to the mix.

This collection of animated works has caused a quiet stir within the editorial department of *Mu*, long-time observers of the world’s mysteries. The works of Shoji Kohara present questions that may truly exist on the flip side of reality, delivered in the form of stories. Unexplained voids. A sense of unease where meaning remains fluid. A sensation that sparks deep speculation within the viewer. This program features a comprehensive screening of "liminal" animations—from past works to the latest—that resonate deeply with the interests of *Mu*. After the experience, the way you see the world may shift, if only slightly.

An omnibus collection of short animations by Director Seiji Ohara, who has earned high acclaim both in Japan and abroad for his hand-drawn works and unique worldview. Produced between 2011 and 2025 in collaboration with "Mu"—a cultural magazine dedicated to exploring the mysterious and the unknown—the collection features six films centered on enigmatic themes.

title:メイン・テーマ: Ogasawara Shibuki meets Daito Shima Ken, who is training in magic, and decides to go on a trip in his car. Shibuki's destination is Osaka, and Ken's is Okinawa. The two don't get along and argue constantly during the trip. In Hamamatsu, Ken's uncle has a magic show, and Shibuki ends up helping out. However, during the show, Ken meets with a jazz singer named Ise Masayo. Seeing Ken so smitten with Masayo, Shibuki feels jealous. The car arrives in Osaka, and the two part ways. But Shibuki can't stop thinking about Ken and sets off for Okinawa, where her sister and brother-in-law live.
title:メモリィズ: Starring Tasuku Emoto, this drama explores themes of family memory and records. Yuta, who lives with his wife and daughter in Tokyo, travels to a rural town in Kyushu to care for his father-in-law Makoto, who has broken his leg, until he recovers. While helping out at Makoto's old-fashioned photo studio, Yuta exchanges videos taken on his smartphone with his wife and daughter back in Tokyo. Even without major events, the accumulation of daily trivial records and memories quietly and vividly reveals the long span of a family's life. Moka Kamishiraishi ("Shōgun," "Girl Encounters") plays Yuta's wife Yuki, who continues working and raising their child in Tokyo. Issey Ogata plays Makoto, the taciturn father-in-law, and Yū Kashii plays a character symbolizing precious family memories. Director Miu Sakanishi, who gained attention for short films while at Kyoto University of Art and Design and later worked as an assistant director for Yūya Ishii and a making-of cameraman for Yūichirō Doi, makes her feature-length directorial debut.
title:メモリードア: A human drama that portrays the pure love between a woman facing early-onset dementia and a young man who has lived his life obeying his parents, while incorporating social themes such as dementia, young caregivers, and human dignity. Kazuya, a 27-year-old office worker, is a so-called obedient child who always listens to his parents. He lives a stable life meeting their expectations, but feels a sense of emptiness somewhere in his heart. One day, he happens to visit a "dementia café" and meets Reiko, a woman 20 years his senior. Despite suffering from early-onset dementia, Reiko's smile lights up those around her, and Kazuya is captivated. Witnessing Reiko facing her loneliness, he is drawn to her strength and human vulnerability. This encounter frees Kazuya from the rails laid by his parents, and for the first time in his life, he discovers true love. Directed and written by Etsuo Kato, whose 2023 film "Three Souls" was screened and won awards at numerous film festivals including the Tanabe-Benkei Film Festival. Minehiro Kinomoto and Shinobu Tsuji, who also appeared in "Three Souls," play Kazuya and Reiko respectively. Winner of the Grand Prix at the 20th Nakajima Film Festival.
title:メリリー・ウィー・ロール・アロング: A filmed recording of the Broadway musical 'Merrily We Roll Along,' which won four Tony Awards, screened in theaters. Based on the play of the same name by George S. Kaufman and Moss Hart, this musical, which premiered in 1981, features music by the legendary Stephen Sondheim, creator of numerous masterpieces including 'Sweeney Todd.' The story depicts the tumultuous 30-year relationship between Frank, a successful Hollywood producer; Mary, a former best-selling author; and Charlie, a Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright, told in reverse chronological order. This recording captures the 2023–24 Broadway production starring Maria Friedman, which was a huge hit. Jonathan Groff, known for the Netflix series 'Mindhunter' and as the voice of Kristoff in Disney's 'Frozen,' plays producer Frank; Daniel Radcliffe of the 'Harry Potter' series plays playwright Charlie; and Lindsay Mendez, a veteran of numerous Broadway musicals, plays former best-selling author Mary. At the 2024 Tony Awards, the production won Best Revival of a Musical, Best Actor in a Musical (Jonathan Groff), Best Featured Actor in a Musical (Daniel Radcliffe), and Best Orchestrations.
title:メレディス・モンク 踊る声、歌う身体: A documentary exploring the creative life of 83-year-old legendary New York-based artist Meredith Monk. Living in a TriBeCa loft with a turtle, the woman with trademark braids, Meredith Monk, was born on November 20, 1942, and raised in New York. She has worked as a composer, singer, director, choreographer, and performance artist creating various music-theatre works, films, and installations, influencing many musicians. A pioneer of contemporary artistic expression, she treats her voice—spanning over three octaves—as an instrument, continuously pursuing original, genre-transcending expression. The film weaves together extensive archival footage of Monk's stage and performance works with interviews from admirers like Björk and David Byrne, connecting fragments of her 60-year career like a concept album to depict her unique expression and life. It highlights her strong, resilient, and charming persona, having started her career in the male-dominated 1960s and continued her own path despite occasional critical scorn.

title:メロスたち: This is the sequel to the 2022 documentary "Run! Run Run Melos," which followed four high school students in Shimane Prefecture as they discovered the joy of performing on stage. The drama club at the Kakeya Branch of Shimane Prefectural Mitoya High School had earned unexpectedly high praise for their original play "Run! Run Run Melos," based on Osamu Dazai’s classic novel "Run, Melos!" Since then, their advisor Mr. Yoshihiro Kameo, who first guided them into the world of theater, has transferred to another school, and the four members have moved into their final year of high school. As they each begin to decide on their future paths, Shogo Sota finds himself standing alone on stage at the Chugoku regional drama competition. The film captures the individual choices of the four students as they face graduation, grappling with loneliness, conflict, and anxiety. It also features footage of their March 2023 reunion just before graduation, where they performed a show titled "Graduation Ceremony" before large audiences in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo, and Matsue, Shimane.
title:メロディがいた季節: A documentary capturing Mark Lester and Tracy Hyde—stars of the 1971 British coming-of-age masterpiece *Melody*—as they attend fan events in Japan and revisit filming locations near London. In 2022, the Yokohama movie theater Cinema Novecento held a screening event to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the release of *Melody*. In addition to special screenings of *Melody* and the film *Graduation Journey* (which Lester starred in in Japan) using new 35mm prints, fan events featuring Lester
title:モアナと伝説の海: A musical adventure that is a live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated feature 'Moana', which follows the journey of a young girl named Moana who shares a special bond with the ocean as she sets out on an adventure to save the world. On the mystical South Pacific island of Motunui, 16-year-old Moana, who loves the ocean and her people more than anyone and was raised as the pride of her family, is told by her grandmother Tala the truth of the legend passed down on the island and her destiny. With an evil darkness approaching, Moana, entrusted with a mission as 'the one chosen by the ocean', sets sail on a small canoe across the vast ocean to find the legendary hero Maui and return the heart of the goddess Te Fiti. The role of Moana is played by newcomer Australian actress Catherine Laga'aia, who showcases a powerful singing voice. The role of the demigod hero Maui is reprised by Dwayne Johnson, who voiced the same role in the animated version. Directed by Thomas Kail, who brought the acclaimed Broadway musical 'Hamilton' to the screen, the film uses the immersive visuals unique to live-action cinema and exquisite music to tell the story.
title:モダン・タイムス: A classic comedy masterpiece by Charles Chaplin, who directed, wrote, produced, composed the music for, and starred in it, offering a scathing satire of industrial civilization and capitalist society. Charlie, working in a large factory, goes mad from performing monotonous tasks with the same machine every day and is sent to a hospital. After being discharged, he is mistaken for the leader of a protest march and imprisoned. When proven innocent and freed, he starts working at a shipyard but is quickly fired, leading him to consider ways to return to prison. Eventually, he is arrested for eating without paying and meets a young girl who stole bread in the police van. The heroine is played by Paulette Goddard, Chaplin's partner at the time. This was the first film in which Chaplin spoke on screen and sang his own composition, "Titina." The famous song "Smile" played during the final scene also leaves a lasting impression.
title:モテキ: One year after the whirlwind of romantic opportunities that came to the penniless and girlfriend-less Yukiyo Fujimoto—his 'Moteki' (sudden popularity with women)—his relationships with the four girls have ended. But new girls begin approaching him again, and a 'Second Moteki' is about to arrive.
title:モディリアーニ！: Paris, 1916. Three tumultuous days that changed the life of the artist Modigliani. While on the run from the police, Modigliani longs to end his career and leave Paris behind. His fellow painters Maurice Utrillo and Chaïm Soutine, as well as his muse Beatrice Hastings, attempt to dissuade him. He seeks counsel from his friend and art dealer Léopold Zborowski, but his mind remains in turmoil. Ultimately, he meets Maurice Gangnat, a collector who will change the course of his life forever.
title:モブ子の恋: Director Taichi Kazama, known for the TV drama "Silent," adapts manga artist Akari Tamura's comic into a live-action film, a love story about the first crushes of "supporting characters" who have quietly lived on the fringes of society. Shy and reserved college student Nobuko Tanaka identifies with the term "mob," meaning crowd, extra, or non-major character, and has lived her life watching from afar as other protagonists shine. Then, she notices Hiroki Irie, a young man working part-time at the same supermarket. Touched by Irie's natural thoughtfulness, Nobuko gradually becomes drawn to him. Through her encounter with Irie, she begins to struggle to break free from the shell that has bound her, and while sometimes confronted with harsh realities, she perseveres with the support of her coworkers. Meanwhile, Irie also notices Nobuko's quiet kindness and looks straight at her. The accumulation of small, everyday moments eventually gives them both the strength to take a step forward. Hiyori Sakurada ("The Diary of a Substitute Lie") plays Nobuko, aka Mobuko, and Taisei Kido ("Yukite Kaeranu") plays Hiroki Irie, the object of her first love. The cast also includes Ikoi Hayase as Nobuko's junior coworker Abe, Erika Karata as senior coworker Shinozaki, Takuya Kusakawa as fellow part-timer and Irie's friend Kaneko, Tsubasa Araki as new part-timer Ono, and Kanji Furutachi as store manager Orihara.
title:モロカイ・バウンド:
The second feature film by director Alika Tengan, a Native Hawaiian with roots in Okinawa, this drama explores the bond between a father and son in modern-day Hawaii. Among the Hawaiian Islands, Molokai remains largely untouched by tourism, a place where pristine nature and traditional culture endure. Kainoa, a Native Hawaiian who left Molokai to live on Oahu, is released on parole after serving time in prison. While struggling with the stigma of being an "ex-con," Kainoa sets out on a difficult path to reconnect with his estranged son, Jonathan, and reclaim his indigenous identity, but...

Based on Tengan’s 2019 short film of the same name, the director himself adapted the story into a feature-length production. The cast, led by Holden Mandrial-Santos as Kainoa, features friends who grew up with Tengan in Hawaii. The film won the Best Made in Hawaii Feature Film Award and the Kau Ka Hōkū Award (Emerging Filmmaker Award) at the 44th Hawaii International Film Festival in 2024, as well as the Pacific Islands Special Award at the 2nd Cinema at Sea: Okinawa Pan-Pacific International Film Festival.
title:モンキービジネス おさるのジョージ著者の大冒険: A documentary about Hans and Margret Rey, the couple who created the beloved children's book series "Curious George," cherished worldwide. Hans and Margret, originally from Hamburg, Germany, were living in Paris and creating children's books when they invented the character Curious George, who would become the protagonist of their future bestseller. When World War II began, the Jewish couple fled Paris on bicycles to escape the Nazi invasion, carrying the original illustrations for "Curious George" with them. After the war, they continued their writing careers in New York, protecting the character of George for the rest of their lives. The film portrays their tumultuous lives using a wealth of archival footage, precious original artwork, and handwritten animation. This is the feature-length directorial debut of Ema Yamazaki, acclaimed in Japan and abroad for works like "Elementary School: A Small Society" and "Koshien: Field of Dreams," completed in 2017. It was released in theaters in 2018 as part of the Shinjuku Cinema Qualite special program "Caricolle 2018 / Qualite Fantastic! Cinema Collection 2018." A Japanese dubbed version with narration by Yuuimi Kawai is scheduled for release in 2026.

title:モンテ・クリスト伯: Alexandre Dumas’ 19th-century masterpiece "The Count of Monte Cristo," a cornerstone of revenge literature also known in Japan as "Gankutsuou," has been adapted into a live-action film in France. Young sailor Edmond Dantès is on the verge of a promotion to captain and an upcoming marriage when he is imprisoned for a crime he did not commit due to a sinister plot. Losing his will to live in the depths of despair, Dantès finds hope again after meeting an old priest planning an escape. The priest provides him with an education and reveals the existence of a hidden treasure belonging to the Knights Templar. Fourteen years after his incarceration, Dantès miraculously escapes, acquires the vast fortune, and finally sets his plan for revenge in motion. Appearing in Parisian high society as the mysterious millionaire "The Count of Monte Cristo," he skillfully closes in on the three men who stole his life. Pierre Niney (*Yves Saint Laurent*) stars, delivering an elegant and delicate performance as the ill-fated avenger Dantès. He is joined by Bastien Bouillon (*The Night of the 12th*), Anaïs Demoustier (*The New Girlfriend*), and Anamaria Vartolomei (*Happening*). At the 50th César Awards in 2025, the film received a year-high 14 nominations and won for Best Production Design and Best Costume Design.
title:モーレツ宇宙海賊 ABYSS OF HYPERSPACE -亜空の深: The theatrical film version of the TV anime "Mouretsu Pirates," which aired from January to June 2012, based on Yuichi Sasamoto's popular SF light novel "Mini-Skirt Space Pirates." Marika Kato, a high school girl who is a legitimate space pirate holding a government-issued "privateer's license," leads a busy life juggling her studies, club activities in the space yacht club, a part-time job at a café, and her role as captain of the space pirate ship "Bentenmaru." One day during spring break, just before she is about to advance to her third year, Marika takes on a pirate business job aboard a luxury liner and meets Kanata Mugen, the son of the renowned subspace diver, Dr. Mugen. The opening theme, following the TV series, is "Mouretsu Uchuu Koukyoukyoku Dainanagakushou 'Mugen no Ai'" by Momoiro Clover Z. The director is Tatsuo Sato, known for "Martian Successor Nadesico."
title:モーレツ宇宙海賊（パイレーツ） ABYSS OF HYPERSPAC: The theatrical film version of the TV anime "Mouretsu Pirates," which aired from January to June 2012, based on Yuichi Sasamoto's popular SF light novel "Mini-Skirt Space Pirates." title:ヤマトタケル 白鳥伝説:
A puppet entertainment film based on the ancient hero Yamato Takeru, who appears in the "Kojiki" and "Nihon Shoki." The story unfolds based on the legend of Yamato Takeru, who, under the orders of the Yamato Court, embarked on an expedition to unify the Japanese archipelago and, after achieving victory, transformed into a white swan and returned to the heavens.

In Habikino City, Osaka, fourth-graders Yuya, Yuri, and Jiro are guided by a white swan soaring through the sky to the Yamato Takeru Shiratori-ryo (Mausoleum). Suddenly, they are enveloped in a dazzling light and transported back in time to an ancient land inhabited by puppets with souls. Now in puppet form, the three children are entrusted with the vital task of safeguarding
title:ヤンヤン 夏の想い出: A family drama by Edward Yang, the master of Taiwanese New Cinema known for 'A Brighter Summer Day' and 'The Terrorizers,' which quietly observes the life changes that befall each member of a five-person family living in Taipei. Yang won the Best Director award at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival in 2000 for this film. Elementary school student Yang-yang lives a comfortable life in a luxury apartment with his father NJ, who runs a computer company, his mother Min-min, his high school sister Ting-ting, and his gentle grandmother. They seem like a picture-perfect happy family, but troubles begin after the wedding of the mother's younger brother. The grandmother falls into a coma from a stroke, the father is shaken by a reunion with his first love, and the mother seeks solace in a new religion. To save his company from bankruptcy, the father travels to Japan to secure a contract with a genius game designer named Ota. Meanwhile, the sister starts dating the boyfriend of her neighbor Li-li... Issey Ogata appears as the game designer Ota. As director Yang passed away in 2007, this became his final completed feature film. A 4K restoration was screened as the opening film of the Cannes Classics section at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.
