title:ロボット・ドリームズ: The first feature-length animated film by Spanish director Pablo Berger, known for 'Blancanieves.' Based on the graphic novel of the same name by American author Sara Varon, it depicts the friendship between a dog and a robot in 1980s New York, where anthropomorphic animals live, entirely without dialogue or narration. In Manhattan, New York. Dog, deeply lonely, builds a robot to be his friend, and they deepen their bond. In summer, Dog and Robot go to the beach, but Robot rusts and becomes immobile. Dog tries everything to repair Robot, but the beach closes for the off-season with Robot left behind, and the two are separated. Nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 96th Academy Awards in 2024.
title:ロルナの祈り: The Dardenne brothers, directors of 'The Son' and 'The Child,' craft a moving human love story centered on an immigrant woman who enters a sham marriage to obtain citizenship. With a bold structure, they suspensefully portray the conflict that arises when unexpected feelings develop within the false marriage, and the protagonist's growing desperation as she is cornered by her inescapable ties to the criminal underworld. Starring newcomer Arta Dobroshi, with Jérémie Renier from 'The Child.' Lorna, a woman from Albania, comes to Belgium. Dreaming of opening a bar with her fellow countryman lover, she enters a sham marriage with a drug-addicted young man, Claudy, arranged by a shady broker, Fabio, to gain citizenship. Initially finding him annoying, Lorna gradually develops special feelings for Claudy as he struggles to quit drugs and earnestly seeks her affection...
title:ロングウォーク: The first-ever film adaptation of Stephen King's first novel, "The Long Walk," written while he was in college in the 1960s and published under the pseudonym Richard Bachman in 1979. In a near-future America divided by war, a national competition called "The Long Walk" is held as a beacon of hope for a struggling society. Fifty selected teenage boys challenge this contest, where the only requirement is to keep walking. The prize is a staggering sum of money and the fulfillment of one wish. The rules are simple: maintain a pace of 4.8 km/h, receive a warning if you slow down, be executed after three warnings, and keep walking until only one person remains. Surrounded by armored vehicles and under the threat of guns, the boys desperately continue walking in extreme conditions with no rest or sleep allowed... Starring Cooper Hoffman ("Licorice Pizza") and David Johnson ("Alien: Romulus") as the young participants, and Mark Hamill ("Star Wars" series) as the Major who oversees the competition. Directed by Francis Lawrence ("The Hunger Games" series) with a screenplay by J.T. Molner ("Strange Darling").
title:ロングウォーク（字幕）: The first-ever film adaptation of Stephen King's first novel, "The Long Walk," written while he was in college in the 1960s and published under the pseudonym Richard Bachman in 1979. In a near-future America divided by war, a national competition called "The Long Walk" is held as a beacon of hope for a struggling society. Fifty selected teenage boys challenge this contest, where the only requirement is to keep walking. The prize is a staggering sum of money and the fulfillment of one wish. The rules are simple: maintain a pace of 4.8 km/h, receive a warning if you slow down, be executed after three warnings, and keep walking until only one person remains. Surrounded by armored vehicles and under the threat of guns, the boys desperately continue walking in extreme conditions with no rest or sleep allowed... Starring Cooper Hoffman ("Licorice Pizza") and David Johnson ("Alien: Romulus") as the young participants, and Mark Hamill ("Star Wars" series) as the Major who oversees the competition. Directed by Francis Lawrence ("The Hunger Games" series) with a screenplay by J.T. Molner ("Strange Darling").
title:ロン・ライス作品集（1）: Ron Rice (1935–1964) passed away at the young age of 29, yet he is regarded as one of the most pivotal figures of 1960s underground cinema for his singular originality. His masterpiece, *The Flower Thief*, captures the sensibility of the Beat Generation in its purest form through cinematography that utilizes American landscapes and improvisational performances. Lead actor Taylor Mead, while active as a poet, appeared in numerous underground films, including those by Andy Warhol. Mead was later symbolically cast in Jim Jarmusch’s *Coffee and Cigarettes* (2003), a film profoundly influenced by these underground works.
title:ロン・ライス作品集（2）: In *Senseless*, a record of a trip to Mexico is poetically woven together, liberated from the constraints of conventional cinematic grammar. Meanwhile, *Chumlum* invites the audience into a fantastical and anti-normative atmosphere through a deluge of images created by multiple exposures and vivid colors. Feeling restricted in his work in the United States due to censorship and unfair undervaluation, Rice moved his base of operations to Mexico, only to die there shortly after. This screening features outtakes from *Chumlum*—including a brief glimpse of a figure resembling Taylor Mead, who was not intended to appear in the final version—alongside unfinished footage shot in Mexico for his next project.
title:ワイズ・ブラッド: A feature film directed in 1979 by John Huston, the master of American cinema who left behind numerous classics such as 'The Maltese Falcon,' 'The Treasure of the Sierra Madre,' and 'The African Queen.' An unconventional drama that adapts the novel 'Wise Blood' by Flannery O'Connor, a leading figure of Southern literature, vividly portraying the unique atmosphere and spirituality of the American South. When young Hazel Motes is discharged from the U.S. Army and returns home, he finds only a wardrobe and a tombstone left in his family home. In a strange city, he begins preaching the 'Church Without Christ' and encounters a motley cast of characters, including a blind preacher, his daughter, and a simple young man. Eventually, Hazel becomes consumed by madness and despair... Brad Dourif, nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for 'One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest,' plays Hazel. The cast also includes Amy Wright, Harry Dean Stanton, and Ned Beatty. Although it was never theatrically released in Japan, it will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 as part of the special screening series 'John Huston 120th Anniversary' commemorating the 120th anniversary of his birth.
title:ワン、ツー、スリー／ラブハント作戦: A slapstick comedy filmed in Germany. McNamara, the head of Coca-Cola's Berlin branch, is tasked by a company executive with babysitting his daughter. However, this girl is a troublesome handful who defies easy handling. The protagonist's mindset of doing anything for career advancement echoes Billy Wilder's previous film "The Apartment." The rapid-fire exchange of gags in the dialogue is quintessentially Wilder. The film also showcases the full comedic charm of James Cagney, who also worked as a director.
title:ワンダフルライフ: A fantasy drama by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "Maborosi" fame, depicting the seven days between death and reaching heaven. Twenty-two deceased people arrive at a facility shrouded in mist. The staff waiting for them instruct them to choose the single most important memory from their lives within the seven days before they go to heaven. Some choose a memory immediately, while others struggle to decide. But the final day, when a screening will be held, steadily approaches. Starring ARATA in his film debut.
title:ワールドクラシック＠シネマ2011 オペラ 「ばらの騎士」 バーデン: One of eight productions in "World Classic @ Cinema 2011," which screens performances from renowned opera houses and ballet companies around the world in movie theaters. This production features Richard Strauss's masterpiece opera, conducted by Thielemann, one of Germany's leading conductors, leading the Munich Philharmonic. It was performed in 2009 at the winter music festival in Baden-Baden, a famous spa town in southwestern Germany.
title:ワールド・ブレイカー: An sci-fi survival action film starring Milla Jovovich of the "Resident Evil" series and Luke Evans from the live-action "Beauty and the Beast." In the year 20XX, invaders from another world descend upon Earth. With governments and militaries collapsed, the few remaining survivors live in constant terror across a desolate wasteland. After the men are defeated in the struggle against the invaders, the fate of humanity is entrusted to the women. Ella, who had been living a quiet life in a mountain shelter with her beloved husband and daughter, takes up a sword to protect her family. Entrusting her daughter to her husband, she throws herself into the heart of the brutal conflict. Directed by Brad Anderson ("The Machinist," "The Call") from a screenplay by actor Joshua Rollins. Screened as part of "Unexperienced Zone Movies 2026" (starting January 23, 2026, at Human Trust Cinema Shibuya).
title:ヴァリドマン:
This original tokusatsu (special effects) film was produced by the Kuno Laboratory at Bunkyo Gakuin University, led by film producer and director Professor Tsutomu Kuno, whose research focuses on content creation, management, and marketing for industrial renovation. The project was driven by a group of kaiju-loving students passionate about the genre, who collaborated with professional staff, voice actors, and cast members to bring the film to life.

On the day of her father’s funeral, a young girl named Miku takes a part-time job traveling around Tokyo in a mascot costume of Bunkyo City’s character, "Kattan." However, the being inside Kattan is actually an ancient inhabitant of the lost continent of Mu. Sensing that the Fierce Beast Taifu—the creature that once destroyed Mu—is about to awaken from its seal, Kattan pleads with Miku to become the warrior Validman and fight. Just as Miku begins to bond with Kattan and his yokai followers, Taifu finally resurrects. Kattan grows to a giant size to engage in a fierce battle, but is ultimately defeated. In that moment of dire peril, Miku transforms into the giant hero Validman.

The voice of Kattan is performed by popular voice actor Tomokazu Sugita, famous for his roles as Gintoki Sakata in "Gintama" and Gyomei Himejima in "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba." Chie Koujiro, known for "Obocchama-kun," also makes a special appearance.
title:ヴァージン・スーサイズ: Sofia Coppola, daughter of the master Francis Ford Coppola, made her feature directorial debut with this 1999 film. Based on the novel "The Virgin Suicides" by American author Jeffrey Eugenides, it depicts the emotional fluctuations of adolescent girls harboring a sense of danger with fresh, vivid visual beauty. In a 1970s American suburban town. The Lisbon house has five sisters, aged 13 to 17, each born a year apart, and the neighborhood boys are infatuated with them. One June day when dragonflies are swarming, the youngest daughter, Cecilia, attempts suicide. A few days later, the family throws a party to cheer her up, but during the party, she throws herself out of a window... Kirsten Dunst, who gained attention in "Interview with the Vampire," plays the fourth daughter Lux, while James Woods and Kathleen Turner play the sisters' parents. The French electronic duo AIR composed the music. A 4K restored version was released in May 2025 as part of the "12 Months of Cinema Relay 2024-2025."
title:ヴィクラム: A crime action film produced by and starring Indian national star Kamal Haasan, alongside Vijay Sethupathi from "Jawan" and Fahadh Faasil from "Pushpa: The Rise." It depicts a three-way battle between a drug cartel boss, an unemployed middle-aged man, and a special agent through intense action sequences. Three consecutive terrorist attacks by masked groups occur in Chennai. Special agent Amar suspects Sandhanam, the drug lord who controls the city's gangs, is involved. Meanwhile, Sandhanam is searching for two tons of missing cocaine base that vanished from his territory. As the investigation progresses, Amar becomes strangely preoccupied with Karnan, an unemployed man who was the second victim. Karnan had a police officer son-in-law, who was also killed by the same terrorists. Directed and written by Lokesh Kanagaraj, known for "Master" and "Kaithi," with action choreography by the twin stuntmen Anbariv (Anbumani & Arivumani) active in the Indian film industry.
title:ヴィクラムとヴェーダ ヒンディー語版: A crime suspense film starring Hrithik Roshan of "Bang Bang!" and Saif Ali Khan of "Go Goa Gone," adapted as a Hindi remake of a 2017 Tamil-language film. Vikram, an excellent police commissioner who aims to eradicate crime itself rather than boost his record through arrests, sees his convictions shaken when the criminal he was targeting, Veda, surrenders himself, bringing forth a series of mysteries. Eventually, Vikram and Veda, each with their own purposes, are forced to fight together. Hrithik Roshan plays Veda, and Saif Ali Khan plays Vikram.
title:ヴィヴァルディと私: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.
title:一一: A family drama by Edward Yang, the master of Taiwanese New Cinema known for 'A Brighter Summer Day' and 'The Terrorizers,' which quietly observes the life changes that befall each member of a five-person family living in Taipei. Yang won the Best Director award at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival in 2000 for this film. Elementary school student Yang-yang lives a comfortable life in a luxury apartment with his father NJ, who runs a computer company, his mother Min-min, his high school sister Ting-ting, and his gentle grandmother. They seem like a picture-perfect happy family, but troubles begin after the wedding of the mother's younger brother. The grandmother falls into a coma from a stroke, the father is shaken by a reunion with his first love, and the mother seeks solace in a new religion. To save his company from bankruptcy, the father travels to Japan to secure a contract with a genius game designer named Ota. Meanwhile, the sister starts dating the boyfriend of her neighbor Li-li... Issey Ogata appears as the game designer Ota. As director Yang passed away in 2007, this became his final completed feature film. A 4K restoration was screened as the opening film of the Cannes Classics section at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.
title:一枚のハガキ: Near the end of the war, 100 middle-aged soldiers are called up. Their postings are decided by their superior officer's lottery. Realizing he won't return alive after being assigned to the Philippines, Morikawa Teizo asks Matsuyama Keita to deliver a postcard to his wife, Tomoko, and tell her he read it. After the war ends, only six soldiers, including Keita, survive. Based on the postcard, they visit Tomoko's house, but...
title:一生売れない心の準備はできてるか: A documentary following Nasa Shigeki, the leader of the Okinawan band "Yachimun Shigeki Nasu." Born in Miyazaki Prefecture in 1964, Nasa moved to Okinawa in 1982 to attend university, and after graduating, he worked as a photographer while forming "Yachimun" in 1991 to start his music career. The group evolved from a trio to a duo, and is now Nasa's solo unit; since 2013, he has also performed as a band under the name "Yachimun Shigeki Nasu." He has released 12 albums to date, and while his 1994 song "Ganbare Iboyaru" was a minor hit within Okinawa Prefecture, it remains his only notable success. Nasa continues his energetic activities while earning a living primarily as a street performer in Naha. In 2016, to commemorate the band's 25th anniversary, this perpetually "unsuccessful" man held a live performance at Okinawa's oldest movie theater, "Shuri Gekijo." With his free-spirited performance, he captivated the audience and basked in a single night of spotlight. The film centers on powerful footage from that concert, performed with an 18-piece big band, and conveys the appeal of Nasa's music through interviews with him. Directed by Tōma Hayashi, known for "Pineapple Tours" and other works.
title:七年目の浮気: A sexy comedy adapted by Billy Wilder from a hit stage play, following "Stalag 17." In a sweltering New York apartment, Richard is enjoying a temporary bachelor lifestyle while his wife and children are on vacation. A beautiful woman from the upstairs apartment comes down seeking air conditioning. The scene of Marilyn Monroe's white skirt billowing up as she stands over a subway grate is famously iconic. Tom Ewell, who also played the lead role on stage, reprises the role of Richard in the film version.
title:万引き家族: Directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "The Third Murder" and "Our Little Sister," this human drama portrays human connections through the lens of a family that engages in petty crimes together. At the 71st Cannes Film Festival in 2018, it won the Palme d'Or, the top prize, for the first time for a Japanese film since "The Eel" in 1997. It also earned high praise overseas, including a nomination for Best Foreign Language Film at the 91st Academy Awards, the first for a Japanese film in a decade. At the 42nd Japan Academy Film Prize, it won eight awards, including Best Picture. In a working-class district of Tokyo, in an old one-story house seemingly left behind among high-rise apartments, live the homeowner Hatsue, the couple Osamu and Nobuyo, their son Shota, and Nobuyo's younger sister Aki, all dependent on Hatsue's pension. They make ends meet by shoplifting, living on the fringes of society, yet their days are filled with laughter. One winter day, Osamu brings home a little girl shivering on the balcony of a nearby apartment complex, and Nobuyo decides to raise her as a daughter. Triggered by an incident, the close-knit family begins to fall apart, revealing the secrets and desires each of them harbors. Alongside regular Kore-eda collaborators Lily Franky as the father Osamu, who repeatedly shoplifts with his son, and Kirin Kiki as Hatsue, the film marks the first Kore-eda works for Sakura Ando as Nobuyo and Mayu Matsuoka as Aki, Nobuyo's sister.
title:三人の⼥強盗: A selection of the "Ireland Film Festival 2026" (May 29 – June 11, 2026, at YEBISU GARDEN CINEMA).
title:三人の女強盗: A featured film of the Ireland Film Festival 2026 (May 29 – June 11, 2026, at Yebisu Garden Cinema).
title:三度目の殺人: Lawyer Shigemori (Fukuyama) takes on the defense of Misumi (Yakusho), who has been arrested on suspicion of murdering the president of the company where he worked. Misumi had previously been sentenced to life imprisonment for a robbery-murder committed 30 years ago and was on parole. Misumi's testimony shifts back and forth repeatedly. Eventually, an unexpected connection emerges between the victim's daughter, Sakie (Hirose), and Misumi... This film, framed as a courtroom suspense, questions ethical issues that lie outside legal judgment.
title:三角屋の交差点で: A documentary observing a 99-year-old woman and her son and daughter-in-law, who were affected by the Great East Japan Earthquake and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster and live in disaster recovery public housing, over a three-year period from 2018 to 2021. Seven years after the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake and Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster, a family forced to evacuate from Namie Town, Fukushima, wavers between returning to their hometown and choosing a new life. Having closed their long-running printing business due to the disaster and living in disaster recovery public housing in Iwaki City, the roles and relationships within the family quietly change. Tetsu, the 99-year-old mother, clings to memories of her birthplace, Okuma Town, even as her memory fades. Her taciturn son Takemasa respects his mother but leaves most of her care to his wife Shigeko. Shigeko, who has continued to bear this role, begins to reexamine her taken-for-granted position within the family and her own way of living. Through the family's daily life in flux, the film questions what "home" is and what "I" is. Directed by Toru Yamada, who has continued making films in Fukushima since the Great East Japan Earthquake.
title:下妻物語: A youth comedy set in Shimotsuma City, Ibaraki Prefecture, depicting the friendship between two girls with completely opposite values: a Lolita and a Yankee. Based on the novel of the same name by Novala Takemoto, directed and adapted by Tetsuya Nakashima. In Shimotsuma City, Ibaraki, surrounded by endless rice fields, 17-year-old Momoko is a super laid-back girl who adores Rococo-era France. She dresses in her beloved Lolita fashion and commutes to Daikanyama, where the flagship store of her worshipped brand is located. One day, she starts selling counterfeit famous brands to earn money for clothes, and a girl her age named Ichigo, a member of a local biker gang, appears before her. Ichigo takes a liking to the gutsy Momoko and begins frequently visiting her home. Momoko the Lolita girl is played by Kyoko Fukada, and Ichigo the Yankee girl is played by Anna Tsuchiya. In 2024, marking the 20th anniversary of its release, it was converted to Digital Cinema Package (DCP) and screened in revival.
title:不屈の女たち 旧東ドイツ編: To be screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:不思議惑星キン・ザ・ザ: A deadpan sci-fi comedy made in Soviet-era Georgia in 1986, which became a huge hit in the USSR at the time. One day, a student named Gedevan asks construction engineer Mashkov for help, looking troubled, saying, 'There are some men over there who claim to be aliens.' Mashkov, who doesn't believe in aliens, presses a button on a space travel device the men were holding, and in the next instant, Mashkov and Gedevan are warped to the planet Pluke in the Kin-Dza-Dza Nebula, far from Earth. There, for some reason, Earth matches are extremely valuable, and the two try to use the value of matches to somehow return to Earth... Culturally popular in Japan as well, it was first introduced at the 'Soviet SF Film Festival' held in Tokyo in 1989, later released in a new print in 2001 and a digital remaster in August 2016. In May 2021, to coincide with the release of the animated version 'Ku! Kin-Dza-Dza,' the live-action film had its fourth theatrical release.
title:不毛地帯: A socially conscious drama based on Yamasaki Toyoko's novel of the same name, depicting the shadowy maneuvers of trading companies and their collusion with political and financial circles over the selection of the main fighter jet for the second defense buildup. Kinki Shoji is locked in a bloody battle with other trading companies over the selection of the main fighter jet for the second defense buildup, which is said to involve a total budget exceeding one trillion yen. Before long, the conflict inevitably escalates into a war of 'live ammunition' attacks on the political world.
title:不気味なものの肌に触れる: A medium-length drama shot by director Hamaguchi Ryusuke, who continues to attract attention with works like 'THE DEPTH' and 'Intimacy,' as a prequel to his planned feature film 'FLOODS.' Chihiro, a boy who has lost his father, comes to live with his half-brother Togo and Togo's lover Misato. Togo and Misato warmly welcome Chihiro, but plagued by loneliness, Chihiro throws himself into dance practice with his same-age friend Naoya. Around them, unsettling events begin to occur... The cast includes talented actors such as Shota Sometani from 'Himizu,' Kiyohiko Shibukawa from 'The Wandering Beast,' and Hotsushi Ishida from 'Canary.'
title:不気味なものの肌に触れる濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: After losing his father, Chihiro is taken in by his half-brother, Togo. Togo and his girlfriend Satomi welcome Chihiro warmly, yet his loneliness remains. Chihiro finds solace in dancing with Naoya, a boy his own age. However, in the town where they dance with abandon, unsettling events soon begin to unfold... A singular work that serves as a pilot for the upcoming feature film *FLOODS*.
title:不貞の女: A suspense thriller from French master Claude Chabrol, a leading figure of the New Wave, starring his wife at the time, Stéphane Audran. Charles, an insurance executive, lives a happy life with his wife Hélène and their son, but one day he happens to catch Hélène answering a suspicious phone call. Suspecting her of infidelity, Charles hires a private detective and discovers that her lover is a writer named Pégala. Charles visits Pégala’s home to meet his wife's lover face-to-face. Though he initially maintains a facade of composure, he is gradually overcome by jealousy and rage... Highlights include the sophisticated visual beauty captured by cinematographer Jean Rabier (known for Agnès Varda’s *Le Bonheur* and Jacques Demy’s *The Umbrellas of Cherbourg*), the performances of a distinguished cast, and delicate psychological portrayals. Previously unreleased in Japanese theaters, the film will make its domestic theatrical debut as part of the "Claude Chabrol Masterpiece Selection" (starting February 13, 2026, at Cinema Rise, Morc Asagaya, and other venues), a retrospective featuring three of Chabrol’s suspense films released between the late 1960s and 1970.
title:与太郎戦記 女は幾万ありとても: A beautiful women's unit arrives at an army that bans women! The soldiers look impressive, but the bumbling fool Yotaro, who messes up everything he does, causes a riot of laughter when he takes on the women's unit. This definitive edition of the popular Yotaro War Chronicles series adds a touch of allure, escalating the comedy even further!
title:与太郎戦記女は幾万ありとても: A beautiful women's unit arrives at an army that bans women! The soldiers look impressive, but the bumbling fool Yotaro, who messes up everything he does, causes a riot of laughter when he takes on the women's unit. This definitive edition of the popular Yotaro War Chronicles series adds a touch of allure, escalating the comedy even further!
title:世界が認めた栄冠のショート傑作選: Nine Academy Award-winning and nominated short films come together for a special event. A special theatrical screening has been confirmed, offering a chance to experience both live-action and animation on the big screen. Nine masterpieces, including Academy Award winners and nominees (four live-action and five animated shorts), will be presented in theaters as separate live-action and animation omnibus programs.
title:世界の果てまで3キロ: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:世界名作童話 白鳥の王子: The only fairy tale adaptation directed by Nishizawa Nobutaka. What is the mission entrusted to the younger sister Elisa to turn her brothers, who were transformed into swans by a witch's daughter, back into humans? Elisa's pitiful yet steady hands as she weaves nettle shirts lend a powerful realism to this fantastical story. Miyazaki Kyōko, an actress also known as the wife of Nakadai Tatsuya, wrote the screenplay under the name Takaba.
title:両親が決めたこと:
STORY
Claudia (80), a stage actress in Barcelona, is suffering from terminal cancer. As the cancer metastasizes to her brain, bringing with it the threat of confusion, partial paralysis, and the loss of her sense of self, she chooses euthanasia. Claudia has always lived her life prioritizing the stage over motherhood. Her husband, Flavio, has supported his charming actress wife throughout her career and remains deeply in love with her. Bound by an eternal bond, the couple decides to undergo euthanasia together and reveals their plan to their three children. The children do not agree with their father’s decision, and the eldest daughter goes as far as to accuse her mother of manipulation, leading to a confrontation. However, the father’s resolve is firm. As the parents proceed with the necessary steps for their joint euthanasia, the departure for their final journey suddenly draws near...
title:丹下左膳 乾雲坤竜の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title:丹下左膳 乾雲坤龍の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title:丹下左膳余話 百万両の壺: Known as a masterpiece by early Showa period master Tomu Uchida, who died at just 28, this period drama stars Denjiro Okochi as the ronin Tange Sazen. Tange Sazen, a ronin living at an archery range and working as a bodyguard, and the proprietress Ofuji take in Chobian, the son of a man stabbed to death at the shop. Chobian carries a certain pot around carefully, using it as a goldfish bowl, but it actually contains a hidden map to a million ryo. This is one of only three surviving films by Uchida, most of whose original prints have been lost. It was remade in 2004 as "Tange Sazen: The Million Ryo Pot" starring Etsushi Toyokawa.
title:丹下左膳餘話 百萬兩の壺: A commotion over a pot that reveals the hiding place of a large sum of money draws in the swordsman Sanzen... A delightful gem showcasing the talent of Yamanaka, who lightly and skillfully portrays Daigoro's signature role of Sanzen.
title:主人公: Directed, written, and scored by the Indian master Satyajit Ray, this drama skillfully critiques the issues within the Bengali film industry through the crisis and introspection of a movie star. Arindam, a popular actor in Bengali cinema, is scheduled to attend an awards ceremony in Delhi, but after failing to secure a flight, he makes the journey by sleeper train. On board, he is recognized by all the passengers, including an eccentric old man who disapproves of his drinking habits and a mother and daughter who are fans. During the trip, Arindam is interviewed by Aditi, a female journalist who happens to be on the same train. Through their conversation, he reflects on his life and confronts the loneliness and inner conflict hidden behind his glamorous success. Uttam Kumar, a legendary star of the Bengali film industry at the time, plays the lead role of Arindam, while Sharmila Tagore (The World of Apu) portrays the journalist Aditi. In Japan, the film will make its theatrical debut in July 2025 as part of the "Satyajit Ray Retrospective 2025," a special screening series commemorating the 70th anniversary of the director's debut.
title:久里洋二 短篇アニメーション作品集: Yoji Kuri pioneered the possibilities of Japanese independent animation with his stark, razor-sharp lines and a boundless imagination fueled by absurdity and eros. Throughout the 1960s and 70s, he collaborated with avant-garde luminaries from various fields, including musicians Toru Takemitsu, Toshi Ichiyanagi, and Isao Tomita, and the poet Shuntaro Tanikawa. This program presents a collection of his award-winning works from international animation festivals—masterpieces that sent shockwaves through the global creative community.
title:二代目はクリスチャン: Kyoko, a nun at St. Saffron Church on Mount Rokko, plays hymns on the organ. Haruhiko Tenryu, the second-generation head of the Tenryu-gumi yakuza clan, is deeply in love with Kyoko because of her refined beauty, and has even forced his underlings to be baptized as Christians. Also harboring feelings for Kyoko is Detective Jindai, whose family runs a Tendai sect temple, presenting another formidable obstacle. However, Kyoko herself secretly harbors feelings for Eiji, whom she met fatefully one stormy day. As the feelings of those around her intertwine, Kyoko's destiny begins to move in an unexpected direction.
title:二十四時間の情事: An actress, once condemned for having an affair with an enemy soldier in a French village under German occupation, visits Hiroshima for a film shoot and indulges in a one-day affair with a Japanese architect. Through this, she learns of Hiroshima's tragedy. The date is August 6th. Against the backdrop of the anti-nuclear movement, their lonely conversation continues. The city, miraculously rebuilt from the ashes, can never forget the shadow of death.
title:二宮金次郎: A biographical drama depicting the little-known half-life of Ninomiya Kinjiro, famous for the statue of a boy reading a book while carrying firewood that once stood in many elementary school grounds. Ninomiya Kinjiro lost his parents and spent his childhood living apart from his siblings. As a young man, Kinjiro is entrusted with the restoration of the Sakurama domain (present-day Moka City, Tochigi Prefecture) by the Odawara domain. Kinjiro works on village restoration using his own original methods, but faces strong opposition from conservative villagers. Meanwhile, the Odawara domain dispatches the samurai Toyoda Shosaku, who begins various acts of obstruction against Kinjiro's measures, claiming "Kinjiro is destroying order." Kinjiro is played by Masahito Goda, known for the drama "Mito Komon," with a cast including Misato Tanaka, Riri Narita, Vino Inuyama, Takaaki Enoki, Shingo Yanagisawa, Min Tanaka, Ikkei Watanabe, Kenjiro Ishimaru, and Katsuhiko Watabiki. Directed by Takumi Saitoh, known for "Sayonara, Mine" and "Five for Freedom."
title:五月の雨:
This film explores the issues surrounding the post-divorce joint custody system, set to be introduced in Japan in April 2026, through a blend of drama and documentary. By weaving together a fictional narrative set in a future where the system is in effect with real-life cases, testimonies from domestic violence survivors, and interviews with legal experts, the film exposes the inherent dangers of post-divorce joint custody.

Kaori Hasegawa, a housewife and mother to a young son, suffers from the psychological abuse of her husband, Naoki. He constantly criticizes her over trivial matters, such as the seasoning of her cooking or her choice of clothing; even when she apologizes, he relentlessly interrogates her for explanations. Driven to a breaking point by his control, Kaori flees their home and seeks legal help. After three years of deadlocked mediation due to conflicting claims, the divorce is finally granted. However, having conceded to her husband’s demand for "joint custody," Kaori finds herself still under his psychological thumb. From visitation rights to decisions about their son’s education, Naoki continues to exert control at every turn, leaving Kaori increasingly cornered.

Mari Yasukawa, who appeared in the NHK morning drama series *The Tiger and Her Wings*, stars as Kaori. Director Leo Tomita, a veteran of numerous television programs, makes his feature film directorial debut with this work.
title:人はなぜラブレターを書くのか: A young man died in a train derailment in the year 2000. Twenty-four years later, a letter from a woman who was in love with him arrives for his father... A story depicting the bonds between people carrying loss.
title:人情紙風船: The final work of renowned early Showa period director Tomu Uchida, who died of illness at just 28, this is a humanistic period drama. In the Edo period, Shinzo, a barber living in a poor tenement, runs a gambling den and catches the eye of yakuza. Strapped for cash, he tries to pawn his barber tools but is refused. Meanwhile, Matajuro, a ronin living in the same tenement, seeks employment with a samurai his father once served, but is completely ignored. One day, Shinzo accidentally kidnaps the pawnshop owner's daughter and brings her back to the tenement... An adaptation of Kawatake Mokuami's kabuki play "Kamiyui Shinzo."
title:人狼 JIN-ROH: A film adaptation of Mamoru Oshii's manga "Kerberos Panzer Cop," part of the "Kerberos Saga" that also includes Oshii's live-action films "The Red Spectacles" and "StrayDog: Kerberos Panzer Cops." Set in an alternate 1960s Japan, it depicts the love, hatred, and tragic romance between an elite special forces officer and a guerrilla girl. In the Tokyo metropolitan area, emerging from post-war chaos, the "Capital Police" is formed to combat escalating armed conflicts. Kazuki Fuse, a member of the Special Assault Team, encounters a girl carrying a bomb during a riot suppression. Hesitating to pull the trigger, the girl detonates the bomb and kills herself. Fuse is sent back to training school for failing his mission, but one day he meets a woman who looks exactly like the girl. This is the directorial debut of animator Hiroyuki Okiura, known for key animation on "Akira" and "Patlabor," and it received high praise at the Berlin International Film Festival. In March 2026, a 4K remastered and Dolby Atmos version will be released for revival screenings and home video to mark the 25th anniversary.
title:人間の証明: A black man is murdered in an elevator at a luxury hotel in Tokyo, leaving behind the word 'Stoha' and a poetry collection by Saijo Yaso. Fashion designer Kyoko Yasugi and her son appear and disappear along the investigative trail. Detective Muneyori travels to the United States to trace the black man's past. The unexpected relationship between Kyoko and the black man, as well as the connection between the American detective and Detective Muneyori, comes to light.
title:今は昔、栄養映画館の旅:
This documentary follows Akira Emoto and Tatsuki Nishimoto of the theatrical troupe Gekidan Tokyo Kandenzu as they tour independent cinemas across Japan with their staged reading of "Ima wa Mukashi, Eiyo Eigakan" (Once Upon a Time, the Nutrition Cinema).

Originally a masterpiece of absurdist theater by playwright Juichiro Takeuchi that premiered in 1983, the play was performed in its entirety as a staged reading by the duo of Emoto and Nishimoto in November 2024. It went on to have multiple encore performances at "Atelier Kandenzu," the troupe's rehearsal space and theater in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo. Because the play depicts the banter between a director and an assistant director waiting for a film's completion ceremony to begin in a movie theater, screenwriter and director Haruhiko Arai—who attended a performance—conceived the idea of staging the reading in actual cinemas. A month-long tour of 24 independent cinemas across the country took place from May 1 to 31, 2025, receiving critical acclaim from film and theater enthusiasts in every region.

This film captures their journey, showing Emoto, Nishimoto, and fellow members of Gekidan Tokyo Kandenzu as they travel to cinemas across Japan in a single van. Masaaki Takeda, who has served as an assistant director on works by directors Haruhiko Arai and Sang-il Lee, handled the direction, cinematography, and editing.
title:今日からぼくが村の映画館:
Set in a small village nestled within the majestic Andes Mountains of Peru, this drama follows the coming-of-age of a young boy captivated by the magic of cinema. Sistu, an inquisitive boy living in the highlands, happens upon a movie advertisement carried by the wind on the first day of the new school term. Guided by the flyer, he finds his way to a mobile cinema, where he experiences film for the first time and is instantly enchanted by its storytelling. From that day forward, Sistu becomes the village’s weekly storyteller, recounting the films he has seen to the local residents. However, when the mobile cinema suddenly vanishes into thin air, events begin to take an unexpected turn.

Directed by Cesar Galindo in his second feature film, the story weaves complex themes—the realities of the Peruvian education system, the marginalization of Andean highland communities, discrimination within a multicultural society, and the lingering scars of civil war—into a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a cast largely comprised of non-professional actors, including breakout lead Victor Acurio as Sistu, the film is spoken in Quechua, one of Peru’s official languages. It went on to become the highest-grossing Quechua-language film in the history of Peruvian cinema.
title:今日の空が一番好き、とまだ言えない僕は: Director Akiko Oku, known for "Dating My Daughter" and "Stop Me," adapts Shusuke Fukutoku's 2020 romance novel, originally written by the comedy duo Jarujaru. College student Toru Konishi lives a dull life far from his imagined campus experience. One day, he is captivated by the dignified appearance of a bun-haired female student, Hana Sakurada, and musters the courage to speak to her. Through a series of coincidences, they quickly hit it off. Amid their endless conversations, Hana casually says, "I want to feel that every day is fun. I want to feel that today's sky is the best," a phrase that pierces Toru's heart—because it is the same words his late grandmother, whom he loved dearly, used to say. Toru rejoices at meeting Hana, but soon an incident strikes them. Toru is played by Riku Hagiwara, popular for the "Beautiful Man" series, and Hana is played by Yuumi Kawai, a rising young talent known for "Extremely Inappropriate!" and "Namibia no Sabaku." The film was selected for the competition section of the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2024.
title:伊賀忍法帖: Kashin Koji, a mysterious man who appears during the Sengoku period, is a master of various mystical arts, and tales of his sightings and experiences are told in many places. He is summoned by the warlord Matsunaga Hisahide. Hisahide harbors a desire for Miyoshi Yoshiyuki's wife, Ukon no Tsubone, and plots to have his way with her. Kashin proposes a plan to create an "lust stone"—an aphrodisiac capable of melting any woman's heart. It is made by having seven ninja monks under Kashin's command rape women and boiling down the resulting fluids. The sheer horror of this plan leaves the assembled Sen no Rikyū and Yagyū Shinzaemon trembling in fear.
title:何食わぬ顔（long version）濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然:
Nomura begins filming his late brother’s posthumous 8mm project at the urging of his friends. His non-committal attitude, however, leaves those around him bewildered. Shot entirely on 8mm film by the University of Tokyo Film Study Group, the work is heavily influenced by John Cassavetes’ *Husbands* (1970), a director Hamaguchi deeply admires. From its intricate film-within-a-film structure to its core sensibilities, the essence of Hamaguchi’s cinema is already fully present in this work.

*Note: The source material is an SD digitization of the original 8mm film.
title:侍タイムスリッパー: A period comedy depicting a late-Edo period samurai who time-travels to a modern-day period drama studio and struggles as a sword-falling extra. In Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, Kosaka Shinzaemon, a retainer of the Aizu domain, receives a secret order from the chief retainer to kill a Choshu domain samurai, but at the moment his blade meets his target's, he is struck by lightning and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a modern period drama studio. Shinzaemon causes commotions wherever he goes, and is stunned to learn that the Tokugawa shogunate fell 140 years ago. Resigned to death at first, he is helped by kind-hearted people and regains his will to live. Eventually, relying only on his polished swordsmanship, he knocks on the studio's door and decides to live as a sword-falling extra. Starring Makiya Yamaguchi, who has appeared in numerous period dramas including the TV series "Kenkaku Shobai," with Norimasa Tomiya and Yuno Sakura co-starring. Directed and written by Junichi Yasuda ("Gohan," "Kenju to Medamayaki"), it was completed with special cooperation from Toei Kyoto Studio despite being an independent production. Released exclusively at Ikebukuro Cinema Rosa on August 17, 2024 (a "Deluxe Version" with added scenes began screening at Kawasaki Cinecitta from August 30), word of mouth spread, and from September 13 of the same year, with Gaga as co-distributor, it expanded to over 100 theaters nationwide including Shinjuku Piccadilly and Toho Cinemas Hibiya. It became an unprecedented hit for an independent film and achieved the feat of winning the Best Picture award at the 48th Japan Academy Film Prize.
title:侠客道: A small city on the outskirts of Osaka. The Teramitsu-gumi, backed by the Kansai crime syndicate Josei-kai, proposes a merger to their rivals, the Ishida-gumi, but is rejected by the lieutenant, Ibuki. In retaliation, the Teramitsu-gumi begins a campaign of harassment. Around that time, Prosecutor Nakagami is assigned to the city. Although Nakagami was Ibuki’s university classmate and had married the daughter of the Ishida boss, Tatsunosuke, he remains cold toward them. Meanwhile, Teramitsu summons Tatsunosuke, and when he refuses the deal once more, Teramitsu murders him...
title:俺の血はピンクの血 映画俳優久保新二: This documentary spotlights actor Shinji Kubo, known as the 'Emperor of Porn' and 'King of Pink' for his countless appearances in pink films, tracing his 50-year career racing down the backstreets of Japanese cinema. After dropping out of high school, Kubo joined the theater troupe Himawari and made his film debut in 1966 with Koji Wakamatsu's 'Blood Is Redder Than the Sun.' From the early days of pink film, he appeared in numerous works, totaling over 800 films. His acting career, spanning more than 50 years until his passing in May 2024, represents a hidden side of Japanese cinema rarely discussed. Shot from Kubo's own wish to leave behind a record of himself, the film revisits landmark events in film history—guerrilla and anarchic shoots with various directors, the behind-the-scenes story of how he came to play comedy in pink films and created the hit 'Widow's Boarding House' series with director Shinya Yamamoto, and more. It also captures Kubo confronting a certain person after more than a decade of estrangement. Directed by Takahiro Tanaka, known for scripting the 2004 film '1 Litre of Tears.'
title:偏向報道: A social drama directed and written by Kinshirō Ogino ('Ikushima Tanga,' 'My Bone MY BLOOD BONE'), focusing on 'biased reporting'—how news organizations edit and emphasize information based on specific stances or intentions to sway public opinion. Drawing from his own experience as a TV program director, Ogino depicts a rigid, top-down society where a director at a subcontracting production company confronts the corrupt practices of TV network executives. Suzuko Aburakami, a blunt-speaking director working for a subcontractor of the local TV station 'TV Top,' is asked to stop the broadcast of a fabricated video produced by the network's subsidiary, based on dubious information about the governor's harassment. Comedian and actress Miyuki Torii stars as Suzuko, with Seiya Makoto as the news director who intimidates subsidiaries and subcontractors. The cast includes Sayaka Higashi, Ippei Ōsako, Ami Tokitō, Hozumi Gōda, Shinya Ono, and Setsujirō Hotaru.
title:健康ちえのわトランポリン教室: A psycho-therapy thriller set against the backdrop of modern society, rife with self-validation needs and codependency, depicting the unraveling daily life of an ordinary couple after they stumble upon a bizarre 'hobby class.' Yui, a housewife in her second year of marriage, is forced by her seemingly gentle husband Kōhei to be a 'wife who needs protecting,' suffering from the 'non-malicious violence' lurking in everyday life while maintaining a facade of peace. One day, she discovers a strange class called the 'Kenkō Chienowa Trampolin Kyōshitsu' (Healthy Wisdom Ring Trampoline Class) and starts attending. Through interactions with the teacher and classmates, Yui begins to confront her suppressed 'true self,' but her marital relationship with Kōhei grows increasingly distorted, and the two are swallowed by the darkness hidden in their daily lives. Directed by Kōichi Ishikawa, who co-founded the film production group 'Heisei Nanook' with producer Dai Miyazawa, this feature debut took two years to conceive and three years to complete, winning the Semi-Grand Prix at the 13th Shitamachi Film Festival. Starring Mayu Tano, Tō Shimoegō, and Takano Kōga.
title:偶然と想像: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
title:偶然と想像濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
title:僕のなかのブラウニー:
A touching human drama that follows a boy who lost his younger sister in a disaster and the people around him, told through a warm and compassionate lens.

Kazuki Morimoto, a fifth-grader who lost his sister in an earthquake several years ago, has moved to a new town with his single father, Yosuke, who runs a ramen shop. However, Kazuki struggles to fit in at school and with his new surroundings. One day, after learning about the existence of fairies called "Brownies," Kazuki begins to truly believe that his sister didn't die, but was instead spirited away by them. He sets out on a quest to find the Brownies. While those around him are bewildered by his behavior, his classmate Toko Izumi decides to help him, joined by her relative, a translator named Daisuke Izumi. Eventually, sparked by a lie from a "young carer" named Sota, Kazuki embarks on a journey to find the Brownies. Toko, Sota, and a truant boy named Masato follow after him.

Ayaki Hirano, known for the NHK morning drama series *The Tiger and Her Wings*, stars as the protagonist Kazuki. Junnosuke Taguchi plays Daisuke, the translator who holds the key to the story, while comedian Akira 100% portrays Kazuki’s father, Yosuke. The screenplay is written by Yuiko Miura (*Memories of Tomorrow*), and director Yuta Soma, who has created numerous short films centered on the theme of "children and social issues," makes his feature film directorial debut.
title:僕の帰る場所: Set in Japan and Myanmar, this drama is based on a true story about a Myanmar family living in Japan. Kane lives in a small Tokyo apartment with her two young sons. After her husband Aise is detained by immigration authorities, Kane must support the family alone. Since her children grew up in Japan and cannot speak their native language, Kane pours all her love into them using her imperfect Japanese, but the brothers, stressed by their father's absence, fight daily. Growing anxious about their future, Kane increasingly longs to return to Myanmar, where she was born and raised. This is director Akiro Fujimoto's feature-length debut. The film was screened in the 'Asian Future' section of the 30th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2017, where it won both the section's Best Picture Award and the Japan Foundation Asia Center Special Prize.
title:億万長者の不都合な終末: A thriller dripping with black humor that depicts the collapse of capitalist society following the outbreak of a mysterious disease called "Rich Flu" that only infects the wealthy. Directed and written by Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia of the "The Platform" series, which sharply depicted social inequality, it thrillingly portrays the chaos brought about by a reversal of values. Laura, a high-ranking producer at a streaming platform company, prioritizes her career over her family and is on the verge of success in the glamorous film industry. But just then, a mysterious disease called "Rich Flu" suddenly spreads worldwide, killing wealthy people one after another. As wealth transforms from a symbol of success into a "mark of elimination," capitalist society collapses and the world descends into chaos. In this extreme situation, Laura makes a decision. Mary Elizabeth Winstead, known for films like "Gemini Man" and "Birds of Prey," plays the career-driven Laura who neglects her family. Raf Spall, who has appeared in major works like "Life of Pi" and "Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom," plays Tony, her husband who is exasperated with her yet gets caught up in the unprecedented pandemic alongside her. Timothy Spall, known for the "Harry Potter" series and "Mr. Turner," plays the billionaire Sebastian Snail.
title:光る校庭:
A story of one summer, told with a warm perspective, about the meeting of a boy contemplating death and a boy suffering from a serious illness, and how they and their families gradually move forward. Up-and-coming director Kazushi Higa set the film in his hometown of Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture.

Tomoya Oba, whose father was declared dead after going missing, moves from Tokyo to his mother’s family home in Toyota City during the summer of his fifth year in elementary school. A new life begins with his mother, who has yet to accept her husband's death, his reliable older sister, and his cheerful grandfather. At his new school, Tomoya meets Tsubasa Nishikawa, a classmate battling a serious illness. While feeling a sense of unease toward the teacher and classmates who treat the frail Tsubasa with excessive caution, Tomoya grows closer to him. Tsubasa’s presence begins to awaken a new perspective on life and death within Tomoya.

The film stars Yumi Adachi as Tomoya’s mother and Ken Mitsuishi as his grandfather.
title:免許返納!?: A comedy starring Hiroshi Tachi, depicting a 70-year-old movie star caught up in a major uproar over surrendering his driver's license. Nanjo Hiroshi, who has enjoyed a smooth acting career and recently won numerous film awards for art films, secretly longs to appear in action movies. When his longtime actor friend Ozaki Makoto gets into a motorcycle accident, Nanjo is asked by the media for comment as a fellow actor of the same generation. His remarks admonishing Ozaki unexpectedly attract public attention, and the narrative takes on a life of its own, involving his manager and family, and being interpreted in ways far from his original intent. Although Nanjo wants to continue performing action scenes with cars and motorcycles, those around him expect him to surrender his license, plunging him into the biggest crisis of his life. Hiroshi Tachi comically plays actor Nanjo Hiroshi, the same name as the character he played in the 1994 film "License!". Nishino Nanase plays his manager Kawauna Mai, who is thrown into chaos by Nanjo; Kurokawa Sooya plays young man Kugami Ryo, whose life changes dramatically after meeting Nanjo; Yoshida Kotaro plays Mita Atsushi, the president of Nanjo's talent agency; and Uzaki Ryudo plays Ozaki Makoto, an actor friend who built an era alongside Nanjo. Directed by Kawai Yuji of "Kaguya-sama: Love Is War" fame, with screenplay by Hayashi Tamio of "From the Land of Love to the Land of Sorrow".
title:八月十五日の動乱: On August 6, 1945, the atomic bomb was dropped on Hiroshima, and Japan's defeat became all but certain. The Prime Minister's secretary, Nakajima, sounds out senior statesmen about accepting the Potsdam Declaration. But this peace faction's moves provoke the resistance-minded military officers. Unable to persuade the army and out of options, the Prime Minister petitions for an Imperial Conference to be held.
title:六つの顔:
Director Isshin Inudo (*Josee, the Tiger and the Fish*, *The Floating Castle*) presents a documentary following Living National Treasure and Kyogen master Nomura Mansaku. A leading figure in Kyogen—a traditional Japanese performing art with a history of over 650 years—Mansaku continues to take the stage even today, with a career spanning more than 90 years. Following his receipt of the Order of Culture in 2023, a commemorative performance was held in June 2024, where he performed "Kawakami," a masterpiece he has polished as his lifework.

The film follows him through that special day of performance while employing a bold yet delicate approach to explore his artistic realm, using animation to depict the "six faces" Mansaku envisions when reflecting on his past. In addition to Mansaku himself speaking on his devotion to Kyogen, the film features interviews with his son, Nomura Mansai, and grandson, Nomura Yuki. Furthermore, the camera captures the majestic, primordial scenery of Kongo-ji Temple in Kawakami Village, Nara—the setting of "Kawakami"—bringing Mansaku’s long-pursued worldview to the screen alongside his supreme artistry.

The animation is handled by Koji Yamamura, who was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film for *Mt. Head*, with narration by actor Joe Odagiri. Nomura Mansaku and Nomura Mansai served as supervisors for the film.
title:共に、世界一へ デフサッカー日本代表の軌跡: Together, to the Top of the World: Japan National Deaf Soccer Team... Watch related works: THE FIRST SLAM DUNK, Mixed Doubles, Let's Go, JETS! (The True Story of High School Girls Who Conquered America with Cheer Dance), Creed II, I, Tonya, King Richard, Creed, OVER DRIVE, Ping Pong, Minding the Gap.
title:兵隊やくざ: An entertainment film based on Arima Yorichika's original work "Kisaburo Ichidai," adapted by Kikushima Ryuzo and directed by Masumura Yasuzo. Its success led to a series of nine films. The dynamic duo of the outrageous protagonist played by Katsu Shintaro and the intellectual officer played by Tamura Takahiro are the highlight.
title:兵隊やくざ: An entertainment film based on Arima Yorichika's original work "Kisaburo Ichidai," adapted by Kikushima Ryuzo and directed by Masumura Yasuzo. Its success led to a series of nine films. The dynamic duo of the outrageous protagonist played by Katsu Shintaro and the intellectual officer played by Tamura Takahiro are the highlight.
title:冬の旅: A film by renowned French filmmaker Agnès Varda, tracing the steps of a young girl who freezes to death after wandering, which won the Golden Lion, the top prize, at the 42nd Venice International Film Festival in 1985. In winter in southern France, the body of an 18-year-old girl, Mona, is found frozen to death in a roadside ditch in the countryside. The film traces Mona's journey over the final weeks of her life as she hitchhikes aimlessly and continues a solitary journey, through the testimonies of the people she met on the road. Starring Sandrine Bonnaire (from "The Hairdresser's Husband"), with co-stars Macha Méril (from "Belle de Jour"), Stéphane Freiss (from "The Five Senses"), and Yolande Moreau (from "Séraphine"). It recorded over one million admissions in France at the time, becoming Varda's biggest hit.
title:冬よ: A documentary in which the confessions of East German women illuminate the contradictions of the regime on the eve of the fall of the "Wall." This film captures the lives of women from various backgrounds living in East Germany just before the collapse of the Berlin Wall. The breakthrough work of director Helke Misselwitz, it features women speaking candidly about their lives before the camera; their words, filled with hardship and regret, bring to light a quiet critique of the socialist ideal of gender equality. Winner of the Silver Dove at the 1988 International Leipzig Festival for Documentary and Animated Film (DOK Leipzig).
title:冬冬の夏休み: Taiwanese master Hou Hsiao-hsien crafts a masterpiece drama that vividly portrays the beauty of nature and childhood friendship through the story of a young brother and sister spending a summer in their grandfather's countryside home. After graduating from elementary school in Taipei, Tongtong's mother is hospitalized, so he and his little sister spend summer vacation at their grandfather's house in the countryside. They quickly become friends with the neighborhood children, and Tongtong enjoys a fun summer running through the fields. Meanwhile, his sister Tingting struggles to join the group and passes the time by playing pranks on her brother and his friends, until their father eventually comes from Taipei to pick them up. The father of the siblings is played by filmmaker Edward Yang, known for "The Terrorizers" and "Yi Yi." First released in Japan in 1990. Digital remastered versions were re-released in 2016 and 2025.

title:刑事キャレラ／血の絆: A police inspector from the Montreal Police Department solves a murder case using clues obtained from the victim's diary.
title:別れる決心: From Park Chan-wook, director of 'Oldboy' and 'The Handmaiden', comes a suspense drama about a detective investigating a murder and the victim's wife, a suspect to whom he finds himself drawn. When a man falls to his death from a mountain peak, Detective Hae-joon suspects it may be murder rather than an accident. He focuses on the victim's mysterious wife, Sore, but she has an alibi. As the investigation proceeds, Hae-joon finds himself attracted to Sore, and she develops special feelings for him too. Just when a lead emerges and the case seems solved... Park Hae-il plays Hae-joon, Tang Wei plays Sore, with Lee Jung-hyun and Go Kyung-pyo in supporting roles. The film won the Best Director award at the 75th Cannes Film Festival in 2022.
title:別離: Nader is in divorce negotiations with his wife, who wants to leave Iran for the sake of their daughter. He hires a woman named Razieh to care for his father, who suffers from dementia and lives with him, but an unexpected incident sets off a chain of events... An exquisite drama that intertwines a mystery with Iran's divorce issues.
title:創造と神秘のサグラダ・ファミリア: A documentary about the Sagrada Família, the century-spanning architectural project conceived by Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí, under construction since 1882 for over 130 years. Registered as a World Heritage Site in 2005, the Sagrada Família continues to captivate over three million visitors annually from around the world. As construction continues towards a projected completion in 2026, computers have been introduced on site, and staff repeatedly experiment to determine how to best reproduce Gaudí's vision with current technology. Incorporating footage from inside the site, inaccessible to outsiders, and interviews with architectural staff, the film unravels the project surrounding the Sagrada Família, including how the construction period, once said to require '300 years until completion,' has been shortened to a projected completion in 2026.
title:劇場版 とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムハムージャ! 幻のプリンセス: Hamtaro had a dream. It was a dream of a beautiful hamster princess... 'Help me... Please... Come here quickly...' The princess was trapped inside a soap bubble, tears in her eyes. Even after waking up, Hamtaro can't stop worrying about the princess from his dream. So, he and the Ham-Hams decide to go rescue her. They arrive at the 'Hamja Kingdom,' the homeland of hamsters with a history of 8686 in the Ham Calendar, surrounded by desert. The sky is dark, and the hamsters living there seem downcast. No wonder—Princess Shera of the Hamja Kingdom, who was engaged to Prince Hamuha of the neighboring country, has been kidnapped by a mysterious cat that suddenly appeared and trapped her just like in Hamtaro's dream. That cat wants to marry Princess Shera and take over the kingdom! At this rate, the princess and the kingdom are in danger! Can Hamtaro and the Ham-Hams save the princess and protect the hamsters' homeland? An adventure of love and courage begins now.
title:劇場版 とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムランド大冒険: It's Laura's birthday. Hamtaro has prepared a present, but Laura ignores him, and in frustration he runs away from home. Seeing this, the Ham-Hams are about to help Hamtaro run away when a mysterious fairy hamster appears and takes everyone to Ham-Ham Land, a dream world where only hamsters live. But Hamtaro can't stop thinking about Laura. Hearing from the fairy hamster about 'magic sunflower seeds' that allow hamsters to talk to humans, Hamtaro sets out on an adventure to find them. But what awaits?
title:劇場版 アイカツ スターズ！: The theatrical film of the TV anime 'Aikatsu Stars!', which began airing in April 2016 as a new series following the popular idol anime 'Aikatsu!'. It depicts the struggles of girls, including the protagonist Yume Nijino, who enrolls at Yotsusei Gakuen aiming to become the top idol. In this first theatrical film of 'Aikatsu Stars!', the story is set on a southern island where the characters come for an event. It revolves around the rumored 'Legendary Dress' said to be sleeping on the island, and depicts the friendship between Yume and Laura Sakuraba, as well as the school's top four-idol unit 'S4' taking the stage together. The short film 'Aikatsu! The Targeted Magical Aikatsu! Card' is shown simultaneously.
title:劇場版 モーレツ宇宙海賊 ABYSS OF HYPERSPACE -: The theatrical film version of the TV anime "Mouretsu Pirates," which aired from January to June 2012, based on Yuichi Sasamoto's popular SF light novel "Mini-Skirt Space Pirates." Marika Kato, a high school girl who is a legitimate space pirate holding a government-issued "privateer's license," leads a busy life juggling her studies, club activities in the space yacht club, a part-time job at a café, and her role as captain of the space pirate ship "Bentenmaru." One day during spring break, just before she is about to advance to her third year, Marika takes on a pirate business job aboard a luxury liner and meets Kanata Mugen, the son of the renowned subspace diver, Dr. Mugen. The opening theme, following the TV series, is "Mouretsu Uchuu Koukyoukyoku Dainanagakushou 'Mugen no Ai'" by Momoiro Clover Z. The director is Tatsuo Sato, known for "Martian Successor Nadesico."
title:劇場版 仮面ライダーディケイド オールライダー対大ショッカー: Kamen Rider Decade, aka Kadoya Tsukasa, arrives in a "certain world." In this world, for some reason, the photos Tsukasa takes do not distort the image. Suddenly, a certain Western-style mansion comes to mind. Following faint memories, Tsukasa reaches the mansion, where he meets a girl who calls herself his sister, Kadoya Sayo. Tsukasa becomes convinced this is his own world. However, even in this world, the "collapse of worlds" is progressing. Sayo's servant, Tsukikage Nobuhiko, claims that the cause of the world's collapse lies in the Riders born in each world, and declares that to stop it, they must decide on a single "strongest Rider."
title:劇場版 仮面ライダー響鬼と7人の戦鬼: In present-day Japan, the giant demonic monster Orochi appears on a coast. Hibiki and Asumu rush to fight it, but Hibiki is defeated by Orochi and falls into a coma. Asumu seeks clues to save Hibiki in the Takeshi's ancient documents describing Orochi, but there he finds the name "Asumu," the same as his own, along with the stories of Oni... The ancient document tells of a village in the Sengoku period. There, Orochi demanded a human sacrifice every year. When Asumu's acquaintance Hitoe is chosen as the sacrifice, Asumu consults Tobei Tachibana to find a way to save her. Following the idea of asking an Oni for help, Asumu and the others set out to search for an Oni.
title:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ [前編] 始まりの物語: The first part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the 12-episode TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired from January to April 2011. One day, a mysterious transfer student named Homura Akemi arrives at the middle school attended by Madoka Kaname, an ordinary girl living a mundane life. After school that day, guided by a mysterious voice, Madoka encounters a strange creature calling itself Kyubey, who tells her, 'I want you to make a contract with me and become a magical girl.' The staff from the TV series, who built its unique worldview, including chief director Akiyuki Shinbo, screenwriter Gen Urobuchi (Nitroplus), and the otherworldly space design team Gekidan Inu Curry, have reunited for this film.
title:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ[後編] 永遠の物語: The second part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired in 2011, created a huge sensation, and won numerous awards including the 16th Animation Kobe Award for TV Series, the 11th Tokyo Anime Award at Tokyo International Anime Fair 2012, and the Grand Prize in the Animation Division at the 15th Japan Media Arts Festival. Sayaka, who became a magical girl for the sake of her beloved Kyosuke, becomes consumed by despair upon learning the truth about magical girls and ultimately transforms into a witch. Madoka accepts Kyoko's proposal to try and save Sayaka, but... A dark fantasy depicting the harsh fate of five girls who chose to fight as magical girls in exchange for having just one wish granted.
title:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ[新編]叛逆の物語: The third film in the theatrical series of "Puella Magi Madoka Magica," which aired on TV from January to April 2011 and received high acclaim and popularity, including winning the Grand Prize in the Animation Division at the 15th Agency for Cultural Affairs Media Arts Festival. Following the "Beginning Story" and "Eternal Story" films, which recompiled the 12-episode TV series, this is a completely new feature-length work with newly written script and animation. In a new world where Madoka Kaname freed magical girls from the chain of cruel fate, Homura Akemi, left behind unable to fulfill her feelings for Madoka, continues to fight alone, believing she can meet Madoka again. New magical girl Nagisa Momoe appears as a new character alongside Madoka and Homura.
title:劇場版 かげる針路: A documentary that delves into the serious 'shadow' beginning to appear over Fukushima's course, which was set on the ideals of 'nuclear phase-out' and 'renewable energy promotion' following the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. This is a theatrical remake of the Fukushima TV documentary program 'Kageru Shiro' (Shadowy Course), which aired in May 2025 and sparked a huge response. Fukushima Prefecture, having experienced one of the world's worst nuclear accidents, shifted course toward abandoning nuclear power and promoting renewable energy. Fifteen years after that turning point, Fukushima now stands at a critical crossroads. As mega-solar plants rapidly expand, carving up mountains, issues like shoddy construction and landscape degradation have surfaced, intensifying headwinds against renewable energy. Meanwhile, with the government still unable to show a clear picture of completing the decommissioning of the crippled Fukushima Daiichi plant, it has shifted its energy policy back toward nuclear power, moving to restart reactors. The film turns its camera on the environmental destruction and friction with local residents caused by the rapid expansion of mega-solar, and the government's return to nuclear power, which becomes clearer as the end of decommissioning remains out of sight, vividly capturing Fukushima's present wavering between ideals and reality.
title:劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話 ゾクゾク変な間取り: The third installment in the omnibus horror series "Theatrical Edition: Real Scary Stories - Strange Floor Plans," depicting inexplicable events in homes with bizarre layouts. It portrays a chain of supernatural occurrences in a house in an area called "Kyūkyōzuka" from five different perspectives. Momoko Nanase, who works for a property management company, visits an old house to take photos of the property, but the photos she takes with her smartphone show a dilapidated Japanese-style room and a dark figure that she doesn't remember capturing (CASE 1: "Property Photos"). Shinji Niimi, a salesman at a real estate investment company, is approached by an old woman and invited into her home, where he is led to a room enshrining an eerie "Portrait of Mother and Child" (CASE 2: "The Portrait"). Keita Kyūjō, living happily with his pregnant wife Ayane, is visited by his sister Shiori, who wears a prayer bead necklace and warns him that being with Ayane will bring misfortune (CASE 3: "Beloved Wife"). Gōtoku Mikami, an occult YouTuber, crosses a forbidden boundary after a spirit appears in his stream and his view count skyrockets (CASE 4: "The Streamer"). Three members of an investigation company that scientifically explains anomalies in stigmatized properties and proves "there is nothing abnormal" head to a house to investigate, but when one of them witnesses a female spirit, tension begins to brew within the team (CASE 5: "On-Site Investigation"). Ginji Watanabe of the comedy duo "Dondecorte," Daigo Nagami and Junpei Hamada of "Kabe Poster" each make their film acting debuts, with Kōhei Masuda of "Kageyama" also appearing.
title:劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話 ゾク変な間取り:
The second installment in the omnibus horror series "The Movie: True Scary Stories - Strange Floor Plans," which depicts inexplicable events occurring in houses with bizarre layouts.

Director Matsumura and cameraman Fujii are reviewing footage for a documentary following Rinko Soma, a "Seikashi" (House Organizer)—a professional who specializes in "arranging" homes. As Soma "loosens" the pillars and floors of a house where a gruesome incident once occurred, the camera captures something unexpected (Episode 1: "The House Organizer").

Okudera, who works for a real estate management company, tracks the whereabouts of a missing rookie employee named Mishima to a vacant house that has failed to find a buyer. On the floor plan of that house, suspicious marks—not standard legal symbols—were inscribed (Episode 2: "Site Investigation").

Having lost his fiancée Mari just before their wedding, Ohno spends his final moments in the room where they were supposed to share a peaceful life together... (Episode 3: "Newlywed Life").

Funyao Harada of the comedy duo "Danbi Ramucho," Koji Ito of "Lanjatai," and solo artist Sui star in each respective episode.
title:劇場版 ロッキンミュージカル シン・シャドウブラウン＆ブラックパイレ:
"Rockin' Musical: The Adventures of Shin Shadow Brown & Black Pirates" is a filmed theatrical release of the rock musical directed, staged, structured, and composed by musician Diamond Yukai.

The project traces its roots back to 1992, when Yukai conceived the story and music for "Shadow Brown & Black Pirates," a concept album released under the theme of "Rock x Adventure x Musical Theater." In 2025, 33 years after its debut, the original band members reunited to reconstruct the work into a rock musical that seamlessly blends music and drama. Capturing the performance held in Tokyo on March 15, 2025, this film brings to the big screen the exhilarating tale of a rockin' pirate band sailing through time and space.

Shadow Brown and his crew arrive at Jenny Island, a place where music has been banned. Though the island was once overflowing with song, all sound and smiles have since vanished, leaving the hearts of its people frozen in silence. After meeting a young girl who has lost her hope and light, Shadow Brown rises up to restore the joy of music to the world.
