title:恩讐を越えて［龍の岬 改題］: Sentaro Shirai (1907–1945) is a director deserving of re-evaluation. After apprenticing under Takuji Furumi at Utaemon Productions, he made his directorial debut and went on to direct numerous popular period dramas at Daito Eiwa (which became Daiei following the 1942 wartime merger). This film, Shirai’s final work, employs masterful direction to depict a sister and brother (Ichikawa and Hara) who find themselves drawn to the enemy (Kataoka) they seek to kill. New print from the original version held by KADOKAWA.
title:息を殺して: This is the graduation work from Kohei Igarashi's master's program at Tokyo University of the Arts. Igarashi, who studied under Nobuhiro Suwa and Kiyoshi Kurosawa, received high international praise for his first feature film, "The Voice of Wind and Rain," made while he was still a student. It is December 30, 2017, about two years before the Tokyo Olympics, and the constitution has been revised and a National Defense Force established. A stray dog wanders into a garbage processing plant. Tani-chan, who works in the office, searches for the dog but can't find it. Ken, who finished his night shift, plays video games with Go, who is off duty that day. Adachi-san refuses to go home, while Yan-san is busy putting up New Year's decorations. The workers at the plant each grapple with similar problems: pregnancy, infidelity, family, and friends who died in the war. Amidst this, Tani-chan, troubled by her affair with Adachi-san, begins to feel that her late father, the former plant manager, might be present in this place.
title:息子のまなざし: The Dardenne brothers, directors of 'Rosetta' and 'The Promise,' sincerely and ambitiously tackle a profound motif that could be called humanity's eternal challenge in civilized society. They depict the extreme inner turmoil of a protagonist burdened with complex emotions in a stripped-down, understated style. Olivier Gourmet won the Best Actor award at the 2003 Cannes Film Festival. One day, a boy named Francis enters a vocational training center. He wants to join the woodworking class, but the instructor, Olivier, turns him away, saying he's too busy. Yet, Olivier finds himself strangely preoccupied with Francis. Eventually, Olivier accepts Francis into his class...
title:悪は存在しない: In Mizuhiki Town, Nagano Prefecture, blessed with abundant nature. Takumi and his only daughter Hana have lived modestly there for generations, but one day a plan emerges to build a glamping site nearby, and its repercussions gradually reach their lives. A feature film born alongside "GIFT," a silent live concert film by Eiko Ishibashi, who composed the music for "Drive My Car." Winner of the Silver Lion (Grand Jury Prize) at the 80th Venice International Film Festival.
title:悪は存在しない濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: In Mizuhiki Town, Nagano Prefecture, blessed with abundant nature. Takumi and his only daughter Hana have lived modestly there for generations, but one day a plan emerges to build a glamping site nearby, and its repercussions gradually reach their lives. A feature film born alongside "GIFT," a silent live concert film by Eiko Ishibashi, who composed the music for "Drive My Car." Winner of the Silver Lion (Grand Jury Prize) at the 80th Venice International Film Festival.
title:悲しくて美しい世界 THIS IS SPARKLEHORSE: This documentary explores the enigmatic life and music of Mark Linkous, the central figure of the American act Sparklehorse, who emerged during the mid-1990s alternative rock boom and earned a devoted following for his singular musicality. Sparklehorse released their debut album, *Vivadixiesubmarinetransmissionplot*, in 1995, garnering critical acclaim across the West for its inventive sound. The band gained further prominence as the opening act for Radiohead and R.E.M., but during a European tour with Radiohead, Linkous suffered a near-fatal alcohol and drug overdose. Though he survived, the lasting effects of the incident cast a long shadow over his life, and in 2010, while working on his sixth album, he took his own life. Through interviews recorded shortly before his death and testimonies from fellow musicians and filmmaker David Lynch, this film unravels the reality of Linkous’s existence and his music.
title:情事: Sandro, his lover Anna, and her friend Claudia go sailing on a yacht. When they land on a certain island, Anna suddenly disappears. Sandro and Claudia search for her, but gradually find themselves drawn to each other, giving in to their desires despite their guilt.
title:惊天大营救: A revenge action film starring Thai action star Tony Jaa, known for 'Ong-Bak' and 'Tom-Yum-Goong'. It depicts a man who lost his family confronting a massive conspiracy, packed with powerful Muay Thai-based hand-to-hand combat and high-speed, hard-hitting action. After his wife and daughter are killed by a mysterious organization, Bai An heads to the Republic of Parivina to uncover the truth and exact revenge. As he investigates on his own, he discovers a giant corporation secretly controlling the drug trade, but behind it swirls a vast conspiracy involving the military and police. The situation becomes intricately tangled with a mad drug lord, corrupt military police, and unexpected trials involving the only daughter of the corporation's owner. Bai An is tossed about but continues to battle the enemies closing in on him. Directed by Cheung Sui-yee. Co-stars include Xing Yu from 'Master Z: Ip Man Legacy', Philip Keung from 'Goldfinger', and Jason Han from 'Overheat: The Final Sanction'.
title:惑星ソラリス: When communication is lost with the space station Prometheus, which is exploring the ocean-and-cloud-covered planet Solaris, psychologist Kris is sent to investigate. Upon arriving at the Prometheus, Kris witnesses the suicide of a friend, traces of people who shouldn't be there, and a series of inexplicable phenomena caused by the sentient organic ocean.
title:惑星ソラリス 4Kレストア: When communication is lost with the space station Prometheus, which is exploring the ocean-and-cloud-covered planet Solaris, psychologist Kris is sent to investigate. Upon arriving at the Prometheus, Kris witnesses the suicide of a friend, traces of people who shouldn't be there, and a series of inexplicable phenomena caused by the sentient organic ocean.
title:愛と殺意: The feature-length debut by Italy's master filmmaker Michelangelo Antonioni, released in 1950. A noir-toned drama of love and hatred woven between a capitalist's wife and her former lover. Milan capitalist Enrico hires a detective to investigate the past conduct of his beautiful wife Paola. Ironically, this investigation leads Paola to reunite with her former lover Guido. Bored with her loveless marriage, she rediscovers passion in her relationship with Guido. As her husband's investigation progresses, the two gradually step into a dangerous affair. Paola is played by Milan-born actress Lucia Bosè, who appeared in "Lumière" and "Last Harem." The role of former lover Guido is played by Massimo Girotti, known for his appearances in Luchino Visconti works such as "The Postman Always Rings Twice" and "Summer Storm." In this work, Antonioni—who continually examined modern loneliness and the futility of love between men and women—already depicts the alienation in human relationships that would carry through his later films. In Japan, it will receive its theatrical premiere in a 4K restored version at the special screening series "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: The Futility of Love, Wandering Souls" in August 2026.
title:愛のごとく:
"Ai no Gotoku" (Like Love) is the posthumous short story by Masao Yamakawa, a brilliant figure of post-war Japanese literature, originally published in 1964. Director Kishu Ido, renowned for his adaptations of literary classics such as "Manji" and "A Fool's Love," brings this exploration of human nature—caught between love and solitude—to the screen for the first time.

Hayao, a man who debuted as a novelist but now earns a living as a writer, happens upon a couple immersed in a world of SM one night. Despite being bound by her husband, the wife locks eyes with Hayao and offers a smile—a sight that leaves a deep impression on his soul. Soon after, he reunites with his former lover, Izumi, for the first time in eight years. As reality, memory, and fantasy intertwine, Hayao’s heart begins to waver, drawing him back toward his past with Izumi.

Robin Furuya, known for the drama "VIVANT," makes his feature film starring debut as Hayao. Reimi Miyamori ("My Head is Always Noisy") portrays Izumi, supported by a cast including Mami Yamasaki, Mutsuo Yoshioka, Miyoko Yoshimoto, and Chizuru Azuma. The screenplay is penned by Kaori Kotani, marking her third collaboration with Director
title:愛のコリーダ: In the 11th year of the Showa era (1936). Sadako, a maid at a Japanese inn, becomes infatuated with the inn's master and begins an affair. When the affair is discovered by the man's wife, the two decide to elope. As they indulge in days of pleasure, Sadako becomes unwilling to ever let him go, and eventually strangles him to death to keep him for herself, then cuts off his genitals.
title:愛の世紀: A drama by Jean-Luc Godard, the master who led the French New Wave, centered on the theme of 'love.' Edgar, a young artist in Paris, conceives a new work depicting four moments related to love—'encounter, passion, separation, reconciliation'—using three couples. The heroine Edgar considers ideal for this project is a woman he met two years ago. She is the granddaughter of an elderly couple who were once involved in the Resistance, whom Edgar met while researching the history of the Resistance in Brittany. Searching for her, Edgar revives his memories of Brittany two years ago. The first half depicts present events in richly shaded black-and-white 35mm film, while the second half shows protagonist Edgar's flashbacks in vivid color using digital video. The 4K restored version will be screened in Japan for the first time as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
title:愛の挨拶: A short film directed by Akira Iwamatsu, known for "Thirst for Love." This psychological thriller explores a romance wavering between truth and delusion through the testimony of a woman making a bizarre confession. A woman appears at a police station claiming to have committed a break-in, pleading, "I want you to arrest me." However, no such report has been filed. Is her testimony reality or delusion? As the interrogation progresses, her true objective gradually comes to light. Set within the confined space of a meeting room, the woman’s story is visualized through the imagination of the officer questioning her. The film was produced out of actress Yuna Takahashi’s desire to produce a project starring herself, with Takahashi serving as both lead and producer. The screenplay was also written specifically for her. Director Iwamatsu constructed the story based on various real-life accounts, depicting the desire for validation and the distorted romantic psychology of today's youth.
title:愛の挨拶 Short Film Biotope #9: This film was produced out of actress Yuna Takahashi’s strong desire to produce a movie starring herself. The project was born from Director Iwamatsu’s wish to realistically portray the romantic psychology of modern Japanese youth, based on a true story he heard from an actress acquaintance. The screenplay was written specifically for Takahashi, crafted with a focus on bringing out her unique personality to the fullest. Furthermore, the production was a true labor of love, with the entire cast and crew participating on a volunteer basis and filming locations secured through the cooperation of the local community. By working together as one within such an environment, the team has created a work truly infused with heart and sincerity.
title:愛の新世界: Ray is an actress in a small theater troupe. By day, she devotes herself to rehearsals with her friends, and by night, she works as a dominatrix at an SM club in Shibuya. One evening, Ray becomes friendly with Ayumi, a hotel escort girl she occasionally sees in the elevator of the building where the club is located. Ayumi is a shrewd girl living with Kenji, a ronin studying for medical school entrance exams. The two hit it off and head out into the nightlife. After drinking, dancing, and partying, they part ways, promising to go see the sea at dawn together someday. Finally, the day of Ray's theater troupe's performance arrives. With Ayumi and Ray's client Sawatari watching, Ray's play is a success, met with thunderous applause. Ray is moved by the satisfaction of accomplishing something. Ayumi is also moved seeing Ray like this. The two head out to the coast at dawn in a car driven by a man they picked up.
title:愛の言葉: A love story starring Sungmo and Jihyuk of the popular K-pop group "Supernova," set against the rich natural backdrop of Chuncheon City, also known as a filming location for "Winter Sonata." It depicts a young man who has lost his words meeting a loved one and finding hope to live again. Teo, a piano tuner with a speech disorder caused by aftereffects of brain tumor surgery, meets Inha, a former popular singer who has lost her sight due to retinitis pigmentosa and is recuperating in a small village in Chuncheon. Unable to speak, Teo plays the piano to accompany Inha's singing, which leads Inha to open her heart to him. However, Inha's ex-lover Romy appears to take her back, and Inha ends up returning to Seoul. The director is Han Sang-hee, who directed "First Snow's Love: Virgin Snow" starring Lee Joon-gi and Aoi Miyazaki.
title:愛憎三都錦繪［敵討三都錦繪 戦後改題版］: Hideo Koi (also known as Hideo Koi), recognized as the producer of Kenji Mizoguchi’s *Lady Musashino* (1951) and the "Wataridori" (Wandering Guitarist) series (1959–1962), directed this film during his time as an assistant director, stepping in for the ailing Tomiyasu Ikeda. While it is a traditional *chanbara* period drama starring Yataro Kurokawa and Ranko Hanai, the direction is notable for its striking use of animals such as spiders and frogs. The version to be screened is the post-war retitled edition.
title:我々のものではない世界: Screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2013, where it won the Grand Prize.
title:我ら山人たち: A documentary by the renowned Swiss master Fredi M. Murer, known for 'Höhenfeuer' (Alpine Fire), capturing the mountainous region of his native Canton of Uri. Exploring the lives and spiritual world of mountain people in a changing alpine landscape, the film contains many elements that would later connect to 'Höhenfeuer,' such as folkloric themes and the insularity of communities. It won the International Critics' Prize at the 1974 Locarno International Film Festival. This film, along with 'Höhenfeuer' and 'Green Mountain,' forms the 'Mountain Trilogy.'
title:我在這裡等你: A road movie set in Hong Kong and Taiwan, depicting a midsummer miracle connected by a single letter. Against the beautiful, shimmering landscapes of Taiwan, it portrays a time-spanning bond between a wounded writer and a lonely young man. Tianyu, a popular Hong Kong writer, faces fierce public backlash after accusations of plagiarism. Deeply hurt, he travels alone to Taiwan in search of the 'Whale's Vanished Cove,' a place said to lead to heaven, which a boy he once corresponded with told him about. After being cheated in an unfamiliar country and getting drunk in the bustling streets of Taipei, Tianyu is helped by Ashang, a local thug. When Tianyu reveals the purpose of his journey, Ashang, claiming to know the 'Whale's Vanished Cove,' offers to take him there, and their summer journey begins... Terence Lau, known for 'Twilight Warriors: Final Battle in the Kowloon Walled City,' delicately portrays the gentle and pure writer Tianyu, while Fandy Fan, from 'Destiny Matchup,' co-stars as the thug Ashang.
title:戦いの向こう 侍たちの記録 2026 WORLD BASEBALL: A documentary providing an intimate behind-the-scenes look at Samurai Japan, the Japanese national baseball team, during the 6th World Baseball Classic (WBC) held in March 2026. Having vowed to "discard admiration and surpass it" to win the world championship in a hard-fought battle at the 2023 WBC, the team entered this tournament under the immense pressure of being the reigning champions, facing the inescapable burden of "having to remain the winning champions." The film explores what the players felt and how they fought during their quest to remain on top, and how they came to terms with the result of losing in the quarterfinals. Through the lens of the only camera granted exclusive access to the team for this tournament, the documentary gets to the heart of the action behind the scenes. The director is Shintaro Miki, who has previously made documentaries closely following Samurai Japan, such as "Unity, Beyond: The Warriors' Anguish and Hope" and "The Samurai Who Surpassed Admiration: Record of Becoming World No. 1." Narration is provided by Kazunari Ninomiya, and the theme song is performed by Koshi Inaba. It began streaming on Netflix on April 20, 2026, and had a limited theatrical release nationwide in Japan starting August 14, 2026, including at Aeon Cinema Itabashi.

title:戦国自衛隊: Led by Lieutenant Yoshiaki Iba, 21 members of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, armed with modern weapons, suddenly time-slip along with their supply depot to the Sengoku period while en route to an exercise. As they stand bewildered, Nagao Heizo Kagetora arrives with his retainers to meet them. Upon first seeing Iba, Kagetora takes an instant liking to him, calling him "a kindred spirit," and is drawn to their unfamiliar clothing and weapons, hoping to recruit them. Iba and his soldiers struggle to accept the reality of their time slip. However, after encountering Kagetora and being attacked by guerrilla forces of a rival feudal lord—resulting in a comrade's death—and witnessing Kagetora's battle firsthand, they are forced to come to terms with having arrived in the Sengoku period.
title:打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？: Summer vacation. Norimichi, an elementary school student, is invited by his classmate Nazuna—who is set to transfer schools after the summer due to her parents' divorce—to go to the fireworks festival with her that night. However, Nazuna is planning to run away from home, and Norimichi finds himself being dragged along. Meanwhile, Norimichi's friends, including Junichi, have decided to go to the festival to see for themselves whether fireworks look round or flat when viewed from the side. Nazuna remains determined to carry out her plan to run away.
title:抽象アニメーション作品集: This program provides an overview ranging from the works of visual music pioneers Oskar Fischinger (1900–1967) and Mary Ellen Bute (1906–1983) to 1960s American experimental animation—including Robert Breer’s (1926–2011) *Breathing* (1963) and James Whitney’s (1921–1982) *Lapis* (1966)—and through to *Frank Film* (1973), the first autobiographical work to win the Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film. Influenced by the Beat Generation, these abstract animations are meditative, characterized by an interest in new technology, a departure from narrative, and an approach that treats animation as an extension of intellectual and artistic activity. They were produced using techniques such as direct painting on film, cut-outs, collage, and analog computers.
title:拳銃 兵士の休暇: Vijay, a star of the Indian Tamil-language film industry known for films like "Master" and "Leo: Bloody Sweet," stars in this 2012 crime action film. Jagadish, a Tamilian living in Mumbai who serves as a soldier in Kashmir, encounters a bomb attack targeting a bus while home on leave. Investigating on his own, he uncovers clues to a larger, coordinated terrorist plot and, along with his colleagues, takes action to prevent it. Jagadish soon finds himself in a tense battle of wits against the enemy commander. This is the first collaboration between Vijay and director A.R. Murugadoss, known for "Kaththi" and "Sarkar." Upon its release in India in 2012, it became the highest-grossing Tamil film of that year and won numerous awards.
title:捕风追影: A battle action film starring Jackie Chan, depicting the fight between a police force led by a tracking expert and a cybercrime group led by a former assassin. In Macau, a series of clever heists by an elusive cybercrime group occur. With the surveillance system hijacked and the investigation stalled, the police seek help from Huang Dezhong, a retired tracking expert, as their trump card. Teaming up with young elite police officers, Huang Dezhong uses old-school investigative techniques and the latest technology to pursue the cybercrime group led by a former assassin known as 'Shadow.' Leon Ka-Fai, known for 'The Lover' and 'Cold War,' plays the former assassin leader of the criminal group, reuniting with Jackie Chan for the first time in about 20 years since 'The Myth.' JUN, a member of the popular K-POP group SEVENTEEN who also works as an actor, takes on his first villain role as a member of the criminal group. Zhang Zifeng, from 'Sister Summer's Farewell,' and Zusha, from the TV drama 'Mountain and River Shadows,' also appear. The film is directed and written by Larry Yang, who previously worked with Jackie Chan on 'Ride On.'
title:探偵物語: This was a highly anticipated comeback film for Yakusho, who had taken a break from acting to prepare for university entrance exams after the massive hit of her starring movie "Sailor Suit and Machine Gun" (1981). The story follows a pampered college girl, played by Yakusho, who is bodyguarded by a private detective played by Matsuda. Director Negishi Kichitaro and the staff devised various strategies to help Yakusho grow as an actress, and she rose to the occasion. It was first released as a double feature with "The Girl Who Leapt Through Time" starring Harada Tomoyo. College student Arai Naomi is set to leave for America, where her father awaits, in one week. Invited by her admired senior Nagai, she heads to a hotel, but a man claiming to be her uncle bursts in and drives Nagai away. The man is a private detective named Tsujiyama Shuichi, hired by her father's former secretary to protect her until her departure. One day, Tsujiyama's ex-wife Sachiko shows up at his apartment, saying she is suspected of stabbing Kazuya, the heir to the Okazaki gang, at a hotel. Naomi suggests to Tsujiyama that they search for the real culprit together.
title:揺さぶられる正義: A documentary based on years of reporting by a lawyer-journalist on Shaken Baby Syndrome (SBS) cases, which have led to numerous wrongful convictions. Following the clash of competing "justices," the film questions the state of the judiciary and the media.
title:撃たれた自由の声を撮れ: A documentary recording the daily struggles of women who continue to seek freedom in Afghanistan under Taliban rule. In August 2021, the Taliban seized control of nearly all of Afghanistan, collapsing the two-decade democratic government. With the Taliban's return to power, women were once again barred from working outside the home, deprived of educational opportunities, and girls were forced into marriages with much older men and confined to their houses. Sisters Rashmin and Nastaran, along with other women, take to the streets to raise their voices against countless inequalities. Undaunted even by armed men, they hide smartphones under their scarves to film and broadcast the current situation in Afghanistan. They continue their resistance while moving from one relative's home to another, but in a patriarchal society, their father despises the women participating in demonstrations, and they are forced to live in fear of neighbors informing on them. Despite such harsh circumstances, Rashmin, driven by the desire not to make the next generation experience the same suffering, rushes out into the streets. The director is Zainab Entezar, an Afghan-born female filmmaker, producer, and writer who, while living in exile, continues to broadcast the voices of the women of her homeland to the world.
title:敗北者たち: The second feature film by Italian master Michelangelo Antonioni, known for "L'Avventura" and "Red Desert," made in 1953. An omnibus ensemble drama depicting young people who commit crimes, set in cities across France, Italy, and England. Paris, Rome, London. In each city, driven by greed for money, vanity, or unfulfilled boredom, young people turn to crimes such as murder and smuggling. Against the backdrop of postwar prosperity regaining its wealth, the spiritual emptiness of a younger generation that has lost its way, and shifting values, quietly come to the surface. Antonioni handled direction, original story, and screenplay, with Suso Cecchi D'Amico, a leading Italian screenwriter known for Visconti works like "White Nights" and "The Leopard," and writer Giorgio Bassani co-writing the script. His gaze, calmly observing the alienation and apathy behind crime, carries forward into his later works. In Japan, it will receive its theatrical premiere in a 2K restored version at the special screening "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: The Futility of Love, Wandering Souls" in August 2026.
title:教授と美女: At the Totten Foundation in New York, eight scholars are putting the finishing touches on an encyclopedia, but when grammar professor Potts overhears a slang term, he realizes their work has been isolated from the real world and ventures into the city to investigate. There, he seeks the help of O'Shea, a nightclub singer... Although the film was a hit in the U.S. upon release, it was never imported due to the times. Billy Wilder contributed to the script on the condition that he be allowed to observe Hawks' direction. He made his directorial debut the following year, having used this as preparation.
title:敵:
Director Daihachi Yoshida (*The Kirishima Thing*, *Kiba: The Fangs of Fiction*) adapts Yasutaka Tsutsui’s novel of the same name into a monochrome cinematic experience. It tells the story of an elderly man living a tranquil, solitary life who is suddenly confronted by an "enemy."

Gisuke Watanabe, 77, is a retired university professor and widower living alone in the traditional Japanese house he inherited from his grandfather. He wakes at the same hour every morning, prepares his own meals, and treats every item he owns—from his clothing to his stationery—with meticulous care. Occasionally, he shares drinks with a few close friends or hosts dinner for a former student. His days pass in peace as he calculates how many more years his savings will sustain this lifestyle. However, into this quiet existence comes a disturbing message, flashing across his computer screen: "The enemy is coming."

Kyozo Nagatsuka takes on his first leading film role in 12 years as Gisuke. He is joined by Kumi Takiuchi as his former student, Asuka Kurosawa as his late wife, and Yuumi Kawai as a university student he meets at a bar, with Satoru Matsuo, Takashi Matsuo, Shinsuke Kato, and Ayumu Nakajima rounding out the supporting cast. The film competed at the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2024, where it achieved a triple crown: the Tokyo Grand Prix / The Governor of Tokyo Award, Best Director (Daihachi Yoshida), and Best Actor (Kyozo Nagatsuka).
title:新・平家物語: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.
title:新作歌舞伎 風の谷のナウシカ 前編: The first part of "New Kabuki: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind," a kabuki adaptation of all seven volumes of Hayao Miyazaki's manga version of "Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind." The story is set in a world where industrial civilization was destroyed by a war known as the "Seven Days of Fire," and most of the land is covered by the "Sea of Corruption," a forest that emits giant insects and toxic miasma. Nausicaä, the daughter of the chieftain of the small "Valley of the Wind," where people who control the wind live, is not afraid of the feared Sea of Corruption or its insects and seeks to unravel the mystery of its origin. One day, a stone containing the power to revive the "God Warrior," which burned the world in the Seven Days of Fire, is discovered in the small kingdom of Pejite, and the powerful empire of Tolmekia moves to seize it. This first part includes three of the seven acts: Act I "The One in Blue Garments Stands in a Golden Field," Act II "The Revival of the Devil's Law," and Act III "The White Witch Marches on the Bloody Path." This is a recorded video of the stage performance held at Shinbashi Enbujo Theatre from December 6 to 25, 2019, screened as a delayed viewing in February 2020 at Togeki, Shinjuku Piccadilly, and other venues (Part 1: February 14–20, 2020 / Part 2: February 28–March 5, 2020, each for a limited one-week run).
title:新作歌舞伎 風の谷のナウシカ 後編: The second part of the "New Kabuki: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind," a kabuki adaptation of Hayao Miyazaki's manga version of "Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind." This kabuki adaptation covers the entire epic story of the original seven-volume manga, which was not depicted in the anime film directed by Miyazaki himself. The stage production was performed at the Shinbashi Enbujō Theatre as a daytime (first part) and evening (second part) continuous performance, and this is a filmed recording of that acclaimed stage. Kikunosuke Onoe plays the protagonist Nausicaä, and Shichinosuke Nakamura plays Princess Kushana, Nausicaä's adversary. The script was written by Keiko Niwa, who has worked on many Studio Ghibli films such as "Tales from Earthsea" and "The Secret World of Arrietty." Direction was handled by G2, who also directed "New Kabuki: NARUTO." This second part includes Act 4 "Great Tsunami," Act 5 "Forest of Purification," Act 6 "Awakening of the God Warrior," and the Grand Finale "Secrets of the Shrine of Shuwa" from the total of seven acts. The stage performance at Shinbashi Enbujō from December 6 to 25, 2019, was filmed and screened as a delay viewing at Tōgeki, Shinjuku Piccadilly, and other venues in February 2020 (first part: February 14–20, 2020; second part: February 28–March 5, 2020, each for a limited one-week run).
title:新凱旋門物語: The Grande Arche, a monumental cube-shaped building in the La Défense district west of Paris, stands on the "Paris historical axis" stretching straight from the glass pyramid of the Louvre. Behind its completion lies the unknown story of an anonymous architect whose fate was shaken. Based on historical fact, this human drama immerses viewers in the bizarre life of an architect who challenged a national project while being tossed about by ideals and political maneuvering. An ensemble of talented actors lends the film credibility, earning it a selection in the Un Certain Regard section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival and eight César Award nominations. This architectural drama resonates with debates surrounding Japan's National Stadium and the Osaka Expo. In 1983 Paris, President Mitterrand envisioned a new monument to celebrate the bicentennial of the French Revolution. The international design competition selected the unknown Danish architect Johan Otto von Spreckelsen. His bold plan—a cube-shaped arch of Italian Carrara marble with a cloud-like roof floating at its base—captured the president's heart and made him an overnight sensation. However, budget constraints, political pressure, and the expectations of those around him stood in the way of his pursuit of perfection. Should he stick to his ideals or compromise with reality? Caught in the vortex of a massive project, what "certain decision" will one architect make?
title:新劇場版☆ケロロ軍曹 復活して速攻地球滅亡の危機であります！: As part of the 20th-anniversary project for the TV anime "Sergeant Keroro," based on the manga by Mine Yoshizaki serialized in "Monthly Shonen Ace" since 1999, this theatrical anime is the first in 16 years since "Keroro Gunso the Super Movie: Creation! Ultimate Keroro, Wonderous Time-Space Island!!" in 2010. It depicts the Keroro Platoon, who were supposed to invade Earth, fighting to protect the planet from a new invader. Sergeant Keroro and his platoon members, who came to Earth to invade but now spend their days idly at their host family's home, encounter mysterious phenomena occurring across the country. Feeling a sense of crisis, the Keroro Platoon rises to the challenge, putting their pride as invaders on the line, but they encounter mysterious letters wherever they go. The screenplay and general direction are handled by Yuichi Fukuda, known for directing the live-action "Gintama" series. The staff includes key members who have supported the series, with Satoshi Ozaki as director, Satoshi Koike as character designer, and BN Pictures handling animation production. Jesse from SixTONES voices the theatrical original characters, the brothers Aruru and Deruru, playing both roles.

title:新喜劇之王: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. One day, her minor cosmetic surgery for a role catches the eye of a staff member, and she is selected for the blockbuster "Snow White: Bloody Chinatown," starring former star actor Ma. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

title:新感染 ファイナル・エクスプレス: A Korean survival panic action film depicting the terror and chaos caused by the sudden outbreak of a mysterious virus spreading aboard a high-speed train connecting Seoul and Busan. Seok-woo, a fund manager working in Seoul, is separated from his wife and lives with his young daughter Su-an. Su-an insists on going alone to meet her mother in Busan for her birthday, and Seok-woo reluctantly agrees to escort her. They board the KTX high-speed train from Seoul to Busan, but just before departure, a suspicious commotion occurs near Seoul Station. A woman infected with the mysterious virus also boards KTX train 101, the same train as the father and daughter. Alongside the protagonist Seok-woo and his daughter, various passengers—a pregnant woman and her husband, high school baseball players, and a selfish middle-aged businessman—face a life-or-death struggle for survival in a state of extremity where being caught by the infected means certain death, and their individual human dramas unfold. This is the first live-action feature film by Yeon Sang-ho, a rising director who has garnered attention in the Korean animation scene, and the story preceding this film is revealed in the animated feature 'Seoul Station'.

title:旅立ちのラストダンス: A human drama reuniting Hong Kong comedy king Michael Hui, popular in Japan for the 'Mr. Boo!' series, and Dayo Wong, a top Hong Kong comedian and actor ('A Witness Out of the Blue'), after 32 years. It became a massive hit, breaking Hong Kong's all-time box office record. Set in Hong Kong's funeral industry, it carefully explores universal themes of family, tradition, and views on life and death. Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.

Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.
title:无名: Set in Shanghai during World War II, this spy noir depicts the back-and-forth battle of nameless spies among the Chinese Communist Party, the Kuomintang, and the Japanese military. Starring Hong Kong superstar Tony Leung, who won the Best Actor award at the 53rd Cannes International Film Festival for 'In the Mood for Love' (2000) and has recently gained attention from younger generations for his role in 'Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings' (21). The other lead is Wang Yibo, who debuted as a member of the China-Korean joint unit 'UNIQ' and later broke out as an actor in the TV drama 'The Untamed' (19), now one of the most sought-after young actors in China. This film marks his first leading role in a movie, and he has since starred in multiple films, winning the Best Actor award at the 20th Film Channel Media Awards for his second lead role in 'Born to Fly' (23) alongside this film. The intense, stunt-free action sequences performed by the two leads captivate with overwhelming tension and unparalleled beauty. Directed by Chen Er, who previously helmed 'Once Upon a Time in Shanghai' (16). Chen also wrote and edited this film, and Tony Leung was so impressed by the script—only Chen's fourth feature—that he agreed to star. Nominated for eight awards including Best Picture and Best Actor at the 36th China Film Golden Rooster Awards, the highest honor in Chinese cinema, held in November last year. Wang Yibo, making his film debut, was nominated for Best Supporting Actor. Tony Leung won Best Actor, and director Chen Er won Best Director and Best Editing, achieving a triple crown.
title:日動短篇集: The origins of Toei Animation trace back to Nihon Dōga, founded by pre-war animation artists Masaoka Kenzo and Yamamoto Sanae. After releasing the "Tora-chan" series, which reflected the social conditions immediately following Japan's defeat in the war, the studio was renamed Nichidō Eiga and began producing animations commissioned by the Toei Education Film Division. The first commissioned work was "Ukare Violin," directed by Yabushita Taiji (also known as Yabushita Taiji). The positive reception of this work led Toei to decide on acquiring Nichidō Eiga, which in turn led to the establishment of Toei Dōga. Notably, Yabushita had experience shooting and directing cultural and documentary films as a commissioned staff member of the Ministry of Education's Film Section, and he would go on to play a central role as a director at Toei Dōga.
title:日本のいちばん長い日: The film depicts the 24 hours from noon on August 14, 1945 (Showa 20), when the Showa Emperor and cabinet ministers decided to surrender at an Imperial Conference, to noon on August 15, when the acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration was announced to the public via the radio broadcast of the Emperor's Jewel Voice (Gyokuon-hoso) through NHK.
title:日本鬼子（リーベン・クイズ） 日中15年戦争・元皇軍兵士の告白: This documentary interviews 14 former Japanese soldiers who carried out acts of aggression against China during the 15-year Sino-Japanese War, which began with the Manchurian Incident in 1931, and records their confessions of the atrocities they committed. The interviewees include military doctors and Unit 731 members who repeatedly performed vivisections and bacterial experiments, military police who conducted torture and mass executions for their own achievements and honor, and soldiers who were drilled into the Japanese military's unique structure through private punishment of lower ranks by superiors, losing their humanity. These witnesses, with diverse upbringings, educations, occupations, and military careers, speak of the horrific facts they themselves carried out, driven by a poignant desire to convey the madness-like acts humans are capable of, their weaknesses, and the true nature of war. Produced and released in 2001. A DCP version was re-screened at Theater Image Forum in Tokyo in August 2019.
title:日泰小食: Set in a small diner on Cheung Chau, an outlying island of Hong Kong, this documentary observes a changing world through the islanders who gather there. Located about 30 minutes southwest of Hong Kong Island by ferry, Cheung Chau is a small island known as a fishing village, where colorful boats bob in the harbor and time flows gently. The 'Yat Tai' diner on the island is always bustling with locals who gather to play cards and mahjong with a beer in hand. However, societal changes and the fervor of citizens reach this island far from Hong Kong, and the diner's regulars cannot remain indifferent. From the owner staring at the TV to young people eagerly seeking information, each person grapples with the tides of the era from their own perspective and distance. Eventually, the pandemic that engulfs the world also has a major impact on this diner. The director is Frankie Shin, for whom this is his first feature-length documentary. Shin, a native of Cheung Chau who was also a regular at the Yat Tai diner, carefully captures how the people he treated like family faced the changing times and continued their daily lives. The film won the Best Documentary Award at the 29th Busan International Film Festival in 2024.

title:星の時: "I am a typist, a virgin, and I like Coke and hot dogs." Based on the novel by Clarice Lispector, known as 'Brazil's Virginia Woolf,' this film shines with an unforgettable brilliance in the history of Brazilian cinema. After 40 years, it receives its first theatrical release in Japan.
title:星を追う子ども: Makoto Shinkai, the animation artist known for delicate psychological portrayals and meticulous visual beauty in works like 'Voices of a Distant Star' and 'The Place Promised in Our Early Days,' returns with his first original feature in five years since '5 Centimeters per Second.' This juvenile animation follows a girl named Asuna who, triggered by mysterious music heard through a mineral radio left by her father, embarks on a grand adventure. The familiar staff supporting Shinkai's works, including art director Takumi Tanji and composer Tenmon, come together for this film.
title:映画 HUGっと！プリキュア♡ふたりはプリキュア オールスターズメモ: Cure Black, Cure White, and Shiny Luminous defeat a monster rampaging through the city. However, a mysterious monster named Miden appears and transforms Luminous into a child. Miden steals memories from all the previous Pretty Cures and turns them into baby Cures. Miden also appears before Hana and the others, and Hana fights alongside Black and White, who rush to help, but Cure Ange, Cure Etoile, Cure Macherie, Cure Amour, and even White are all reduced to toddlers. Hana, sinking into grief and despair before her young companions who have forgotten everything about themselves, and Nagisa, who cannot transform into a Pretty Cure without Honoka, find themselves in an utterly desperate crisis.
title:映画 えんとつ町のプペル 〜約束の時計台〜: The sequel to the 2020 anime film 'Poupelle of Chimney Town,' based on the picture book of the same name by Akihiro Nishino. Based on the 2019 picture book 'Tick Tock: The Promised Clock Tower,' it is adapted on a much larger scale, depicting the story of the boy Rubitch meeting his dear friend Poupelle, who went far away in the previous film, once again. One year has passed since the miracle night when Chimney Town was enveloped in a starry sky. The boy Rubitch, who lost his dear best friend Poupelle, continued to believe in their reunion but eventually gives up to move forward. One day, Rubitch wanders into a mysterious otherworld that controls time, the 'Millennium Fortress.' In this world, clocks that no longer tell time are disposed of, but there is a mysterious clock tower that, though not broken, has stopped at 11:59. The mission Rubitch is given to return to his original world is to get this stopped clock tower moving again. Rubitch meets a man who has kept a promise and waited for 100 years, and regains the courage to believe. Continuing from the previous film, Akihiro Nishino serves as executive producer, original creator, and screenwriter, Yusuke Hirota directs, and STUDIO4°C handles the animation production. Yuzuna Nagase, a child actor known for the TV drama series 'Asa ga Kita,' voices the protagonist Rubitch, and Masataka Kubota, who voiced Poupelle in the previous film, reprises his role.
title:映画 それいけ！アンパンマン パンタンと約束の星: The key word in the film 'Anpanman: Pantan and the Star of Promise' is 'promise.' The central character in this work is a new character, a red panda traveler named Pantan. Pantan embarks on a grand adventure to find a treasure said to be on the Rainbow Star shining in the night sky, in order to keep a precious promise made long ago with a certain adventurer! Along the way, Pantan meets Anpanman, Cream Panda, and other friends, and together they join forces to face one challenge after another! What kind of adventure awaits Pantan and the others? And will they be able to obtain the treasure...? Enjoy a thrilling, suspenseful, and epic story! Long ago, the red panda Pantan was traveling to keep a precious promise made with a certain adventurer. However, during the journey, he was hit by Baikinman's baby spray and turned into a child! Helped by Anpanman and the others, he tells everyone about the reason for his journey and his regret over breaking that important promise. Jam Uncle encourages him, saying, 'Isn't the important thing the feeling of wanting to keep a promise?' Renewing his resolve to 'keep the promise this time,' Pantan sets off for the Rainbow Star with Cream Panda. Cream Panda promises Pantan, 'I will never give up!' and joins the adventure, but is nearly discouraged by many crises. Meanwhile, Baikinman and his gang, who secretly boarded the plane, also come after the treasure... Pantan and the others keep trying, determined never to give up no matter what! When the Rainbow Star shines again, what they see at the promised place is... Can Pantan keep his promise this time? A story of precious promises and friendship.
title:映画 デジモンアドベンチャー: The first theatrical film in the "Digimon" series. From a midnight computer screen, a strange creature named "Botamon" is born! While Tai is uneasy, his little sister Kari is overjoyed. Botamon evolves into Agumon! Suddenly, the Digital World, home to digital monsters, appears. A bird-like monster charges at Agumon. But then, another change occurs in Agumon's body... Evolution into the giant monster "Greymon" begins! Two colossal monsters clash—what will be the outcome of this fierce battle?
title:映画 プリキュアオールスターズDX3 未来にとどけ！世界をつなぐ☆虹: Childhood friends Hibiki Hojo and Kanade Minamino, along with the fairy Hummy, visit a massive shopping mall on its opening day, but they lose sight of Hummy along the way. They manage to find her, but end up crashing into a fashion show hosted by Erika Kurumi. Amidst this, buildings and residents from other worlds, such as the Toy Kingdom and the Dessert Kingdom, suddenly appear. Furthermore, powerful enemies who once tormented the Pretty Cures are revived by the dark power of a black hole, plotting to wither the miracle flower connecting worlds, the "Prism Flower," and plunge the world into darkness. The Pretty Cures are sent to different worlds by the enemies' scheme, separated from their usual partners and allies, and each is invited into the worlds created by their formidable foes.

title:映画 プリキュアオールスターズDX3 未来にとどけ！世界をつなぐ★虹: The 10th theatrical film in the "Precure" series, which has enjoyed immense popularity among girls since its broadcast began in 2004. Hibiki Hōjō and Kanade Minamino visit a huge shopping mall and, while searching for the lost fairy Hamy, crash into Tsubomi's fashion show. Suddenly, fairies descend from the sky, and buildings from the "Toy Country" and giant sweets from the "Dessert Kingdom" appear one after another. Furthermore, the formidable enemies the Precures have fought in the past are resurrected.
title:映画 冬のソナタ 日本特別版:
"Winter Sonata," the masterpiece drama that aired on Korea's KBS in 2002 and ignited the "Hallyu" boom in Japan after achieving high ratings on NHK in 2004, returns to theaters in a special 4K remastered edition exclusive to Japan. Conceived by director Yoon Seok-ho and the original production team as a gesture of gratitude for the enduring love from Japanese fans, this version features 4K remastered visuals and a soundtrack rearranged specifically for the cinema. Director Yoon oversaw the entire process, distilling the story down to its core—the "pure love" between the two protagonists—to create this definitive edition.

In high school, Joon-sang and Yu-jin were each other's first loves. However, Joon-sang is involved in a tragic car accident and never returns. Ten years later, Yu-jin, now running an interior design firm, encounters a man named Min-hyeong who looks exactly like her lost love.

Bae Yong-joon plays the dual roles of Joon-sang and Min-hyeong, starring alongside Choi Ji-woo as the heroine.
title:映画 潜行一千里: A making-of documentary following the production of "Bangkok Nites," directed by Katsuya Tomita of the film collective "Kuzoku" and released in theaters in February 2017. Ten years in the making, "Bangkok Nites" was filmed entirely on location, traversing 4,000 kilometers across Thailand and Laos. From Thaniya Road—Bangkok’s red-light district catering to Japanese clientele—to the northeastern Isan region, the border town of Nong Khai on the banks of the Mekong River, and deep into the remote reaches of Laos, the production was a continuous journey where the act of filming became the journey itself. The documentary captures Kuzoku’s signature production style: a process where locals are cast as actors and join the crew as collaborators to bring a film to life. The documentary is directed by Masahiro Mukoyama of "Studio Ishi" (the visual unit of the hip-hop crew "stillichimiya"), who also served as the cinematographer for the original film.
title:映画『それいけ！アンパンマン パンタンと約束の星』: Pantan, a red panda, is traveling to keep a precious promise made with an adventurer. However, during the journey, he gets sprayed with Baikinman's baby spray and turns into a child! Pantan had long regretted breaking a promise in the past, but Uncle Jam encourages him, saying, 'What matters is the will to keep a promise.' Determined to keep the promise this time, he sets off with Cream Panda toward the Rainbow Star. When the Rainbow Star shines once more, what do they see at the promised place?
title:映画『仮面ライダーゼッツ さよならのミッション』 映画『超宇宙刑事ギ: "Kamen Rider Zetts" (Sundays 9:00-9:30 AM on TV Asahi) follows the story of Yorozu Baku, a good-natured young man who dreams of becoming an invincible agent, who transforms using the first-ever "chest-mounted transformation belt (Zetts Driver)"! To save humanity from the nightmare monsters known as "Nightmares," he carries out missions. His sister Miro is actually an agent with no blood relation to Baku, and her real father is...?! The movie for Kamen Rider Zetts, which is entering a turbulent second chapter in the TV series, makes its grand debut this summer! Don't miss a world unique to cinema where dreams and reality intertwine!
title:映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ: Based on the original manga serialized on X (formerly Twitter) since 2020 by illustrator Nagano, the massively popular "Chiikawa" franchise—winner of the Japan Character Grand Prix three times, with its 2022 TV anime's catch-up streams on YouTube surpassing 400 million views—gets an animated film adaptation. Under the complete supervision of creator Nagano, the film adapts the particularly popular long-form "Siren Arc" from the original manga series, depicting a grand adventure of Chiikawa and friends on a mysterious island through epic music and powerful visuals. One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware are relaxing in the square, a rabbit with a flyer stuck to its face appears. Hachiware reads the flyer, which turns out to be an invitation to a "special island." Tempted by promises of "easy monster subjugation on the island for 100x rewards" and "limited island ramen, limited sweets—sweet and spicy stuff all practically free," Chiikawa and friends decide to join the island camp. Along with a skeptical otter, they board a ship and land on the island, but... CygamesPictures, known for "Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era," handles the animation production.

title:映画クレヨンしんちゃん 奇々怪々！オラの妖怪バケ～ション: The 33rd theatrical film in the 'Crayon Shin-chan' TV anime series. It depicts the Nohara family's great adventure after they wander into a land of yokai (supernatural creatures), a strangely nostalgic and bizarre world. One summer day, strange phenomena are reported across Japan, causing a stir. Amid this, the Nohara family plans to visit Hiroshi's parents in Akita Prefecture. While preparing for the trip, a suspicious shadow peeks from behind a garden bush at Shin-chan, who is cheerfully playing a yokai game. Arriving in Akita, the Noharas spend a peaceful time at Grandpa Ginnosuke's house, but the next morning, a strange incident occurs: flyers for 'Obake-shon Village' are scattered in the room where Shin-chan and the others slept. At Shin-chan's request, the family heads to Obake-shon Village, but on the way, they wander into a strange space deep in a remote mountain. It is the entrance to the 'Land of Yokai,' forbidden to humans. Masaki Watanabe, who has directed the TV anime 'Crayon Shin-chan' since 2022, makes his film directorial debut, with screenplay by Yoshiko Nakamura, who has written for the TV series. Actress Sairi Ito voices the nine-tailed fox yokai 'Yako,' who guides Shin-chan and the others in the yokai land, and comedy duo 'Mayurika' members Sakamoto and Nakatani appear as guest voice actors.
title:映画史特別編 選ばれた瞬間: A special edition of the monumental video monument 'Histoire(s) du cinéma' by Jean-Luc Godard, the master of the French New Wave, re-edited by Godard himself. 'Histoire(s) du cinéma' is an epic work completed by Godard over ten years from 1988 to 1998, spanning 8 chapters and totaling 5 hours. This video art, weaving together a rich tapestry of images and sounds while freely quoting films, music, literature, and art from around the world that Godard loved, garnered significant attention, particularly in Europe. This film is a reconstruction of the original digital video version, re-edited by Godard in 2002 with new arguments and his unique perspective, and produced on 35mm film for theatrical release. It was given a special screening at the 58th Cannes Film Festival in 2005. In Japan, it will be screened in theaters for the first time as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
title:春光乍洩: A love story directed by Wong Kar-wai of 'Days of Being Wild,' starring Leslie Cheung and Tony Leung as lovers, depicting the poignant romance and human relationships between two men set in Argentina. Ho Po-wing and Lai Yiu-fai, who have loved intensely but repeatedly broken up, head to Iguazu Falls to repair their relationship, but get lost, argue, and part on bad terms. Later, a wounded Ho Po-wing shows up at the apartment of Lai Yiu-fai, who is working as a doorman at a tango bar in Buenos Aires. Lai Yiu-fai reluctantly lets him stay, but after recovering, Ho Po-wing starts going out while Lai Yiu-fai is away. Meanwhile, Lai Yiu-fai changes jobs to work at a Chinese restaurant and becomes close with a young coworker named Chang. It won the Best Director award at the 50th Cannes International Film Festival. Released in theaters in 1997. In February 2018, it had a special screening at Bunkamura Le Cinema to coincide with the release of the digital remaster of Wong Kar-wai's 'Days of Being Wild.' In 2022, a 4K restored version was screened as part of 'WKW4K' (from August 19, 2022, at Cine Mart Shinjuku, Grand Cinema Sunshine, Cinema City, etc.).
title:春树:
Winner of the Best Director Award and Best Actor Award in the Competition Section of the 38th Tokyo International Film Festival.

A woman who has lost her mother tongue returns home. Dreams, love, memories, and the time of cinema gently unravel—

Chunshu, 37, has lost her way as an aspiring actress and is stuck in her love life. Returning to Chengdu, her former hometown she left twenty years ago, she visits her old acting instructor, Zhang Mei. But Zhang Mei has dementia and is gradually losing her speech. Unable to find a place anywhere, Chunshu is quietly accompanied by Dongdong, Zhang Mei's son who has returned from Shanghai to care for his mother. Like the decaying national film studio that remains in ruins, past glories, teachings, and lessons are gradually forgotten in the flow of time, and days pass quietly beside people stuck in stagnation.

Released simultaneously with its sister film "Twilight in Luomu," shot consecutively with the same cast.

title:昭和元禄落語心中 “与太郎放浪篇”ディレクターズカット版: Haruko Kumota’s popular manga series "Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju," which explores the true nature and deep-seated karma of storytellers set against the backdrop of the Showa-era rakugo world, receives an animated adaptation. This theatrical release compiles the two-part original animation DVD (OAD) "Yotaro Wandering Arc"—previously bundled with the special editions of the manga’s 7th and 8th volumes—into a single feature, screening ahead of the January 2016 television broadcast. For its theatrical run, the film features newly enhanced sound effects, heightening the immersive atmosphere of the rakugo performances delivered by the characters on stage.
title:是枝裕和初期TVドキュメンタリー作品集: A collection of TV documentaries researched and directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda during his time at Television Man Union. This program screens the first two works that Kore-eda himself has said 'directed my path afterward.'
title:時々、私は考える:
Daisy Ridley (the "Star Wars" series) stars in and produces this human drama about an awkward woman who discovers the beauty of life through a new romance and connections with her colleagues.

Set in the quiet port town of Astoria, Oregon—famously known as the setting for "The Goonies"—the story follows Fran, a socially awkward woman who leads a solitary life, simply commuting between her office and her home. With no friends or romantic partners, her sole comfort lies in indulging in surreal daydreams of her own death. Her stagnant routine begins to slowly shift following a series of small interactions with a friendly new coworker named Robert. But even as her dates with Robert progress smoothly, Fran finds herself unable to break free from the emotional barriers holding her back.

Director Rachel Lambert, who was named one of IndieWire’s "28 Rising Female Directors to Watch" in 2023, brings this feature-length adaptation of Stephanie Abel Horowitz’s 2019 short film of the same name to the screen.
title:時のおと:
Actor and filmmaker Toru Katayama, who gained international acclaim with his 2019 feature debut *Roar*, presents a cinematic poem filmed over the course of a year across the four seasons in five towns of his native Fukui Prefecture. Centered on local dialects and the philosophy that "a town is defined by its sounds," the film offers a sincere portrayal of the people living there.

A high school girl facing her final summer in the drama club; a woman captivated by the sounds of the town, trying to make time stand still; a fisherman confronting an inevitable generational shift; and a man who moved to the area to grow vegetables while waiting for spring. The sounds of daily life they produce are gentle and quiet, yet unique to each location—sounds that resonate with the memories of every viewer.

The film stars Shiori Ueno (*The Legend of the Strongest Hitman Kunioka*), Utano Aoi (*Time Machine Girl*), Nami Sasaki (*Bachiranun*), Tamaki Kubose (*Randen*), and veteran actor Kanji Tsuda. Produced with the full cooperation of Fukui City, Obama City, Minamiechizen Town, Sabae City, and Katsuyama City, it also features many real-life residents of these communities.
title:時をかける少女: The first anime adaptation of Yasutaka Tsutsui's classic novel, previously adapted into TV dramas and films. A youth sci-fi drama depicting high school girl Makoto, who gains the power of "time leap" to travel to the past by chance, and realizes the preciousness of irreplaceable moments in life as she repeatedly redoes the past. Second-year high school student Makoto Konno gains the power to "time leap" back to the past after accidentally cracking a walnut found in the school science lab. Using this power, Makoto fully enjoys her carefree daily life, singing karaoke as much as she wants with her male friends Chiaki Mamiya and Kosuke Tsuda, and making spectacular plays in baseball. No matter what happens, she can go back in time and reset as many times as she wants. But this fun everyday life was supposed to continue... Directed by Mamoru Hosoda, who had worked on theatrical versions of "Digimon Adventure" and "ONE PIECE" and later became a leading Japanese animation director with films like "Summer Wars," "The Boy and the Beast," and "Mirai." Character design by Yoshiyuki Sadamoto ("Neon Genesis Evangelion"), animation production by Madhouse. Riisa Naka voices the protagonist Makoto, and Sachie Hara made her voice acting debut as Makoto's aunt, Kazuko Yoshiyama. Initially released in only 6 theaters in 2006, it gained popularity through word-of-mouth and achieved a long run exceeding 8 months. In 2021, it was re-released with the immersive 4DX system as part of a project commemorating the 10th anniversary of Hosoda's production company, Studio Chizu.
title:時をかける少女 4K: The first anime adaptation of Yasutaka Tsutsui's classic novel, previously adapted into TV dramas and films. A youth sci-fi drama depicting high school girl Makoto, who gains the power of "time leap" to travel to the past by chance, and realizes the preciousness of irreplaceable moments in life as she repeatedly redoes the past. Second-year high school student Makoto Konno gains the power to "time leap" back to the past after accidentally cracking a walnut found in the school science lab. Using this power, Makoto fully enjoys her carefree daily life, singing karaoke as much as she wants with her male friends Chiaki Mamiya and Kosuke Tsuda, and making spectacular plays in baseball. No matter what happens, she can go back in time and reset as many times as she wants. But this fun everyday life was supposed to continue... Directed by Mamoru Hosoda, who had worked on theatrical versions of "Digimon Adventure" and "ONE PIECE" and later became a leading Japanese animation director with films like "Summer Wars," "The Boy and the Beast," and "Mirai." Character design by Yoshiyuki Sadamoto ("Neon Genesis Evangelion"), animation production by Madhouse. Riisa Naka voices the protagonist Makoto, and Sachie Hara made her voice acting debut as Makoto's aunt, Kazuko Yoshiyama. Initially released in only 6 theaters in 2006, it gained popularity through word-of-mouth and achieved a long run exceeding 8 months. In 2021, it was re-released with the immersive 4DX system as part of a project commemorating the 10th anniversary of Hosoda's production company, Studio Chizu.

title:時代劇作品集: For Japanese films produced before the 1950s using nitrate (flammable) film, original negatives rarely survive; even when they are discovered, they are often screening prints (positive film). *Zoku Mito Komon Kaikokuki* is an exceptional case where the original nitrate negative remained—though only for the final three reels—and the prints duplicated from it convey the rich tonal gradations inherent to the original film. It will be screened alongside a print of *Mito Komon Kaikokuki*, which was duplicated from an internegative created from a nitrate print. *Sengoku Jidai* is a period drama in which Ryunosuke Tsukigata plays dual roles: a fisherman caught up in war and the priest Rennyo Shonin. This film is also a restoration from a nitrate print, though the eighth of its nine reels is missing.
title:曦曦: This documentary, the feature debut of Taiwanese director Wu Fan, captures the bond she forms with the unique Chinese dancer XiXi, whom she met by chance in Berlin, portraying the vibrant lives of two women. While studying in Europe from Taiwan, director Wu Fan meets XiXi, a Chinese contemporary dancer, in Berlin. Deeply drawn to XiXi, who dances like a free bird, Wu Fan begins filming her daily life. XiXi's journey, wandering Europe as a dancer in search of a free soul, appears beautiful to Wu Fan's eyes, like a wild bird unafraid to take flight. At the same time, XiXi lavishes love on her daughter Nina, whom she is allowed to see occasionally while staying in touch with her ex-husband Mederic. Eventually, Wu Fan's camera begins to capture the deep wounds hidden in XiXi's past. This becomes a catalyst for Wu Fan herself to confront her own family trauma. The film won the Emerging International Filmmaker Award at the Hot Docs Canadian International Documentary Festival 2024.
title:書かれた顔 4Kレストア版: This film approaches Kabuki actor Bandō Tamasaburō and, through the existence of the onnagata (female-role specialist), brings into relief a traditional Japanese feminine ideal as a construct of fiction. An unconventional work that blends fiction and reality and depicts its subject in a fantastical manner.
title:書を捨てよ町へ出よう: A grandmother who is a habitual shoplifter, a father who is a war criminal, and a sister with an obsessive love for rabbits. Raised in a dysfunctional family, "I" am always thinking of running away from home, while "he" is placed in a privileged environment. Burdened by a restless, pent-up passion with nowhere to go, "I" encounters strange people and wanders through a city where fantasy and memory blend together.
title:最初の半歩: In 1984, Hong Kong before the handover to China. In the suburban new town of Sha Tin, the first youth baseball team in Hong Kong, the 'Sha Yan' team, is formed. In Hong Kong, where baseball is not a major sport, a group of underachieving boys with no baseball experience begin practicing with balls made of rolled-up newspapers, but in their first game, they suffer a crushing defeat against a Taiwanese elementary school team. Nevertheless, guided by their strict yet caring principal Law (played by Liu Kai-chi), the team members gradually grow, centered on the childhood friends—the introverted Lung (played by Lam Yiu-sing) and the impulsive but loyal Wai (played by Tony Wu). The final showdown against their arch-rivals, the Japan Buffaloes, becomes a stage for them to re-examine their 'past' and 'future'—a youth drama based on a true story, set in early 1980s Hong Kong, leaving a quiet resonance that is not reduced to the outcome of the sport.
title:最初の年 民意が生んだ、社会主義アジェンデ政権: The feature-length directorial debut released in 1972 by Chilean master Patricio Guzmán, renowned for documentary works such as *The Battle of Chile* trilogy and *Nostalgia for the Light*. In 1970, Salvador Allende was elected as the first socialist president in Chilean history, signaling the start of a nationwide social transformation. This film meticulously captures the tumultuous first year of his administration from the perspective of the people. Guzmán recorded voices in mines, rural villages, ports, cities, and schools, reflecting the impact of government policies on daily life, the public's sense of elation, and their spirit of participation in the revolution through imagery brimming with hope and energy. Meanwhile, the camera also documents ominous signs, including friction with existing power structures, economic chaos, and political instability. Following the 1973 military coup in Chile, many prints were lost, and the film became a legendary "lost" work. However, it has been resurrected through a restoration process spanning half a century under Guzmán’s supervision, with the 2K restored version making its world premiere at the Anthology Film Archives in New York in September 2023. It will have its first theatrical release in Japan in November 2025.
title:最初の年：民意が生んだ、社会主義アジェンデ政権: In 1970, Salvador Allende became the first democratically elected socialist president in Chile, South America, signaling the start of a nationwide social transformation. This film documents the tumultuous first year of his administration. Following workers long exploited by capitalists, indigenous people rising up to reclaim their land, and youth emboldened by the promise of a new future, the film meticulously records their earnest words and expressions. Through footage brimming with hope and energy, it captures a citizenry galvanized by land reform, the nationalization of industry, and radical social change, alongside the historic visit to Chile by Cuban socialist leader Fidel Castro.
title:最後の賭け: Screened as part of "Eiga no Kuni Masterpiece Selection II: Claude Chabrol Unreleased Masterpieces," a series showcasing previously unreleased works in Japan by the French New Wave master who passed away in 2010. The film depicts the fate of a pair of con artists who steal money from the mafia, captured through diverse location filming ranging from the snowy mountains of Switzerland to the tropical Antilles. The lead duo is played by Isabelle Huppert (*The Piano Teacher*) and Michel Serrault (*The Children of the Marshland*).
title:最後通告: A 1998 fantasy film by Swiss filmmaker Fredi M. Murer, known for 'Höhenfeuer' and 'We, the Mountain People,' which allegorically depicts the mass disappearance of children. Through the form of fantasy, it portrays social issues still relevant today, such as the runaway collective psychology fueled by uncertain information and miscommunication within families. One morning after a full moon, ten-year-old children vanish across Switzerland: six boys and six girls, evenly selected from the four language regions. With police and media unable to find solid leads, the incident develops into an inexplicable situation. Reflecting the contradictions and anxieties lurking in society, the story moves toward the next full moon. Directed and written by Murer, with cinematography by Pio Corradi ('Höhenfeuer') and music by Mario Beretta. Starring Hanspeter Müller, Lilo Bauer, and Benedikt Freitag. It won the Grand Prix at the 1998 Montreal World Film Festival. Released in Japan in 2000, it will receive a special 35mm film screening in 2026 to coincide with the final Japanese screenings of Murer's documentary trilogy, the 'Mountain Trilogy.'
title:月あかりの下で ある定時制高校の記憶: Directed by Naoko Ota, a former part-time high school teacher, this documentary captures the lives of various students attending a nighttime high school. Set at Saitama Prefectural Urawa Commercial High School, the film follows a single class over four years, from their enrollment in 2002 to their graduation in 2006. From students in flashy attire who lash out at teachers to those unable to attend school due to domestic violence or those struggling with self-harm, the film portrays young people who support one another while grappling with deep-seated issues in their families and social lives.
title:月に囚われた男: Sam takes a job that requires him to stay alone on the moon for three years to mine a necessary energy source for Earth. Direct communication with Earth is not permitted, and his only conversation partner is a single artificial intelligence computer. But one day, with only two weeks left until the end of his mission, Sam encounters a person with the same face as his own.
title:月の犬:
Starring Masato Hagiwara, this noir drama depicts the existential despair of two men who would never have met if not for one woman taking an interest in them. Having failed to notice his long-time wife’s illness and living in regret after her death, Higashijima leaves the yakuza underworld behind. He drifts into an unfamiliar town and meets a woman named Saori at a bar. Intrigued by him, Saori begins to entrust him with work. Meanwhile, Minami, a member of a criminal organization, finds himself unable to endure the monotony of his daily life. Upon learning of Higashijima’s existence through Saori, Minami hopes the man will change the scenery of his world and assigns him to look after a young boy named Shogo. Higashijima carries out his duties in silence, but after discovering Shogo’s secret, he defies his orders and takes the boy outside...

Masato Hagiwara plays Higashijima, Tomoka Kurotani plays Saori, and Motoki Fukami plays Minami, supported by a cast including Soraji Shibuya, Kyosuke Yabe, Eriko Nakamura, Suzuka Ohgo, Hideko Hara, and Susumu Terajima. The film is directed by Kenji Yokoi, who won the
title:月老: From Giddens Ko, director of "Mon Mon Mon Monsters!" and "You Are the Apple of My Eye," comes a pure love fantasy inspired by the Taiwanese folk deity "Yue Lao" (the God of Matchmaking) and the concept of reincarnation. After being struck by lightning and brought to the underworld, Xiao Lun, along with Pinky who also arrives there, returns to the mortal world as the Taiwanese matchmaking god "Yue Lao" to tie the fates of people together. One day, a dog appears before them, triggering Xiao Lun to recover his lost memories of his past life. He remembers a promise he made to his first love, Xiao Mi, which he was unable to fulfill due to his sudden death. Starring popular Taiwanese actors: Ku Chen-dong ("You Are the Apple of My Eye") as Xiao Lun, Vivian Sung ("Our Times") as Xiao Mi, and Wang Jing ("The Soul of the Banquet," "My Ghost Friend") as Pinky.
title:月老〜また会う日まで〜: From Giddens Ko, director of "Mon Mon Mon Monsters!" and "You Are the Apple of My Eye," comes a pure love fantasy inspired by the Taiwanese folk deity "Yue Lao" (the God of Matchmaking) and the concept of reincarnation.
