The setting is a suburban house that Harper's mother is preparing to sell. An unidentified black shadow dwells there, but only Harper can perceive its presence... A small sense of unease eventually leads to a truth that overturns expectations. Are Harper's actions, threatened by the eerie presence, born of love? Or madness—? This unpredictable psychological horror accelerates the fear through its masterful story development, leading you to an unprecedented finale.
title_norm:the bibi files: A documentary that delves into the corruption allegations against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Following the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel by the Islamic fundamentalist organization Hamas, the Israeli military began its assault on the Gaza Strip, leading to the seemingly endless Gaza-Israel conflict with massive loss of life. A key figure in this conflict is Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, a charismatic leader whose hardline political stance is controversial. He is also the first sitting Israeli prime minister to be criminally indicted. In 2017, as the corruption investigation progressed, parts of police interrogation records of Netanyahu and his associates were secretly leaked to the film's production team. These records documented collusion with business and media circles, bribery, and provision of benefits. The film features testimonies from former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert, a former head of the domestic intelligence agency Shin Bet, Netanyahu's former spokesperson, and prominent investigative journalists. It exposes how corruption led to national decay, and how Netanyahu colluded with far-right forces to maintain his long-term rule and avoid conviction, pushing democracy into crisis. Netanyahu himself sought to stop the film's release and threatened legal action; it was banned from screening in Israel. Alex Gibney, known for 'Taxi to the Dark Side' and 'Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room,' served as executive producer, and Alexis Bloom, director of 'Anita: Speaking Truth to Power,' directed the film.
title_norm:the big lebowski: A comedy directed and written by the Coen brothers (Joel and Ethan), who won the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay for 'Fargo,' about a man mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and caught up in a kidnapping plot. Los Angeles, 1991. The Dude, an unemployed middle-aged man living a carefree, day-to-day existence, is mistaken for millionaire Jeffrey Lebowski and threatened by two thugs for a debt. Angered, the Dude barges into Lebowski's mansion to demand compensation but is turned away. A few days later, summoned by Lebowski, the Dude is asked to deliver the ransom for Lebowski's kidnapped wife, Bunny. The cast features an ensemble of distinctive actors, including Jeff Bridges in the lead role, John Goodman, and Steve Buscemi.
title_norm:the black house: Director Morita Yoshimitsu, known for '39 Criminal Law Article 39,' adapts the novel of the same name by Kishi Yusuke, which won the 4th Japan Horror Novel Award. Wakatsuki Shinji, who works at an insurance company, encounters the hanged body of a woman's son when he visits her home to explain insurance payouts. The police rule it a suicide, and the insurance money is paid out accordingly. However, sensing something suspicious in the parents' attitude, Wakatsuki begins his own investigation, doubting the suicide verdict. Gradually, the couple's abnormal behavior concerning the insurance money comes to light.
title_norm:the butcher: Directed by Claude Chabrol, a leading figure of the French New Wave known for numerous suspense and mystery masterpieces, this crime drama is set in a peaceful rural village. It quietly and sharply delves into the darkness of the human psyche through a series of murders committed by a lonely butcher and the female teacher who is loved by him. Hélène, a primary school teacher in a small village in southwestern France, meets Paul, a war veteran burdened with loneliness, and they gradually grow close. Meanwhile, a series of murders of women shakes the village's calm daily life. One day, during a picnic with her students, Hélène discovers a brutally murdered body; beside it lies a lighter identical to one she had given Paul. Stéphane Audran, who was married to Chabrol at the time, stars as Hélène, the same character name as in 'Les Biches'. Jean Yanne plays the butcher Paul. Although never theatrically released in Japan, the film will have its Japanese theatrical premiere as part of the 'Claude Chabrol Masterpiece Selection' (starting February 13, 2026, at Cinema Rise and Morc Asagaya, among others), featuring three of Chabrol's suspense films from the late 1960s to 1970.
title_norm:the cell: The Campbell Institute on the outskirts of Chicago. Young psychologist Catherine is researching technology to enter the human subconscious and dreams. She receives a request to look inside the mind of a serial killer who derives sexual pleasure from watching a woman drown while trapped in a glass cell.
title_norm:the chatterboxes: A comedy about a prideful feud between a deaf Japanese family and a Kurdish family, told through Japanese Sign Language and Kurdish. Natsumi Koga lives with her deaf father and younger brother, who run an electronics shop. One day, their family gets into a minor conflict with a Kurdish family living in the same town. Natsumi, who can hear, and Hiwa, the only member of the Kurdish family who speaks Japanese, are drafted as interpreters for their respective families. As they interpret for each other, a bond of trust grows between Natsumi and Hiwa, but the conflict between the two families only deepens. Then one day, a mysterious drawing by Natsumi's younger brother Shun escalates into an incident that engulfs the entire town. Nagisa Nagashima of "The End of Love" plays the protagonist Natsumi. Kazuyoshi Kezuka, a deaf ramen shop owner in Tokyo's Nishi-Nippori, makes his acting debut as Natsumi's father. Hideaki Nasu of the TV drama "Deaf Voice: Court Sign Language Interpreter" and Akito Imai of "The Two Worlds of My Life" play the father's friends. Shunya Itabashi of "Laughing Kaibutsu" plays a community organizer planning a town revitalization project, and Karin Ono of "Animation x Paralympic: Who Is the Hero?" plays a teacher at a school for the deaf. The film is directed by Ken Kawai, known for works like "Nanno-chan's Second World War" and who is himself a CODA (Child of Deaf Adults).
title_norm:the child: 18-year-old Sonia (Déborah François) and 20-year-old Bruno (Jérémie Renier) have a son. After returning from the hospital, Sonia asks Bruno, who has no steady job and lives day-to-day through shady dealings, to get serious about working.
title_norm:the corporation: A socially conscious drama based on Yamasaki Toyoko's novel of the same name, depicting the shadowy maneuvers of trading companies and their collusion with political and financial circles over the selection of the main fighter jet for the second defense buildup. Kinki Shoji is locked in a bloody battle with other trading companies over the selection of the main fighter jet for the second defense buildup, which is said to involve a total budget exceeding one trillion yen. Before long, the conflict inevitably escalates into a war of 'live ammunition' attacks on the political world.
title_norm:the cremator: Set in Prague, Czechoslovakia on the eve of World War II, this dark comedy depicts how an ordinary citizen working at a funeral home is influenced by his pro-Nazi friend and the social climate, driving him toward a disastrous solution. Karel Kopfrkingl, who works as a cremator at a small Prague funeral home, is an ordinary man who loves his family. One day, he reunites with a war buddy from World War I, who has become a member of the Nazi Party. Persuaded by his friend to monitor the local Jewish community, Karel gradually becomes influenced by his friend and the social situation... The film portrays how an utterly ordinary person becomes a perpetrator, using beautiful yet eerie expressionistic imagery. This work, which exposes the terror of totalitarian ideology, was banned in its home country of Czechoslovakia and could not be shown until the fall of the communist regime in 1990. It won the Grand Prize at the 5th Sitges - Catalonian International Film Festival. In Japan, it will have its theatrical premiere in April 2026 as part of "Czech Film Masterpieces," a series featuring classics of the Czech New Wave.
title_norm:the curse of the cat people: The directorial debut of Robert Wise, the master behind "West Side Story" and "The Sound of Music," made in 1944. This is a sequel to the cult horror film "Cat People" directed by Jacques Tourneur. A lonely, imaginative girl named Amy finds a beautiful ring in a dilapidated old house in her neighborhood. When she returns home and makes a wish on the ring, a beautiful woman named Irena appears before her. Amy becomes friends with Irena, whom only she can see, but...
title_norm:the day the earth stood still: A flying saucer suddenly arrives in Washington. An alien named Klaatu lands and, concerned for Earth's future, demands that humanity abandon nuclear weapons. He declares that if his demand is not accepted, he will shut down all energy on Earth...
title_norm:the devil wears prada 2: A sequel to the 2006 hit film "The Devil Wears Prada," based on the bestselling novel of the same name by American author Lauren Weisberger, set 20 years later. Miranda rules the fashion world as the charismatic editor-in-chief of New York's top fashion magazine "Runway." Andrea, who was once hired as her assistant and endured grueling days under her strict perfectionism, now works as a news reporter. One day, learning that Miranda and her right-hand man Nigel are facing a crisis, Andrea returns to "Runway" as a features editor. She also reunites with her former assistant colleague Emily, who has become an executive at a luxury brand and holds the key to "Runway's" survival. As their dreams and ambitions clash, events take an unexpected turn. The cast reunites from the previous film, including Meryl Streep as Miranda, Anne Hathaway as Andrea, Emily Blunt as Emily, and Stanley Tucci as Nigel. David Frankel returns as director, and Aline Brosh McKenna as screenwriter.
title_norm:the drama: Charlie and Emma, who meet by fate at a Boston café, are living the happiest of days. On the night just seven days before their wedding, during dinner with their best friend couple who are also their attendants, they confess their worst past deeds. It starts as a lighthearted game, but everyone is utterly put off by Emma's 'worst secret.' Charlie begins to fear that Emma may have another side beyond his imagination. Their peak of happiness plummets into the depths of suspicion and paranoia, but there is no way to stop the wedding preparations, and the day finally arrives—.
title_norm:the emperor waltz: A musical film sprinkled with comedic elements, including a parody of trademarked dogs and Freudian psychoanalysis of a dog. An American phonograph salesman arrives in Vienna. His rare phonograph is mistaken for a bomb, and he falls in love at first sight with an aristocrat's daughter, dragging his pet dog into a series of mishaps. Bing Crosby's expansive singing voice is a delight to hear. However, this became Billy Wilder's only musical film, as he later said he lacked the talent to make musicals.
title_norm:the end of oak street: A survival thriller co-starring Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor, depicting on a sweeping scale and with suspense the fate of a family struggling to survive when anomalies strike their peaceful town. The Platt family of four lives an ordinary life in the peaceful town of Oak Street. But one day, strange phenomena begin occurring in the town, and water and electricity completely shut off. As an uneasy atmosphere envelops the town, dinosaurs that should have gone extinct appear one after another and begin mercilessly attacking residents. The Platt family grabs whatever weapons are at hand and races to escape the town, navigating the threats of various dinosaurs... McGregor plays the father Greg, Hathaway plays the mother Denise, Maisy Stella ("My Old Ass") plays daughter Audrey, and Christian Convery ("The Monkey") plays son Brian. Directed and written by David Robert Mitchell ("It Follows," "Under the Silver Lake"). The production includes hitmaker J.J. Abrams ("Cloverfield," the "Mission: Impossible" series).
title_norm:the face of jizo: Three years after losing her family and friends in the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, Mitsue lives alone. Suddenly, her father, who should have died, appears before her. She tells him about a young man she met at the library where she works.
title_norm:the family: A socially conscious drama centered on a wealthy banking family, depicting human ambition, love, and hatred over wealth and power spanning political and financial circles. Director Yamamoto Satsuo's epic adaptation of Yamasaki Toyoko's novel of the same name. Daisuke Manpai, president of Hanshin Bank. The Manpai family, renowned in Kansai financial circles, expands its influence by marrying off its children one after another to major figures in politics and finance, solidifying its power. These maneuvers are orchestrated not by Daisuke's naive aristocratic wife, Neiko, but by Aiko Takasu, who has long served as both a tutor and housekeeper. However, the family's gears gradually begin to grind out of sync...
title_norm:the fifth horseman is fear: Set in Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, this drama portrays the terror of an informant society during wartime. Dr. Braun, a Jew living in Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, is forbidden from practicing medicine. The elderly man seems to have already accepted the fate of the Jews. Then one day, a neighbor asks him to treat a wounded political fugitive, and he reluctantly provides care. Eventually confronting his inner self, Dr. Braun decides to continue illegal treatment for the resistance to reclaim his identity. He wanders the streets of Prague in search of the morphine needed for this, but... Through the various people Dr. Braun meets and the wartime cityscape, the film depicts a society decaying and collapsing under war with hallucinatory visual beauty. In Japan, it will have its theatrical premiere in April 2026 as part of "Czech Film Masterpieces," a series featuring classics of the Czech New Wave.
title_norm:the five star stories: A film adaptation of Nagano Mamoru's work of the same name, centered on episodes from the original first volume. In the star cluster year 2988, on the planet Adler, the unveiling of a new Fatima created by the renowned scientist Balanche is approaching. Headliners confident in their skills gather from across the star cluster, vying to be chosen as the master of the Fatima made by the master craftsman, when Balanche's friend, Radios Sopp, arrives on Adler.
title_norm:the four times: Italian filmmaker Michelangelo Frammartino tells the story of four lives that are born and die. Based on the Pythagorean concept of "four transmigrations," the film presents humans, animals, plants, and minerals with equal weight from a fundamentally egalitarian perspective that does not center the human world. After an elderly shepherd quietly dies in a mountain village in Calabria, southern Italy, his young goat dies beside a large fir tree. The tree is cut down for a village festival and eventually becomes charcoal. With no dialogue and long takes, the film captures nature as it is. In Japan, it screened in the natural TIFF section of the 23rd Tokyo International Film Festival in 2010 and was released theatrically in 2011. It will be released in 2026 as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."
title_norm:the garden of words: From the director Makoto Shinkai, known for delicate drama and visual beauty in works like 'The Place Promised in Our Early Days' and '5 Centimeters per Second,' comes a love story set for the first time in modern Tokyo. Takao, a high school student aiming to become a shoemaker, skips school on rainy days to sketch shoes in a park's Japanese garden. One such day, he meets a mysterious older woman named Yukino, and the two grow closer through meetings that happen only on rainy days. For Yukino, who says she has lost her place in the world, Takao tries to craft shoes that make her want to walk more, but... The main staff for character design, art, and music features new faces different from Shinkai's previous works. The short film 'Dareka no Manazashi' is shown as a double feature.
title_norm:the gaze of sisyphus: A youth suspense film depicting the struggles and growth of a university student working on a documentary about an incident that occurred in a certain local city. University student Mayu Kuroda is tasked with creating a documentary for a class project based on her own high school experience. Back then, rumors spread that a male teacher, Nitta, had engaged in inappropriate sexual acts with her senior in the broadcasting club, Nojima, whom she admired. Articles in weekly magazines and social media posts drastically changed Nojima's life. Feeling this situation was unjust, Mayu intended to create a work that would serve as a warning about the information society by reflecting on that time. However, as she proceeds with research and filming alongside her university classmates, she is confronted with the reality that the local community is not welcoming the reopening of the case. Furthermore, facts she didn't know at the time and the various intentions of those involved and related parties come to light. Director Hiroki Inoue, highly acclaimed domestically and internationally for the short film 'Aza' and the VR live-action film 'Nagisa ni te', depicts social issues such as bullying, reputational damage via social media, and the insularity of local communities through an original script. Luna Toyota, in her first lead film role, naturally and delicately portrays the protagonist Mayu. Co-stars include Koshu Hirano from the special effects drama 'Ultraman Z', Kohei Yamashita from 'Toritsukushima', Yu Takaoka from the short film 'Tsunagaru', and Yuri Some no from 'Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken!'.
title_norm:the general: Comedy king Buster Keaton produced, directed, and starred in this action comedy inspired by a real train robbery during the American Civil War era. Engineer Johnny Gray deeply loves both his locomotive, "The General," and his beloved Annabelle. One day, however, "The General" is stolen by Union spies, and Annabelle is trapped in the boxcar. Johnny pursues the General on another locomotive, but unwittingly finds himself deep in Union territory... Also known under the Japanese titles "Keaton's Great Train Chase" and "Keaton's Great Train Robbery."
title_norm:the girl who leapt through ti: The first anime adaptation of Yasutaka Tsutsui's classic novel, previously adapted into TV dramas and films. A youth sci-fi drama depicting high school girl Makoto, who gains the power of "time leap" to travel to the past by chance, and realizes the preciousness of irreplaceable moments in life as she repeatedly redoes the past. Second-year high school student Makoto Konno gains the power to "time leap" back to the past after accidentally cracking a walnut found in the school science lab. Using this power, Makoto fully enjoys her carefree daily life, singing karaoke as much as she wants with her male friends Chiaki Mamiya and Kosuke Tsuda, and making spectacular plays in baseball. No matter what happens, she can go back in time and reset as many times as she wants. But this fun everyday life was supposed to continue... Directed by Mamoru Hosoda, who had worked on theatrical versions of "Digimon Adventure" and "ONE PIECE" and later became a leading Japanese animation director with films like "Summer Wars," "The Boy and the Beast," and "Mirai." Character design by Yoshiyuki Sadamoto ("Neon Genesis Evangelion"), animation production by Madhouse. Riisa Naka voices the protagonist Makoto, and Sachie Hara made her voice acting debut as Makoto's aunt, Kazuko Yoshiyama. Initially released in only 6 theaters in 2006, it gained popularity through word-of-mouth and achieved a long run exceeding 8 months. In 2021, it was re-released with the immersive 4DX system as part of a project commemorating the 10th anniversary of Hosoda's production company, Studio Chizu.
title_norm:the glenn miller story: Young trombonist Glenn Miller was always in search of a new sound. He joined a prestigious orchestra but left to focus on arranging. The turning point in his music came from his beloved wife Helen. Following her advice, he formed his own band and eventually achieved unprecedented popularity and fame. However, when World War II began, he volunteered for the Air Force. In late 1944, the plane carrying Glenn Miller disappeared over the English Channel... An emotional musical film, with numerous hit songs coloring the love and bond between the couple played by James Stewart and June Allyson!
title_norm:the golden bird: A classic fairy tale produced for theatrical release after a long absence. The story follows three princes in search of a golden bird, with the addition of a witch and robots. Directed by Hirata Toshio with character designs by Ōhashi Manabu, both former Toei Dōga staff, the actual production was handled by Madhouse. The rounded, line-suppressed characters and soft art style make it approachable, and the musical animation by Nankei Kōji is also enjoyable.
title_norm:the great arch: The Grande Arche, a monumental cube-shaped building in the La Défense district west of Paris, stands on the "Paris historical axis" stretching straight from the glass pyramid of the Louvre. Behind its completion lies the unknown story of an anonymous architect whose fate was shaken. Based on historical fact, this human drama immerses viewers in the bizarre life of an architect who challenged a national project while being tossed about by ideals and political maneuvering. An ensemble of talented actors lends the film credibility, earning it a selection in the Un Certain Regard section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival and eight César Award nominations. This architectural drama resonates with debates surrounding Japan's National Stadium and the Osaka Expo. In 1983 Paris, President Mitterrand envisioned a new monument to celebrate the bicentennial of the French Revolution. The international design competition selected the unknown Danish architect Johan Otto von Spreckelsen. His bold plan—a cube-shaped arch of Italian Carrara marble with a cloud-like roof floating at its base—captured the president's heart and made him an overnight sensation. However, budget constraints, political pressure, and the expectations of those around him stood in the way of his pursuit of perfection. Should he stick to his ideals or compromise with reality? Caught in the vortex of a massive project, what "certain decision" will one architect make?
title_norm:the green ray: The fifth film in Éric Rohmer's "Comedies and Proverbs" series. Through lively dialogue and beautiful imagery, it depicts the journey of a lonely woman seeking love and happiness on vacation, winning the Golden Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. Delphine, who works as a secretary, is looking forward to a vacation in Greece, but her female friend who was supposed to go with her cancels at the last minute. She goes to the South of France with other friends but can't fit in and returns to Paris alone. Later, visiting the beach at Biarritz alone, Delphine hears about the "green ray" from a Jules Verne novel—a flash of light visible only for an instant just before sunset. Starring Marie Rivière of "The Aviator's Wife" and "Autumn Tale."
title_norm:the handmaiden: Directed by Park Chan-wook of 'Oldboy' fame, this suspense drama is based on Sarah Waters' novel 'Fingersmith' but transposed to 1930s Japanese-occupied Korea. Sook-hee, a girl raised by a gang of swindlers in a slum, is approached by a con man known as Count Fujiwara with a plan: seduce Lady Hideko, an heiress to a vast fortune, marry her, then commit her to an asylum and steal her wealth. Agreeing to take part, Sook-hee begins working as a maid named Ok-ju at a remote mansion where Hideko lives with her domineering, Japanophile uncle Kouzuki. But as devoted Sook-hee gradually opens Hideko's heart, Sook-hee herself finds herself drawn to the woman she is supposed to betray. Kim Min-hee plays Hideko, while newcomer Kim Tae-ri was cast as Sook-hee through auditions. Ha Jung-woo plays the Count, and Cho Jin-woong plays Uncle Kouzuki.
title_norm:the human centipede: Dr. Josef Heiter, a German who was once a renowned surgeon for separating conjoined twins, harbors a secret desire to do the opposite of his previous operations: to connect a human's mouth to another's anus and create a "Human Centipede." One day, two American women traveling, Lindsay and Jenny, get a flat tire while driving and seek help at Dr. Heiter's house. To fulfill his desire, Heiter welcomes the unsuspecting pair warmly and begins work on creating a human centipede, adding Katsuro, a Japanese man he had already captured, to the mix.
title_norm:the human centipede 2: Screening dates: August 22 (Sat), 24 (Mon), 26 (Wed). Synopsis: In the dead of night in London. Martin, a young man working as a security guard in an underground parking garage, feels an abnormal excitement towards the film 'The Human Centipede' and becomes obsessed with the desire to create his own 'Human Centipede'. He plans to connect 12 people... and intends to place an actress from 'The Human Centipede' at the front. He kidnaps men and women one after another and confines them in a huge warehouse. Then, Martin, who has no medical knowledge whatsoever, begins his gruesome surgery using carpentry tools and no anesthesia...
title_norm:the human centipede 3: Screening dates: August 23 (Sun), 25 (Tue), 27 (Thu). Synopsis: Prison warden Bill Boss has a problem. His prison has the highest rates of riots, medical costs, and staff turnover in the nation, and the state governor, having seen enough, gives him an ultimatum: 'If this continues, you're fired.' Then, one day, Bill's right-hand man Dwight proposes a dream-like idea that could save billions of dollars. It's an idea inspired by the movie 'The Human Centipede'—literally making the prisoners 'kneel' and giving them the ultimate punishment and deterrent! Once connected, food costs are just one portion! Bill and Dwight set out to connect 500 prisoners and create a centipede prison...
title_norm:the inugami family: The will of the old family patriarch Saibee Inugami is made public, but it states that the heir to the vast fortune is the one who marries Tamayo Nonomiya, the granddaughter of Saibee's mentor. Saibee's three grandsons each scheme to claim Tamayo for themselves, but this soon escalates into a series of murders...
title_norm:the language of love: A love story starring Sungmo and Jihyuk of the popular K-pop group "Supernova," set against the rich natural backdrop of Chuncheon City, also known as a filming location for "Winter Sonata." It depicts a young man who has lost his words meeting a loved one and finding hope to live again. Teo, a piano tuner with a speech disorder caused by aftereffects of brain tumor surgery, meets Inha, a former popular singer who has lost her sight due to retinitis pigmentosa and is recuperating in a small village in Chuncheon. Unable to speak, Teo plays the piano to accompany Inha's singing, which leads Inha to open her heart to him. However, Inha's ex-lover Romy appears to take her back, and Inha ends up returning to Seoul. The director is Han Sang-hee, who directed "First Snow's Love: Virgin Snow" starring Lee Joon-gi and Aoi Miyazaki.
title_norm:the last dance: A human drama reuniting Hong Kong comedy king Michael Hui, popular in Japan for the 'Mr. Boo!' series, and Dayo Wong, a top Hong Kong comedian and actor ('A Witness Out of the Blue'), after 32 years. It became a massive hit, breaking Hong Kong's all-time box office record. Set in Hong Kong's funeral industry, it carefully explores universal themes of family, tradition, and views on life and death. Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.
title_norm:the last hero: The International A-Class 500cc final (All-Japan Road Race Championship, Round 8) is held at the UGO Circuit. The fateful showdown between bike racers Akio Kitano and Keishi Oki ends just before the finish line when Oki overtakes Kitano, pushing the decisive battle to the final round. Kitano uses his handsome looks and sexual prowess to secure funding from multiple patrons to maintain his team. When Christine Adams, heir to a billion-dollar fortune and owner of an international conglomerate, arrives in Japan, Kitano quickly approaches her and successfully secures funding. Finally, Kitano faces the final race, but...
title_norm:the last vikin: Danish director Anders Thomas Jensen, known for writing "Riders of Justice," "The Good Life," and "After the Wedding," delivers a human drama starring his frequent collaborator Mads Mikkelsen. After serving time for a robbery, Anker is released and reunites with his brother Manfred, who hid a large sum of money during the heist, for the first time in 15 years. However, Manfred not only has forgotten the hiding place but also believes he is John Lennon. The two set out on a journey to find the bag of hidden money, but the trip gradually transforms into a journey of self-reflection for both of them. Mikkelsen plays Manfred, who has lost his memory and believes he is John Lennon, embodying this eccentric and unique character. Anker is played by Nikolaj Lie Kaas, another frequent collaborator of Jensen's. The film had its world premiere in the Out of Competition section of the 2025 Venice International Film Festival and became a massive hit in its native Denmark, breaking the country's all-time box office record for a live-action film.
title_norm:the lavender hill mob: A crime comedy that depicts, with ironic humor, how two men's gold bullion heist plan takes an unexpected turn. One of the 'Ealing Comedies,' a series of comedy films produced at Ealing Studios in the UK from the late 1930s to the mid-1950s, directed by Charles Crichton, who was later nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director for 'A Fish Called Wanda.' Henry, a serious man who has worked as a bank security guard for 20 years, conspires with his friend Pendlebury, a souvenir shop owner, to steal a shipment of gold bullion. After successfully pulling off the heist, they process the gold into miniature Eiffel Towers to smuggle it abroad, but in a lounge at the Eiffel Tower in Paris, they accidentally sell them to a group of schoolchildren on a trip from England... Alec Guinness of 'Star Wars' fame plays Henry, and Stanley Holloway of 'My Fair Lady' plays Pendlebury. A young Audrey Hepburn appears in a single scene. The film won the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay at the 25th Academy Awards in 1953. This film is part of the special screening series 'The Golden Age of British Ealing Comedies' (June 20–July 17, 2026, at Shinjuku K's Cinema).
title_norm:the life of chuck: A human mystery film adaptation of Stephen King's 2020 short story "The Life of Chuck," directed by Mike Flanagan of "Doctor Sleep." As massive natural and man-made disasters strike the Earth one after another, the world is nearing its end. With no internet or social media, mysterious advertisements suddenly appear everywhere on street signs, TVs, and radios, reading: "Thanks to Charles Krantz. For 39 great years, thanks, Chuck." When high school teacher Marty rushes out of his house to see his ex-wife Felicia, the deserted city is filled with Chuck's ads. As Marty and Felicia, who have safely reunited, gaze at the stars, feeling the apocalypse approaching, and hold hands, the scene shifts to the perspective of the man in the ads, Chuck, and a story tracing his life unfolds through beautiful imagery. Tom Hiddleston of the "Avengers" series plays the protagonist Chuck, with Chiwetel Ejiofor of "12 Years a Slave," Karen Gillan of the "Guardians of the Galaxy" series, Jacob Tremblay of "Wonder," and Mark Hamill of the "Star Wars" series co-starring. Mandy Moore, choreographer of "La La Land," choreographs the dance scenes. It won the Audience Award, the top prize, at the 2024 Toronto International Film Festival.
title_norm:the little prince and the eig: The sixth feature-length anime from Toei Animation, this adventure fantasy humorously explores Japanese mythology. In the age of the gods long ago, Prince Susanoo, born to Izanagi and Izanami, enjoys happy days on Onogoro Island. One day, his mother Izanami dies. Unable to accept her death, Susanoo sets out with a rabbit named Akahana on a journey to Yomi-no-Kuni, the land of the dead where his mother is said to be. After adventures in the Night Land ruled by his brother Tsukuyomi and Takamagahara ruled by his sister Amaterasu, Susanoo arrives in Izumo Province. There, to save the princess Kushinada, he decides to fight the Yamata-no-Orochi. This was the directorial debut of Yugo Serikawa, later known for the 'Cyborg 009' series, with original animation direction by Koji Mori. The Orochi battle scene, which took Yasuo Otsuka and Sadao Tsukioka six months to complete, is celebrated as one of the greatest moments in Japanese animation history. The music was composed by Akira Ifukube, known for 'Godzilla'.
title_norm:the living dragon: Bruce Lee, Jackie Chan, Jet Li, Donnie Yen... Yasuaki Kurata is the one and only active action actor who has engaged in fierce battles with countless legends. Now 80 years old and celebrating 60 years as an action actor, this legend takes on a new challenge! Directors Koichi Sakamoto, Kenji Tanigaki, and Yuji Shimomura—three currently active talents who are graduates of the Kurata Action Club—have taken the helm. Filming also took place in Hong Kong, resulting in a historic reunion on screen with Sammo Hung! The miraculous film 'Dream Story' follows a man who has dedicated his life to action. Be sure to see its full scope on the big screen!
title_norm:the long walk: The first-ever film adaptation of Stephen King's first novel, "The Long Walk," written while he was in college in the 1960s and published under the pseudonym Richard Bachman in 1979. In a near-future America divided by war, a national competition called "The Long Walk" is held as a beacon of hope for a struggling society. Fifty selected teenage boys challenge this contest, where the only requirement is to keep walking. The prize is a staggering sum of money and the fulfillment of one wish. The rules are simple: maintain a pace of 4.8 km/h, receive a warning if you slow down, be executed after three warnings, and keep walking until only one person remains. Surrounded by armored vehicles and under the threat of guns, the boys desperately continue walking in extreme conditions with no rest or sleep allowed... Starring Cooper Hoffman ("Licorice Pizza") and David Johnson ("Alien: Romulus") as the young participants, and Mark Hamill ("Star Wars" series) as the Major who oversees the competition. Directed by Francis Lawrence ("The Hunger Games" series) with a screenplay by J.T. Molner ("Strange Darling").
title_norm:the longin: A human drama about a young man who could only feel himself through committing crimes, and how he finds meaning in life through his encounter with a couple running an okonomiyaki restaurant. Directed and written by Toshizo Fujiwara, who has acted in films such as "A Scene at the Sea," the film was selected for the Panorama section of the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025. Hiroyuki and Sonoko Kiuchi, a couple running an okonomiyaki shop, hire former prisoners and juvenile detention center graduates to help them reintegrate into society. However, since an incident involving a former employee a year ago, they have been plagued by online harassment. During an interview at a juvenile detention center, the Kiuchis meet 18-year-old Yuto Nishimura, who pleads to start his life over, and they hire him as a new employee. Yuto begins working earnestly, but after a certain event, he reconnects with his old friends and becomes strongly drawn to Yukiha, a dancer he meets at a club. The script was written based on extensive research at various sites, including an okonomiyaki shop in Osaka that actually supports the employment of former prisoners and juvenile detainees, and incorporates Fujiwara's own experiences. Daiki Ido stars in his first leading role as Yuto, Fujiwara plays Hiroyuki, Rino Tsuneishi plays Sonoko, with supporting roles by Tomoko Fujita and Jiei Kabira.
title_norm:the lost weekend: A serious drama acclaimed worldwide, winning four Academy Awards and the Grand Prix at the Cannes Film Festival. Don, a struggling writer living in New York, drowns his days in alcohol. Desperate for drink money, he steals from his brother and even tries to sell his typewriter. Ray Milland delivers a powerful performance as Don wandering the depths of despair, earning him an Oscar for Best Actor. Director Wilder met his second wife, Audrey Young, during the making of this film.
title_norm:the love that remains: In a small rural town in Iceland, artist Anna lives with her responsible eldest daughter Ida, her mischievous twin sons Grímur and Þorgils, and her dog Panda, while searching for her path as an artist. Though she married young and is supposedly "no longer a couple" with her ex-husband Magnús, he can't seem to cut ties, constantly finding excuses to visit, share meals, and even join picnics. Before she knows it, they slip back into a daily life as if they were "still a family"—but what comes next?
title_norm:the major and the minor: Billy Wilder's second directorial work, which was never theatrically released in Japan. This was his highly anticipated first Hollywood film, successfully casting the era's star Ginger Rogers. To save money on train fare to Iowa, Susan disguises herself as a 12-year-old girl. A faint affection begins to blossom between her and Colonel Philip, who happens to be on the same train... Although the film touches on the theme of attraction to a minor, it was produced 12 years before the publication of the bestselling novel "Lolita."
title_norm:the man in the white suit: A social satire comedy that depicts the fate of a scientist obsessed with developing a 'miracle fiber' that never gets dirty, delving into the fundamental contradictions of capitalism. One of the 'Ealing Comedies,' a series of comedy films produced at Ealing Studios in the UK from the late 1930s to the mid-1950s, directed by Alexander Mackendrick, known for 'The Ladykillers.' Sidney, a scientist working in the British textile industry, spends his days experimenting to develop a fiber that never gets dirty and never frays, no matter how much it's washed. He builds strange contraptions in a corner of the factory, remaining expressionless and unfazed by the lack of understanding around him. With the backing of the company president and his daughter Daphne, Sidney finally completes the 'miracle fiber,' but... The lead role of the scientist Sidney is played by the renowned actor Alec Guinness, known for 'Star Wars' and 'The Bridge on the River Kwai.' This film is part of the special screening series 'The Golden Age of British Ealing Comedies' (June 20–July 17, 2026, at Shinjuku K's Cinema).
title_norm:the metropolitan opera el últ: The eighth installment of the 2025-26 season of "MET Live Viewing," which records and screens the latest opera performances at the Metropolitan Opera House in New York. Based on Mexican painters Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera, this production reverses the setting of the classic Italian opera "Orfeo ed Euridice," depicting a deceased wife returning from the underworld to her husband for just one day in "Frida and Diego: The Last Dream" (recording of the performance staged on May 30, 2026). In 1957, on Mexico's Day of the Dead. Diego, who lost his wife Frida three years earlier, is tormented by age and grief, longing to reunite with her. Meanwhile, Frida, freed from suffering in the underworld, is told by La Catrina, the guardian of the dead, that she should accompany Diego at the end of his life, and reluctantly agrees to return to the earthly world for only 24 hours. Diego and Frida have a moving reunion, but Frida is bound by a rule that she must not touch the living.
title_norm:the moment: A film conceived by global musician Charli XCX, who also stars, depicting the turbulent behind-the-scenes world of show business involving top stars and industry insiders. In 2024, pop star Charli XCX became a global sensation with her album "brat," sparking a social phenomenon called "Brat Summer" and becoming an icon of the era. Bold and unapologetic, she daily pursues her authentic self. However, her music label, manager, and social media handlers, using the slogan "Brat Summer Forever," try to forcibly prolong the movement, intervening in live performances and promotions with backing from Amazon, pushing Charli into a clichéd star image. Overwhelmed by her busy schedule, Charli escapes to Ibiza for a vacation just days before a live show, throwing the production into chaos. Directed by Aidan Zamiri, who has directed music videos for Billie Eilish and others. The cast includes Alexander Skarsgård, Rosanna Arquette, and Kylie Jenner.
title_norm:the moment ザ・モーメント: A film conceived by global musician Charli XCX, who also stars, depicting the turbulent behind-the-scenes world of show business involving top stars and industry insiders. In 2024, pop star Charli XCX became a global sensation with her album "brat," sparking a social phenomenon called "Brat Summer" and becoming an icon of the era. Directed by Aidan Zamiri, who has directed music videos for Billie Eilish and others. The cast includes Alexander Skarsgård, Rosanna Arquette, and Kylie Jenner.
