title_norm:x cross: Based on the novel "Sono Keitai wa XX de" by Nobuyuki Jōkō, directed by Kenta Fukasaku of "Battle Royale II: Requiem" and scripted by Tetsuya Ōishi of "Death Note." Shiyori and Aiko visit the remote hot spring village "Agari Village" and split up after a trivial quarrel. That night, a phone rings near Shiyori in her room. A mysterious voice warns her to "run or your legs will be cut off," and as she is bewildered, the villagers begin attacking her one after another. Starring Nao Matsushita and Ami Suzuki.
title_norm:xixi: This documentary, the feature debut of Taiwanese director Wu Fan, captures the bond she forms with the unique Chinese dancer XiXi, whom she met by chance in Berlin, portraying the vibrant lives of two women. While studying in Europe from Taiwan, director Wu Fan meets XiXi, a Chinese contemporary dancer, in Berlin. Deeply drawn to XiXi, who dances like a free bird, Wu Fan begins filming her daily life. XiXi's journey, wandering Europe as a dancer in search of a free soul, appears beautiful to Wu Fan's eyes, like a wild bird unafraid to take flight. At the same time, XiXi lavishes love on her daughter Nina, whom she is allowed to see occasionally while staying in touch with her ex-husband Mederic. Eventually, Wu Fan's camera begins to capture the deep wounds hidden in XiXi's past. This becomes a catalyst for Wu Fan herself to confront her own family trauma. The film won the Emerging International Filmmaker Award at the Hot Docs Canadian International Documentary Festival 2024.
title_norm:xixi（シィシィ）、私を踊る: This documentary, the feature debut of Taiwanese director Wu Fan, captures the bond she forms with the unique Chinese dancer XiXi, whom she met by chance in Berlin, portraying the vibrant lives of two women. While studying in Europe from Taiwan, director Wu Fan meets XiXi, a Chinese contemporary dancer, in Berlin. Deeply drawn to XiXi, who dances like a free bird, Wu Fan begins filming her daily life. XiXi's journey, wandering Europe as a dancer in search of a free soul, appears beautiful to Wu Fan's eyes, like a wild bird unafraid to take flight. At the same time, XiXi lavishes love on her daughter Nina, whom she is allowed to see occasionally while staying in touch with her ex-husband Mederic. Eventually, Wu Fan's camera begins to capture the deep wounds hidden in XiXi's past. This becomes a catalyst for Wu Fan herself to confront her own family trauma. The film won the Emerging International Filmmaker Award at the Hot Docs Canadian International Documentary Festival 2024.
title_norm:yamaguchi kun isnt so bad: A youth romance live-action film adaptation of the shōjo manga of the same name by Yu Saiki, serialized in Kodansha's 'Bessatsu Friend,' starring Kyōhei Takahashi of the idol group 'Naniwa Danshi.' It depicts the romantic journey of Satsuki, an ordinary high school girl who dreams of love, and Yamaguchi-kun, a transfer student with a scary-looking face and a Kansai dialect. Yamaguchi-kun, who transfers to Satsuki's school, has blonde hair and piercings, giving him a menacing look, and rumors circulate that he's a yakuza. After a certain incident brings her close to Yamaguchi-kun, Satsuki learns about his shy and kind true nature and gradually becomes drawn to him. Satsuki tries to keep Yamaguchi-kun's hidden charms all to herself, but a handsome classmate, Ishizaki, who inexplicably has a grudge against Yamaguchi-kun, stands in her way. It turns out Ishizaki also harbors special feelings for Yamaguchi-kun, suddenly emerging as Satsuki's romantic rival. The love triangle of these three takes an unexpected turn. Kyōhei Takahashi plays Yamaguchi-kun, who has a kind and pure heart beneath his scary appearance; Hikaru Takahashi ('Romantic Killer') plays the heroine Satsuki, who grows close to Yamaguchi-kun; and Yōji Iwase ('The Girl and the Guard Dog') plays Ishizaki, the classmate who stirs up trouble between Yamaguchi-kun and Satsuki. The film is directed by Kentarō Moriya ('PRINCE OF LEGEND,' 'Seaside Motel').
title_norm:yi yi: A family drama by Edward Yang, the master of Taiwanese New Cinema known for 'A Brighter Summer Day' and 'The Terrorizers,' which quietly observes the life changes that befall each member of a five-person family living in Taipei. Yang won the Best Director award at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival in 2000 for this film. Elementary school student Yang-yang lives a comfortable life in a luxury apartment with his father NJ, who runs a computer company, his mother Min-min, his high school sister Ting-ting, and his gentle grandmother. They seem like a picture-perfect happy family, but troubles begin after the wedding of the mother's younger brother. The grandmother falls into a coma from a stroke, the father is shaken by a reunion with his first love, and the mother seeks solace in a new religion. To save his company from bankruptcy, the father travels to Japan to secure a contract with a genius game designer named Ota. Meanwhile, the sister starts dating the boyfriend of her neighbor Li-li... Issey Ogata appears as the game designer Ota. As director Yang passed away in 2007, this became his final completed feature film. A 4K restoration was screened as the opening film of the Cannes Classics section at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.
title_norm:you are the film: A youth comedy directed by Makoto Ueda, head of the theater group "Europe Kikaku," known for writing screenplays for numerous hit films like "Summer Time Machine Blues" and "River, Don't Flow On." This is his feature directorial debut, set in the real-life building "Shelbo Shimokitazawa" in Shimokitazawa, employing innovative gimmicks. At the cinema Tollywood on the second floor of "Shelbo Shimokitazawa," Madoka, a playwright from Shimokitazawa, and Kazuma, a band musician from Sangenjaya, each go to see a movie. An impossible structure emerges where each other's events are projected onto the screen as a film. Meanwhile, problems arise at the shops adjacent to the cinema, "Good Heavens" and "Mikazuki Rock." Madoka and Kazuma try to solve the problems using this structure, but their films influence each other, and the situation spirals in unexpected directions. Starring Maria Ito ("Summer Film ni Notte") as Madoka the playwright and Kai Inowaki ("Musicophilia") as Kazuma the band musician. The cast also includes Oshiro Maeda and Hinako Kikuchi as members of Madoka's theater troupe, Suzuyuki Kaneko and Yusuke Mikawa as members of Kazuma's band, Takafumi Imai as a semi-delinquent who frequents "Mikazuki Rock," and the comedy duo "The Geese" as a pair of detectives. Additionally, members of Europe Kikaku, including Gota Ishida, Shintaro Kanamaru, and Riko Fujitani, play unique characters.
title_norm:you can succeed, too: The pinnacle of Japanese musicals, depicting a salaryman struggling in the battle for foreign tourists in Tokyo just before the Olympics. Throughout the film, talented performers sing and dance, and Frankie's astonishing physical abilities leave you in awe. The grand group dance in 'Man Alone' is especially breathtaking.
title_norm:you, fireworks, and our promi: A youth romance anime film adaptation of the novel of the same name by Madoroka. Set against the backdrop of the 'Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Display' in Nagaoka City, Niigata Prefecture, one of Japan's three major fireworks festivals that attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors annually, it depicts a promise that transcends time and a summer in the lives of high school students. One day shortly after entering high school, Makoto Natsume meets his classmate Akira Hayama. Since childhood, Akira has been told by her great-grandmother that she would 'one day meet Makoto Natsume,' and she holds a single painting of fireworks. As they investigate the secret of the painting, which Makoto has no memory of, the two discover the existence of 'a certain promise' made in the past. Eventually, the meaning of a fate connected across time becomes clear. The voice of the protagonist, Makoto, is played by Shōri Satō, a member of the popular group 'timelesz,' in his first lead role in an anime film. The heroine, Akira, is voiced by Nanoka Hara, known for playing the protagonist Suzume Iwato in 'Suzume.' The director is Kei Suzuki of the TV anime 'Tower of God.' The project is produced by Shin-Ei Animation, with animation production jointly handled by SynergySP and Answer Studio.
title_norm:young mothers: An ensemble drama by Belgian masters Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne, known for "The Child" and "The Kid with a Bike," depicting five young mothers living in a mother-child support facility. The five girls—Jessica, Perla, Ariane, Julie, and Naima—live together in a facility that supports women who became pregnant young. Without anyone to rely on and facing various problems like poverty and violence, they become mothers while confused, troubled, and unable to find a model for the family they should aim for. Struggling not to be swallowed by the overwhelming loneliness, the girls who still wish "to love" sometimes lean on others and choose their own paths to follow. Lukas Dhont, director of "Close," is listed as a co-producer. Screened in the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025, it won the Best Screenplay Award and the Ecumenical Jury Prize.
Director Makoto Shinkai, known for delicately portraying the nuances of male-female emotions against beautiful landscapes in works like "The Place Promised in Our Early Days" and "5 Centimeters Per Second," delivers his first original feature in three years since "The Garden of Words." Character design by Masayoshi Tanaka of "Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day" fame, animation direction by Masashi Ando, known for his work on Studio Ghibli films like "Princess Mononoke" and "Spirited Away," and music including the theme song by popular rock band RADWIMPS. The film remained in the top 10 of domestic box office rankings for 29 consecutive weeks, achieving historic blockbuster success with over 25 billion yen in revenue. It won the Award for Best Screenplay at the 40th Japan Academy Prize, a first for an animated work. One month before a comet approaches for the first time in 1000 years, Mitsuha Miyamizu, a high school girl living in a mountainous rural town, dreams she is a male high school student in Tokyo. Mitsuha, who feels cramped by her small town and longs for the city, enjoys city life in her dream. Meanwhile, Taki Tachibana, a male high school student in Tokyo, dreams he is a high school girl in a mountain town he's never visited. As the body-swapping phenomenon continues and they become aware of each other, Taki and Mitsuha eventually discover an unexpected truth. Voice cast includes Ryunosuke Kamiki as Taki and Mone Kamishiraishi as Mitsuha, with Masami Nagasawa and Etsuko Ichihara among others.
title_norm:yuho no border: A documentary tracing the journey and present life of Yuho Asaka, one of Japan's pioneers of peer counseling. Born in Fukushima City, Fukushima Prefecture in 1956, Yuho Asaka has a condition characterized by brittle bones. From a young age, she was forced to give up on learning and grew angry at a society that discriminates and excludes based on disability and gender. Always searching for her place in the world, Asaka connected with the cerebral palsy activist group "Fukushima Prefecture Aoi Shiba no Kai" and, drawing on the independent living movement and feminism she encountered while studying in the U.S., helped establish Japan's first independent living center. She also participated in international conferences and helped spark changes to the Eugenic Protection Law. The film follows Asaka's relentless pursuit of freedom, while also depicting her sister Aiko, who was caught in the turbulent relationship between their father and Yuho; her daughter Sora, who was born with the same condition and works at an overseas institute advocating for the rights of people with disabilities while attending graduate school; and the young caregivers who share daily life with her in a free-spirited relationship. Yumiko Asano, producer of "What Could Have Been?," makes her directorial debut, with Tomoaki Fujino, director of that same film, handling cinematography, editing, and production.
title_norm:yurie: This drama depicts a chef with communication difficulties and a free-spirited Korean woman who comes to learn Japanese cuisine. As they repeatedly try to revitalize the restaurant, they gradually break free from their rigid values. It is the feature-length debut of director Harumi Ikemoto, whose short film 'The Hunt' won the Excellence Award in the short film category at the 2023 SKIP City International D-Cinema Festival. Three years after losing his father, George Uehara took over the restaurant 'Yurie.' Although his cooking skills are solid, he is forced to accept the reality that the restaurant has recently seen fewer customers. Then Kim Juri, who came to Japan from Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, appears and starts working part-time at the restaurant. Despite clashing due to their differing values, they gradually grow closer and try various ideas to boost the restaurant's business. Sho Aoyagi, a member of 'Gekidan EXILE' active in films and dramas, plays George, a chef who struggles to express his thoughts and feelings and has some communication difficulties. Yeon-su Ha, who moved her base of operations from Korea to Japan and appeared in the NHK morning drama 'The Tiger's Wing,' plays Kim Juri, the part-time worker who initially keeps her distance from George due to her free-spirited nature. Yusuke Mikawa, known for 'Cloud,' co-stars as Iwakura, another part-time employee who watches over the two.
title_norm:zabriskie point: Italian master Michelangelo Antonioni, who won top prizes at all three major film festivals (Berlin, Venice, Cannes) in the 1960s, made this film after moving to America in 1970. Set in Los Angeles and Death Valley, it depicts the psychological landscape of love between a man and a woman. In the late 1960s, amidst the peak of counterculture, with university protests raging and students clashing with armed police, Mark grows tired of futile debates at student gatherings. He grabs a gun and confronts the police officers cracking down on campus, but misses his chance to fire and flees. He then steals a Cessna at an airfield and takes to the sky. Meanwhile, Daria, a secretary at a Los Angeles real estate company, is driving across the vast desert to attend a meeting. The two meet by chance and arrive at Zabriskie Point, overlooking Death Valley... The leads are newcomers Mark Frechette and Daria Halprin, whom Antonioni scouted on the streets. The soundtrack effectively features music by Pink Floyd, Jerry Garcia of the Grateful Dead, Kaleidoscope, John Fahey, The Rolling Stones, and The Youngbloods. Released in Japan in 1970, it also had a late-show release in 1996. A revival release is scheduled for 2026, the first in 30 years.
title_norm:zakken! the cosmos beneath ou: A youth story based on the manga 'Zakken!' (published by Shogakukan), which was developed from a real club activity, the 'Weed Research Club,' at Tokyo Metropolitan Hibiya High School, by screenwriter and film director Naho Uemura and the scenario creation team 'Monogatari Lab,' with Uemura herself writing and directing the film adaptation. It delicately and freshly depicts a teenage girl lost and unsure of herself, who discovers her own identity through the weeds growing at her feet, which she had never paid attention to before. Spring of her first year of high school. Sugano Yukari, an ordinary girl who isn't passionate about anything and just goes through the motions, meets her classmate Tokuda Mimi, nicknamed 'Dokudami-chan,' who loves weeds and is fascinated by their vitality. Slightly eccentric but with a straightforward and pure heart, Yukari gradually opens up to her. Dokudami-chan dreams of reviving the 'Zakken,' or 'Weed Research Club,' and Yukari, while hesitant about her enthusiasm, begins activities with her aimed at reviving the club, but... Luna Nakajima, who has starred in films like 'A Town of Old Houses' and 'Tore!' and won the Japan Academy Prize for Newcomer for 'Tokyo Taxi,' plays Sugano Yukari, and Miyu Oshima, known for the NHK morning drama 'Omusubi' and the drama 'Bokutachi nchi,' plays Tokuda Mimi, taking on the lead roles.
title_norm:à bout de souffle: Jean-Luc Godard's first feature-length directorial work. Produced with techniques that broke the conventions of theatrical cinema at the time, such as improvisational direction and handheld street shooting, it is a landmark film of the French New Wave that greatly influenced the later film industry. The original idea was by François Truffaut, and Claude Chabrol also participated as a technical advisor. Michel, a car thief who kills a policeman and flees to Paris, enjoys a free relationship with Patricia, an American student selling newspapers. To test Michel's love, Patricia informs the police of his whereabouts and tells Michel what she has done... A digitally remastered version with a new translation by Jiro Terao was released in 2016. In 2022, a 4K restored version created to commemorate the 60th anniversary of its release was shown. In 2026, a 4K restored version will be revived in conjunction with the release of Richard Linklater's film 'Nouvelle Vague,' which depicts the production process of 'Breathless.'
title_norm:ástin sem eftir er: In a small rural town in Iceland, artist Anna lives with her responsible eldest daughter Ida, her mischievous twin sons Grímur and Þorgils, and her dog Panda, while searching for her path as an artist. Though she married young and is supposedly "no longer a couple" with her ex-husband Magnús, he can't seem to cut ties, constantly finding excuses to visit, share meals, and even join picnics. Before she knows it, they slip back into a daily life as if they were "still a family"—but what comes next?
title_norm:éloge de lamour: A drama by Jean-Luc Godard, the master who led the French New Wave, centered on the theme of 'love.' Edgar, a young artist in Paris, conceives a new work depicting four moments related to love—'encounter, passion, separation, reconciliation'—using three couples. The heroine Edgar considers ideal for this project is a woman he met two years ago. She is the granddaughter of an elderly couple who were once involved in the Resistance, whom Edgar met while researching the history of the Resistance in Brittany. Searching for her, Edgar revives his memories of Brittany two years ago. The first half depicts present events in richly shaded black-and-white 35mm film, while the second half shows protagonist Edgar's flashbacks in vivid color using digital video. The 4K restored version will be screened in Japan for the first time as part of the special screening series 'Jean-Luc Godard in the 21st Century: Our Films 2001-2010' (starting June 20, 2026, at Theater Image Forum Shibuya and other locations nationwide).
title_norm:кин дза дза!: A deadpan sci-fi comedy made in Soviet-era Georgia in 1986, which became a huge hit in the USSR at the time. One day, a student named Gedevan asks construction engineer Mashkov for help, looking troubled, saying, 'There are some men over there who claim to be aliens.' Mashkov, who doesn't believe in aliens, presses a button on a space travel device the men were holding, and in the next instant, Mashkov and Gedevan are warped to the planet Pluke in the Kin-Dza-Dza Nebula, far from Earth. There, for some reason, Earth matches are extremely valuable, and the two try to use the value of matches to somehow return to Earth... Culturally popular in Japan as well, it was first introduced at the 'Soviet SF Film Festival' held in Tokyo in 1989, later released in a new print in 2001 and a digital remaster in August 2016. In May 2021, to coincide with the release of the animated version 'Ku! Kin-Dza-Dza,' the live-action film had its fourth theatrical release.
title_norm:солярис: When communication is lost with the space station Prometheus, which is exploring the ocean-and-cloud-covered planet Solaris, psychologist Kris is sent to investigate. Upon arriving at the Prometheus, Kris witnesses the suicide of a friend, traces of people who shouldn't be there, and a series of inexplicable phenomena caused by the sentient organic ocean.
title_norm:جاده خاکی: A car races across the desolate landscape of Iran. In the back seat, the father entertains his exuberant younger son; in the passenger seat, the mother sways to an old pop song; and in the driver's seat, the eldest son stares silently ahead. While the younger son, unaware of the purpose of the trip, frolics innocently, the family arrives near the Turkish border...
title_norm:جدایی نادر از سیمین: Nader is in divorce negotiations with his wife, who wants to leave Iran for the sake of their daughter. He hires a woman named Razieh to care for his father, who suffers from dementia and lives with him, but an unexpected incident sets off a chain of events... An exquisite drama that intertwines a mystery with Iran's divorce issues.
title_norm:خانه‌ی دوست کجاست؟: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame. At a primary school in the village of Koker in northern Iran, Mohammad is severely scolded by his teacher for doing his homework on a piece of paper instead of a notebook and is told he will be expelled if it happens again. However, his best friend Ahmad, who sits next to him, accidentally takes Mohammad's notebook home. Panicked that Mohammad will be expelled without his notebook, Ahmad searches for his friend's house in a distant neighboring village to return it, but struggles to find it... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title_norm:زندگی و دیگر هیچ: In 1990, a massive earthquake in northern Iran mercilessly struck the village where the 1987 film "Where Is the Friend's Home?" was shot, as well as its residents. After the earthquake, film director Kiarostami, accompanied by his son, heads to the disaster-stricken area to check on the safety of the two brothers who appeared in the film.
title_norm:زیر درختان زیتون: A young couple who married a few days after the earthquake appeared in one scene of 'And Life Goes On.' However, the young man who played the husband had actually proposed to the woman playing the wife before and been rejected. When director Kiarostami learned of their past, he decided to make a film based on this episode.
title_norm:صوت هند رجب: January 29, 2024. Based on the true tragedy the world watched from the sidelines—a soul-shaking true-life drama. On January 29, 2024, a volunteer team from the Palestinian humanitarian organization Palestine Red Crescent Society receives an emergency call. It is from Hind Rajab, a 6-year-old girl trapped in a car under gunfire in the Gaza Strip. The Red Crescent volunteer team keeps the line open with Rajab and exhausts every possible means to rescue her— Directed and written by acclaimed Tunisian filmmaker Kaouther Ben Hania, who continues to explore the boundary between fiction and documentary.
title_norm:طعم گيلاس: Buddy, a middle-aged man, invites people into his car and makes a strange request: "Tomorrow morning, call out to me lying in a hole. If I answer, help me; if there's no answer, cover me with dirt." Everyone refuses, but the old man he finally picks up begins to tell him about the joy of living...
title_norm:قضية الغرباء: An ensemble drama inspired by the reality that 14 million people were forced to flee abroad to escape the long devastation of the Syrian civil war, depicting families torn apart by conflict and those around them from multiple perspectives. Set across four countries—Syria, Turkey, Greece, and the United States—the story unfolds in five chapters, intersecting the lives of five families. As the civil war between government forces and rebel groups intensifies in Syria's dictatorship, Syrian doctor Amira decides to cross dangerous borders with her daughter to reach safety. Syrian border guard Mustafa distrusts the brutal government forces and struggles between being a soldier who follows orders and a human with a conscience. Turkish smuggler Marwan seeks to earn money by loading refugees onto boats bound for Greece to move his sick son to America. Poet Fathi boards that boat with his wife and child, facing mortal danger. Greek coast guard Stavros discovers refugees navigating stormy seas and strives to save lives. Film producer and humanitarian activist Brandt Andersen, who made the 2020 short film "Refugee" as his starting point, makes his feature directorial, screenwriting, and producing debut with this meticulously researched work. Yasmin Al-Masri reprises her role as doctor Amira from the short, and Omar Sy returns as smuggler Marwan.
title_norm:مسافر: The feature-length debut of Iranian master Abbas Kiarostami, made in 1974, this human drama freshly depicts the funny yet poignant adventures of a boy struggling desperately to watch a soccer match. Gassem, a 10-year-old boy attending elementary school, is obsessed with soccer, often neglecting his homework and classes, earning constant scolding from his teacher and mother. Determined to go see an important match held in the capital, Tehran, he tries every trick to get money for transportation and a ticket, including stealing from home and deceiving his friends... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title_norm:مشق شب: A documentary by internationally acclaimed Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami ('Where Is the Friend's Home?'), focusing on homework and school education. Feeling that Iranian children are always overwhelmed by homework, Kiarostami himself acts as interviewer, asking elementary school students and their parents a series of questions about 'homework.' Through the interviews, the complex family circumstances of each child emerge, revealing the problems within Iran's education system. Kiarostami vividly captures the children's diverse expressions and words while sounding an alarm to society. A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program 'And Kiarostami Continues' (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title_norm:जवान: A thrilling action film from the 'King of Bollywood', Shah Rukh Khan, in his first collaboration with a young Tamil film crew. It depicts the righteous struggle of subway hijackers who steal a ransom from arms dealers.
title_norm:पठान: A spy action film starring Indian cinema superstar Shah Rukh Khan, known for films like "My Name Is Khan" and "Om Shanti Om." When the Indian government revokes the autonomy of the Kashmir region spanning India and Pakistan, an enraged Pakistani General Qadir teams up with former Indian soldier Jim to plan a terrorist attack. Pathaan, an agent of India's intelligence agency RAW (Research and Analysis Wing), moves to stop Jim's planned biological weapon attack. However, it is discovered that a biological weapon has been planted on a plane flying over Delhi. With only six minutes left in a desperate situation, Pathaan, India's top agent, fights to protect his homeland. It has become a talking point that Tiger, the spy played by Salman Khan in the film "Tiger: The Legendary Spy"—which also features the same Indian intelligence agency RAW—is set as a colleague of the protagonist Pathaan in this film. Directed by Siddharth Anand of "War" and "Bang Bang!" Deepika Padukone, who has co-starred with Shah Rukh Khan in films like "Om Shanti Om" and "Chennai Express," plays the heroine Rubai.
title_norm:विक्रम वेधा: A crime suspense film starring Hrithik Roshan of "Bang Bang!" and Saif Ali Khan of "Go Goa Gone," adapted as a Hindi remake of a 2017 Tamil-language film. Vikram, an excellent police commissioner who aims to eradicate crime itself rather than boost his record through arrests, sees his convictions shaken when the criminal he was targeting, Veda, surrenders himself, bringing forth a series of mysteries. Eventually, Vikram and Veda, each with their own purposes, are forced to fight together. Hrithik Roshan plays Veda, and Saif Ali Khan plays Vikram.
title_norm:वॉर 2: The second installment in the series following the 2019 Indian spy action blockbuster "War," this is part of the YRF Spy Universe, which shares a world with the "Pathaan" and "Tiger" series. It depicts the fateful battle between two men on a grand, global scale. Kabir, a legendary spy who once betrayed the nation and disappeared, has now transformed into India's greatest threat. To stop the unstoppable Kabir, the government deploys Vikram, an elite Indian army officer. Having lost everything due to a certain incident, Vikram is driven by the sole mission of eliminating Kabir. However, the battle soon turns from a mission into a personal vendetta against Kabir. Hrithik Roshan reprises his role as the legendary agent Kabir from "War," and N.T. Rama Rao Jr. from "RRR" makes his debut in the YRF Spy Universe as the soldier Vikram, who engages in a fierce battle with him. The film is directed by Ayan Mukerji, known for "Brahmastra."
title_norm:சர்வம் தாளமயம்: A youth music film about a young man's struggle to become a player of the mridangam, a traditional Indian percussion instrument. Peter, the son of a mridangam craftsman living in Chennai, India, is inspired to become a player himself after seeing a master perform on a mridangam his father made. Apprenticing under the master and training diligently, Peter faces various challenges including caste discrimination, conflicts over preserving traditional arts, and generational differences, but confronts them with passion and respect. The music is composed by A. R. Rahman, who won an Academy Award for 'Slumdog Millionaire.' G. V. Prakash Kumar, Rahman's nephew and a renowned film music composer, plays the protagonist Peter. Screened under the title 'The World Is Full of Rhythms' in the World Focus section of the 31st Tokyo International Film Festival in 2018. For its theatrical release in October 2022, the film was distributed by 'Nandori,' a South Indian restaurant in Tokyo's Arakawa Ward that fell in love with the film.
title_norm:டூரிஸ்ட் ஃபாமிலி: A family, fed up with their impoverished life in Sri Lanka, illegally enters India and, armed with 'smiles and a little bit of meddling', sparks small miracles!
title_norm:மார்க் ஆண்டனி: This Indian sci-fi action film comically and eccentrically depicts a gangster's son who obtains a phone that allows him to talk to people in the past and tries to rewrite fate. In 1975, mad scientist Chiranjeevi invents a telephone that can call people in the past. Using it, he can avert disasters about to befall his past self or loved ones, or make choices that lead to profit. However, Chiranjeevi gets caught in a gang war at a bar while celebrating, and the phone goes missing. Twenty years later, auto mechanic Mark stumbles upon the phone and learns its special abilities and how to use it. This phone eventually sparks a massive upheaval involving Mark's foster father, gang boss Jackie; Jackie's son Madan; and Mark's deceased father, Antony. In Japan, Vishal plays dual roles as mechanic Mark and his gangster father Antony, while S. J. Surya, known for "Jigarthanda Double X," co-stars as Antony's partner Jackie.
title_norm:விக்ரம்: A crime action film produced by and starring Indian national star Kamal Haasan, alongside Vijay Sethupathi from "Jawan" and Fahadh Faasil from "Pushpa: The Rise." It depicts a three-way battle between a drug cartel boss, an unemployed middle-aged man, and a special agent through intense action sequences. Three consecutive terrorist attacks by masked groups occur in Chennai. Special agent Amar suspects Sandhanam, the drug lord who controls the city's gangs, is involved. Meanwhile, Sandhanam is searching for two tons of missing cocaine base that vanished from his territory. As the investigation progresses, Amar becomes strangely preoccupied with Karnan, an unemployed man who was the second victim. Karnan had a police officer son-in-law, who was also killed by the same terrorists. Directed and written by Lokesh Kanagaraj, known for "Master" and "Kaithi," with action choreography by the twin stuntmen Anbariv (Anbumani & Arivumani) active in the Indian film industry.
title_norm:రౌద్రం రణం రుధిరం: From S.S. Rajamouli, director of the "Baahubali" series, which was a huge hit and had a long theatrical run in Japan, comes this spectacular action entertainment set in the turbulent era of British colonial India, depicting the clash of friendship and duty between two men. In 1920, during British rule in India, Bheem rises to save a young girl kidnapped by the British army, while Rama becomes a police officer for the British government for a greater cause. Though they are on opposing sides, driven by their own passionate beliefs, fate brings them together without knowing each other's true identities, and they become inseparable friends. However, an incident forces them to choose between friendship and their missions. N.T. Rama Rao Jr., known for "Baadshah," plays Bheem, and Ram Charan, who starred in Rajamouli's "Magadheera," plays Rama. The title "RRR" is derived from the initials of "Rise," "Roar," and "Revolt." It became the first Indian film to gross over 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office. The song "Naatu Naatu" also became a sensation, winning the Academy Award for Best Original Song at the 95th Academy Awards, a first for an Indian film.
title_norm:ಕಾಂತಾರ: A legendary suspense-action film set in South India, centered on the ancient ritual of 'Bhuta Kola' (spirit worship). It powerfully depicts the strange fate of a land protected by divine grace and became a long-running hit in India. About 170 years ago, a vast forest was granted to the indigenous people by the oracle of the god Panjuruli. The village of Kadu Bettur has long performed the Bhuta Kola ritual and maintained peace through divine protection, even when landlords tried to reclaim the land. However, the newly appointed forest officer Murali attempts to incorporate the villagers' land into a state-designated protected forest. As the village faces a crisis of survival, Shiva, a buffalo race champion whose father was a Bhuta Kola performer, opposes the forest department to protect the village's peace, leading to an incident. Rishab Shetty, who has an unusual background of juggling jobs in water vending and real estate before entering the film industry, directed, wrote, and starred in the film, passionately playing Shiva, the village's biggest rogue.
title_norm:ผีใช้ได้ค่ะ: In Bangkok, Thailand, where dust pollution is severe, March (Wisarut Himmarat) spends his days in grief after losing his beloved wife Nat (Davika Hoorne) to a respiratory disease. One day, Nat's soul returns, inhabiting a vacuum cleaner, and the two reaffirm their love. Meanwhile, at the factory run by March's family, the spirit of a deceased employee possesses the machinery, bringing operations to a halt. Rejected by family troubled by the spirit and by society, Nat tries to prove her true love for her husband and her own existence as a 'useful ghost' by helping with the factory's exorcism...
title_norm:ลุงบุญมีระลึกชาติ: A fantasy drama by Thai director Apichatpong Weerasethakul, internationally acclaimed for "Tropical Malady," which brought Thailand its first Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival. Boonmee, who is nearing the end of his life in the mountains of Thailand, invites his wife's younger sister Jen to his farm. There, the ghost of Boonmee's wife, who passed away nineteen years earlier, appears, and his missing son also shows up in a transformed state. Eventually, Boonmee ventures with them into the deep forest.
title_norm:ལུང་ནག་ན: A Bhutanese film set in the real village of Lunana, located at an altitude of 4,800 meters in the Himalayas, depicting the interaction between a young teacher from the city and the village children. Ugyen, a young teacher dreaming of becoming a musician, is ordered to take a post at a school in Lunana, the most remote village in Bhutan. After a journey of over a week, he arrives at the village, where children eagerly await the teacher's arrival, wanting to study. Ugyen is initially bewildered by life in a place without electricity or toilet paper, but gradually finds his place while spending time with the villagers. Director Pawo Choyning Dorji, a Bhutanese native making his directorial debut, beautifully captures the simple yet precious lives of the villagers, questioning what true happiness really is. The film earned Bhutan's first-ever nomination for the Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards. It was released in Japan in 2021. In 2026, it is scheduled for a revival screening as part of the 40th anniversary of Japan-Bhutan diplomatic relations.
title_norm:’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!!: Beginning in 1963 when a re-edited version of the TV anime "Wolf Boy Ken" was screened alongside "Wanwan Chushingura" at some theaters, screenings that bundled children's works such as anime and special effects films became established, held twice a year in spring and summer. Though the name changed over time, it was fixed as "Toei Manga Matsuri" from spring 1969, and from spring 1990, special effects works were separated, and it was held as "Toei Anime Matsuri" and "Toei Anime Fair." The December 1986 "'87 Otoshidama Toei Manga Matsuri" consisted solely of anime works. "GeGeGe no Kitaro" is a theatrical version of the third TV anime series, telling the story of yokai using strange weather to occupy the National Diet Building, with Shigeru Mizuki and his wife appearing in the film. "Dragon Ball" is the first theatrical film, set as a parallel story to the TV anime. "Kinnikuman" is the seventh theatrical film and the only one in standard (4:3) format.
title_norm:〈主婦〉の学校: A documentary covering a coeducational home economics school in Iceland. Founded in 1942 in Reykjavik, the capital of Iceland, 'The School of Housewives' is a small home economics school where students live together in a dormitory and learn practical household management skills. Once common worldwide, home economics schools that trained women, who had few educational opportunities after compulsory education, to become good housewives have largely declined with the changing times. Amidst this, this school became coeducational in the 1970s, attracting students regardless of gender who seek wisdom and skills for 'living in the present.' Through the students learning the art of enjoying an independent life, the film gently questions our approach to daily living and housework.
title_norm:《シネマ歌舞伎》: "Ninin Dojoji" is a performance of the grand Kabuki dance piece "Musume Dojoji" danced by two people. The brilliant dance of Tamasaburo and the eighth-generation Kikugoro is enhanced with cinematic techniques, creating a world of fantastical beauty.
title_norm:「be bop highschool」シリーズ: The OVA served as a vessel for violent depictions and risqué dialogue that were difficult to air on TV, making it an ideal medium for the delinquent manga that were hugely popular at the time. This work, at the forefront of the boom—a thrilling youth action piece that was hard-hitting yet thoroughly comedic—selected episodes centered on conflicts with other schools for its OVA release. Character designs were by Junichi Hayama. The musical tracks by James Fujiki are also exquisite.
title_norm:「sf西遊記 スタージンガー」シリーズ: Based on Eisuke Ishikawa's novel 'SF Saiyuki,' with designs by Leiji Matsumoto. To restore the depleted Galaxy Energy, Princess Aurora and her party head to 'Daiōsei' at the center of the galaxy. Her companions are three cyborgs: Kūgo, Hakka, and Jōgo. Ginkaku's gourd is adapted into a black hole, the kintoun cloud into a small fighter craft, and the rough-and-tumble Kūgo is abandoned and banished by the princess. Bellamis, appearing in the latter half of the series, gained popularity as a handsome character. 64 episodes total. Subsequently, 'SF Saiyuki Starzinger II' aired for 9 episodes.
title_norm:「ひゃくえむ。」メイキングドキュメンタリー 真剣（ガチ）に: A making-of documentary for *Hyakuemu.*, the 2025 theatrical anime adaptation of Uoto's manga directed by Kenji Iwaisawa (*On-Gaku: Our Sound*). Utilizing the rotoscoping technique—where animation is created by tracing over live-action footage—the documentary provides close-up coverage of every department, from live-action filming to animation production and sound design, recording the trajectory of the film's completion. It captures the behind-the-scenes process from multiple perspectives, offering a rare look at the live-action shoots that form the foundation of the rotoscoping process, the production of key animation and background art, and the final sound and visual checks. The film vividly portrays the long journey from the project's inception to its conclusion, highlighting the staff's meticulous dedication and trial-and-error process as a single animated work takes shape. This documentary allows viewers to relive the four-year production period and the immense passion poured into the project. It is composed and edited by Ayumu Miyazaki, who also served as the editor for the main feature.
title_norm:「もーれつア太郎」シリーズ: Original work by Fujio Akatsuka. 90 episodes total, with color broadcasting beginning from episode 78. Minoru Tajima handled character designs, and Isao Takahata directed 9 episodes including the finale. While carrying the charm of a working-class neighborhood human drama, it unfolds Akatsuka's signature style of unbridled, outrageous gag comedy. The voice actors, who performed the intensely distinctive characters true to the original's flavor, also contributed greatly.
title_norm:「湘南爆走族」シリーズ: Based on the manga of the same name by Satoshi Yoshida. Toei Video released all 12 volumes as OVAs, and 35mm film—the same used for theatrical animation—was used for shooting. The piercing transmitted light accurately captures the Shonan sun, and the color design that produced strikingly vivid blue skies vividly colors the fleeting youth of high school students speeding on public roads over three years—a time often misconstrued as brutal. Only 'Shonan Bousouzoku III: 10 Ounces of Bonds' was released theatrically.
title_norm:「花のあすか組!」シリーズ: Based on the manga of the same name serialized in Monthly Asuka, the first installment depicts the battle between protagonist Asuka Kugura and her former underworld organization 'Zen'naka Ura,' while the second installment portrays a betting tournament orchestrated by a party company. The era's scenery—Kabukicho, the front of Koma Theater, Roppongi—is vividly captured. Directed by Atsunori Umezawa, who would go on to helm many works with female protagonists. Animation direction was handled by Yuri Handa for the first installment and Hideyuki Motohashi for the second.
title_norm:「魔女っ子メグちゃん」シリーズ: A work that marked a turning point in the "witch girl" genre, featuring a tomboyish heroine and the introduction of a rival witch. The sleek character designs by Shingo Araki, the European-style cityscapes by Isamu Tsuchida, and the romance-filled Meg all realized the planning slogan of "beautiful, cute, and chic." Talent from Mushi Production, including the original creator Hiromi Pro and director Susumu Sakaguchi, also joined the project. The final episode, directed by Yugo Serikawa, masterfully drives Meg into a heartbreaking farewell. 72 episodes total.
title_norm:「魔法のマコちゃん」シリーズ／「魔法使いチャッピー」シリー: An ambitious work based on the fairy tale "The Little Mermaid," incorporating romantic elements to raise the target age range from the traditional witch girl series. Character design was handled by Shinya Takahashi, and director Yugo Serikawa's direction fills Mako's daily life with the lyricism of a melodrama tinged with tragedy. 48 episodes total.
title_norm:『 丹下左膳餘話 百萬兩の壺』 ＊デジタル上映: A commotion over a pot that reveals the hiding place of a large sum of money draws in the swordsman Sanzen... A delightful gem showcasing the talent of Yamanaka, who lightly and skillfully portrays Daigoro's signature role of Sanzen.
title_norm:『 沓掛時次郎 遊俠一匹』 ＊デジタル上映: Tokijiro sets out on a journey with the wife and child of a man he killed out of obligation to the underworld. This eighth film adaptation of a classic play, directed by Tai Kato, crystallizes supreme lyricism into a poignant love story, resulting in a masterpiece.
title_norm:『open house』: Synopsis: Director Isao Yukisada’s little-known feature debut. Set amidst the chaotic atmosphere of the 1990s, the film lyrically depicts three men and women drifting through life, burdened by a sense of alienation.
title_norm:『あじさいの歌』: Synopsis: An old Western-style mansion on a hill—there, an eccentric father and his sheltered daughter (Ashikawa) reach a turning point in their lives after a chance encounter with a young man (Ishihara) they unexpectedly take in. You are sure to be captivated by Ashikawa’s radiance as she matures from a somber girl into an independent woman.
title_norm:『いのちの朝』: Synopsis: Fuyuko (Ashikawa) supports her household by working at an insurance company. She asks her father, a painter, to paint her portrait, but... This literary masterpiece depicts the profound bond between a struggling artist and the daughter who devotedly supports him. Ashikawa is breathtakingly beautiful, portraying a strong-willed woman with poise and dignity.
title_norm:『しろばんば』: Synopsis: Early Taisho era. This film depicts the growth of a boy raised by an elderly woman in a mountain village on the Izu Peninsula. A masterpiece of literary drama, it was adapted and filmed by master director Keisuke Kinoshita from the autobiographical novel by the literary giant Yasushi Inoue. Incidentally, "Shirobamba" refers to the snow bug. Ashikawa plays the role of the boy’s fleeting "Madonna."
title_norm:『エレノアってグレイト。』トークイベント付: Eleanor is left with a gaping hole in her heart after the death of her longtime best friend, Bessie. Her estranged family won't give her the time of day. Then one day, thinking she's going to a casual tea party, she accidentally stumbles into a support group for Holocaust survivors. Intending it as a one-time lie, she begins to tell the story of her deceased friend Bessie's life, recounting her memories of the Holocaust. A journalism student named Nina, inspired by the dramatic story, grows close to Eleanor, and Eleanor's heart soars with this new friendship. But as her harmless lie takes on a life of its own, it spirals into a huge commotion.
title_norm:『カウント・ベイシー』トークイベント付: Count Basie, who brought the blues into jazz and sparked a rhythm revolution, built the golden age of swing jazz and was hailed as the 'King of Swing'. In Japan, he has captivated many jazz fans for years, and his music remains highly popular in the repertoires of student big bands and wind ensembles. This film focuses not only on his brilliant public career but also on his little-known private life, which Basie himself rarely discussed. The film's production team discovered numerous home movies shot by his family, vast photo albums, letters, and other valuable materials. It reveals his family love for his daughter Diane, who was born with cerebral palsy, and his wife Catherine, who supported the African American civil rights movement from its early days and interacted with Martin Luther King Jr. and his wife. The film also features members of the still-active Basie Orchestra and friends like Quincy Jones and Annie Ross. Through their portrayals of Basie and valuable archival materials, including collaborations with Frank Sinatra and Billie Holiday, his life's journey and the turbulent social history of 20th-century America are brought into sharp relief.
title_norm:『ビトゥーカ ミルトン・ナシメント フェアウェルツアー』ト: Called the 'Voice of Brazil,' Milton Nascimento, affectionately known as Bituca, led MPB (Brazilian popular music post-bossa nova) alongside contemporaries Gilberto Gil, Caetano Veloso, and Chico Buarque, and collaborated with countless international musicians. This documentary film traces Milton's life and music while following his global farewell concert tour, announced upon turning 80 in 2022. In the first half, Milton's troupe tours Europe and the Americas, receiving ecstatic welcomes. Pat Metheny, Spike Lee, Quincy Jones, and Wayne Shorter speak about Milton, and there are scenes of collaboration with Esperanza Spalding and Herbie Hancock. Milton reflects on his childhood raised as an adopted son, converses with his own adopted child on the road, and shares memories of his benefactor, singer Elis Regina. The second half begins with the landscapes of Minas Gerais, the highland region of inland Brazil that is Milton's home and musical origin. Friends like Chico, Caetano, and Gil, collaborating poets like Márcio Borges and Ronaldo Bastos, and younger musicians who admire Milton, discuss the appeal and depths of his music. Inescapable negative histories, such as racism and Brazil's 20-year military dictatorship starting in 1964, are also revealed. Then, the farewell concert finale approaches: the concert at Mineirão, the football stadium in Belo Horizonte, the capital of Minas Gerais. Members of Clube da Esquina (Corner Club), the title of a landmark 1972 album and the name for the family of Minas musicians centered around Milton—Lô Borges, Beto Guedes, Wagner Tiso, and Toninho Horta—share behind-the-scenes stories and perform together.
title_norm:『人情紙風船』 ＊デジタル上映: The final work of renowned early Showa period director Tomu Uchida, who died of illness at just 28, this is a humanistic period drama. In the Edo period, Shinzo, a barber living in a poor tenement, runs a gambling den and catches the eye of yakuza. Strapped for cash, he tries to pawn his barber tools but is refused. Meanwhile, Matajuro, a ronin living in the same tenement, seeks employment with a samurai his father once served, but is completely ignored. One day, Shinzo accidentally kidnaps the pawnshop owner's daughter and brings her back to the tenement... An adaptation of Kawatake Mokuami's kabuki play "Kamiyui Shinzo."
title_norm:『倖せは俺等のねがい』 ＊デジタル上映: A couple working at a factory, on the verge of marriage and moving into their long-awaited new home, are saddled with four distant relatives' children... The third directorial work by the renowned actor Uno, who captures the modest happiness of ordinary people. Frankie won the Blue Ribbon Award for Best Actor for this film and 'The Sun of the Meiji Restoration'.
title_norm:『天外者』七夕上映会 vol.6: A historical ensemble drama starring Haruma Miura, depicting the life of Tomoatsu Godai, a great man who built the foundations of modern Japan's economy and was called a rare 'Tengaramon' (a person with extraordinary talent). Written by Eriko Komatsu and directed by Mitsutoshi Tanaka, who previously collaborated on 'Ask This of Rikyu' and '1890', it is an original story. In the late Edo period, Japan is shocked by Perry's arrival. Young samurai Tomoatsu Godai (later known as Tomoatsu), sensing the dawn of a new era, ignores the internal strife over expelling foreigners versus opening the country and looks to the world. After meeting the courtesan Haru, he is driven by the desire to 'see a free dream' and joins forces with Ryoma Sakamoto, Yataro Iwasaki, Hirobumi Ito, and others to create a country where everyone can dream. Shohei Miura plays Godai's ally Ryoma Sakamoto, Takanori Nishikawa plays Yataro Iwasaki (who later founded the Mitsubishi conglomerate), Yuki Morinaga plays a young Hirobumi Ito (who became Japan's first Prime Minister), and Aoi Morikawa plays the courtesan Haru. [Admission Fee] Flat rate of 1,000 yen. *As this is a special screening, various tickets, free passes, and shareholder discount coupons cannot be used. In the late Edo period, in a corner of Japan shaken by Perry's arrival, two young samurai who keenly sense the arrival of a new era race forward at full speed. Tomoatsu Godai (Haruma Miura) and Ryoma Sakamoto (Shohei Miura). For some reason, both are being targeted by many samurai. Their lives, which see far into Japan's future, begin to intersect at this moment. Expel the barbarians or open the country? Godai ignores the intense internal strife and looks to the world. Then, he meets the courtesan Haru (Aoi Morikawa) and is driven by the desire to 'see a free dream,' joining forces with Ryoma Sakamoto, Yataro Iwasaki (Takanori Nishikawa), and Hirobumi Ito (Yuki Morinaga) to create a country where everyone can dream.

title_norm:『殘菊物語』 ＊デジタル上映: A commentary: Kikunosuke, the son of a kabuki family abandoned by those around him, walks a thorny path of artistic dedication, supported by the devoted love of O-Toku, his younger brother's wet nurse... This is a pinnacle of the artistic path genre and a miraculous masterpiece that allows one to touch the essence of Mizoguchi through a succession of tension-filled shots, making heavy use of long takes.
title_norm:『気まぐれ渡世』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: Joe (Shishido) makes a killing by putting his sharpshooting skills to work. After being entrusted with a baby by a man he meets in a bar who then turns up dead, Joe finds himself suspected of murder. Ashikawa plays the beautiful nun at the orphanage where Joe takes the child.
title_norm:『河内山宗俊』 ＊デジタル上映: To save the daughter of an amazake shop owner from a dire situation, two rogues throw themselves into the fray. A masterpiece showcasing perfect chemistry between the renowned actors of Zenshinza and director Yamanaka. The beauty of a 15-year-old Setsuko Hara is captivating.
title_norm:『牛乳屋フランキー』 ＊デジタル上映: A cheerful young man moves to Tokyo to help at a relative's milk shop and struggles to outdo his business rivals. A film adaptation of a popular radio drama, this is an early representative work of Frankie Sakai, known as a hidden gem of slapstick comedy.
title_norm:『知と愛の出発』 ［カラー復元版］ ＊デジタル上映: High school student Momoko (Ashikawa) nurtures a tender romance while dreaming of her future at university. Set against a backdrop of breathtaking lakeside scenery, this impactful film vividly portrays the sometimes cruel reality of youth. Experience Ashikawa’s legendary appearance in a sailor uniform on the big screen.
title_norm:『祈るひと』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: Akiko (Ashikawa), now of marriageable age, repeatedly attends arranged marriage meetings at the urging of those around her. However, perhaps due to growing up in a home lacking in affection, she finds herself unable to embrace the idea of marriage. In this film adaptation of a novel serialized in a women's magazine, Ashikawa delivers a dignified performance as a heroine seeking her own path to independence.
title_norm:『西鶴一代女』 ＊デジタル上映: Commentary: An old street prostitute (Tanaka) standing at the gate of an ancient temple recalls her tumultuous life... How did a girl from a good family with experience serving at the imperial court fall so low? Hailed as the greatest masterpiece of the Mizoguchi-Tanaka partnership, it won an international award at the Venice Film Festival.
title_norm:『誘惑』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: A romantic rivalry unfolds among the colorful characters frequenting the art galleries of Ginza. Widely acclaimed as Nakahira’s masterpiece, this stylish romantic comedy features Ashikawa as a young girl who is the spitting image of the protagonist’s first love. Delightful cameo appearances by famous painters like Taro Okamoto and Seiji Togo are another highlight.
title_norm:『雪夫人絵図』 ＊デジタル上映: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.
title_norm:『青春怪談』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: A young businessman (Mihashi) and an aspiring ballerina (Kitahara) are engaged, but as their marriage arrangements progress, they are drawn into a series of strange occurrences. A sophisticated romantic ensemble drama featuring a star-studded cast. Ashikawa delivers a brilliant, eccentric performance as a peculiar young beauty who harbors feelings for Kitahara!
title_norm:『風船』 ＊デジタル上映: Synopsis: The story of a man who abandoned his dream of becoming a painter to achieve success as a businessman, and his family. Ashikawa plays the role of the youngest daughter, who remains bright and brave despite suffering from a serious illness. Discovered by Yuzo Kawashima during her time at Shochiku, this film marks Ashikawa's first collaboration with the director since moving to Nikkatsu. The costumes by Hanae Mori are also stunning.
title_norm:【20分シネマ】島: Winner of both Best Director and Best Drama at the USC First Look Awards. Andrew is a boy attending a private elementary school in modern Singapore, where the pressures of an academic meritocracy swirl around him. One day, a minor accident during a physical education class causes matters to escalate far beyond what is necessary... ■Ticket price: Flat 1,000 yen. *Free tickets, invitation tickets, and various other discount services cannot be used. title_norm:【revival by the river】スパイダーマン: THE RIVER, one of Japan's largest overseas pop culture media outlets, celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026. "REVIVAL by THE RIVER" is a new project expanding the community of online film fans into the real-world space of movie theaters. THE RIVER brings the films we once longed for back to the big screen. THE RIVER reunites films with their audiences! The commemorative first screening is 'Spider-Man 2'! Two years after the fierce battle with the Green Goblin, college student Peter Parker struggles with part-time jobs and classes while fighting for justice, leading a hectic life. Torn between his love for MJ and his friendship with Harry due to his identity as Spider-Man, Peter accepts his fate. A new enemy, Doctor Octopus, stands in his way. title_norm:【第2回日本モンゴル映画祭】tatar: A human drama depicting the natural beauty of Shimane and the bond between father and son, centered around the motif of traditional Tatara steelmaking.
title_norm:あいつのロシェル:
Winner of the Best Short Film Award at the 2025 New Zealand Screen Awards. Reckless young Mac decides to give his late friend's beat-up car, "Rochelle," one last moment in the spotlight. He heads to the local junk car race. At first his friends are exasperated, but soon they are moved by Mac's dream and begin to cheer him on in earnest...

title_norm:あなたならどうする？ 人生を決める百万ドルのキス: A massive hit released in Vietnam in 2025, drawing approximately 2.56 million viewers and earning around 1.2 billion yen at the box office, ranking among the country's top 10 highest-grossing films of all time. Its universal themes of love, money, family, and life choices resonated with audiences across generations. To reclaim a lost family home filled with memories, Van reluctantly follows a plan devised by her sister Kieu and best friend Thien, approaching two wealthy suitors who are pursuing her. One is a man with calm, mature charm and warmth. The other is young, unconventional, and a playboy. Van eventually discovers her true feelings, but also learns that both men have their own hidden motives for approaching her. Thu Tran, who has been active as a Vietnamese actor and producer, makes her directorial debut while also starring and producing.
title_norm:あなたならどうする？人生を決める 百万ドルのキス: Story: To reclaim the lost house of cherished memories, Van reluctantly follows the plan devised by her sister Kieu and best friend Thien, and approaches two wealthy suitors who are pursuing her. One is a man with calm, mature charm and warmth. The other is young, quirky, and a playboy. But when Van realizes her true feelings, she discovers that both of them had "their own reasons" for approaching her... Whose lips will Van choose for the "million-dollar kiss"? Director/Producer: Thu Trang. Cast: Doan Thien An, Le Xuan Tien, Tien Luat, Huynh Phuong, Vo Thanh Phat, Ma Lan Do, Thu Trang. Distribution: New Gates. Distribution cooperation: Uplink. (C)THU TRANG ENTERTAINMENT 2024. ALL RIGHT RESERVED
title_norm:あなたを偲ぶ旅: Screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title_norm:あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。: The sequel and conclusion to the 2023 blockbuster 'Till We Meet Again on the Lily Hill', a live-action adaptation of Shiomi Natsue's best-selling novel, which depicted the poignant love between a high school girl who time-travels from the present to 1945 and a kamikaze pilot. Based on the sequel novel 'I Want to Meet You Again on That Starry Hill', it follows the story of Yuri, the protagonist, after she wakes up in the present day, having lost her beloved in a senseless manner. Seven years have passed since her parting with Akira, the kamikaze pilot. Yuri has become a high school teacher, a dream of Akira's, and leads a busy life, but her heart remains left behind on that lily-covered hill in 1945. A young man named Ryo, who bears a resemblance to Akira, appears before her. He is a temporary teacher assigned as the deputy homeroom teacher for Yuri's class. Yuri is swayed by Ryo's straightforward affection, but she cannot bring herself to embrace a new love, feeling it would betray Akira. Amidst her inner conflict, Yuri meets Chiyo, an elderly woman spending her peaceful final days in a hospice. It's another form of love that Chiyo walked after losing Ishimaru. And what Chiyo entrusts to Yuri is a book left by Akira just before his sortie, addressed to the future Yuri. The cast reunites members from the previous film, including Fukuhara Haru as Yuri, Deguchi Natsuki, and Ito Kentaro. Additionally, Hosoda Kanata plays Ryo, the young man with Akira's likeness, and Baisho Chieko plays the elderly Chiyo. Directed by Niinobe Katsuhiko of '366 Days', with the theme song performed by Fukuyama Masaharu, continuing from the previous film.
title_norm:あの鷹巣町の その後: A documentary exploring "what happened next" in Takanosu Town, Akita Prefecture, once called Japan's number one welfare town. Under Mayor Toru Iwakawa, who took office in 1991, Takanosu built a high level of elderly welfare. However, when Iwakawa suffered a major defeat in the 2003 mayoral election, the new mayor, who claimed the town had "gone too far with welfare," drastically shifted the town's welfare policies. Director Sumiko Haneda, who had been covering Takanosu Town for over a decade, captures the town's astonishing changes and highlights various issues facing Japanese welfare.
title_norm:あぶない刑事フォーエヴァー the movie: Yokohama Port Police detectives Takayama and Oshita, a duo, once arrest Jojima, a member of the internationally wanted terrorist group 'NET,' but Jojima escapes from the police hospital, and the detectives pursue him. One day, an incident occurs where Jojima and his comrades attack a transport vehicle carrying firearms seized by the police, attempting to steal the weapons. Ignoring orders to stay off the case, Takayama and Oshita return to the scene, thwarting Jojima's gang's scheme, but the group's leader Date is advancing an even larger plan.
title_norm:ある子供: 18-year-old Sonia (Déborah François) and 20-year-old Bruno (Jérémie Renier) have a son. After returning from the hospital, Sonia asks Bruno, who has no steady job and lives day-to-day through shady dealings, to get serious about working.
title_norm:あゝひめゆりの塔: A war drama depicting the tragedy of the 'Himeyuri Student Corps,' mobilized as nursing staff during the Battle of Okinawa at the end of the Pacific War. Director Toshio Masuda brings together Nikkatsu's golden couple Sayuri Yoshinaga and Mitsuo Hamada to adapt Keiichiro Ishino's novel of the same name. In 1943, in Okinawa, still untouched by the shadow of war, Yonamine Kazuko, a student at the Okinawa Normal School for Girls, enjoys a sports day with her classmates and meets Nishizato Junichiro, a student from the men's normal school. By 1944, the war situation worsens. As Okinawa itself is about to become a battlefield, Kazuko and Junichiro, now engaged in building fortifications, begin to develop feelings for each other. Soon, Saipan falls. Kazuko's mother Hatsu, an elementary school teacher, boards a transport ship to accompany the schoolchildren who have been ordered to evacuate to the mainland, but the ship is sunk and she never returns. In October, the air raids finally begin. A state of total emergency is declared across the island. Female students are sent to the Haebaru Army Hospital as temporary nurses, while male students join the army as part of the Blood and Iron Student Corps.
title_norm:あゝ特別攻撃隊: A war film depicting the fleeting youth of kamikaze pilots who perished in vain at the end of the Pacific War. This is the directorial debut of Yoshio Inoue, based on a script by Kimiyuki Hasegawa (known for "The Squirrel and the American: Gunshot in the Ruins"). Yoshio Inoue was born in Tokyo in 1926, graduated from Urawa High School's humanities track, joined Daiei in February 1938, and studied under Seiji Hisamatsu, Kon Ichikawa, and Yasuzo Masumura. Cinematography by Toru Watanabe (known for "The White Path Across the River").
title_norm:いしぶみ: A theatrical release version re-edited from a special 70th post-war anniversary program broadcast on Hiroshima TV in August 2015. It reveals the portraits of 321 first-year students of the former Hiroshima Prefectural Hiroshima Second Middle School, who lost their lives in the atomic bombing and for whom a memorial stone was erected along the Motokawa River, based on the writings of their bereaved families. While building on a reading drama broadcast on the same station in 1969, composed by Matsuyama Zenzo, it adds original elements such as projection performances using wooden boxes and interview footage by Ikezawa Akira.
title_norm:いってらっしゃいの花: A fantastical human drama themed around "accepting the death of a loved one," depicting a woman who returns to the world as a ghost after losing her life. Ayaka, who dies suddenly at a young age, wakes up in a "waiting room" that connects the afterlife and the living world. Told by a male guide she meets there that she has a grace period to return to the world, she becomes a ghost and visits her father, her best friend Chiaki, and her fiancé Sota, but no one notices her presence. As Ayaka wishes to exchange words with them just one more time, and Chiaki and Sota are consumed by grief, each reflects on the past and their feelings. Directed, written, and edited by Rei Shiina (known for "Gradation" and "Koko Igai no Dokoka e"), with cinematography by Akira Kawachi (known for "Fear of Missing Out"). Starring Ao Morimoto as Ayaka, Rei Fukuda as Chiaki, and Django Yamada as Sota, with supporting roles by Yusuke Sunaga, Takehiko Fujita, and Ikko Konatsu. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Jūsan Shitamachi Film Festival.
title_norm:いのちのかたち 画家・絵本作家 いせひでこ: This documentary follows the four-year creative journey of painter and picture book author Hideko Ise, who sensed "life" in the fallen trees left behind in the areas devastated by the Great East Japan Earthquake. In Watari, Miyagi Prefecture, where 300 lives were lost, the village of Yoshidahama—once famous for its beautiful coastline—was left in ruins by the tsunami. Though Ise initially found herself unable to paint in the disaster zone, facing a single black pine tree remaining in Watari moved her to naturally pick up her sketchbook and begin to draw. The film is directed by Shinichi Ise, who has crafted numerous human documentaries capturing the essence of daily life, including *The Shape of Wind*, *It’s Okay*, and *Beside: A Journey from March 11*.
title_norm:いろは:
Twenty-two-year-old Iroha lives at home, dissatisfied with her current self and facing an uncertain future. One day, her older sister Karen returns for the first time in five years. Karen is free-spirited and lives for romance—a woman who, unlike Iroha, has always made bold choices in life. But the reality she carries with her is this: "I'm pregnant. But I don't know who the father is."

There are three possibilities: a wealthy heir, an older man with a violent streak, and an ex-boyfriend burdened by debt. In each relationship, there remains an ambiguity that falls short of being called "love." Why does Karen keep repeating romances she knows will only end in pain? Dragged along on the search for the father, Iroha travels across Nagasaki Prefecture with her sister, witnessing the loneliness and the desperate need for validation that lie beneath the surface of romance.

The sister who seemed so strong was, in truth, longing to be loved more than anyone else. Contrary to her glamorous exterior, she had been constantly entrusting her self-worth to others. At the same time, Iroha realizes that she herself had been running away from being hurt by avoiding love altogether.

More important than being chosen by someone else is acknowledging yourself. Before being loved by another, you must accept yourself. Clashing and baring their true feelings, the sisters finally come to understand each other's weaknesses. Carrying their love without answers and their own imperfect selves... the sisters' journey continues.
title_norm:うずまき: "Hey, want to run away with me?" Kirie Goshima is bewildered by the sudden confession from her childhood boyfriend, Shuichi Saito. Lately, Shuichi has been acting listless, as if terrified of something, and Kirie has been worried about him. Eventually, triggered by the incident of a student at Kirie's high school jumping to death from a spiral staircase, Shuichi utters something horrifying. He claims that their town, Kurozu-cho, is possessed by an unknown force of "spirals." Afterward, when Shuichi's father, Toshio, dies a mysterious death, ominous and bizarre spiral phenomena begin to occur one after another around the two of them.
title_norm:うたうひと: The third part of the Tohoku documentary trilogy co-directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi ('PASSION') and Ko Sakai ('Home Sweet Home'). Following the first two works that collected dialogues of Great East Japan Earthquake survivors, this documentary records folk tales passed down in the Tohoku region. With folk tale researcher Kazuko Ono as the listener, three storytellers with richly inflected dialects perform their tales. The unique atmosphere that arises between storyteller and listener is brought to the screen through creative camerawork.
title_norm:えんとこの歌 寝たきり歌人・遠藤滋: This documentary captures the life of Shigeru Endo, who, despite being confined to his bed by cerebral palsy, interacts with young caregivers and composes numerous tanka poems from his bedside. The film is directed by Shinichi Ise, a friend of Endo since their student days, who previously helmed the 1999 documentary *Entoko*, which also followed Endo’s daily life. Despite his physical limitations, Endo organized his own caregiver network called "Entoko" (meaning both "where Endo is" and "a place of connections"). As his disability progressed over more than 35 years in bed, Endo began writing tanka in his late 50s, using poetry to give voice to the cries of his soul. Through the deep emotional connection between Endo and his caregivers, the film portrays people living in a way that honors and sustains life exactly as it is.
title_norm:おいしい結婚: Mieko, a widow running a pawnshop, tries to arrange a favorable marriage for her only daughter Non, but Non pretends to be in a relationship with her coworker Kawata to avoid it. However, the two unexpectedly fall in love and decide to marry for real, only for various incidents to arise between both families surrounding the wedding. This home drama explores what it means to have a happy marriage.
title_norm:おかえりの湯: Produced with full cooperation from the Tokyo Somei Onsen SAKURA hot spring facility, this heartwarming fantasy depicts human connections and renewal set in a hot spring. Directed by Taiichiro Natsume ("First Love Comedian"), the film stars Toru Kazama, with Yuna Hoshino, who gained attention in "Kamen Rider Geats," as the heroine. Sayama, the manager of the hot spring facility, helps a young amnesiac woman named Sakura who has collapsed, and gives her a job at the spa since she has nowhere to go. Sakura's sincere work ethic and mysterious demeanor soothe the guests, bringing a warm atmosphere to the spa. Watching over Sakura, Sayama immerses himself in his hobby of rakugo (traditional comic storytelling), preparing for a performance at the banquet hall. However, on the day before the show, Sakura suddenly disappears. Along with a letter she left behind, Sayama quietly reflects on his time with her as he performs the rakugo piece "Sugagamo no Kitsune" on stage. The cast includes Toru Kazama as Sayama, Yuna Hoshino as Sakura, along with Yuma Ishigaki, Yoji Tanaka, Daisuke Shima, Tamao Sato, Riko Kawase, Mari Irikawa, Sayaka Mizuse, and Kiyoshi Beat.
title_norm:おくりもの: This is the feature debut of 2003 by Michelangelo Frammartino, a solitary and distinctive filmmaker in Italian cinema. Starring the director's grandfather, Angelo Frammartino, it quietly depicts the final days of an old man's life with unique humor, set in a small Calabrian village on the verge of abandonment due to depopulation. An old man lives in a depopulating rural village in southern Italy. One day, young men who help him bury his old dog leave behind a cell phone and a scrap of paper—a nude photo taken for personal purposes. Later, the old man notices a woman in the village; she is the person in the photo. Using no professional actors, filming with local residents, the film creates a quiet visual poem exploring universal themes of "tradition and modernity," "life and death," and "community and solitude." It will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 in a 4K restored version as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."
title_norm:おとうと: Set in Mukojima, Tokyo, during the Taisho era. Siblings Gen and Aoiro live with their writer father and stepmother. Gen takes care of Aoiro, covering for their sick stepmother, but Aoiro starts hanging out with a bad crowd. They protect each other at times and have big fights at others, living together as siblings, until Aoiro falls ill with tuberculosis.
title_norm:おばあちゃんの秘密: A home drama set in Tainai City, Niigata Prefecture, depicting a cross-generational connection between a grandmother with a secret longing and her granddaughter. Kamishita Riri, living in Tokyo, visits Tainai City to sort through the belongings of her deceased grandmother, Tokiko, as per her will. Inside the house where Tokiko lived alone after her husband's death, Riri discovers 131 letters exchanged between her grandmother and a man other than her husband. Hurt by her parents' discord, Riri is perplexed by her beloved grandmother's secret but begins to trace her footsteps and memories. The memories of Tainai City and her grandmother's secret slowly melt Riri's heart, and she gradually overcomes her own conflicts. Hidden within is a certain feeling that Tokiko, who entrusted Riri with sorting her belongings, wanted to convey to her. Takei Shizue plays the deceased grandmother Tokiko, vividly embodying the emotional fluctuations of a woman who lived with a hidden love in a realistic manner. Shimada Airisu, known for 'Fish Eye' and 'I'll Come to Parent-Teacher Conference Tomorrow,' freshly portrays the granddaughter Riri, who grows while being perplexed by her grandmother's secret. Imazeki Akiyoshi, known for 'Ren Ren Tofu' and 'Aiko Sixteen,' serves as original creator and director, with Kobayashi Hirotoshi, known for 'Beyond the Starry Sky,' handling the screenplay.
title_norm:おへその大将: Set in a slum along the Hirano River in eastern Osaka. A fine human drama depicting the interactions between the so-called 'Apache tribe,' who make a living by stealing scrap metal, and a town doctor (Frankie) who strives to stand by them. Michiyo Aratama, playing his wife, also delivers a remarkable presence.
title_norm:お別れの歌:
Beyond the goodbye, I found the living present.

People live their lives through birth and meeting, parting and reuniting. Through repeated mistakes and the occasional small miracle, the "precious things" we hold in our hearts grow one by one. Until the day we finally wave goodbye to everything, we live quietly, clutching what is irreplaceable.

The latest film from director Keisuke Shibata, who has steadily built a reputation for noteworthy works. A slapstick rhapsody of
title_norm:お嬢さん: Directed by Park Chan-wook of 'Oldboy' fame, this suspense drama is based on Sarah Waters' novel 'Fingersmith' but transposed to 1930s Japanese-occupied Korea. Sook-hee, a girl raised by a gang of swindlers in a slum, is approached by a con man known as Count Fujiwara with a plan: seduce Lady Hideko, an heiress to a vast fortune, marry her, then commit her to an asylum and steal her wealth. Agreeing to take part, Sook-hee begins working as a maid named Ok-ju at a remote mansion where Hideko lives with her domineering, Japanophile uncle Kouzuki. But as devoted Sook-hee gradually opens Hideko's heart, Sook-hee herself finds herself drawn to the woman she is supposed to betray. Kim Min-hee plays Hideko, while newcomer Kim Tae-ri was cast as Sook-hee through auditions. Ha Jung-woo plays the Count, and Cho Jin-woong plays Uncle Kouzuki.
title_norm:お早よう: In a suburban housing complex, several families live side by side like in a row house. The Hayashi family's sons Minoru (Kōji Shidō) and Isamu (Masahiko Shimazu) beg their parents for a television, but their request is denied. The children go on strike, refusing to speak until their demand is met, and eventually, their parents give in and buy one.
title_norm:お気楽探偵アトレヤ: A film screened at "Indian Movie Week 2020" (September 11 – October 9, 2020, at Kinema Omori / from September 25, 2020, at Shinjuku Piccadilly).
title_norm:お祭りの日:
Director Yuki Horiuchi—who earned high praise at various domestic indie film festivals, including winning the Grand Prix at a student film festival for the dialogue-driven drama *At the End of the Night*, which depicted the end of summer for youths struggling to grow up—returns with an ensemble piece about those who don't go to the festival on the day of a summer celebration.

A man in a coffee shop tries to persuade the school's "Madonna" to star in his independent film. People at a bus stop wait endlessly for a bus that shows no sign of coming. Someone, enraged that the festival's fireworks display was canceled, steals fireworks to set them off themselves. Two girls wake up hungover to find their air conditioner remote missing and search for it while retracing their memories of the night before. A girl works her shift at a cafe. On the day of the festival, the ordinary summer lives of these people who aren't attending begin to intertwine.

The film won the Special Jury Prize at the 24th TAMA NEW WAVE competition. It stars Masahiro Mera, who also appeared in *At the End of the Night*.
title_norm:お笑えない芸人: A fusion of individuality from promising young creators. Directed by Yuka Nishida, a graduate of Kyoto University of the Arts, who now belongs to STARDUST CREATORS as a screenwriter. This film is her graduation project, made when she was 22.
