The film depicts Swinton, her two children, and artists who admired Berger visiting Berger at his home in the French Alpine village of Quincy. Through four chapters structured around the seasons in Quincy, it portrays their dialogues on memories of war, humans and animals, politics and art, and passing on legacies to the next generation.
title_norm:スイス・アーミー・マン: An unconventional survival story in which Daniel Radcliffe, of "Harry Potter" fame, plays a corpse, and Paul Dano, known for "Little Miss Sunshine" and "Love & Mercy," plays a young man who attempts to escape a deserted island using the corpse. After being shipwrecked and washing ashore on a deserted island, Hank, a young man, is about to end his life in despair when he discovers a man's corpse washed up on the shore. Noticing that the corpse is emitting gas and has buoyancy, Hank makes a decision and tries to escape the island by straddling the corpse, but... This is the feature debut of directing duo Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert (known as Daniels), who come from a background in commercial directing. The film garnered attention with awards at the Sundance Film Festival and the Sitges Film Festival. Mary Elizabeth Winstead (from "10 Cloverfield Lane") co-stars.
title_norm:スカーフェイス: A violent action film starring Al Pacino from 'The Godfather' series, depicting the rise and fall of a man climbing Miami's criminal underworld in the 1980s, with extreme violence. Directed by Brian De Palma, written by Oliver Stone, it is a modern remake of Howard Hawks' classic gangster film 'Scarface'. In 1980, many criminals flood into America among Cuban refugees. Tony Montana, an anti-Castro exile arriving in Miami, takes on a hit at a refugee camp for Frank, a Miami drug lord. Tony gains trust through drug deals and murders for Frank, while also falling for Frank's mistress Elvira. As Tony rises in the underworld, his arrogance and insatiable greed drive him toward destruction. Al Pacino embodies Tony's madness and desire with intense performance. Steven Bauer plays Tony's right-hand man Manny, Robert Loggia plays drug lord Frank, and Michelle Pfeiffer plays Frank's mistress Elvira. With domestic screening rights ending at the end of June 2026, a 4K revival screening is held.
title_norm:スクラップ・ヘブン: The third feature film by director Sang-il Lee, made in 2005, based on his original screenplay. It depicts young people carrying aimless anger and loneliness as they attempt small acts of rebellion against an unreasonable society. Shingo, who became a police officer dreaming of being a "hero of justice," is fed up with days spent doing only desk work and after-the-fact paperwork. One day, he encounters a bus-jacking incident. On the bus are a young man, Tetsu, and a woman in sunglasses, Saki. For Shingo, it should have been the perfect situation, but the incident ends without him laying a finger on the culprit. Three months later, Shingo coincidentally meets Tetsu again, and prompted by Tetsu's words, "This world lacks imagination," the two begin a game of "revenge proxy," fulfilling the wishes of people who have despaired of society. Requests for revenge pour in one after another, and dragged along by the free-spirited Tetsu, their game escalates. Meanwhile, Saki, working as a pharmacist, conducts secret experiments in her room. Tetsu and Shingo's game heats up further, and things begin to spiral in unexpected directions. Ryo Kase plays Shingo, Joe Odagiri plays Tetsu, and Chiaki Kuriyama plays Saki. The rock band Fujifabric provides the ending theme. Scheduled for a revival screening in April 2026.
title_norm:スター・ウォーズ マンダロリアン・アンド・グローグー: The first theatrical feature film in about seven years from the globally popular sci-fi saga "Star Wars". It depicts on a grand scale the story of the lone bounty hunter Mandalorian and the young Force-sensitive being Grogu, as portrayed in the drama series "The Mandalorian". Set in the galaxy after "Star Wars: Return of the Jedi", the era is chaotic, with the New Republic's rule incomplete and outlaws and Imperial remnants running rampant. Amidst this, the orphan Grogu, who possesses immense Force power, is pursued by those who covet his strength. The bounty hunter Din Jarin, aka the Mandalorian, decides to protect him, and as they travel through a dangerous galaxy, they gradually develop a father-son bond. The film shows a grown Grogu using the Force powers he honed under Luke Skywalker's training, and features intense, fast-paced battles against Imperial remnants, delivering the large-scale action unique to the "Star Wars" series. A new character, Colonel Ward, is played by the renowned actress Sigourney Weaver. Dave Filoni, Lucasfilm's Chief Creative Officer, serves as executive producer, and Jon Favreau directs, bringing together the creators behind "The Mandalorian" series.

title_norm:スティング: A blockbuster hit from director George Roy Hill, who reunited with stars Paul Newman and Robert Redford after 'Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.' Chicago in the 1930s. Young con man Hooker, whose partner was killed by a powerful gangster, teams up with gambler Gondorff to pull off the ultimate scheme for revenge. A brilliant crime drama with a twist-filled plot and crisp pacing. Won 7 Academy Awards in 1973, including Best Picture, the most of any film that year.
title_norm:ストップ・メイキング・センス: A live documentary of the rock band Talking Heads. Capturing their 1983 stage performance at the Pantages Theatre with various camera angles, it conveys the raw energy and excitement directly.
title_norm:ストレンジ・ダーリン:
Set in a town gripped by the terror of a serial killer, this thriller depicts a chance encounter between a man and a woman that spirals into unpredictable territory, told through a masterfully non-linear six-chapter structure. As a series of murders sends shockwaves through the public, a car pulls up in front of a motel. Inside are a man and a woman who have only just met at a bar. Before long, the woman, "The Lady," finds her life targeted by the man, "The Demon," and she flees in desperation from his gun...

Willa Fitzgerald (*Reacher*, *Pulse*) stars as "The Lady," and Kyle Gallner (*Smile*) plays "The Demon," with supporting performances by Madisen Beaty (*The Clovehitch Killer*), Steven Michael Quezada (*Breaking Bad*), Ed Begley Jr. (*She-Devil*), and Barbara Hershey (*Black Swan*). The film is written and directed by J.T. Mollner, who has garnered significant attention for this work and is also penning the screenplay for the film adaptation of Stephen King’s *The Long Walk*. Actor Giovanni Ribisi, known for his roles in *Cold Mountain* and *Avatar*, serves as both producer and cinematographer.
title_norm:ストレンジ・ハーベスト インランド・エンパイアの怪事件: A mockumentary horror directed, written, produced, and edited by Stuart Ortiz of "Grave Encounters" fame. It depicts the outcome of a bizarre 18-year serial murder case in California, constructed from footage of the pursuit of the killer and testimonies from those involved, compiled by a documentary crew. In San Bernardino, part of California's Inland Empire, a 911 call on July 9, 2010, reports a friend unreachable for days. When deputies enter the residence, they find a family of three, including a young daughter, drained of blood and killed, with a mysterious symbol painted on the ceiling. Homicide detective Joseph Kirby recalls an unsolved serial murder case from 1993 to 1995. The ritualistic methods and extreme brutality are eerily similar to the current case. It's then discovered that letters sent to the police by a perpetrator calling himself "Mr. Shiny" also bore the same symbol, revealing that the nightmare from 15 years ago was not over. Starring Peter Zizzo of "The Girlfriend Experience" and Andy Lauer of "Screamers."
title_norm:スノードロップ: Naoko lives with her mother, who has dementia, and her father, who is unemployed due to a worsening chronic illness. The family begins to consider applying for public assistance, but... A drama based on a real-life incident involving "a certain choice."
title_norm:スパイダーマン ブランド・ニュー・デイ: The fourth installment of Tom Holland's 'Spider-Man' series, part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Set four years after the previous film 'Spider-Man: No Way Home,' it depicts a new battle for Peter Parker—Spider-Man—who has been erased from people's memories. To protect his loved ones, Peter Parker chose to erase all memory of his existence from the world. Living a lonely life in New York, where no one knows him, he spends his days fighting crime as Spider-Man and dedicating himself to protecting the city's people. But as public expectations of Spider-Man rise, the pressure threatens his very existence, causing life-threatening physical mutations. At the same time, mysterious crimes occur frequently in the city, and an unprecedented threat looms over Spider-Man. Co-stars include Zendaya as MJ, Jacob Batalon as Ned, and other familiar faces from the previous three films, plus Jon Bernthal as Frank Castle/The Punisher from the MCU series 'Daredevil' and 'The Punisher,' and Mark Ruffalo as Bruce Banner/The Hulk from 'The Avengers.' The director is Destin Daniel Cretton of 'Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings,' replacing Jon Watts, who directed the previous three films.
title_norm:スパイダーマン2: THE RIVER, one of Japan's largest overseas pop culture media outlets, celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026. "REVIVAL by THE RIVER" is a new project expanding the community of online film fans into the real-world space of movie theaters. THE RIVER brings the films we once longed for back to the big screen. THE RIVER reunites films with their audiences! The commemorative first screening is 'Spider-Man 2'! Two years after the fierce battle with the Green Goblin, college student Peter Parker struggles with part-time jobs and classes while fighting for justice, leading a hectic life. Torn between his love for MJ and his friendship with Harry due to his identity as Spider-Man, Peter accepts his fate. A new enemy, Doctor Octopus, stands in his way. The most powerful action entertainment ever, surpassing its predecessor and achieving historic box office records. Flat rate of 1,600 yen (free tickets, invitation tickets, and various discount services not applicable). Online/TCG members: June 23 (Tue) 18:00~. General sale: June 23 (Tue) 21:00~. Box office sales begin June 24 (Wed). Screenings: July 3 (Fri) ~ July 9 (Thu), one screening per day at 18:10.

title_norm:スパイ・ゲーム: Brad Pitt and Robert Redford, the duo from 'A River Runs Through It', reunite. A story of the passionate friendship between CIA spies and a desperate rescue mission.
title_norm:スマッシング・マシーン: The untold story of mixed martial artist Mark Kerr, who rose to fame during the early days of the "PRIDE" tournament that captivated all of Japan, is brought to film by Dwayne Johnson—also known as the wrestler The Rock—who stars and produces. Making his MMA debut in 1997, Mark Kerr rose undefeated to the top. After consecutive wins in the UFC, he also made a stunning run in Japan's PRIDE, becoming feared as "the strongest man in the hominidae family," but the pressure quietly eroded his mind. Kerr gradually became dependent on painkillers, and his relationship with his girlfriend Dawn deteriorated. After experiencing his first defeat, he finally confronts his own weakness and decides to step back into the ring to rebuild his life. Dwayne Johnson, inspired by the 2002 documentary of the same name, personally secured the film rights and carefully portrays the vulnerable side of a tough man. Emily Blunt plays Kerr's girlfriend Dawn, and Japanese actors including Tadanobu Asano, Satoshi Ishii, Yasuko Mitsuura, and Tomoyasu Hotei also appear. Benny Safdie, highly acclaimed for his co-directed works with his brother Josh such as "Uncut Gems," makes his solo directorial debut with this film, winning the Silver Lion for Best Director at the 82nd Venice International Film Festival in 2025. A team led by Japanese makeup artist Kazuhiro Tsuji handled the special effects makeup, earning a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Makeup and Hairstyling at the 98th Academy Awards.
title_norm:スマラグダ: Screened at "EU Film Days 2026" (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title_norm:スミコ22: Directed and written by Fukuoka Sawako of the filmmaking unit "Shidoromodori," which gained attention for "I Still Don't Know You," this drama humorously depicts the relatable struggles of a woman in her twenties, based on her own experiences. Shizuoka Sumiko, 22, realizes that her senses have somehow become vague. Since then, she spends her days having conversations with herself. She realizes that her family's cat is very important to her, that after trying hard to fit into an uncomfortable space she needs to eat delicious chocolate, and that she's bothered by people wearing white skinny jeans that show their underwear. When she tries to remember the previous day while hungover, she ends up remembering things she didn't need to. After quitting the company she joined after graduating university in just four months, Sumiko spends her days in her new life, confirming the things she truly believes. Hori Haruna (from "Hamabe no Game") stars in a lead film role for the first time in five years, with Hamada Satsuki (a member of "Shidoromodori" who also served as assistant director on this film) and Matsuo Shohei (from "Lost Baby Lost") co-starring.
title_norm:スムース・トーク: Produced in 1985, this film marks Laura Dern’s first starring role. Based on a short story by Joyce Carol Oates, this coming-of-age drama explores the perils and awakenings of adolescence, capturing the ambiguous and precarious boundaries of girlhood. Fifteen-year-old Connie spends her days hanging out at the mall with friends and losing herself in music, all while testing the limits of her own charm and freedom. At home, she is in constant conflict with her conservative mother, grappling with the loneliness and frustration unique to her age. One summer day, a mysterious young man named Arnold Friend appears. His honeyed words and unsettling presence begin to quietly and decisively transform Connie’s world. The film was directed by Joyce Chopra, a veteran documentarian making her narrative feature debut. Laura Dern stars as Connie, with Treat Williams (*Prince of the City*) playing Arnold. The cast also features Mary Kay Place as her mother, Katherine, and Levon Helm of the rock band The Band as her father, Harry. The film won the Grand Jury Prize at the 1986 Sundance Film Festival.
title_norm:スリ: Michel, a poor university student, discovers by chance that he has a talent for pickpocketing. Though once caught by a detective, he is released due to lack of evidence and soon targets others' wallets again. Eventually, his methods become organized as he brings in accomplices. In 'A Man Escaped,' Bresson realistically and thrillingly depicted a prison break; here, he turns his focus to pickpocketing, introducing actual techniques while portraying a lonely young man distrustful of others. A gripping masterpiece where the realism born from amateur actors and the suspense created by various pickpocketing scenes blend seamlessly.
title_norm:スリ（1959）: A suspense drama centered on the theme of pickpocketing by director Robert Bresson, following his work *A Man Escaped*. Michel, a poor university student with a natural manual dexterity, eventually begins to make a living as a pickpocket. Though initially caught by the police, he is released due to insufficient evidence, and his crimes gradually become more organized. Meanwhile, Jeanne, who lives in the room next to his mother’s apartment, finds herself drawn to him... The film depicts Michel, a young man who believes that superior individuals have the freedom to break the law, as he becomes captivated by the craft of pickpocket
title_norm:スローなブギにしてくれ: Goro and Sachino first met on the Third Keihin Expressway. Sachino, thrown out of a white Mustang, was rescued by Goro, who was riding a motorcycle. The two begin living together. Meanwhile, the middle-aged man who was driving the Mustang is also leading a strange cohabitation. Sachino starts working at a snack bar called Queen Elizabeth. Goro gets into a fight and quits his part-time job. When Goro leaves home, Sachino decides to meet the middle-aged man.
title_norm:スーパーガール: A DC Universe film following James Gunn's 2025 "Superman," this hero action movie centers on Supergirl / Kara Zor-El, the cousin of Superman / Clark Kent. In a world after Superman saved Earth, Kara Zor-El, who lost her home planet Krypton, lives quietly with her beloved dog Krypto, her only emotional anchor. One day, a mysterious enemy named Krem suddenly appears and poisons Krypto. To obtain the antidote, Kara embarks on a grand cosmic battle alongside Lucy, an alien girl whose family was also taken by Krem, and a vicious bounty hunter robot. Millie Alcock, the young Australian actor who gained attention for the TV series "House of the Dragon," reprises her role as Supergirl / Kara Zor-El from "Superman." Evey Ridley (Netflix's "3 Body Problem") plays the alien girl Lucy Mary Noelle, and Jason Momoa ("Aquaman," "A Minecraft Movie") co-stars as the bounty hunter robot. Superdog Krypto, who appeared in "Superman," also returns. Produced by James Gunn's DC Studios following "Superman," the film is directed by Craig Gillespie ("I, Tonya," "Cruella").
title_norm:センチメンタル・バリュー: Swedish director Joachim Trier, who gained international attention with "The Worst Person in the World," crafts a family drama centered on the tangled bonds of love and hate inherent in the parent-child relationship. Nora, an actress thriving in Oslo, and her sister Agnes, who chose family life and lives quietly with her husband and son. One day, their father Gustav, a film director who abandoned the family when they were young and has been out of contact for years, reappears and offers Nora the lead role in his first autobiographical film in 15 years. Filled with anger and disappointment toward her father, Nora firmly refuses, and soon the popular young American actress Rachel is cast instead. When Nora learns that the film will be shot at the family's old home, a place filled with memories, uncontrollable emotions surge within her once again. Renate Reinsve, who also starred in "The Worst Person in the World," plays the protagonist Nora, with acclaimed actor Stellan Skarsgård as her father Gustav. Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas plays sister Agnes, and Elle Fanning plays the popular American actress Rachel. The film won the Grand Prix at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. At the 98th Academy Awards, it received nine nominations across eight categories, including Best Picture, and won the award for Best International Feature Film.
title_norm:セーラー服と機関銃: The boss of a small yakuza gang called Medaka-gumi, who has only four underlings, dies leaving a will stating that his successor must be a blood relative. Around the same time, high school girl Izumi Hoshi is saying her final goodbye at the crematorium to her father Takashi, who died after being hit by a car in front of Narita Airport. Izumi's mother passed away long ago, leaving her truly alone. When Izumi returns to her apartment, a woman named Mayumi is there, carrying a letter from her father that says, 'If I die, please take care of Izumi.' The next day, a crowd of men in black suits lines up in front of her school. Ignoring her friends Tomoki, Tetsuo, and Shuhei, who try to stop her, Izumi heads toward the school gate. The man from the crematorium steps forward and says, 'You're Izumi Hoshi, right?' This man, named Sakuma, takes her to a shabby office and asks her to succeed as the fourth-generation boss of the Medaka-gumi.
title_norm:ゼンブ・オブ・トーキョー: A youth ensemble drama featuring all fourth-generation members of the popular idol group Hinatazaka46. Directed by the renowned Kumakiri Kazuyoshi, known for 'My Man' and '#Manhole,' it follows eleven unique high school girls on a school trip to Tokyo as they race through the big city to enjoy everything it has to offer. High school student Ikezono, visiting Tokyo on a school trip, meticulously plans a perfect itinerary to tour famous spots, intending to lead her group. However, on the long-awaited free day, the group inexplicably splits up, and Ikezono finds herself alone at the base of Tokyo Skytree. Determined to complete her plan, she sets out to explore Tokyo, but unbeknownst to her, her group members each have their own agendas for being in Tokyo. Shogenji Yoko, who served as center for Hinatazaka46's single 'Kimi wa Honeydew,' stars as the protagonist Ikezono, with all eleven fourth-generation members appearing. The screenplay is by Fukuda Shohei of the 'HiGH&LOW THE MOVIE' series and Tsuchiya Ryoichi of the film 'Osomatsu-san.' From the planning stage, they directly interviewed all eleven members, gathering memories from their school days, pre-idol stories, and feelings about Tokyo, crafting an original script woven from their real-life stories.
title_norm:ソイレント・グリーン: Directed by Richard Fleischer of "Fantastic Voyage" fame, this 1973 near-future sci-fi film adapts Harry Harrison's novel "Make Room! Make Room!" and depicts various social issues such as overpopulation, extreme weather, food shortages, resource depletion, ecological collapse, and poverty. In 2022, New York City is suffering from explosive population growth, leaving people homeless and food shortages commonplace, while rapid climate change has subjected the city to heat waves. In a world of extreme inequality, most people spend their days idly waiting for the weekly government ration of the nutrient food "Soylent." Amidst this, a murder occurs: Simonsohn, an executive of the Soylent Corporation who just announced the new product "Soylent Green" as the ultimate nutrition, is killed. Homicide detective Thorn takes on the investigation... Charlton Heston of "Ben-Hur" stars as Detective Thorn, with Edward G. Robinson of "Little Caesar" co-starring. A digitally remastered version was revived in theaters in May 2024.
title_norm:ソングス・フォー・ドレラ: A documentary recording the 1989 Andy Warhol tribute concert by Lou Reed and John Cale of the legendary rock band The Velvet Underground. Warhol, who was deeply involved in the band's formation, was an overwhelming mentor and a friend of both love and hate for the band's two leading figures, Reed and Cale. Reed and Cale had parted ways due to differences in musical direction, but three years after Warhol's death, in 1989, they reunited for the first time in 21 years at the tribute concert. The one-of-a-kind performance, where regret and affection for Warhol, Reed, and Cale intersect, was captured by renowned cinematographer Edward Lachman, known for films like "Carol." The film was restored in 4K from the original 16mm negative discovered by director Lachman during the production of Todd Haynes' "The Velvet Underground."
title_norm:ソング・サング・ブルー: A musical drama starring Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson in their first collaboration, based on the true story of a married couple who performed as a tribute band to American national singer Neil Diamond. Mike, who once dreamed of a music career, now can only get on stage by imitating someone else's singing, hitting rock bottom in life. One day, he meets Claire, a woman with the same passion, and they form a tribute band to their beloved Neil Diamond. Starting from a small garage, their voices gradually capture the hearts of the people in their town. But then, a sudden tragedy strikes them. Jackman and Hudson deliver powerful performances of Neil Diamond's classic songs, including 'Sweet Caroline.' The cast includes Michael Imperioli from 'The Sopranos,' Ella Anderson from 'The Glass Castle,' and singer-songwriter King Princess. Based on the 2008 documentary of the same name, Craig Brewer, director of 'Hustle & Flow,' wrote and directed the film. Hudson was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards.
title_norm:ソーゾク: A humorous drama about the inheritance disputes that erupt within a once-close family after the death of their elderly mother. The Suzuki family mourns the loss of their mother, but soon, arguments break out over her estate: the eldest and second daughters insist on selling the family home and splitting the proceeds, the younger brother and his wife claim the land and house as their inheritance as the family successor, and the widow of the deceased eldest son joins the fray, souring their previously warm relationships. When a later-discovered will surfaces, objections arise, worsening the rifts. The conflict escalates to the point of litigation, but... Nene Otsuka plays the eldest daughter Reiko, Yami Yumiko plays the second daughter Satomi, and Shinobu Nakayama plays Sanae, the widow of the late eldest son. Akiko Matsumoto takes on the role of a consultant offering inheritance advice from a legal standpoint, while Yota Kawase plays Reiko's husband Seiichi. The film is directed and written by Fujimura Mamiya, known for scripting the 'Care Nin' series, which depicted the realities of nursing care.
title_norm:ゾンビ1 2 〜right side of the liv:
"Zombie 1/2: Right Side of the Living Dead" is the second production in the M CINEMA series presented by MMJ. Featuring an introverted office worker who has become the world's only zombie as its protagonist, 24-year-old rookie director and zombie geek Erika Ota delivers a brand-new sensation in zombie horror-comedy like you've never seen before!

Humanity has triumphed over the zombie threat, leaving only one zombie left in the world. This "last zombie" is the protagonist of our story. Having maintained his sanity even after being bitten, he lives an ordinary life as an office worker, accepted by society as a "half-zombie."

However, after he instinctively bites an intern named Uzame, a new zombie pandemic erupts! Dragging in his crush, Eruko-senpai, and the zombie researcher Dr. Horafukida, a mysterious man named Hiiringu—who operates in the shadows of a facility called the "Healing Half-Zombie House"—also appears...

Can our hero save the world and everyone in it—!?
title_norm:タイガー・ストライプス: Inspired by Malaysian myths and folklore, this body horror film fantastically and powerfully depicts the 'pain' and 'liberation' that accompany a girl's adolescence. It won the Grand Prize at the 2023 Cannes Film Festival's Critics' Week. Twelve-year-old Zafan attends an Islamic girls' school, bound by traditional norms but living innocently with occasional rebellious behavior. However, when she gets her first period earlier than her friends, she is shunned and isolated. As confusion sets in, her body begins to transform into something grotesque. Adults try to suppress her outbursts, but her madness only escalates. Eventually, she accepts herself and unleashes everything. The film is the feature debut of Amanda Nell Eu, previously acclaimed for her short films. Lead actress Zafreen Zairizal, who plays Zafan, embodies the anxiety and conflict of a girl bewildered by puberty's changes, winning a Special Jury Prize for Best Actress at the Sitges Film Festival. The film was also featured in the 2023 Tokyo Filmex Competition section.
title_norm:タリーと私の秘密の時間: Marlo, a mother of three including a newborn, is given a night nanny by her brother. Initially hesitant, she soon bonds deeply with Tully, a nanny who is thoughtful, surprising, and at times challenging.
title_norm:タービュランス 絶空16,000フィート: A situational survival thriller set in the inescapable space of a floating hot air balloon, depicting the threats of nature and human conflict. To repair his relationship with his wife Amy, who is grieving a miscarriage, ambitious CEO Zach joins a hot air balloon tour crossing the Italian Dolomites with her. A mysterious woman named Julia joins them, and the flight with the three passengers begins. But high in the sky, Julia suddenly reveals that she had a secret meeting with Zach the previous day, accusing him of infidelity. Zach denies it, but suspicion swirls, and Julia suddenly pulls a knife. During the struggle, the pilot falls out, and the balloon goes out of control. With the radio dead and the balloon reaching an oxygen-thin altitude of 16,000 feet, battered by turbulence and storms, the three are forced into extreme choices with no escape. Directed by Claudio Fae of 'Air Lock: Underwater Emergency Shelter,' with a screenplay by Andy Mason, who wrote and produced 'Air Lock: Underwater Emergency Shelter' and '47 Meters Down.' The cast includes Hera Hilmar of 'Mortal Engines' as Amy, Jeremy Irvine of 'War Horse' as Zach, and Olga Kurylenko, known as a Bond girl from 'Quantum of Solace,' as Julia.
title_norm:ダイナソーjr. フリークシーン: A documentary chronicling the history of the American band Dinosaur Jr., a central force in the alternative rock scene from the late 1980s through the 1990s. Formed in Massachusetts in 1984 by members directly impacted by the 80s US hardcore/punk scene, Dinosaur Jr. gained immense support for their unique sound, wrapping melancholic and nostalgic melodies in harsh, roaring noise. Despite lineup changes and hiatuses, they continue to create new music today. Focusing on the relationship between the three original members—guitarist/vocalist J Mascis, bassist Lou Barlow, and drummer Murph—the film traces their roughly 30-year trajectory through rare past footage and testimonies from musicians close to them. Produced by the band themselves, it is directed by music video filmmaker Philipp Reichenheim, who is related to J Mascis by marriage.
title_norm:ダイナマイトどんどん: Set in 1950, in Kokura, Northern Kyushu, under U.S. occupation just after the war. To resolve the escalating yakuza conflict between the Okagen and Hashiden gangs, the police chief proposes a peaceful solution: a yakuza baseball tournament instead of a turf war. The protagonist, Kasuke of the Okagen gang, uses his wits to suppress Hashiden's offense, but the impatient Hashiden brings in their secret weapon, Ginji. A pitcher who became a yakuza after having his fingers severed over a woman, his magical pitches turn the tide, putting Okagen in a tough spot.
title_norm:ダイヤモンド 私たちの衣装工房: A humorous human drama set in a 1970s Rome costume workshop, depicting the lives of the seamstresses, which became a hot topic in Italy. Directed by Ferzan Özpetek ("Bitter Coffee," "Tomorrow's Pasta is Al Dente"), the film is inspired by his memories of the people he met at a historic Roman costume workshop during his time as an assistant director, paying homage to the artisans who supported the golden age of Italian cinema. In 1970s Rome, at the costume workshop run by the Canova sisters, the seamstresses work busily. Behind the scenes of glamorous costume creation, each woman has her own troubles: Paolina, a single mother in charge of hats, and Nicoletta, a seamstress afraid of her violent husband. One day, a request for a new creation comes from a world-renowned costume designer. To meet their high demands, they strive to create a supreme, one-of-a-kind garment unlike anything seen before... Starring Luisa Ranieri ("Parthenope"), Jasmine Trinca ("The Son's Room"), and Stefano Accorsi ("The Starting Line"). Costumes are designed by Stefano Ciamitti, who also designed the costumes for the closing ceremony of the 2026 Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics. The film won the Audience Award at the 70th David di Donatello Awards in 2025.
title_norm:ダウントン・アビー: Set in early 20th-century Britain, this is the final chapter of the masterpiece drama depicting the intricate human relationships and changing times of the aristocratic Crawley family and their servants living in a magnificent mansion.
title_norm:ダブル・クラッチ: Centered on the bond between a young man (Go) who dreams of becoming a racer and his older sister (Matsuzaka), who works as a station vendor by day and a hostess by night to support him and fulfill his dream. The story also unfolds a passionate love affair between the sister and a teacher (Chii), as well as a gentle romance between the young man and the teacher's sister-in-law (Morishita). However, one day, a tragic event strikes the close-knit siblings. The teacher, whom the sister trusted, turns out to be married; he impregnates her and ultimately murders her. Enraged for his sister, the young man seeks revenge, double-clutching his car into a deadly car chase against the teacher.
title_norm:チェイサーゲームw 水魚の交わり: A film version serving as a sequel to the TV dramas 'Chaser Game W: My Ex-Girlfriend is My Harassing Boss' and 'Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens,' which delicately portrayed the realities of the game industry and a romance between women. Set seven years after the drama, it depicts the relationship evolving over time and the two women confronting life choices. Itsuki and Fuyu live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, now a middle school student. As they become consumed by housework, childcare, and work, their time together becomes routine. Over the seven years, their relationship shifts from lovers to family, and they gradually begin to drift apart. Though they maintain a peaceful home while being disturbed by each other's casual words and attitudes, their daughter Tsuki senses the unease between her parents. One day, Tsuki gets into trouble and is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter prompts Itsuki and Fuyu to confront each other's true feelings for the first time and re-examine the form of love they have lost sight of. Continuing from the drama series, Sugai Yuka stars as Itsuki, Nakamura Yurika as Fuyu, Okamoto Mirai as their middle-school-aged daughter Tsuki, Ito Ayumi as taxi driver Kozue, and Kurotani Tomoka as Department Chief Ro. Directed by Ota Isamu, who also worked on the drama series, with a screenplay by Asada Atsushi.
title_norm:チャオ・パンタン: A French noir directed by Claude Berri in 1983, known for 'The Old Man and the Child' and 'Jean de Florette'/'Manon des Sources,' which became a huge hit in France attracting nearly 4 million viewers. Set in the Parisian underworld, it vividly portrays the loneliness and sorrow of those cast out from the city through a tale of friendship and revenge between a lonely middle-aged man and a young drug dealer. In the 18th arrondissement of Paris, one night, a young man named Bensoussan, of Jewish and Arab descent, flees into the gas station where Lambert, an alcoholic middle-aged man, works. Bensoussan begins visiting Lambert frequently, and Lambert starts looking after him. However, Bensoussan, a drug dealer, is killed by two men on a motorcycle. Lambert swears revenge, takes a gun, and heads out into the night. French national comedian Coluche plays the protagonist Lambert, and Richard Anconina, known for 'The Pistol and the Boy,' plays Bensoussan. At the 9th César Awards, Coluche won Best Actor, and Anconina won Best Supporting Actor and Most Promising Actor. Based on the novel by Alain Page, known for 'The Sun Knows,' the screenplay was co-written by Page and director Berri. Scheduled for a revival release in Japan in July 2026 in a 4K digital version.
title_norm:チャーリー・イズ・マイ・ダーリン: A documentary recording The Rolling Stones' tour of Ireland on September 3 and 4, 1965. This film, the Stones' first official film, captures their electrifying stage performances at a time when they were riding high on the worldwide success of '(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction,' along with off-stage footage and interviews from the tour. Directed by Peter Whitehead, known for documenting British and American subcultures in works such as 'Tonite Let's All Make Love in London.' In 2011, previously unedited and unreleased stage footage was newly discovered, and in 2012, a 2K restored version was produced with that footage added and re-edited. The 2K restored version was released in theaters in August 2022.
title_norm:チルド: At a convenience store called AnyMart in a corner of Tokyo, the assistant manager Sakai (Sosuke Ikematsu) has spent most of his twenties working there since his student days. Register work. Stocking shelves. Disposal. Mobile games. Dating apps. Just repeating the same things every day. The owner (Masahiko Nishimura) rules the store within the convenience store system, allowing no deviation. However, the arrival of a new part-time worker, Ogawa (Erika Karata), begins to quietly disrupt the store's equilibrium. Eventually, this distortion silently and surely transforms the convenience store into an extreme space.
title_norm:ツイッギー: A documentary exploring the life and allure of Twiggy, the legendary British model who captivated the world in the 1960s. Debuting at age 16 in 1965, Twiggy quickly rose to stardom, and with her famously slender, twig-like figure and unique fashion sense, she overturned conventional standards of beauty. Becoming an icon of the Swinging London youth culture, she revolutionized the fashion world, sparking a global miniskirt boom. Later, pursuing her own forms of expression, she also found success as an actress and singer, notably starring in Ken Russell's 1971 musical film "The Boy Friend," which drew significant attention. Through Twiggy's own words, rare archival footage, and interviews with those connected to her—including Brooke Shields, Dustin Hoffman, Paul McCartney, and Sienna Miller—the film portrays her life as a woman and mother, her struggles, and her choices. The director is actress Sadie Frost, who also helmed the documentary "Mary Quant: The Legend of Swinging London."
title_norm:ツーリストファミリー: A family, fed up with their impoverished life in Sri Lanka, illegally enters India and, armed with 'smiles and a little bit of meddling', sparks small miracles!
title_norm:テルマがゆく！ 93歳のやさしいリベンジ: A comedy-drama about a 93-year-old grandmother's struggle against a grandparent scam, starring June Squibb, nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for 'Nebraska,' in her first leading film role at age 93. Thelma, 93, lives alone after losing her husband, lonely but carefree. One day, hearing that her beloved grandson Danny has caused an accident and is in jail, she sends $10,000 for bail to help him, but it's a classic scam. Determined to find the culprit and get her money back, Thelma drags her old friend Ben along and sets out on a great adventure on an electric scooter. Fred Hechinger, from 'Gladiator II,' plays the grandson Danny. The role of old friend Ben is played by Richard Roundtree, known for 'Shaft,' who passed away in October 2023. Additionally, Parker Posey from 'Beau Is Afraid' co-stars as Thelma's daughter Gail, and Clark Gregg from 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.' plays Gail's husband Alan. Malcolm McDowell from 'A Clockwork Orange' plays a key figure who appears in the latter half of the story. The film is the feature debut of director and screenwriter Josh Margolin, based on his real-life experiences with his own grandmother, Thelma.
title_norm:ディスタンス: Four men and women, all family members of the perpetrators of a murder case committed by a cult three years earlier, meet once a year to pay their respects at the lake where the ashes were scattered. That year, their car goes missing as they try to return from the lake. Stranded, they end up spending the night at a lodge where the cult members once lived, along with a former cult member who also lost his motorcycle. Directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "After Life" fame. Starring ARATA, Yusuke Iseya, Susumu Terajima, Tadanobu Asano, and others.
title_norm:ディッシュアップ: This drama depicts a chef with communication difficulties and a free-spirited Korean woman who comes to learn Japanese cuisine. As they repeatedly try to revitalize the restaurant, they gradually break free from their rigid values. It is the feature-length debut of director Harumi Ikemoto, whose short film 'The Hunt' won the Excellence Award in the short film category at the 2023 SKIP City International D-Cinema Festival. Three years after losing his father, George Uehara took over the restaurant 'Yurie.' Although his cooking skills are solid, he is forced to accept the reality that the restaurant has recently seen fewer customers. Then Kim Juri, who came to Japan from Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, appears and starts working part-time at the restaurant. Despite clashing due to their differing values, they gradually grow closer and try various ideas to boost the restaurant's business. Sho Aoyagi, a member of 'Gekidan EXILE' active in films and dramas, plays George, a chef who struggles to express his thoughts and feelings and has some communication difficulties. Yeon-su Ha, who moved her base of operations from Korea to Japan and appeared in the NHK morning drama 'The Tiger's Wing,' plays Kim Juri, the part-time worker who initially keeps her distance from George due to her free-spirited nature. Yusuke Mikawa, known for 'Cloud,' co-stars as Iwakura, another part-time employee who watches over the two.
title_norm:デジモンアドベンチャー: The first theatrical film in the "Digimon" series. From a midnight computer screen, a strange creature named "Botamon" is born! While Tai is uneasy, his little sister Kari is overjoyed. Botamon evolves into Agumon! Suddenly, the Digital World, home to digital monsters, appears. A bird-like monster charges at Agumon. But then, another change occurs in Agumon's body... Evolution into the giant monster "Greymon" begins! Two colossal monsters clash—what will be the outcome of this fierce battle?
title_norm:デスストーカー: From Steven Kostanski, the mad genius director of "Psycho Goreman" (2020) and member of Canada's notorious effects collective Astron-6, who has contributed special effects to Hollywood blockbusters like "Resident Evil: Retribution" (2012) and "Pacific Rim" (2013). His two latest films, "Frankie Freako" and "Deathstalker," will be released sequentially in Japan starting July 3rd at Cinemart Shinjuku and other theaters nationwide. Kostanski, who wrote and directed both films, is known for his unique creature designs reminiscent of classics like "E.T." (1982), "Gremlins" (1984), and "The Goonies" (1985), blending 80s-style monster panic with absurdist black humor, creating a devoted fanbase. These new films bring his signature style to Japan. "Deathstalker" is a reboot of the 1984 cult classic "Deathstalker" (executive produced by Roger Corman). It reconstructs the sword-and-sorcery world with Kostanski's signature nightmarish horror and gore, infused with comedy and darkness. Daniel Bernhardt ("The Matrix Reloaded," "John Wick") stars as the titular Deathstalker. Slash, guitarist of Guns N' Roses, contributes to production and music. Synopsis: In a chaotic world ruled by sword and sorcery, the kingdom of Abraxion suffers under attacks from the sudden appearance of the crimson knight order, the Dread Knights, and is in decline. Unsettling rumors spread that this war is a precursor to the resurrection of the ancient sorcerer Necromemnon. Amidst this, the insolent wandering warrior Deathstalker comes into possession of a cursed amulet, making him a target for the Dread Knight's assassins. To break the curse and repel the approaching evil, Deathstalker embarks on a perilous journey, eventually being drawn into a battle that will decide the fate of the world.
title_norm:デッドマンズ・ワイヤー: Tony Kiritsis (Bill Skarsgård), a middle-aged single man living in Indianapolis, believing he was swindled out of his entire life savings by the mortgage company Meridian Mortgage, breaks into their office and takes the president's son and executive, Dick Hall (Dacre Montgomery), hostage. Using a device called a "dead man's wire"—a shotgun and wire rigged to his and the hostage's necks so that any sudden movement would trigger the gun—he demands an apology and compensation from the company. With the local police completely unable to act, Tony calls a popular radio show to expose Meridian Mortgage's wrongdoing, involving the show's DJ Fred Temple (Coleman Domingo) to broadcast his claims. The mortgage company's representative issues a statement on TV accepting Tony's demands, but Tony refuses, insisting that the president, M.L. Hall, must apologize in person first. As the situation shows no sign of improvement, the FBI arrives and begins profiling Tony, while police prepare for a raid. Suspicion of a bomb on the scene brings in a bomb squad, tightening the net around Tony. Meanwhile, Tony's next move is to call in the three major US networks and other media to the scene, holding a press conference with the dead man's wire still pointed at Dick. Tony's appeal through the media divides public opinion and throws America into chaos.
title_norm:デッドロック: A crime action film directed in 1970 by Roland Klick, the reclusive German filmmaker who pursued his own unique vision. Dam, the superintendent of the closed Deadlock mine, finds a man collapsed in the wilderness along with a metal suitcase full of money. At Deadlock are Corinna, a former prostitute, and Jessie, a beautiful mute girl who appears to be her daughter; the atmosphere is filled with an indescribable tension, but Kid recovers there. A few days later, Sunshine, Kid's partner and a ruthless killer, appears, torments Dam, and takes the money. Sunshine tries to flee alone, but Kid and Jessie have set a trap. The film features only seven characters, and although set in America, it was shot in the Israeli desert. A German film that was criticized by critics and contemporary New German Cinema directors upon release but was commercially successful and has been passed down as a cult film. The music was handled by the legendary rock band CAN. Its first Japanese release was realized in 2021.
title_norm:デーヴァラ: A sea battle entertainment film starring NTR Jr. from "RRR." In 1996, on the eve of the Cricket World Cup, the Indian police headquarters, under high alert, receives intelligence about a sabotage plot by a massive criminal organization. Special investigation officer Shivam pursues the organization's leader to Ratnagiri in South India. A settlement of four villages in the region known as the "Red Sea" is feared as a den of vicious smugglers. Disguising himself as a smuggler to gather information, Shivam learns from the elder Singappa about a brutal conflict that began 12 years ago and the bloody legend of the Red Sea's hero, Devaraj, and his son Vara. NTR Jr. plays dual roles as the legendary hero Devaraj and his son Vara. Saif Ali Khan from "Vikram Vedha" plays Devaraj's nemesis Bhaira, and Janhvi Kapoor from "Gunjan Saxena: The Kargil Girl" plays the heroine. The film is directed and written by Koratala Siva, known for "Mirchi" and "Janatha Garage."
title_norm:トイ・ストーリー5: The fifth installment in Disney and Pixar's beloved 'Toy Story' series, which has always explored the bond between toys and children. It depicts Woody and Buzz joining forces once again to face an unprecedented threat from modern technology. Buzz, Jessie, Forky, and the others living with Bonnie are enjoying their usual daily life. However, everything changes when the latest electronic tablet, the 'Lilypad,' arrives. Seeing Bonnie absorbed in the multi-functional device, the toys begin to doubt their own purpose. As anxiety spreads that 'toys are no longer needed,' Woody receives an SOS from his friends and returns to Bonnie's side, reuniting with Buzz. The legendary duo stands up to a new threat to protect the place of toys. Directed and written by Andrew Stanton, known for 'Finding Nemo' and 'WALL-E,' who has also worked on the 'Toy Story' series as a story and scriptwriter, bringing a new story as a creator who has supported the series. The co-director is Kena Harris, who directed the Pixar short 'Alberto's Letter.' The Japanese dub features the familiar cast including Toshiaki Karasawa as Woody, George Tokoro as Buzz, Yumi Kusaka, and Ryo Ryusei.

title_norm:トゥインクル・トゥインクル・キラー・カーン: The directorial debut of William Peter Blatty, known as the author of 'The Exorcist,' who adapted his own novel. Blatty wrote, directed, produced, and scripted this unique human drama set in an old castle used as a psychiatric hospital. In a remote mountain castle serving as a sanatorium, soldiers driven insane by the Vietnam War are gathered and treated. Among them is astronaut Billy Cutshaw, who was committed after going mad just before a rocket launch. One day, Navy psychiatrist Hudson Kane arrives at the facility. Kane listens sympathetically to the patients, but Cutshaw is defiant, and Kane soon begins to be plagued by nightmares. Won the Golden Globe for Best Screenplay. Stars Stacy Keach of 'Roadgames' and 'Escape from L.A.' Although never theatrically released in Japan, it will have its first theatrical screening in 2026 as part of the 'Shinjuku Hardcore Masterpiece Selection 2' special screening (April 17 - May 21, 2026, at CineMart Shinjuku).
title_norm:トゥルーマン・ショー: A comedy-drama depicting a man whose entire life is broadcast live on a reality TV show. Truman, a man born and raised on the isolated island town of Seahaven, works at an insurance company and lives a peaceful daily life with his dependable wife Meryl. However, there is a shocking fact that only he doesn't know. In reality, since his birth, every moment of Truman's life has been broadcast live 24 hours a day on the TV show 'The Truman Show.' The town he lives in is a massive set, and all the residents, including his wife and best friend, are actors. Beginning to feel that something is off about the world he lives in, he frantically tries to uncover the truth... Jim Carrey plays the protagonist Truman, and Ed Harris plays the show's producer. The film won Best Actor and Best Supporting Actor at the 56th Golden Globe Awards. Directed by Peter Weir ('Witness'), with a screenplay by Andrew Niccol ('Gattaca').
title_norm:トップガン マーヴェリック: The sequel to the worldwide hit "Top Gun" (1986) that shot Tom Cruise to stardom. Maverick, a legendary pilot, returns to TOPGUN, the U.S. Navy's elite pilot training school, as an instructor. He, who knows the harshness and beauty of the sky better than anyone, teaches the difficulty of protecting and the harshness of fighting, but the trainees are confused and resistant to his unconventional methods. Among them is Rooster, the son of Goose, Maverick's wingman who died during a training flight with him. Rooster resents Maverick and confronts him... Cruise reprises his role as Maverick, with Miles Teller ("Whiplash") and Jennifer Connelly ("A Beautiful Mind") co-starring, and Val Kilmer, who played Maverick's rival Iceman in the previous film, also returns. Directed by Joseph Kosinski ("Oblivion"), with a script by Christopher McQuarrie, known for directing the "Mission: Impossible" series and writing "The Usual Suspects." It was a worldwide blockbuster, grossing over $700 million in North America and over 13.5 billion yen in Japan. Nominated for six Academy Awards at the 95th ceremony including Best Picture, winning Best Sound.
title_norm:トニー滝谷: A love story adapted from Haruki Murakami's short story of the same name, directed by Jun Ichikawa of 'Tokiwa: The Manga Apartment' and 'Tsugumi,' starring Issey Ogata and Rie Miyazawa. Tony Takitani, born as the son of a trombonist, loses his mother shortly after birth and grows up carrying loneliness. After working at a design company, he becomes an independent illustrator, falls in love with a woman, and marries her. But their happy days are short-lived; his wife dies in an accident. Feeling his loneliness, he hires a woman who closely resembles his late wife as an assistant and tries to get used to her death by having the assistant wear the vast collection of clothes his shopaholic wife left behind... Issey Ogata plays the protagonist Tony Takitani and his father, Rie Miyazawa plays Tony's wife and the woman who resembles her, with Hidetoshi Nishijima providing narration. The music is composed by Ryuichi Sakamoto. The film won the Special Jury Prize, the FIPRESCI Prize, and the Youth Jury Award at the 57th Locarno International Film Festival in 2004. A 4K remastered version was re-released in 2026.
title_norm:トラベラー: The feature-length debut of Iranian master Abbas Kiarostami, made in 1974, this human drama freshly depicts the funny yet poignant adventures of a boy struggling desperately to watch a soccer match. Gassem, a 10-year-old boy attending elementary school, is obsessed with soccer, often neglecting his homework and classes, earning constant scolding from his teacher and mother. Determined to go see an important match held in the capital, Tehran, he tries every trick to get money for transportation and a ticket, including stealing from home and deceiving his friends... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title_norm:トランジット・イン・フラミンゴ:
A slightly mysterious and warm road movie about three strangers who set out on a journey to find a "flamingo." Set in Nara, this human drama depicts the emotional turbulence and rebirth of young people harboring feelings with nowhere to go. It is written and directed by Yuki Horiuchi, who has garnered attention in the indie film scene for works such as *At the Dawn* and *Festival Day*.

Sae moved to the area with her lover only to be abandoned; Ryutaro spends his days unable to leave his hometown; and Akari arrives carrying a refrigerator on her back, searching for memories of her best friend. After a chance encounter, the three strangers find themselves on a quest for a "flamingo." As they wander aimlessly, stopping at public baths and supermarkets, the hidden emotions of each begin to surface, and their stalled lives slowly start to move forward again.

The film stars Rio Yamashita (*Yukiko a.k.a.*), Gaku Hosokawa (*Sasaki in My Mind*), and Kilala Inori (*Yamabuki*, *HAPPYEND*), with Kotone Furukawa providing a voice performance. Naomi Kawase—the Nara-based filmmaker internationally acclaimed for works such as *Suzaku* and *True Mothers*—serves as executive producer. The music is by singer-songwriter Yujiro Kudo.
title_norm:トレインスポッティング: A youth film that portrays the cheerful yet miserable lives of young people addicted to drugs, becoming an iconic work of 1990s British pop culture. Renton, a heroin addict living in Edinburgh, Scotland, spends his aimless days hanging out with fellow heroin addicts Sick Boy and Spud, and the violent, alcoholic Begbie. One day, after being arrested for shoplifting, Renton decides to reform, moves to London, and gets a job. However, Begbie and Sick Boy, on the run after a robbery, show up one after another, and Renton gets fired. When they return home, they attend the funeral of their friend Tommy, who turned to drugs after a breakup. Amid overwhelming despair, Renton and the others take a big gamble to change their lives... This is Danny Boyle's second directorial work and the breakout film for Ewan McGregor and Robert Carlyle.
title_norm:トロフィー: The protagonist is Sohui, a 14-year-old Zainichi Korean girl. She attends a Korean school and devotes herself to Korean dance in her club activities. One day, at an exchange event with a Japanese school, she becomes friends with a Japanese girl named Mirai over their shared love of K-Pop, and Sohui gradually connects with the outside world. To earn money for tickets to their favorite K-Pop idol's concert, the two decide to sell unused items from Sohui's house on a flea market app. Surprisingly, the item that sells for a high price is a North Korean CD owned by Sohui's father, Sanju, who is the principal of the Korean school. Emboldened, Sohui and her friend even sell a "medal" awarded to Sanju by his homeland, North Korea.
title_norm:トーキョーナイトフォール: Set against the chaotic nightscape of Tokyo, this human drama delicately portrays young people living with loneliness and unspoken anguish on the fringes of the city, tackling the extreme subject of a mass suicide event held at a nightclub. Directed and written by Yuto Shimizu, who gained attention with his debut feature 'The Fireworks That Bloomed Inside Me.' A young man named Amenashi loses his sister Anna, who changed after witnessing a classmate's suicide in high school and later took her own life. Burdened by guilt over her death, Amenashi continues to chase her shadow. One night, he learns of a secret mass suicide event held in a corner of Tokyo's neon-lit streets and, drawn to it, steps into the nightclub venue. His friends Notsu and Hattori, suspicious of his actions, follow him and infiltrate the club. In this closed space filled with despairing youth, the three try to escape but are forced to confront the emotions buried deep within their hearts. Amenashi is played by Iori Abe, and his sister Anna by Utano Aoi, both reuniting with director Shimizu after 'The Fireworks That Bloomed Inside Me.' The cast also includes Kosuke Tanaka and Taiga Hironaka, with rappers Kan a.k.a. GAMI, Bontou, and Isaac among the diverse supporting roles. The producer is Ken Ochiai of 'Uzumasa Limelight.'
title_norm:ドッグヴィル: An experimental work by the Danish maverick Lars von Trier, who won the Grand Prix for 'Breaking the Waves' and the Palme d'Or for 'Dancer in the Dark' at the Cannes Film Festival. Inspired by the song 'Pirate Jenny' from Brecht's 'The Threepenny Opera,' and referencing Dashiell Hammett's 'Red Harvest' and Kafka's 'Amerika,' he describes this as depicting an 'imaginary America.' The director himself also participated in the filming using a DV camera.
title_norm:ドニー・ダーコ: As the second installment of THE RIVER's original program 'REVIVAL by THE RIVER,' which brings back beloved Western films from the 2000s for revival screenings, the legendary cult film 'Donnie Darko' will be screened once again. An emergency revival screening will take place at Human Trust Cinema Shibuya for a limited weekend on August 22 (Sat) and 23 (Sun), 2026. It returns to Japanese screens to mark the 25th anniversary of its U.S. release. Middlesex, Massachusetts. Donnie Darko, 17. Ever since a plane engine fell onto his house, a silver rabbit has appeared before him. The rabbit tells him [28:06:42:12]. The beautiful transfer student, Dr. Hawking, the basement door... Everything surrounding him is telling him about "it." What awaits him in the world 28 days later? Flat rate of 1,600 yen (various discount services not applicable).
title_norm:ドライブ・マイ・カー: Inheriting the original story of a man's loss and hope after losing his wife, this is a remarkable narrative where the story and the play within the film resonate contrapuntally, boldly incorporating theatrical elements from timeless works like 'Uncle Vanya' and 'Waiting for Godot.' It won four awards including Best Screenplay at the 74th Cannes Film Festival and won the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards.
title_norm:ドライブ・マイ・カー濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: Inheriting the original story of a man's loss and hope after losing his wife, this is a remarkable narrative where the story and the play within the film resonate contrapuntally, boldly incorporating theatrical elements from timeless works like 'Uncle Vanya' and 'Waiting for Godot.' It won four awards including Best Screenplay at the 74th Cannes Film Festival and won the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards.
title_norm:ドラゴンボールz 復活のフュージョン!! 悟空とベジータ: At Enma's palace, where he usually manages heaven and hell, a young psychedelic demon forgets to replace the tank of the spirit laundering device that purifies souls bound for hell. Evil energy leaks from the now-full tank, and using the psychedelic demon's body as a medium, it transforms into the monster Janemba. At the same time, Enma's palace is sealed off by a barrier, throwing the order of the afterlife and the living world into chaos. In the living world, villains previously defeated, such as Frieza, are revived, causing great turmoil. Son Gohan, Son Goten, and Trunks fight back, but they are at a loss for a fundamental solution. Around the same time, during the finals of the Other World Tournament being held again as a rematch of the previous one, a mysterious crystal suddenly appears. Sensing something wrong in the Enma realm, Goku and Pikkon head to Enma's location and attempt to destroy the barrier, but fail. Enma tells them that the one who created the barrier is Janemba, who is above, and with Janemba himself calling him out, Goku takes on the fight. Janemba looks foolish at first glance, but he freely manipulates magical, bizarre techniques and is skilled at reading his opponent's movements, so Goku struggles somewhat. Finally, Goku transforms into Super Saiyan 3 for the second time since his battle with Majin Buu and lands a full-force blow on Janemba. However, Janemba, who seemed to have been killed, instantly regenerates his body and, now in a more combat-oriented form, attacks Goku. Janemba's power is too much even for Goku's Super Saiyan 3, and Goku finds himself in dire straits. Just then, Vegeta, who has regained his original body due to the disturbance in the afterlife's order, rushes to Goku's aid. Vegeta fights bravely on his own, but he cannot match Janemba, and after being shown the clear difference in power, he realizes that even in death, he still falls short of Goku, and is disheartened. Then, Goku proposes the fusion technique as a last resort. To restore the order of the afterlife and the living world, Goku and Vegeta attempt to fuse in the face of the powerful enemy Janemba.

title_norm:ドラマなふたり: Charlie and Emma, who meet by fate at a Boston café, are living the happiest of days. On the night just seven days before their wedding, during dinner with their best friend couple who are also their attendants, they confess their worst past deeds. It starts as a lighthearted game, but everyone is utterly put off by Emma's 'worst secret.' Charlie begins to fear that Emma may have another side beyond his imagination. Their peak of happiness plummets into the depths of suspicion and paranoia, but there is no way to stop the wedding preparations, and the day finally arrives—.
title_norm:ドランクヌードル:
Set against the urban backdrop of Brooklyn and the forests of Upstate New York, this four-chapter tale is woven with poetic imagery that blends daily life, memory, and fantasy. Adnan, a young art student, arrives in Brooklyn for the summer to housesit at his uncle’s sophisticated residence. He begins an internship at a gallery, only to discover that the featured works are by an eccentric embroidery artist he encountered the previous summer. As past and present intersect, a series of encounters between sensuality and creativity begin to blur the contours of Adnan’s reality.

Written, directed, and edited by Lucio Castro—an up-and-coming Argentine filmmaker and fashion designer based in New York—the film draws inspiration from the work of American embroidery artist Sal Salandra, known for depicting humorous sexual motifs through traditional needlepoint. The film is peppered with vibrant, playful imagery of embroidery art throughout. The title, *Drunk Noodle*, refers to the Thai dish Pad Kee Mao; one theory behind the name is that its intense spiciness is enough to sober up a drunk.
title_norm:ドリームオン／ドリームオフ: Screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title_norm:ドロステのはてで僕ら: This is the first original feature-length film by the popular theater troupe 'Europe Kikaku,' known for works like 'Summer Time Machine Blues,' rebooting their short film 'Howling.' On the second floor of a certain mixed-use building, Kato hears a voice from the TV and looks at the screen to see his own face. The Kato on the screen speaks to him, saying 'I'm you from two minutes in the future.' It seems that the second-floor room where Kato is and the first-floor café are connected with a two-minute time difference. The friends who learn of the 'Time TV' become desperate to find out more about the future by facing two TVs towards each other... The film stars troupe members including Kazunari Tosa as the protagonist Kato, along with Aki Asakura and Riko Fujitani. The original concept and screenplay are by the troupe's leader, Makoto Ueda, and the director is the troupe's video director, Junta Yamaguchi.
title_norm:ナイトフラワー: A human suspense film directed by Eiji Uchida ("Midnight Swan"), starring Keiko Kitagawa. Uchida also wrote the original story and screenplay. It thrillingly depicts a mother, hounded by debt collectors, who steps into a dangerous world to make her children's dreams come true. Natsuki Nagashima, who fled to Tokyo with her two children to escape debt collectors, works desperately day and night but still struggles to afford food for the next day. One day, she witnesses a drug deal in the nightlife district and decides to become a dealer herself. She meets Tamae Yoshii, a fighter carrying deep loneliness, who offers to be her bodyguard. Teaming up, they venture into even more dangerous transactions. However, the death of a female college student sends Natsuki and Tamae's fates spiraling in an unexpected direction. Tomochi Morita (live-action "City Hunter") plays Tamae, the female fighter who becomes Natsuki's bodyguard. Daisuke Sakuma (from the idol group Snow Man) plays Tamae's childhood friend, Kaito Ikeda. Ryuta Shibuya (from the rock band SUPER BEAVER) plays Sato, the drug trafficking boss. The cast also includes Kiyohiko Shibukawa, Rena Tanaka, Hiroyuki Ikeuchi, and Ken Mitsuishi.
title_norm:ナショナル・シアター・ライブ「ウォレン夫人の職業」: One of the National Theatre Live series, which films and screens selected acclaimed stage productions from the UK's Royal National Theatre in cinemas. This recording captures 'Mrs. Warren's Profession', featuring five-time Laurence Olivier Award winner Imelda Staunton performing alongside her real-life daughter Bessie Carter. Vivie Warren is a young woman with progressive ideas. Her mother, however, while upholding the old patriarchal system, has built a fortune by exploiting that very system. But a heavy price lies hidden behind it all. This play by Irish playwright George Bernard Shaw, known for 'Pygmalion' and a Nobel laureate in Literature, is directed by Dominic Cooke, who has also worked on screen productions such as the BBC series 'The Hollow Crown' and the film 'The Memory of Justice'. The cast also includes Kevin Doyle from 'Downton Abbey' and Robert Glenister from 'Into the Sky'.
title_norm:ナショナル・シアター・ライブ「ハムレット」: One of the 'National Theatre Live' productions, where the UK's Royal National Theatre films selected acclaimed stage performances for cinema screenings. This recording features 'Hamlet' starring Sri Lankan-born actor Hiran Abeysekara, who won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best Actor for his performance in 'Life of Pi' at the Royal National Theatre. Surrounded by power and privilege, the young Prince Hamlet wavers between duty and doubt. He confronts the ultimate question: 'To be, or not to be.' Directed by Robert Hastie, who became Associate Artistic Director of the Royal National Theatre in January 2025, offering a contemporary perspective on Shakespeare's masterpiece. Co-stars include Alistair Petrie, known for 'The Bank Job' and 'Rush,' Ayesha Dharker, known for 'Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones,' and Francesca Mills, known for the Netflix series 'The Witcher: Blood Origin.'
title_norm:ナショナル・シアター・ライブ「フィフス・ステップ」: Part of the 'National Theatre Live' series, which films and screens selected acclaimed stage productions from the UK's Royal National Theatre in cinemas. This recording captures 'The Fifth Step' by David Ireland, directed by Finn den Hartog, performed at the @sohoplace theatre in London's West End. James, who has long worked on the '12 Steps' alcohol recovery program, becomes the sponsor for newcomer Luca. They drink black coffee, share their stories, and build a fragile friendship through shared experiences. But as Luca approaches the fifth step, the 'moment of confession,' a dangerous truth emerges that threatens the very 'trust' that has been the foundation of both their recoveries. Starring Jack Lowden (known for the film 'Dunkirk' and the series 'The Spy') and Martin Freeman (from 'Sherlock,' 'The Hobbit,' and 'Black Panther' series).
title_norm:ナミビアの砂漠: A youth drama written and directed by Yoko Yamanaka, highly acclaimed for her directorial debut 'Amiko,' which made her the youngest director ever invited to the Forum section of the Berlin International Film Festival. Starring Yuumi Kawai from 'The Girl in the Photograph,' it sharply portrays the love lives and struggles of contemporary Japanese youth. It won the FIPRESCI Prize at the Directors' Fortnight of the 77th Cannes Film Festival in 2024. For 21-year-old Kana, thinking about the future is too boring, and she doesn't even know what she wants out of life. She has no passion for anything, and even love is just a way to kill time. Her live-in boyfriend Honda tries to please her by paying rent and cooking, but as Kana grows closer to the confident creator Hayashi, she begins to feel Honda is a burden. Daikei Kaneko from 'See You at the Jogasaki Cart' and 'Summer Film' plays Hayashi, and Kanichiro from 'Okiku and the World' and 'Promised Land' plays Honda. The cast also includes Yuzumi Shintani, Ayumu Nakajima, Erika Karata, and Shiku Shibuya.
title_norm:ナム・ジュン・パイク 月は最古のtv: A documentary about Nam June Paik, the contemporary artist known as the 'father of video art'. Nam June Paik destroyed the boundaries between art and technology, foreseeing the arrival of the digital society long before the internet became widespread. The film unravels his life journey from Korea to Japan, Germany, and the United States, as well as his pioneering activities and vision, by exploring a vast archive of materials including his performance videos and writings. It depicts how his art, which surpassed people's imagination, intersected with the popular culture of the time, and highlights his deep involvement with the performance art movement of the 1960s and 1970s, including his life-changing encounter with avant-garde musician John Cage and radical collaborations with Joseph Beuys and Charlotte Moorman. Ryuichi Sakamoto composed the theme music, and Steven Yeun, the actor from 'Minari' and 'Burning', narrates the writings. The film will have its Japanese premiere as part of the special screening project 'Performance Art: A Film Festival Around Body and Space' (starting August 1, 2026, at Eurospace and other theaters nationwide).
title_norm:ナースコール: A social human drama that depicts the relentless hard work and unexpected troubles constantly falling on nurses in an understaffed, full hospital ward, which became a huge hit in Switzerland. Directed by Swiss screenwriter and filmmaker Petra Volpe, it realistically and thrillingly portrays the urgent, universal problem of hospital realities. Florie, a dedicated and highly professional nurse working in a state hospital, faces an even busier late shift than usual because a colleague is out sick. The ward is full, and she also has to train nursing students. Despite the situation, Florie treats patients with anxiety and loneliness sincerely, but she falls into an unmanageable situation and eventually faces a major trial. Leonie Benesch, known for 'The Teachers' Lounge' and 'September 5,' stars.
title_norm:ニッポン狂想曲: Directed by Takafumi Ota, who has tackled social issues head-on in works such as *The House of the Rising Sun* and *Okinawa Rhapsody*, this documentary attempts to uncover the truth behind numerous incidents that shook the world but remain shrouded in mystery. Planned by Professor Emeritus Akira Kimura of Kagoshima University, the film features prominent intellectuals—including Taro Yamamoto, Ukeru Magosaki, Kazuhiro Haraguchi, Peter Kuznick, and Yukio Hatoyama—as they conduct a thorough investigation into subjects such as the assassination of former Prime Minister Abe, the attempted assassination of Donald Trump, the U.S. Capitol attack, the hidden struggles of the Hatoyama administration, the connection and vested interests between the Noto Peninsula earthquake and the Osaka Expo, and the COVID-19 vaccine controversy.
title_norm:ニノチカ: A romantic comedy featuring the divinely beautiful Greta Garbo in a comedic performance. The Soviets try to sell jewels confiscated from aristocrats, while the aristocrats are determined to stop them. The man and woman who become their respective agents end up falling in love.
title_norm:ニホンジン: An animated film based on the novel 'Nihonjin' by Oscar Nakazato, which won the 'Jabuti Prize' in 2012, the most prestigious literary award in Brazil's publishing world, depicting the rich human drama of three generations of Japanese immigrants living in Brazil. Inspired by the visual world of contemporary artist Oscar Oiwa, who expresses sweeping, allegorical perspectives with meticulous detail, it was brought to the screen by the Brazilian animation studio PINGUIM CONTENT. Noboru, a 10-year-old boy who is a third-generation Japanese-Brazilian, is given a school assignment to research his cultural identity and visits his grandfather Hideo. The taciturn Hideo has avoided confronting his past, but begins to tell his life story to Noboru. In the 1920s, 20-year-old Hideo arrived in Brazil after a two-month voyage and struggled daily on an unfamiliar coffee plantation. As Noboru delves deeper into his family's history, he learns of an uncle, Haruo, whom he has never met. Ken Kaneko, a painter and first-generation Japanese immigrant from Yokohama, voices the grandfather Hideo, and Pietro Takeda, an 11-year-old with several years of voice acting experience, voices the grandson Noboru.
title_norm:ニューヨーク公共図書館 エクス・リブリス: A documentary by director Frederick Wiseman capturing the behind-the-scenes world of the New York Public Library, one of the world's greatest temples of knowledge and a dream destination for librarians everywhere. The New York Public Library, boasting a collection of 60 million items in its main Beaux-Arts building from the early 19th century and 92 branches, is also known for its thorough service to local residents and researchers. Wiseman, a documentary master who received an Academy Honorary Award in 2016, handled direction, sound, editing, and production, recording the librarians and volunteers working with pride and love for the materials and activities, as well as the behind-the-scenes areas tourists never see. By showing why the library is the most famous in the world, the film illuminates what the public sphere means and what democracy supporting American society is. Numerous celebrities appear, including Dr. Richard Dawkins, Elvis Costello, and Patti Smith. Winner of the International Critics' Week Award at the 74th Venice International Film Festival.
