Surrounded by armored vehicles and under the threat of guns, the boys desperately continue walking in extreme conditions with no rest or sleep allowed... Starring Cooper Hoffman ("Licorice Pizza") and David Johnson ("Alien: Romulus") as the young participants, and Mark Hamill ("Star Wars" series) as the Major who oversees the competition. Directed by Francis Lawrence ("The Hunger Games" series) with a screenplay by J.T. Molner ("Strange Darling").
title_norm:ワイズ・ブラッド: A feature film directed in 1979 by John Huston, the master of American cinema who left behind numerous classics such as 'The Maltese Falcon,' 'The Treasure of the Sierra Madre,' and 'The African Queen.' An unconventional drama that adapts the novel 'Wise Blood' by Flannery O'Connor, a leading figure of Southern literature, vividly portraying the unique atmosphere and spirituality of the American South. When young Hazel Motes is discharged from the U.S. Army and returns home, he finds only a wardrobe and a tombstone left in his family home. In a strange city, he begins preaching the 'Church Without Christ' and encounters a motley cast of characters, including a blind preacher, his daughter, and a simple young man. Eventually, Hazel becomes consumed by madness and despair... Brad Dourif, nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for 'One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest,' plays Hazel. The cast also includes Amy Wright, Harry Dean Stanton, and Ned Beatty. Although it was never theatrically released in Japan, it will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 as part of the special screening series 'John Huston 120th Anniversary' commemorating the 120th anniversary of his birth.
title_norm:ワン、ツー、スリー／ラブハント作戦: A slapstick comedy filmed in Germany. McNamara, the head of Coca-Cola's Berlin branch, is tasked by a company executive with babysitting his daughter. However, this girl is a troublesome handful who defies easy handling. The protagonist's mindset of doing anything for career advancement echoes Billy Wilder's previous film "The Apartment." The rapid-fire exchange of gags in the dialogue is quintessentially Wilder. The film also showcases the full comedic charm of James Cagney, who also worked as a director.
title_norm:ワンダフルライフ: A fantasy drama by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "Maborosi" fame, depicting the seven days between death and reaching heaven. Twenty-two deceased people arrive at a facility shrouded in mist. The staff waiting for them instruct them to choose the single most important memory from their lives within the seven days before they go to heaven. Some choose a memory immediately, while others struggle to decide. But the final day, when a screening will be held, steadily approaches. Starring ARATA in his film debut.
title_norm:ワールドクラシック＠シネマ2011 オペラ 「ばらの騎士」: One of eight productions in "World Classic @ Cinema 2011," which screens performances from renowned opera houses and ballet companies around the world in movie theaters. This production features Richard Strauss's masterpiece opera, conducted by Thielemann, one of Germany's leading conductors, leading the Munich Philharmonic. It was performed in 2009 at the winter music festival in Baden-Baden, a famous spa town in southwestern Germany.
title_norm:ヴァージン・スーサイズ: Sofia Coppola, daughter of the master Francis Ford Coppola, made her feature directorial debut with this 1999 film. Based on the novel "The Virgin Suicides" by American author Jeffrey Eugenides, it depicts the emotional fluctuations of adolescent girls harboring a sense of danger with fresh, vivid visual beauty. In a 1970s American suburban town. The Lisbon house has five sisters, aged 13 to 17, each born a year apart, and the neighborhood boys are infatuated with them. One June day when dragonflies are swarming, the youngest daughter, Cecilia, attempts suicide. A few days later, the family throws a party to cheer her up, but during the party, she throws herself out of a window... Kirsten Dunst, who gained attention in "Interview with the Vampire," plays the fourth daughter Lux, while James Woods and Kathleen Turner play the sisters' parents. The French electronic duo AIR composed the music. A 4K restored version was released in May 2025 as part of the "12 Months of Cinema Relay 2024-2025."
title_norm:ヴィクラム: A crime action film produced by and starring Indian national star Kamal Haasan, alongside Vijay Sethupathi from "Jawan" and Fahadh Faasil from "Pushpa: The Rise." It depicts a three-way battle between a drug cartel boss, an unemployed middle-aged man, and a special agent through intense action sequences. Three consecutive terrorist attacks by masked groups occur in Chennai. Special agent Amar suspects Sandhanam, the drug lord who controls the city's gangs, is involved. Meanwhile, Sandhanam is searching for two tons of missing cocaine base that vanished from his territory. As the investigation progresses, Amar becomes strangely preoccupied with Karnan, an unemployed man who was the second victim. Karnan had a police officer son-in-law, who was also killed by the same terrorists. Directed and written by Lokesh Kanagaraj, known for "Master" and "Kaithi," with action choreography by the twin stuntmen Anbariv (Anbumani & Arivumani) active in the Indian film industry.
title_norm:ヴィクラムとヴェーダ ヒンディー語版: A crime suspense film starring Hrithik Roshan of "Bang Bang!" and Saif Ali Khan of "Go Goa Gone," adapted as a Hindi remake of a 2017 Tamil-language film. Vikram, an excellent police commissioner who aims to eradicate crime itself rather than boost his record through arrests, sees his convictions shaken when the criminal he was targeting, Veda, surrenders himself, bringing forth a series of mysteries. Eventually, Vikram and Veda, each with their own purposes, are forced to fight together. Hrithik Roshan plays Veda, and Saif Ali Khan plays Vikram.
title_norm:ヴィヴァルディと私: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.
title_norm:一一: A family drama by Edward Yang, the master of Taiwanese New Cinema known for 'A Brighter Summer Day' and 'The Terrorizers,' which quietly observes the life changes that befall each member of a five-person family living in Taipei. Yang won the Best Director award at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival in 2000 for this film. Elementary school student Yang-yang lives a comfortable life in a luxury apartment with his father NJ, who runs a computer company, his mother Min-min, his high school sister Ting-ting, and his gentle grandmother. They seem like a picture-perfect happy family, but troubles begin after the wedding of the mother's younger brother. The grandmother falls into a coma from a stroke, the father is shaken by a reunion with his first love, and the mother seeks solace in a new religion. To save his company from bankruptcy, the father travels to Japan to secure a contract with a genius game designer named Ota. Meanwhile, the sister starts dating the boyfriend of her neighbor Li-li... Issey Ogata appears as the game designer Ota. As director Yang passed away in 2007, this became his final completed feature film. A 4K restoration was screened as the opening film of the Cannes Classics section at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.
title_norm:一枚のハガキ: Near the end of the war, 100 middle-aged soldiers are called up. Their postings are decided by their superior officer's lottery. Realizing he won't return alive after being assigned to the Philippines, Morikawa Teizo asks Matsuyama Keita to deliver a postcard to his wife, Tomoko, and tell her he read it. After the war ends, only six soldiers, including Keita, survive. Based on the postcard, they visit Tomoko's house, but...
title_norm:一生売れない心の準備はできてるか: A documentary following Nasa Shigeki, the leader of the Okinawan band "Yachimun Shigeki Nasu." Born in Miyazaki Prefecture in 1964, Nasa moved to Okinawa in 1982 to attend university, and after graduating, he worked as a photographer while forming "Yachimun" in 1991 to start his music career. The group evolved from a trio to a duo, and is now Nasa's solo unit; since 2013, he has also performed as a band under the name "Yachimun Shigeki Nasu." He has released 12 albums to date, and while his 1994 song "Ganbare Iboyaru" was a minor hit within Okinawa Prefecture, it remains his only notable success. Nasa continues his energetic activities while earning a living primarily as a street performer in Naha. In 2016, to commemorate the band's 25th anniversary, this perpetually "unsuccessful" man held a live performance at Okinawa's oldest movie theater, "Shuri Gekijo." With his free-spirited performance, he captivated the audience and basked in a single night of spotlight. The film centers on powerful footage from that concert, performed with an 18-piece big band, and conveys the appeal of Nasa's music through interviews with him. Directed by Tōma Hayashi, known for "Pineapple Tours" and other works.
title_norm:七年目の浮気: A sexy comedy adapted by Billy Wilder from a hit stage play, following "Stalag 17." In a sweltering New York apartment, Richard is enjoying a temporary bachelor lifestyle while his wife and children are on vacation. A beautiful woman from the upstairs apartment comes down seeking air conditioning. The scene of Marilyn Monroe's white skirt billowing up as she stands over a subway grate is famously iconic. Tom Ewell, who also played the lead role on stage, reprises the role of Richard in the film version.
title_norm:万引き家族: Directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "The Third Murder" and "Our Little Sister," this human drama portrays human connections through the lens of a family that engages in petty crimes together. At the 71st Cannes Film Festival in 2018, it won the Palme d'Or, the top prize, for the first time for a Japanese film since "The Eel" in 1997. It also earned high praise overseas, including a nomination for Best Foreign Language Film at the 91st Academy Awards, the first for a Japanese film in a decade. At the 42nd Japan Academy Film Prize, it won eight awards, including Best Picture. In a working-class district of Tokyo, in an old one-story house seemingly left behind among high-rise apartments, live the homeowner Hatsue, the couple Osamu and Nobuyo, their son Shota, and Nobuyo's younger sister Aki, all dependent on Hatsue's pension. They make ends meet by shoplifting, living on the fringes of society, yet their days are filled with laughter. One winter day, Osamu brings home a little girl shivering on the balcony of a nearby apartment complex, and Nobuyo decides to raise her as a daughter. Triggered by an incident, the close-knit family begins to fall apart, revealing the secrets and desires each of them harbors. Alongside regular Kore-eda collaborators Lily Franky as the father Osamu, who repeatedly shoplifts with his son, and Kirin Kiki as Hatsue, the film marks the first Kore-eda works for Sakura Ando as Nobuyo and Mayu Matsuoka as Aki, Nobuyo's sister.
title_norm:三人の⼥強盗: A selection of the "Ireland Film Festival 2026" (May 29 – June 11, 2026, at YEBISU GARDEN CINEMA).
title_norm:三人の女強盗: A featured film of the Ireland Film Festival 2026 (May 29 – June 11, 2026, at Yebisu Garden Cinema).
title_norm:三度目の殺人: Lawyer Shigemori (Fukuyama) takes on the defense of Misumi (Yakusho), who has been arrested on suspicion of murdering the president of the company where he worked. Misumi had previously been sentenced to life imprisonment for a robbery-murder committed 30 years ago and was on parole. Misumi's testimony shifts back and forth repeatedly. Eventually, an unexpected connection emerges between the victim's daughter, Sakie (Hirose), and Misumi... This film, framed as a courtroom suspense, questions ethical issues that lie outside legal judgment.
title_norm:三角屋の交差点で: A documentary observing a 99-year-old woman and her son and daughter-in-law, who were affected by the Great East Japan Earthquake and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster and live in disaster recovery public housing, over a three-year period from 2018 to 2021. Seven years after the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake and Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster, a family forced to evacuate from Namie Town, Fukushima, wavers between returning to their hometown and choosing a new life. Having closed their long-running printing business due to the disaster and living in disaster recovery public housing in Iwaki City, the roles and relationships within the family quietly change. Tetsu, the 99-year-old mother, clings to memories of her birthplace, Okuma Town, even as her memory fades. Her taciturn son Takemasa respects his mother but leaves most of her care to his wife Shigeko. Shigeko, who has continued to bear this role, begins to reexamine her taken-for-granted position within the family and her own way of living. Through the family's daily life in flux, the film questions what "home" is and what "I" is. Directed by Toru Yamada, who has continued making films in Fukushima since the Great East Japan Earthquake.
title_norm:下妻物語: A youth comedy set in Shimotsuma City, Ibaraki Prefecture, depicting the friendship between two girls with completely opposite values: a Lolita and a Yankee. Based on the novel of the same name by Novala Takemoto, directed and adapted by Tetsuya Nakashima. In Shimotsuma City, Ibaraki, surrounded by endless rice fields, 17-year-old Momoko is a super laid-back girl who adores Rococo-era France. She dresses in her beloved Lolita fashion and commutes to Daikanyama, where the flagship store of her worshipped brand is located. One day, she starts selling counterfeit famous brands to earn money for clothes, and a girl her age named Ichigo, a member of a local biker gang, appears before her. Ichigo takes a liking to the gutsy Momoko and begins frequently visiting her home. Momoko the Lolita girl is played by Kyoko Fukada, and Ichigo the Yankee girl is played by Anna Tsuchiya. In 2024, marking the 20th anniversary of its release, it was converted to Digital Cinema Package (DCP) and screened in revival.
title_norm:不屈の女たち 旧東ドイツ編: To be screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title_norm:不思議惑星キン・ザ・ザ: A deadpan sci-fi comedy made in Soviet-era Georgia in 1986, which became a huge hit in the USSR at the time. One day, a student named Gedevan asks construction engineer Mashkov for help, looking troubled, saying, 'There are some men over there who claim to be aliens.' Mashkov, who doesn't believe in aliens, presses a button on a space travel device the men were holding, and in the next instant, Mashkov and Gedevan are warped to the planet Pluke in the Kin-Dza-Dza Nebula, far from Earth. There, for some reason, Earth matches are extremely valuable, and the two try to use the value of matches to somehow return to Earth... Culturally popular in Japan as well, it was first introduced at the 'Soviet SF Film Festival' held in Tokyo in 1989, later released in a new print in 2001 and a digital remaster in August 2016. In May 2021, to coincide with the release of the animated version 'Ku! Kin-Dza-Dza,' the live-action film had its fourth theatrical release.
title_norm:不毛地帯: A socially conscious drama based on Yamasaki Toyoko's novel of the same name, depicting the shadowy maneuvers of trading companies and their collusion with political and financial circles over the selection of the main fighter jet for the second defense buildup. Kinki Shoji is locked in a bloody battle with other trading companies over the selection of the main fighter jet for the second defense buildup, which is said to involve a total budget exceeding one trillion yen. Before long, the conflict inevitably escalates into a war of 'live ammunition' attacks on the political world.
title_norm:不気味なものの肌に触れる: A medium-length drama shot by director Hamaguchi Ryusuke, who continues to attract attention with works like 'THE DEPTH' and 'Intimacy,' as a prequel to his planned feature film 'FLOODS.' Chihiro, a boy who has lost his father, comes to live with his half-brother Togo and Togo's lover Misato. Togo and Misato warmly welcome Chihiro, but plagued by loneliness, Chihiro throws himself into dance practice with his same-age friend Naoya. Around them, unsettling events begin to occur... The cast includes talented actors such as Shota Sometani from 'Himizu,' Kiyohiko Shibukawa from 'The Wandering Beast,' and Hotsushi Ishida from 'Canary.'
title_norm:不気味なものの肌に触れる濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必: After losing his father, Chihiro is taken in by his half-brother, Togo. Togo and his girlfriend Satomi welcome Chihiro warmly, yet his loneliness remains. Chihiro finds solace in dancing with Naoya, a boy his own age. However, in the town where they dance with abandon, unsettling events soon begin to unfold... A singular work that serves as a pilot for the upcoming feature film *FLOODS*.
title_norm:不貞の女: Praised by many critics and hailed not only as one of Chabrol's best works but also as his own greatest confidence piece. Charles, an executive at an insurance company, lives happily with his wife Hélène and son, but one day discovers that Hélène is having an affair with a writer named Pegala. Visiting Pegala's house, Charles initially maintains his composure, but gradually succumbs to rage... A masterpiece thriller capturing Agnès Varda's 'Happiness', Jacques Demy's 'The Umbrellas of Cherbourg', and the sophisticated visual beauty of Jean Rabier, who shot all three films including this one, along with performances by renowned actors, exquisitely delicate psychological portrayal, and startling violence. (1969) *All films screened in digitally remastered versions.
title_norm:与太郎戦記 女は幾万ありとても: A beautiful women's unit arrives at an army that bans women! The soldiers look impressive, but the bumbling fool Yotaro, who messes up everything he does, causes a riot of laughter when he takes on the women's unit. This definitive edition of the popular Yotaro War Chronicles series adds a touch of allure, escalating the comedy even further!
title_norm:与太郎戦記女は幾万ありとても: A beautiful women's unit arrives at an army that bans women! The soldiers look impressive, but the bumbling fool Yotaro, who messes up everything he does, causes a riot of laughter when he takes on the women's unit. This definitive edition of the popular Yotaro War Chronicles series adds a touch of allure, escalating the comedy even further!
title_norm:世界が認めた栄冠のショート傑作選: Nine Academy Award-winning and nominated short films come together for a special event. A special theatrical screening has been confirmed, offering a chance to experience both live-action and animation on the big screen. Nine masterpieces, including Academy Award winners and nominees (four live-action and five animated shorts), will be presented in theaters as separate live-action and animation omnibus programs.
title_norm:世界の果てまで3キロ: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title_norm:世界名作童話 白鳥の王子: The only fairy tale adaptation directed by Nishizawa Nobutaka. What is the mission entrusted to the younger sister Elisa to turn her brothers, who were transformed into swans by a witch's daughter, back into humans? Elisa's pitiful yet steady hands as she weaves nettle shirts lend a powerful realism to this fantastical story. Miyazaki Kyōko, an actress also known as the wife of Nakadai Tatsuya, wrote the screenplay under the name Takaba.
title_norm:丹下左膳 乾 雲 坤 龍 の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title_norm:丹下左膳 乾雲坤竜の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title_norm:丹下左膳 乾雲坤龍の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title_norm:丹下左膳余話 百万両の壺: Known as a masterpiece by early Showa period master Tomu Uchida, who died at just 28, this period drama stars Denjiro Okochi as the ronin Tange Sazen. Tange Sazen, a ronin living at an archery range and working as a bodyguard, and the proprietress Ofuji take in Chobian, the son of a man stabbed to death at the shop. Chobian carries a certain pot around carefully, using it as a goldfish bowl, but it actually contains a hidden map to a million ryo. This is one of only three surviving films by Uchida, most of whose original prints have been lost. It was remade in 2004 as "Tange Sazen: The Million Ryo Pot" starring Etsushi Toyokawa.
title_norm:丹下左膳餘話 百萬兩の壺: A commotion over a pot that reveals the hiding place of a large sum of money draws in the swordsman Sanzen... A delightful gem showcasing the talent of Yamanaka, who lightly and skillfully portrays Daigoro's signature role of Sanzen.
title_norm:二代目はクリスチャン: Kyoko, a nun at St. Saffron Church on Mount Rokko, plays hymns on the organ. Haruhiko Tenryu, the second-generation head of the Tenryu-gumi yakuza clan, is deeply in love with Kyoko because of her refined beauty, and has even forced his underlings to be baptized as Christians. Also harboring feelings for Kyoko is Detective Jindai, whose family runs a Tendai sect temple, presenting another formidable obstacle. However, Kyoko herself secretly harbors feelings for Eiji, whom she met fatefully one stormy day. As the feelings of those around her intertwine, Kyoko's destiny begins to move in an unexpected direction.
title_norm:二十四時間の情事: An actress, once condemned for having an affair with an enemy soldier in a French village under German occupation, visits Hiroshima for a film shoot and indulges in a one-day affair with a Japanese architect. Through this, she learns of Hiroshima's tragedy. The date is August 6th. Against the backdrop of the anti-nuclear movement, their lonely conversation continues. The city, miraculously rebuilt from the ashes, can never forget the shadow of death.
title_norm:二宮金次郎: A biographical drama depicting the little-known half-life of Ninomiya Kinjiro, famous for the statue of a boy reading a book while carrying firewood that once stood in many elementary school grounds. Ninomiya Kinjiro lost his parents and spent his childhood living apart from his siblings. As a young man, Kinjiro is entrusted with the restoration of the Sakurama domain (present-day Moka City, Tochigi Prefecture) by the Odawara domain. Kinjiro works on village restoration using his own original methods, but faces strong opposition from conservative villagers. Meanwhile, the Odawara domain dispatches the samurai Toyoda Shosaku, who begins various acts of obstruction against Kinjiro's measures, claiming "Kinjiro is destroying order." Kinjiro is played by Masahito Goda, known for the drama "Mito Komon," with a cast including Misato Tanaka, Riri Narita, Vino Inuyama, Takaaki Enoki, Shingo Yanagisawa, Min Tanaka, Ikkei Watanabe, Kenjiro Ishimaru, and Katsuhiko Watabiki. Directed by Takumi Saitoh, known for "Sayonara, Mine" and "Five for Freedom."
title_norm:五月の雨:
This film explores the issues surrounding the post-divorce joint custody system, set to be introduced in Japan in April 2026, through a blend of drama and documentary. By weaving together a fictional narrative set in a future where the system is in effect with real-life cases, testimonies from domestic violence survivors, and interviews with legal experts, the film exposes the inherent dangers of post-divorce joint custody.

Kaori Hasegawa, a housewife and mother to a young son, suffers from the psychological abuse of her husband, Naoki. He constantly criticizes her over trivial matters, such as the seasoning of her cooking or her choice of clothing; even when she apologizes, he relentlessly interrogates her for explanations. Driven to a breaking point by his control, Kaori flees their home and seeks legal help. After three years of deadlocked mediation due to conflicting claims, the divorce is finally granted. However, having conceded to her husband’s demand for "joint custody," Kaori finds herself still under his psychological thumb. From visitation rights to decisions about their son’s education, Naoki continues to exert control at every turn, leaving Kaori increasingly cornered.

Mari Yasukawa, who appeared in the NHK morning drama series *The Tiger and Her Wings*, stars as Kaori. Director Leo Tomita, a veteran of numerous television programs, makes his feature film directorial debut with this work.
title_norm:人はなぜラブレターを書くのか: A young man died in a train derailment in the year 2000. Twenty-four years later, a letter from a woman who was in love with him arrives for his father... A story depicting the bonds between people carrying loss.
title_norm:人情紙風船: The final work of renowned early Showa period director Tomu Uchida, who died of illness at just 28, this is a humanistic period drama. In the Edo period, Shinzo, a barber living in a poor tenement, runs a gambling den and catches the eye of yakuza. Strapped for cash, he tries to pawn his barber tools but is refused. Meanwhile, Matajuro, a ronin living in the same tenement, seeks employment with a samurai his father once served, but is completely ignored. One day, Shinzo accidentally kidnaps the pawnshop owner's daughter and brings her back to the tenement... An adaptation of Kawatake Mokuami's kabuki play "Kamiyui Shinzo."
title_norm:人狼 jin roh: A film adaptation of Mamoru Oshii's manga "Kerberos Panzer Cop," part of the "Kerberos Saga" that also includes Oshii's live-action films "The Red Spectacles" and "StrayDog: Kerberos Panzer Cops." Set in an alternate 1960s Japan, it depicts the love, hatred, and tragic romance between an elite special forces officer and a guerrilla girl. In the Tokyo metropolitan area, emerging from post-war chaos, the "Capital Police" is formed to combat escalating armed conflicts. Kazuki Fuse, a member of the Special Assault Team, encounters a girl carrying a bomb during a riot suppression. Hesitating to pull the trigger, the girl detonates the bomb and kills herself. Fuse is sent back to training school for failing his mission, but one day he meets a woman who looks exactly like the girl. This is the directorial debut of animator Hiroyuki Okiura, known for key animation on "Akira" and "Patlabor," and it received high praise at the Berlin International Film Festival. In March 2026, a 4K remastered and Dolby Atmos version will be released for revival screenings and home video to mark the 25th anniversary.
title_norm:人間の証明: A black man is murdered in an elevator at a luxury hotel in Tokyo, leaving behind the word 'Stoha' and a poetry collection by Saijo Yaso. Fashion designer Kyoko Yasugi and her son appear and disappear along the investigative trail. Detective Muneyori travels to the United States to trace the black man's past. The unexpected relationship between Kyoko and the black man, as well as the connection between the American detective and Detective Muneyori, comes to light.
title_norm:今日からぼくが村の映画館:
Set in a small village nestled within the majestic Andes Mountains of Peru, this drama follows the coming-of-age of a young boy captivated by the magic of cinema. Sistu, an inquisitive boy living in the highlands, happens upon a movie advertisement carried by the wind on the first day of the new school term. Guided by the flyer, he finds his way to a mobile cinema, where he experiences film for the first time and is instantly enchanted by its storytelling. From that day forward, Sistu becomes the village’s weekly storyteller, recounting the films he has seen to the local residents. However, when the mobile cinema suddenly vanishes into thin air, events begin to take an unexpected turn.

Directed by Cesar Galindo in his second feature film, the story weaves complex themes—the realities of the Peruvian education system, the marginalization of Andean highland communities, discrimination within a multicultural society, and the lingering scars of civil war—into a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a cast largely comprised of non-professional actors, including breakout lead Victor Acurio as Sistu, the film is spoken in Quechua, one of Peru’s official languages. It went on to become the highest-grossing Quechua-language film in the history of Peruvian cinema.
title_norm:今日の空が一番好き、とまだ言えない僕は: Director Akiko Oku, known for "Dating My Daughter" and "Stop Me," adapts Shusuke Fukutoku's 2020 romance novel, originally written by the comedy duo Jarujaru. College student Toru Konishi lives a dull life far from his imagined campus experience. One day, he is captivated by the dignified appearance of a bun-haired female student, Hana Sakurada, and musters the courage to speak to her. Through a series of coincidences, they quickly hit it off. Amid their endless conversations, Hana casually says, "I want to feel that every day is fun. I want to feel that today's sky is the best," a phrase that pierces Toru's heart—because it is the same words his late grandmother, whom he loved dearly, used to say. Toru rejoices at meeting Hana, but soon an incident strikes them. Toru is played by Riku Hagiwara, popular for the "Beautiful Man" series, and Hana is played by Yuumi Kawai, a rising young talent known for "Extremely Inappropriate!" and "Namibia no Sabaku." The film was selected for the competition section of the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2024.
title_norm:伊賀忍法帖: Kashin Koji, a mysterious man who appears during the Sengoku period, is a master of various mystical arts, and tales of his sightings and experiences are told in many places. He is summoned by the warlord Matsunaga Hisahide. Hisahide harbors a desire for Miyoshi Yoshiyuki's wife, Ukon no Tsubone, and plots to have his way with her. Kashin proposes a plan to create an "lust stone"—an aphrodisiac capable of melting any woman's heart. It is made by having seven ninja monks under Kashin's command rape women and boiling down the resulting fluids. The sheer horror of this plan leaves the assembled Sen no Rikyū and Yagyū Shinzaemon trembling in fear.
title_norm:何食わぬ顔（long version）濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映:
Nomura begins filming his late brother’s posthumous 8mm project at the urging of his friends. His non-committal attitude, however, leaves those around him bewildered. Shot entirely on 8mm film by the University of Tokyo Film Study Group, the work is heavily influenced by John Cassavetes’ *Husbands* (1970), a director Hamaguchi deeply admires. From its intricate film-within-a-film structure to its core sensibilities, the essence of Hamaguchi’s cinema is already fully present in this work.

*Note: The source material is an SD digitization of the original 8mm film.
title_norm:侍タイムスリッパー: A period comedy depicting a late-Edo period samurai who time-travels to a modern-day period drama studio and struggles as a sword-falling extra. In Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, Kosaka Shinzaemon, a retainer of the Aizu domain, receives a secret order from the chief retainer to kill a Choshu domain samurai, but at the moment his blade meets his target's, he is struck by lightning and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a modern period drama studio. Shinzaemon causes commotions wherever he goes, and is stunned to learn that the Tokugawa shogunate fell 140 years ago. Resigned to death at first, he is helped by kind-hearted people and regains his will to live. Eventually, relying only on his polished swordsmanship, he knocks on the studio's door and decides to live as a sword-falling extra. Starring Makiya Yamaguchi, who has appeared in numerous period dramas including the TV series "Kenkaku Shobai," with Norimasa Tomiya and Yuno Sakura co-starring. Directed and written by Junichi Yasuda ("Gohan," "Kenju to Medamayaki"), it was completed with special cooperation from Toei Kyoto Studio despite being an independent production. Released exclusively at Ikebukuro Cinema Rosa on August 17, 2024 (a "Deluxe Version" with added scenes began screening at Kawasaki Cinecitta from August 30), word of mouth spread, and from September 13 of the same year, with Gaga as co-distributor, it expanded to over 100 theaters nationwide including Shinjuku Piccadilly and Toho Cinemas Hibiya. It became an unprecedented hit for an independent film and achieved the feat of winning the Best Picture award at the 48th Japan Academy Film Prize.
title_norm:侠客道: A small city on the outskirts of Osaka. The Teramitsu-gumi, backed by the Kansai crime syndicate Josei-kai, proposes a merger to their rivals, the Ishida-gumi, but is rejected by the lieutenant, Ibuki. In retaliation, the Teramitsu-gumi begins a campaign of harassment. Around that time, Prosecutor Nakagami is assigned to the city. Although Nakagami was Ibuki’s university classmate and had married the daughter of the Ishida boss, Tatsunosuke, he remains cold toward them. Meanwhile, Teramitsu summons Tatsunosuke, and when he refuses the deal once more, Teramitsu murders him...
title_norm:俺の血はピンクの血 映画俳優久保新二: This documentary spotlights actor Shinji Kubo, known as the 'Emperor of Porn' and 'King of Pink' for his countless appearances in pink films, tracing his 50-year career racing down the backstreets of Japanese cinema. After dropping out of high school, Kubo joined the theater troupe Himawari and made his film debut in 1966 with Koji Wakamatsu's 'Blood Is Redder Than the Sun.' From the early days of pink film, he appeared in numerous works, totaling over 800 films. His acting career, spanning more than 50 years until his passing in May 2024, represents a hidden side of Japanese cinema rarely discussed. Shot from Kubo's own wish to leave behind a record of himself, the film revisits landmark events in film history—guerrilla and anarchic shoots with various directors, the behind-the-scenes story of how he came to play comedy in pink films and created the hit 'Widow's Boarding House' series with director Shinya Yamamoto, and more. It also captures Kubo confronting a certain person after more than a decade of estrangement. Directed by Takahiro Tanaka, known for scripting the 2004 film '1 Litre of Tears.'
title_norm:偏向報道: A social drama directed and written by Kinshirō Ogino ('Ikushima Tanga,' 'My Bone MY BLOOD BONE'), focusing on 'biased reporting'—how news organizations edit and emphasize information based on specific stances or intentions to sway public opinion. Drawing from his own experience as a TV program director, Ogino depicts a rigid, top-down society where a director at a subcontracting production company confronts the corrupt practices of TV network executives. Suzuko Aburakami, a blunt-speaking director working for a subcontractor of the local TV station 'TV Top,' is asked to stop the broadcast of a fabricated video produced by the network's subsidiary, based on dubious information about the governor's harassment. Comedian and actress Miyuki Torii stars as Suzuko, with Seiya Makoto as the news director who intimidates subsidiaries and subcontractors. The cast includes Sayaka Higashi, Ippei Ōsako, Ami Tokitō, Hozumi Gōda, Shinya Ono, and Setsujirō Hotaru.
title_norm:健康ちえのわトランポリン教室: A psycho-therapy thriller set against the backdrop of modern society, rife with self-validation needs and codependency, depicting the unraveling daily life of an ordinary couple after they stumble upon a bizarre 'hobby class.' Yui, a housewife in her second year of marriage, is forced by her seemingly gentle husband Kōhei to be a 'wife who needs protecting,' suffering from the 'non-malicious violence' lurking in everyday life while maintaining a facade of peace. One day, she discovers a strange class called the 'Kenkō Chienowa Trampolin Kyōshitsu' (Healthy Wisdom Ring Trampoline Class) and starts attending. Through interactions with the teacher and classmates, Yui begins to confront her suppressed 'true self,' but her marital relationship with Kōhei grows increasingly distorted, and the two are swallowed by the darkness hidden in their daily lives. Directed by Kōichi Ishikawa, who co-founded the film production group 'Heisei Nanook' with producer Dai Miyazawa, this feature debut took two years to conceive and three years to complete, winning the Semi-Grand Prix at the 13th Shitamachi Film Festival. Starring Mayu Tano, Tō Shimoegō, and Takano Kōga.
title_norm:偶然と想像: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
title_norm:偶然と想像濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
title_norm:僕のなかのブラウニー:
A touching human drama that follows a boy who lost his younger sister in a disaster and the people around him, told through a warm and compassionate lens.

Kazuki Morimoto, a fifth-grader who lost his sister in an earthquake several years ago, has moved to a new town with his single father, Yosuke, who runs a ramen shop. However, Kazuki struggles to fit in at school and with his new surroundings. One day, after learning about the existence of fairies called "Brownies," Kazuki begins to truly believe that his sister didn't die, but was instead spirited away by them. He sets out on a quest to find the Brownies. While those around him are bewildered by his behavior, his classmate Toko Izumi decides to help him, joined by her relative, a translator named Daisuke Izumi. Eventually, sparked by a lie from a "young carer" named Sota, Kazuki embarks on a journey to find the Brownies. Toko, Sota, and a truant boy named Masato follow after him.

Ayaki Hirano, known for the NHK morning drama series *The Tiger and Her Wings*, stars as the protagonist Kazuki. Junnosuke Taguchi plays Daisuke, the translator who holds the key to the story, while comedian Akira 100% portrays Kazuki’s father, Yosuke. The screenplay is written by Yuiko Miura (*Memories of Tomorrow*), and director Yuta Soma, who has created numerous short films centered on the theme of "children and social issues," makes his feature film directorial debut.
title_norm:僕の帰る場所: Set in Japan and Myanmar, this drama is based on a true story about a Myanmar family living in Japan. Kane lives in a small Tokyo apartment with her two young sons. After her husband Aise is detained by immigration authorities, Kane must support the family alone. Since her children grew up in Japan and cannot speak their native language, Kane pours all her love into them using her imperfect Japanese, but the brothers, stressed by their father's absence, fight daily. Growing anxious about their future, Kane increasingly longs to return to Myanmar, where she was born and raised. This is director Akiro Fujimoto's feature-length debut. The film was screened in the 'Asian Future' section of the 30th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2017, where it won both the section's Best Picture Award and the Japan Foundation Asia Center Special Prize.
title_norm:億万長者の不都合な終末: A thriller dripping with black humor that depicts the collapse of capitalist society following the outbreak of a mysterious disease called "Rich Flu" that only infects the wealthy. Directed and written by Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia of the "The Platform" series, which sharply depicted social inequality, it thrillingly portrays the chaos brought about by a reversal of values. Laura, a high-ranking producer at a streaming platform company, prioritizes her career over her family and is on the verge of success in the glamorous film industry. But just then, a mysterious disease called "Rich Flu" suddenly spreads worldwide, killing wealthy people one after another. As wealth transforms from a symbol of success into a "mark of elimination," capitalist society collapses and the world descends into chaos. In this extreme situation, Laura makes a decision. Mary Elizabeth Winstead, known for films like "Gemini Man" and "Birds of Prey," plays the career-driven Laura who neglects her family. Raf Spall, who has appeared in major works like "Life of Pi" and "Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom," plays Tony, her husband who is exasperated with her yet gets caught up in the unprecedented pandemic alongside her. Timothy Spall, known for the "Harry Potter" series and "Mr. Turner," plays the billionaire Sebastian Snail.
title_norm:免許返納!: A comedy starring Hiroshi Tachi, depicting a 70-year-old movie star caught up in a major uproar over surrendering his driver's license. Nanjo Hiroshi, who has enjoyed a smooth acting career and recently won numerous film awards for art films, secretly longs to appear in action movies. When his longtime actor friend Ozaki Makoto gets into a motorcycle accident, Nanjo is asked by the media for comment as a fellow actor of the same generation. His remarks admonishing Ozaki unexpectedly attract public attention, and the narrative takes on a life of its own, involving his manager and family, and being interpreted in ways far from his original intent. Although Nanjo wants to continue performing action scenes with cars and motorcycles, those around him expect him to surrender his license, plunging him into the biggest crisis of his life. Hiroshi Tachi comically plays actor Nanjo Hiroshi, the same name as the character he played in the 1994 film "License!". Nishino Nanase plays his manager Kawauna Mai, who is thrown into chaos by Nanjo; Kurokawa Sooya plays young man Kugami Ryo, whose life changes dramatically after meeting Nanjo; Yoshida Kotaro plays Mita Atsushi, the president of Nanjo's talent agency; and Uzaki Ryudo plays Ozaki Makoto, an actor friend who built an era alongside Nanjo. Directed by Kawai Yuji of "Kaguya-sama: Love Is War" fame, with screenplay by Hayashi Tamio of "From the Land of Love to the Land of Sorrow".
title_norm:八月十五日の動乱: On August 6, 1945, the atomic bomb was dropped on Hiroshima, and Japan's defeat became all but certain. The Prime Minister's secretary, Nakajima, sounds out senior statesmen about accepting the Potsdam Declaration. But this peace faction's moves provoke the resistance-minded military officers. Unable to persuade the army and out of options, the Prime Minister petitions for an Imperial Conference to be held.
title_norm:兵隊やくざ: An entertainment film based on Arima Yorichika's original work "Kisaburo Ichidai," adapted by Kikushima Ryuzo and directed by Masumura Yasuzo. Its success led to a series of nine films. The dynamic duo of the outrageous protagonist played by Katsu Shintaro and the intellectual officer played by Tamura Takahiro are the highlight.
title_norm:兵隊やくざ: An entertainment film based on Arima Yorichika's original work "Kisaburo Ichidai," adapted by Kikushima Ryuzo and directed by Masumura Yasuzo. title_norm:冬の旅: A film by renowned French filmmaker Agnès Varda, tracing the steps of a young girl who freezes to death after wandering, which won the Golden Lion, the top prize, at the 42nd Venice International Film Festival in 1985. In winter in southern France, the body of an 18-year-old girl, Mona, is found frozen to death in a roadside ditch in the countryside. The film traces Mona's journey over the final weeks of her life as she hitchhikes aimlessly and continues a solitary journey, through the testimonies of the people she met on the road. Starring Sandrine Bonnaire (from "The Hairdresser's Husband"), with co-stars Macha Méril (from "Belle de Jour"), Stéphane Freiss (from "The Five Senses"), and Yolande Moreau (from "Séraphine"). It recorded over one million admissions in France at the time, becoming Varda's biggest hit.
title_norm:冬よ: A documentary in which the confessions of East German women illuminate the contradictions of the regime on the eve of the fall of the "Wall." This film captures the lives of women from various backgrounds living in East Germany just before the collapse of the Berlin Wall. The breakthrough work of director Helke Misselwitz, it features women speaking candidly about their lives before the camera; their words, filled with hardship and regret, bring to light a quiet critique of the socialist ideal of gender equality. Winner of the Silver Dove at the 1988 International Leipzig Festival for Documentary and Animated Film (DOK Leipzig).
title_norm:冬冬の夏休み: Taiwanese master Hou Hsiao-hsien crafts a masterpiece drama that vividly portrays the beauty of nature and childhood friendship through the story of a young brother and sister spending a summer in their grandfather's countryside home. After graduating from elementary school in Taipei, Tongtong's mother is hospitalized, so he and his little sister spend summer vacation at their grandfather's house in the countryside. They quickly become friends with the neighborhood children, and Tongtong enjoys a fun summer running through the fields. Meanwhile, his sister Tingting struggles to join the group and passes the time by playing pranks on her brother and his friends, until their father eventually comes from Taipei to pick them up. The father of the siblings is played by filmmaker Edward Yang, known for "The Terrorizers" and "Yi Yi." First released in Japan in 1990. Digital remastered versions were re-released in 2016 and 2025.

title_norm:刑事キャレラ／血の絆: A police inspector from the Montreal Police Department solves a murder case using clues obtained from the victim's diary.
title_norm:別れる決心: From Park Chan-wook, director of 'Oldboy' and 'The Handmaiden', comes a suspense drama about a detective investigating a murder and the victim's wife, a suspect to whom he finds himself drawn. When a man falls to his death from a mountain peak, Detective Hae-joon suspects it may be murder rather than an accident. He focuses on the victim's mysterious wife, Sore, but she has an alibi. As the investigation proceeds, Hae-joon finds himself attracted to Sore, and she develops special feelings for him too. Just when a lead emerges and the case seems solved... Park Hae-il plays Hae-joon, Tang Wei plays Sore, with Lee Jung-hyun and Go Kyung-pyo in supporting roles. The film won the Best Director award at the 75th Cannes Film Festival in 2022.
title_norm:別離: Nader is in divorce negotiations with his wife, who wants to leave Iran for the sake of their daughter. He hires a woman named Razieh to care for his father, who suffers from dementia and lives with him, but an unexpected incident sets off a chain of events... An exquisite drama that intertwines a mystery with Iran's divorce issues.
title_norm:創造と神秘のサグラダ・ファミリア: A documentary about the Sagrada Família, the century-spanning architectural project conceived by Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí, under construction since 1882 for over 130 years. Registered as a World Heritage Site in 2005, the Sagrada Família continues to captivate over three million visitors annually from around the world. As construction continues towards a projected completion in 2026, computers have been introduced on site, and staff repeatedly experiment to determine how to best reproduce Gaudí's vision with current technology. Incorporating footage from inside the site, inaccessible to outsiders, and interviews with architectural staff, the film unravels the project surrounding the Sagrada Família, including how the construction period, once said to require '300 years until completion,' has been shortened to a projected completion in 2026.
title_norm:劇場版 かげる針路: A documentary that delves into the serious 'shadow' beginning to appear over Fukushima's course, which was set on the ideals of 'nuclear phase-out' and 'renewable energy promotion' following the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. This is a theatrical remake of the Fukushima TV documentary program 'Kageru Shiro' (Shadowy Course), which aired in May 2025 and sparked a huge response. Fukushima Prefecture, having experienced one of the world's worst nuclear accidents, shifted course toward abandoning nuclear power and promoting renewable energy. Fifteen years after that turning point, Fukushima now stands at a critical crossroads. As mega-solar plants rapidly expand, carving up mountains, issues like shoddy construction and landscape degradation have surfaced, intensifying headwinds against renewable energy. Meanwhile, with the government still unable to show a clear picture of completing the decommissioning of the crippled Fukushima Daiichi plant, it has shifted its energy policy back toward nuclear power, moving to restart reactors. The film turns its camera on the environmental destruction and friction with local residents caused by the rapid expansion of mega-solar, and the government's return to nuclear power, which becomes clearer as the end of decommissioning remains out of sight, vividly capturing Fukushima's present wavering between ideals and reality.
title_norm:劇場版 とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムハムージャ! 幻のプリン: Hamtaro had a dream. It was a dream of a beautiful hamster princess... 'Help me... Please... Come here quickly...' The princess was trapped inside a soap bubble, tears in her eyes. Even after waking up, Hamtaro can't stop worrying about the princess from his dream. So, he and the Ham-Hams decide to go rescue her. They arrive at the 'Hamja Kingdom,' the homeland of hamsters with a history of 8686 in the Ham Calendar, surrounded by desert. The sky is dark, and the hamsters living there seem downcast. No wonder—Princess Shera of the Hamja Kingdom, who was engaged to Prince Hamuha of the neighboring country, has been kidnapped by a mysterious cat that suddenly appeared and trapped her just like in Hamtaro's dream. That cat wants to marry Princess Shera and take over the kingdom! At this rate, the princess and the kingdom are in danger! Can Hamtaro and the Ham-Hams save the princess and protect the hamsters' homeland? An adventure of love and courage begins now.
title_norm:劇場版 とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムランド大冒険: It's Laura's birthday. Hamtaro has prepared a present, but Laura ignores him, and in frustration he runs away from home. Seeing this, the Ham-Hams are about to help Hamtaro run away when a mysterious fairy hamster appears and takes everyone to Ham-Ham Land, a dream world where only hamsters live. But Hamtaro can't stop thinking about Laura. Hearing from the fairy hamster about 'magic sunflower seeds' that allow hamsters to talk to humans, Hamtaro sets out on an adventure to find them. But what awaits?
title_norm:劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話 ゾクゾク変な間取り: The third installment in the omnibus horror series "Theatrical Edition: Real Scary Stories - Strange Floor Plans," depicting inexplicable events in homes with bizarre layouts. It portrays a chain of supernatural occurrences in a house in an area called "Kyūkyōzuka" from five different perspectives. Momoko Nanase, who works for a property management company, visits an old house to take photos of the property, but the photos she takes with her smartphone show a dilapidated Japanese-style room and a dark figure that she doesn't remember capturing (CASE 1: "Property Photos"). Shinji Niimi, a salesman at a real estate investment company, is approached by an old woman and invited into her home, where he is led to a room enshrining an eerie "Portrait of Mother and Child" (CASE 2: "The Portrait"). Keita Kyūjō, living happily with his pregnant wife Ayane, is visited by his sister Shiori, who wears a prayer bead necklace and warns him that being with Ayane will bring misfortune (CASE 3: "Beloved Wife"). Gōtoku Mikami, an occult YouTuber, crosses a forbidden boundary after a spirit appears in his stream and his view count skyrockets (CASE 4: "The Streamer"). Three members of an investigation company that scientifically explains anomalies in stigmatized properties and proves "there is nothing abnormal" head to a house to investigate, but when one of them witnesses a female spirit, tension begins to brew within the team (CASE 5: "On-Site Investigation"). Ginji Watanabe of the comedy duo "Dondecorte," Daigo Nagami and Junpei Hamada of "Kabe Poster" each make their film acting debuts, with Kōhei Masuda of "Kageyama" also appearing.
title_norm:劇場版 アイカツ スターズ！: The theatrical film of the TV anime 'Aikatsu Stars!', which began airing in April 2016 as a new series following the popular idol anime 'Aikatsu!'. It depicts the struggles of girls, including the protagonist Yume Nijino, who enrolls at Yotsusei Gakuen aiming to become the top idol. In this first theatrical film of 'Aikatsu Stars!', the story is set on a southern island where the characters come for an event. It revolves around the rumored 'Legendary Dress' said to be sleeping on the island, and depicts the friendship between Yume and Laura Sakuraba, as well as the school's top four-idol unit 'S4' taking the stage together. The short film 'Aikatsu! The Targeted Magical Aikatsu! Card' is shown simultaneously.
title_norm:劇場版 モーレツ宇宙海賊 abyss of hypersp: The theatrical film version of the TV anime "Mouretsu Pirates," which aired from January to June 2012, based on Yuichi Sasamoto's popular SF light novel "Mini-Skirt Space Pirates." Marika Kato, a high school girl who is a legitimate space pirate holding a government-issued "privateer's license," leads a busy life juggling her studies, club activities in the space yacht club, a part-time job at a café, and her role as captain of the space pirate ship "Bentenmaru." One day during spring break, just before she is about to advance to her third year, Marika takes on a pirate business job aboard a luxury liner and meets Kanata Mugen, the son of the renowned subspace diver, Dr. Mugen. The opening theme, following the TV series, is "Mouretsu Uchuu Koukyoukyoku Dainanagakushou 'Mugen no Ai'" by Momoiro Clover Z. The director is Tatsuo Sato, known for "Martian Successor Nadesico."
title_norm:劇場版 仮面ライダーディケイド オールライダー対大ショッカ: Kamen Rider Decade, aka Kadoya Tsukasa, arrives in a "certain world." In this world, for some reason, the photos Tsukasa takes do not distort the image. Suddenly, a certain Western-style mansion comes to mind. Following faint memories, Tsukasa reaches the mansion, where he meets a girl who calls herself his sister, Kadoya Sayo. Tsukasa becomes convinced this is his own world. However, even in this world, the "collapse of worlds" is progressing. Sayo's servant, Tsukikage Nobuhiko, claims that the cause of the world's collapse lies in the Riders born in each world, and declares that to stop it, they must decide on a single "strongest Rider."
title_norm:劇場版 仮面ライダー響鬼と7人の戦鬼: In present-day Japan, the giant demonic monster Orochi appears on a coast. Hibiki and Asumu rush to fight it, but Hibiki is defeated by Orochi and falls into a coma. Asumu seeks clues to save Hibiki in the Takeshi's ancient documents describing Orochi, but there he finds the name "Asumu," the same as his own, along with the stories of Oni... The ancient document tells of a village in the Sengoku period. There, Orochi demanded a human sacrifice every year. When Asumu's acquaintance Hitoe is chosen as the sacrifice, Asumu consults Tobei Tachibana to find a way to save her. Following the idea of asking an Oni for help, Asumu and the others set out to search for an Oni.
title_norm:劇場版 仮面ライダー響鬼と７人の戦鬼: In present-day Japan, the giant demonic monster Orochi appears on a coast. Hibiki and Asumu rush to fight it, but Hibiki is defeated by Orochi and falls into a coma. title_norm:劇場版 宇野昌磨アイスショー「ice brave 新横浜:
This theatrical release captures "Ice Brave," the first ice show produced by professional figure skater Shoma Uno, specifically filmed during its final performance at the KOSÉ Shin-Yokohama Skate Center on February 1, 2026.

Shoma Uno, a world-class athlete who won silver at the 2018 PyeongChang Olympics and bronze at the 2022 Beijing Olympics before retiring from competition in May 2024, has crafted a show that reimagines his iconic competitive programs as elevated performances that only he can deliver today. Highlights include a collaborative performance with his former coach, world-renowned Swiss skater Stéphane Lambiel, and his first-ever ice dance with popular skater Marin Honda. Their program, "Four Seasons," was a special performance exclusive to the Shin-Yokohama show.

The entire production was captured using nine high-definition 4K cameras, including drones, to ensure every moment was caught in exquisite detail. With audio mixed in 5.1ch surround sound for the theatrical release, this film brings the beauty and power of the ice show to the big screen for an immersive experience.
title_norm:劇場版 旅人検視官 道場修作: The first film adaptation of the popular travel suspense series "Traveling Forensic Examiner: Shusaku Michiba," a BS Nippon TV original two-hour suspense drama starring Takeshi Naito. The story follows Shusaku Michiba, a retired former Metropolitan Police Department forensic examiner, who encounters incidents during his travels while holding his late wife's notebook, and delves into the truth. After retiring, former forensic examiner Shusaku Michiba travels across Japan with his late wife's notebook. Visiting Matsuyama and Uchiko in Ehime Prefecture, he meets people who love haiku and expects to spend a peaceful time. However, the shadow of an unsolved case from 20 years ago hangs over the area. As fragmented memories and people's feelings intertwine, Michiba draws closer to the truth that connects the past and present. Takeshi Naito reprises his role as the protagonist Michiba, joined by a talented cast including Machiko Hada, Ken Ishiguro, Akira Emoto, and Kotaro Satomi. Additionally, Kaho Minami plays Michiba's late wife Yumiko, a character who did not appear in the TV series, shedding light on Michiba's largely untold past. Directed by Ryosuke Kanezaki, who also directed the sixth installment of the TV series.
title_norm:劇場版 米寿の伝言:
A heartwarming comedy depicting the chaos that ensues when a deceased grandfather and his grandson swap bodies. The film is an adaptation of the stage play "The Message of the 88th Birthday," which garnered attention for featuring Masakatsu Nishimoto—an 81-year-old former teacher who had once given up on acting—alongside his two real-life grandsons, both professional actors. Now 85, Nishimoto takes on his first leading film role.

Yonezo, an eccentric inventor, passes away just before his 88th birthday. While his grandson Kyohei and younger brother Kippei are sorting through the inventions their grandfather left behind, a malfunction causes the grandfather in the coffin and Kippei to swap souls. Their joy at reuniting with Yonezo is short-lived when the device breaks, making it impossible to switch them back. Kyohei scrambles to save his brother before the cremation, but...

Kentaro Nishimoto of "Popran" and Ginjiro Nishimoto of the TV drama "Mr. Hiiragi's Homeroom" reprise their roles as Kyohei and Kippei from the stage version, supported by Kasumi Hasegawa, Hina Yamada, Nakagawa Paradise, and Kenta Hamano. Masakatsu Nishimoto's real-life daughter, Hiroko Nishimoto, serves as producer, while screenwriter Gaku Kawasaki ("Walking Time: Waiting for That Day") makes his feature-length directorial debut.
title_norm:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 前編 始まりの物語: The first part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the 12-episode TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired from January to April 2011. One day, a mysterious transfer student named Homura Akemi arrives at the middle school attended by Madoka Kaname, an ordinary girl living a mundane life. After school that day, guided by a mysterious voice, Madoka encounters a strange creature calling itself Kyubey, who tells her, 'I want you to make a contract with me and become a magical girl.' The staff from the TV series, who built its unique worldview, including chief director Akiyuki Shinbo, screenwriter Gen Urobuchi (Nitroplus), and the otherworldly space design team Gekidan Inu Curry, have reunited for this film.
title_norm:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 始まりの物語: The first part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the 12-episode TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired from January to April 2011. One day, a mysterious transfer student named Homura Akemi arrives at the middle school attended by Madoka Kaname, an ordinary girl living a mundane life. After school that day, guided by a mysterious voice, Madoka encounters a strange creature calling itself Kyubey, who tells her, 'I want you to make a contract with me and become a magical girl.' The staff from the TV series, who built its unique worldview, including chief director Akiyuki Shinbo, screenwriter Gen Urobuchi (Nitroplus), and the otherworldly space design team Gekidan Inu Curry, have reunited for this film.
title_norm:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 後編 永遠の物語: The second part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired in 2011, created a huge sensation, and won numerous awards including the 16th Animation Kobe Award for TV Series, the 11th Tokyo Anime Award at Tokyo International Anime Fair 2012, and the Grand Prize in the Animation Division at the 15th Japan Media Arts Festival. Sayaka, who became a magical girl for the sake of her beloved Kyosuke, becomes consumed by despair upon learning the truth about magical girls and ultimately transforms into a witch. Madoka accepts Kyoko's proposal to try and save Sayaka, but... A dark fantasy depicting the harsh fate of five girls who chose to fight as magical girls in exchange for having just one wish granted.
title_norm:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 新編 叛逆の物語: The third film in the theatrical series of "Puella Magi Madoka Magica," which aired on TV from January to April 2011 and received high acclaim and popularity, including winning the Grand Prize in the Animation Division at the 15th Agency for Cultural Affairs Media Arts Festival. Following the "Beginning Story" and "Eternal Story" films, which recompiled the 12-episode TV series, this is a completely new feature-length work with newly written script and animation. In a new world where Madoka Kaname freed magical girls from the chain of cruel fate, Homura Akemi, left behind unable to fulfill her feelings for Madoka, continues to fight alone, believing she can meet Madoka again. New magical girl Nagisa Momoe appears as a new character alongside Madoka and Homura.
title_norm:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 永遠の物語: The second part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired in 2011, created a huge sensation, and won numerous awards including the 16th Animation Kobe Award for TV Series, the 11th Tokyo Anime Award at Tokyo International Anime Fair 2012, and the Grand Prize in the Animation Division at the 15th Japan Media Arts Festival. Sayaka, who became a magical girl for the sake of her beloved Kyosuke, becomes consumed by despair upon learning the truth about magical girls and ultimately transforms into a witch. Madoka accepts Kyoko's proposal to try and save Sayaka, but... A dark fantasy depicting the harsh fate of five girls who chose to fight as magical girls in exchange for having just one wish granted.
title_norm:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ叛逆の物語: The third film in the theatrical series of "Puella Magi Madoka Magica," which aired on TV from January to April 2011 and received high acclaim and popularity, including winning the Grand Prize in the Animation Division at the 15th Agency for Cultural Affairs Media Arts Festival. Following the "Beginning Story" and "Eternal Story" films, which recompiled the 12-episode TV series, this is a completely new feature-length work with newly written script and animation. In a new world where Madoka Kaname freed magical girls from the chain of cruel fate, Homura Akemi, left behind unable to fulfill her feelings for Madoka, continues to fight alone, believing she can meet Madoka again. New magical girl Nagisa Momoe appears as a new character alongside Madoka and Homura.
title_norm:劇場版「hamaツアーズpresents “おもてなしライ:
"HAMA Tours presents 'Omotenashi Live' Sparkle" brings the live event featuring the cast of the mobile game *18TRIP* to the big screen.

Set in near-future Yokohama, *18TRIP* is a "near-future hospitality adventure" where players work to revitalize the tourism industry of HAMA's 18 wards—once a premier special tourism zone that has since fallen into decline—alongside a colorful cast of tourism mayors. To commemorate the game's first anniversary, its first-ever live event, "HAMA Tours presents 'Omotenashi Live' Sparkle," was held on February 21 and 22, 2026, at Pacifico Yokohama in Kanagawa.

This film is a compilation of the three performances held over the two-day event, featuring a curated selection of highlights and performances from each show.
title_norm:劇場版アイカツスターズ！: The theatrical film of the TV anime 'Aikatsu Stars!', which began airing in April 2016 as a new series following the popular idol anime 'Aikatsu!'. It depicts the struggles of girls, including the protagonist Yume Nijino, who enrolls at Yotsusei Gakuen aiming to become the top idol. In this first theatrical film of 'Aikatsu Stars!', the story is set on a southern island where the characters come for an event. It revolves around the rumored 'Legendary Dress' said to be sleeping on the island, and depicts the friendship between Yume and Laura Sakuraba, as well as the school's top four-idol unit 'S4' taking the stage together. The short film 'Aikatsu! The Targeted Magical Aikatsu! Card' is shown simultaneously.
title_norm:劇場版メイドインアビス 深き魂の黎明: A theatrical film based on the TV anime 'Made in Abyss', which itself is adapted from Akihito Tsukushi's manga of the same name. The Abyss is the only remaining unexplored chasm in a world that has been thoroughly explored. This deep, massive vertical hole is home to numerous strange creatures and contains countless precious relics that modern humanity cannot create. Riko, an orphan girl living in the town of Orth, built on the edge of the Abyss, decides to descend into its depths after the discovery of her mother's White Whistle, a legendary cave raider. Along with Reg, a robot boy who has lost his memory, she overcomes various hardships and continues her adventure. At the Fourth Layer, they are joined by Nanachi, a 'Hollow' they encounter. They then venture into the Fifth Layer, where Bondrewd awaits, and there they meet a girl named Prushka.
title_norm:劇場版モノノ怪 第三章 蛇神: The concluding chapter of the theatrical trilogy based on the TV anime "Mononoke," itself a spin-off from the "Bakeneko" segment of the 2006 Fuji TV Noitamina omnibus anime "Ayakashi." It delves into the greatest secret long hidden within the Ooku (the shogun's harem) and depicts the fierce battle between the protagonist, the Medicine Seller, and the most fearsome mononoke of all, the Serpent God, which threatens to shake the Ooku to its foundations. After a deadly struggle with the Medicine Seller, who carries a exorcism sword, and a Tengu umbrella, followed by a decisive battle with the Fire Rat, peace finally seems to have returned to the Ooku. However, the Medicine Seller senses a lingering presence and remains on guard. Around this time, the shogun's official wife, Sachiko, gives birth to a long-awaited son, but the infant soon dies. Sachiko, who had hoped to change her formal marriage to the shogun by bearing an heir, is physically and emotionally exhausted and becomes entangled in a conspiracy that could overturn the Ooku's very existence. Hokuto Mizorogi, the priest of the "Mizusama" faith within the Ooku, watches the events unfold with a solemn expression. At the same time, unnatural earthquakes, as if a giant creature is crawling, occur frequently within the Ooku, and bizarre incidents happen where maids are twisted and crushed to death. Before the Medicine Seller, who rushes to the scene, appears the mononoke Serpent God, taking the form of a giant snake.
title_norm:功夫: A wuxia fantasy action film directed by Taiwanese director Giddens Ko of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'You Are the Apple of My Eye,' starring Ko Chen-tung, who collaborated with Ko on those two previous films. Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.
title_norm:勝手にしやがれ: Jean-Luc Godard's first feature-length directorial work. Produced with techniques that broke the conventions of theatrical cinema at the time, such as improvisational direction and handheld street shooting, it is a landmark film of the French New Wave that greatly influenced the later film industry. The original idea was by François Truffaut, and Claude Chabrol also participated as a technical advisor. Michel, a car thief who kills a policeman and flees to Paris, enjoys a free relationship with Patricia, an American student selling newspapers. To test Michel's love, Patricia informs the police of his whereabouts and tells Michel what she has done... A digitally remastered version with a new translation by Jiro Terao was released in 2016. In 2022, a 4K restored version created to commemorate the 60th anniversary of its release was shown. In 2026, a 4K restored version will be revived in conjunction with the release of Richard Linklater's film 'Nouvelle Vague,' which depicts the production process of 'Breathless.'

title_norm:北浦兄弟: A dark-toned road movie that blends humor and pathos to depict two social outcasts—a pair of brothers—as they spiral through a series of irreversible blunders. Sota, a middle-aged man living a reclusive life under his art teacher father, accidentally kills him in a sudden turn of events. Alongside his estranged younger brother Akira, Sota struggles to cover up their father's death, even as the two remain constantly at odds. However, nothing goes according to plan. As they drag their uncle and their father’s lover into the mess, the situation continues to spiral out of control. Masaaki Nakano (*Ojisan, Gekidan Hajimemashita*) stars as the elder brother Sota, while Hirota Otsuka (*The Moon*) plays the younger brother Akira. The film is directed by Masaki Tsujino (*Woman of the Kappa*).
title_norm:千年女優: Director Satoshi Kon of 'Perfect Blue' crafts an original feature-length animation depicting an actress who has cherished a man for decades, transcending time and space. Tachibana, the president of a small video production company, visits the secluded estate of Chiyoko Fujiwara, a legendary Showa-era actress who once dominated the silver screen, to produce a documentary about her. Chiyoko, who vanished from cinema thirty years ago and has lived in seclusion, begins to recount her memories upon seeing a single key Tachibana brings. Her narrative soon blurs the lines between reality and film episodes, unfolding into a tumultuous tale. At the 5th Agency for Cultural Affairs Media Arts Festival, it won the Grand Prize in the animation division alongside Hayao Miyazaki's 'Spirited Away.' It also received the Best Asian Film award at the 33rd Sitges Film Festival, earning high acclaim domestically and internationally, and was distributed worldwide by DreamWorks.
title_norm:原爆資料館 語り継ぐものたち: A documentary conveying the over-70-year history and message of the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum, one of the world's leading peace museums. Opened in 1955, the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum (commonly known as the Atomic Bomb Museum) had surpassed 80 million cumulative visitors by 2025. Born from the determination and efforts of geologist Shogo Nagaoka, who collected debris like tiles and stones melted by the atomic bomb and opened an "Atomic Bomb Reference Materials Exhibition Room" in a local community center with the wish to "never repeat the tragedy of the atomic bomb," it has been preserved by successive directors who have dedicated their lives to it. Housing over 22,000 artifacts and materials, the main building designed by Kenzo Tange was designated as an Important Cultural Property of Japan in 2006, the first post-war building to receive this honor. In fiscal year 2025, annual visitors exceeded 2.5 million, setting a new record for the third consecutive year. About 40% of visitors are from overseas, and global attention continues to grow. Co-directed by Naoki Tachikawa and Toshiyuki Saito of the Hiroshima Home TV news department, the film reveals the thoughts embedded in this unique Atomic Bomb Museum, which quietly continues to appeal against the horror of nuclear weapons and for peace, through valuable archive footage and new testimonies unearthed from over 100 hours of material. Music is by Eiko Ishibashi of "Drive My Car" and "Evil Does Not Exist."
title_norm:原題：pfau bin ich echt: The perfect son, a cultured lover, a thug for hire for those who want to play hero on a date—Matthias is the top performer at "My Companion," an agency that provides ideal personas for any situation. He flawlessly plays the roles demanded of him, living out various personalities every day. However, triggered by a sudden breakup with his girlfriend Sofia and an unexpected incident with a client, Matthias's gears begin to slowly grind out of alignment, and the boundary between reality and fiction gradually blurs...
title_norm:友だちのうちはどこ: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame. At a primary school in the village of Koker in northern Iran, Mohammad is severely scolded by his teacher for doing his homework on a piece of paper instead of a notebook and is told he will be expelled if it happens again. However, his best friend Ahmad, who sits next to him, accidentally takes Mohammad's notebook home. Panicked that Mohammad will be expelled without his notebook, Ahmad searches for his friend's house in a distant neighboring village to return it, but struggles to find it... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title_norm:友だちのうちはどこ？: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame.
